16ci4p0.title: Clavicular allegedly told 17-year-old to call vodka ‘water’ to avoid Twitch ban before assault
16ci4p0.content:
Streamer Clavicular is accused of instructing a 17-year-old girl to lie about her age and pretend she was drinking water instead of vodka to avoid getting his Twitch livestream banned before an alleged sexual assault.

The 20-year-old influencer, whose real name is Braden Peters, has been indicted on two counts of rape and one count of providing alcohol to a minor in Massachusetts.

According to a police report detailed by Fox News, the allegations stem from an encounter on May 23, 2025, at his family’s home in Chatham, Cape Cod.

The teenager told investigators that she had connected with Peters through Instagram before he invited her to the property to create looksmaxxing content.

Peters allegedly arranged an Uber to bring her to the home, where he was livestreaming on Twitch.

Clavicular accused of telling teen to lie about age on Twitch

According to investigators, Peters knew the girl was 17 but instructed her to tell viewers she was 18. He also allegedly told her to refer to the vodka she was drinking as “water” to prevent his Twitch account or livestream from being banned.

The teenager claimed Peters supplied her with vodka throughout the evening, leaving her increasingly intoxicated.

Instagram: Clavicular

Police subsequently reviewed footage from the Twitch broadcast, including a moment when the girl said, “Wait, I’m so drunk though,” before the two kissed.

She alleged that Peters later had sex with her while she was heavily intoxicated. She also told investigators that she woke up the following morning to Peters having sex with her without her consent.

On November 18, Boston 25 News reported that Peters had been indicted on two rape counts and one count of providing alcohol to a minor.

Peters pleaded not guilty to the original charges at an October 22 court appearance and was released after posting $10,000 cash bail.

His representative, Mitchell P. Jackson, told Fox News on November 18 that the influencer denies all charges and allegations against him.

The criminal proceedings are separate from a Florida civil lawsuit filed by his accuser. As Dexerto previously reported, she removed the sexual assault claim from that lawsuit in October, with her attorney explaining that the decision was made to avoid interfering with the ongoing criminal case.

1x4u8w5.title: Кушнер підтвердив, що США розглядають гарантії безпеки для України за зразком статті 5 НАТО
1x4u8w5.content:
Сполучені Штати готові розглядати надання Україні гарантій безпеки за зразком статті 5 Північноатлантичного договору, однак вони мають відповідати американським інтересам і бути частиною ширшого пакета безпекових заходів.

Про це заявив зять президента США Джаред Кушнер у четвер на спільній пресконференції за підсумками саміту Коаліції охочих у Берліні, передає власний кореспондент Укрінформу.

«З погляду Америки, надання гарантій безпеки за зразком статті 5 – це справді дуже серйозний крок. Я думаю, президент Трамп відкритий до цього, але, очевидно, це має відповідати інтересам Сполучених Штатів», – зазначив Кушнер.

За його словами, американській стороні вдалося переконати Росію сприймати таку модель як можливу основу майбутніх домовленостей.

«Будь-які гарантії безпеки для України ґрунтуватимуться на статті 5, і, як стверджують росіяни, вони мають намір після завершення цієї війни не допустити нової в майбутньому», – сказав він.

Кушнер визнав, що в Росії багато хто скептично ставиться до таких заяв, однак наголосив на необхідності відновити діалог між Європою та Росією, щоб сторони могли безпосередньо обговорювати питання безпеки.

Водночас він вказав, що майбутні домовленості не можна будувати лише на довірі чи запевненнях сторін. Необхідно створити систему стимулів і взаємних інтересів, яка передбачатиме контроль за виконанням угоди, потужне стримування та серйозні наслідки в разі її порушення.

Кушнер також високо оцінив зміни, яких зазнали Збройні сили України за час повномасштабної війни.

Читайте також: Європа співпрацюватиме зі США щодо миру в Україні, доки їхні цілі збігаються - Мерц

«Сьогодні Україна вже не та країна, на яку напали тоді. Вона продемонструвала стійкість і силу, надзвичайно розвинулася і тепер має одну з найкращих армій у світі», – сказав він.

За його словами, важливими складниками майбутньої системи безпеки мають стати не лише гарантії та стримування, а й дієві канали комунікації між сторонами, які допоможуть запобігати новим конфліктам.

Відповідаючи на запитання журналіста стосовно заяви Трампа, що США заробляють на війні великі гроші, спецпосланець президента Стів Віткофф наголосив, що американський лідер послідовно підтримує мирне завершення війни.

Він нагадав, що Трамп направив його та Кушнера до Берліна для участі в саміті Коаліції охочих і доручив зробити все можливе для припинення війни.

За словами Віткоффа, Трамп по телефону повідомив, що виклав ті самі принципи двом  лідерам, з якими зустрічався.

«Він зробив Україну та мирне завершення цієї війни однією з головних тем сьогоднішньої тристоронньої зустрічі, і я вважаю, що за це його слід відзначити», – наголосив спецпосланець.

Кушнер, зі свого боку, зазначив, що оборонна промисловість становить незначну частину економіки США, а Трамп, за його словами, найбільше хотів би, щоб ця галузь скорочувалася завдяки встановленню миру в усьому світі.

«Війна – це гра з від’ємною сумою: від неї програють усі. Мир – це гра з додатною сумою», – сказав Кушнер.

Він наголосив, що президент США прагне припинити страждання, спричинені війною, і вважає, що мир принесе світу значні переваги. За словами Кушнера, питання можливих прибутків від продажу зброї жодним чином не впливає на мотивацію Трампа домагатися миру.

Як повідомляв Укрінформ, президент США Дональд Трамп заявив, що не ухвалюватиме рішень щодо України без участі української сторони.

aws3ch.title: GTA 6 Bigfoot explained: How to find ‘Bigfoot’ in GTA 6
aws3ch.content: GTA 6 players have already encountered something that they are calling “Bigfoot”.In this GTA 6 Bigfoot explained guide, we’ll explain what it actually is players have seen, and how they can start the lengthy quest line to track him down. This guide will be split into parts, with this part of the guide focussing on finding “bigfoot” and starting the quest. Then, we’ll have a separate guide for the questline, as it contains some spoilers.Our GTA 6 Guides Hub is now live, full of walkthroughs, tips for beginners and much more. We reccomend you check it out, and bookmark it for your adventure across Leonida.Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to check out our complete walkthrough hub, featuring beginner tips, navigation experience explained, GTA 6 cheats, and more.GTA 6 Bigfoot ExplainedThe clip that has been widely circulating online of players running into Bigfoot, isn’t Bigfoot. It’s a character that the locals refer to as Skunkape. You may have seen posters of this creature around Key Lento at the beginning of the game, well, before too long you’re going to be on the trail of the Skunk Ape.The Skunk Ape can appear to players in a few different ways, but it most commonly happens as players are driving towards the Kingfishers camp near the water south of Hamlet. You’ll be sent to investigate this camp, but it’s not a main story mission, so it’s possible you run across this event naturally.The other way to begin this questline is to examine enough of the Skunkape posters than can be found around town. After this, the game puts a marker on your map in the general area of the first Skunkape sighting, so you can then go and do it yourself.GTA 6 Bigfoot Explained: What happens next?After you see the Skunkape for the first time, let a few days pass and then you’ll get a from Kirk. He’s the world’s leading expert on the creature, and he wants to enlist you in tracking him down. This will add a marker to your map.You can only start the Skunkape questline with Kirk as Jason, and only at night. That’s everything you need to know about GTA 6’s Bigfoot.

5arqzh.title: Russia and Georgia Resume Direct Dialogue With Official Meeting in Minsk, Moscow Says
5arqzh.content:
A Russian deputy foreign minister and a Georgian special representative for relations with Moscow met in Minsk on Thursday, marking the resumption of direct dialogue between the two countries, the Russian Foreign Ministry said.
The neighbors have had no diplomatic relations since fighting a brief war in 2008. Tbilisi rejects Moscow's recognition of the breakaway regions of South Ossetia and Abkhazia, which Georgia considers parts of its territory.
Mikhail Galuzin, a Russian deputy foreign minister, met on Thursday in the Belarusian capital Minsk with George Zurabashvili, Georgia's first deputy foreign minister, who was appointed the prime minister's special envoy for relations with Moscow last month.

"A thorough exchange of views took place on current issues of bilateral cooperation, with an emphasis on trade, economic, cultural and humanitarian cooperation," the Russian Foreign Ministry said in a statement.
The two officials discussed regional security, the statement said, adding that "a number of practical agreements were reached."
Once the former Soviet Union's most democratic and pro-Western successor state, Georgia has drawn closer to Russia under the ruling Georgian Dream party, government critics say.
With a population of some 3.7 million, Georgia is officially an EU candidate country, but Brussels says it has backslid so far on democratic reforms that its candidacy exists "in name only."
Authorities have cracked down on opposition politicians and former members of the ruling elites alike, jailing several key figures. The country's Constitutional Court is currently hearing a lawsuit filed by the government seeking to ban the main opposition parties outright.

b8nyj9.title: When the Work Gets Heavy, Do Your Tires Hold Up? Cooper’s New Discoverer® HT Is Built to Carry the Weight
b8nyj9.content: For enthusiasts, tire shopping is an upgrade, not a chore. While the casual driver might treat new tires like regular maintenance, anyone who cares about vehicle dynamics knows that what meets the road defines how a truck or SUV rides, tracks, and stops. It is the single most transformative upgrade you can make to your vehicle. For more than 110 years, Cooper tires have catered to drivers who look past the showroom floor and seek out products that overdeliver on performance, capability, and long-term durability.And that level of purpose-built engineering is more vital than ever. As vehicles grow heavier and more capable, tires need to do more than simply roll down an interstate. They have to withstand heavy payload demands, sudden weather changes, and unpredictable pavement. Cooper tires are built to that benchmark. Rooted in American engineering and real-world development, Cooper tires are built to an uncompromising standard that live up to their promises. From the rock-crawling STT Pro to the severe-snow-designated Stronghold AT, the Discoverer® family has earned its reputation through real-world testing from Alaskan ice to jagged mountain trails.Civilized on the Highway, Built for the PayloadThe new Cooper Discoverer® HT adapts that rugged all-terrain lineage for long-distance highway cruising, matching heavy-duty capability with quiet, refined composure. While it retains the structural durability to wander down a gravel trail with a trailer in tow, its core mission is maximizing comfort and control across hundreds of miles of open road.Cooper Discoverer® HTWhere many highway tires trade load capability for a soft ride, the Discoverer® HT is engineered to handle both. Straight, reinforced sidewalls provide the structural foundation needed to maintain an optimal contact patch under load. Whether the vehicle is running light or carrying family, gear, and tongue weight, the tire resists deformation, ensuring consistent steering response and predictable roadholding grip in any condition. It’s engineered for drivers whose tires have to hold their own—providing a dependable, hard-working partner that won’t fold when the truck or SUV is pushed to its limit.Engineered for the Job, Not Just the Showroom FloorCooper tires also tackle truck and SUV tire performance, with advanced features. Its proprietary 3-D Micro-Gauge Siping incorporates interlocking zig-zag sipes inside the tread blocks. Under heavy braking, sharp turns, or loaded acceleration, these interlocking sipes lock together to stiffen the tread block, to help support responsiveness. Crucially, these sipes run deep into the tread rubber, ensuring that gripping edges are still present to help with traction. That structural integrity backs up an exceptional UTQG treadwear rating of 720 and a 70,000-mile limited treadwear warranty on passenger fitments.Cooper Discoverer® HTThis is the tire for drivers who expect their trucks or suvs to show up for the long haul. Whether that means towing a camper into the backcountry, handling moving-day payloads, or eating up cross-country interstate miles in quiet comfort, the mission remains the same: a single set of tires that balances real-world traction, refined manners, and hard-working capability.To fit that wide spectrum of work, Cooper offers the Discoverer® HT across 19 passenger sizes covering 16- to 22-inch wheels (with section widths from 245 to 285 mm), alongside 16 light-truck (LT) options engineered with deeper tread grooves and higher load ratings. Backed by a 45-day satisfaction guarantee and over a century of research and development, the Discoverer® HT delivers what Cooper has always stood for: the quiet confidence that the job was done right.Find out more about the Cooper Discoverer® HT on Coopertire.com or visit your local tire shop retailer.

s9c5eu.title: Google gives Gemini the ability to use your Mac for you
s9c5eu.content:
Google on Thursday announced that it is bringing computer use to its Gemini desktop application on macOS, allowing its AI to complete tasks on users’ behalf, navigating native Mac apps, and browsing websites in the background.

The tech giant is a little late to the game with this launch, as other leading AI model makers like OpenAI, Anthropic, and Meta have already been offering agentic features in their desktop applications for some time. Meanwhile, Google only this week announced the broader rollout of Gemini’s “Tasks,” the in-app feature that allows the AI to work more as an agent, helping users sign into websites, make online purchases, or book appointments.

Google also only recently began admitting early testers to try its revamped “CC” AI agent, announced in September, which is designed to help families stay organized across email, calendars, chats, and tasks.

Computer use is another type of agentic offering that allows an AI agent to take actions directly on the user’s computer — in Gemini’s case, a Mac. This allows the AI to complete multi-step tasks that involve getting things done across the local files, apps, and the web. After the user instructs the AI what they want to do, they’ll see the agent working in a live preview in their chat, while still keeping their screen and cursor free to continue working on other things.

As with other AI agents offering computer use, users can pause, stop, and approve Gemini’s actions before they happen.

Google suggests the feature could be useful for tedious tasks and other workflows, like filling out forms, repeating the same task over and over across a batch of files, organizing files into folders based on specific criteria, creating slideshows from files or information in online dashboards, and more.

The feature is initially available in English in the U.S. and requires the Gemini app for Mac and a Google AI Plus, Pro, or Ultra subscription. The company didn’t say when it would expand to other markets or platforms.

1gzku5u.title: New Baldur’s Gate 3 console mods include spells, and another difficulty mode
1gzku5u.content: A new batch of Baldur’s Gate 3 mods has been approved for release on console.As noted by the Baldur’s Gate 3 modding subreddit, 12 new mods have been approved and can now be downloaded on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S, having previously been available exclusively on PC.The new mods range from cosmetic to sweeping gameplay changes, including a brand new difficulty setting to choose from.Baldur’s Gate 3 console mods approved on November 19Life Drain Spell (Larloch’s Minor Drain): A new level 1 necromancy spellIllithid Powers Per Combat:  – Illithid Powers are now per combatAoman Head Preset: A new head to choose from if you’re playing as an elfHalsin’s Gift: Wooden Duck Earrings: New earrings in the character creatorHoly Avenger Set: Two new weaponsDrow Leather Boots for Minthara: Armour redesign for MintharaBerry’s Vitrinelle – Couture Jewellery Collection: New wearable jewelleryIncreased Boss Health: Makes boss battles harder by giving them more healthBrutal Difficulty: A new difficulty built on top of Tactician in the base gameGrab It (Auto Loot / Apportation): Automatically picks up loot so you don’t have to select every individual objectStarlight Crew Dice: New dice cosmeticsPermanent Blessings of Shar: Makes several Shar-related blessings permanentWhile these mods have been available on PC for some time, the process of getting them on console is much longer. Mod authors must submit their creations for approval to make sure they will work on console and fit Larian‘s guidelines. New batches of mods tend to be approved once a week.Mods can be installed from a menu on the title screen, which takes you to an in-game mod page powered by mod.io.Console mods were added to Baldur’s Gate 3 as part of a path in 2024. While more limited than the offerings on PC, it finally gave console players the chance to download fan-made cosmetics and gameplay tweaks. It was a natural fit for a community that quickly attracted a modding scene, even when the game was in early access prior to 2023.

gh-1410247473.title: GitHub - robongrui/derp: Doom Engine Remaster Project (DERP) — an enhanced / experimental Doom source port featuring dynamic lighting, weather simulation, physics, reflections and more.
gh-1410247473.content:
A few thoughts
The technically correct name would be Remaster Project for DOOM Engine
Games, but RPFDE is a terrible acronym, so DERP it is. Up to v0.4.5 the
project was called Duct-Tape DOOM.
It has grown well past what I first had in mind. The original idea is
described further down and still holds. Along the way I found that what I
enjoy most is working out what these places were meant to look and feel like,
and what the hardware of the time kept them from doing.
My work on Doom, Doom II and Heretic is opinionated. I try to add only what
the original maps, artwork or game logic already suggest, and then take those
hints seriously.
I treat DERP as a creative project. Code is one of the tools I use to build
it. I'm glad to hear whether it works, whether it's fun and whether it does
what it sets out to do. How much of the code I typed myself is a different
question, and one the project isn't trying to answer.
DERP is a hobby project and development happens privately. The public
repository holds the versions I choose to release, without my ongoing
experiments or unfinished work. I sometimes show upcoming features on
YouTube; they reach the repository when I'm ready to release them.
Forks and contributions
The GPL gives you every right to fork DERP, and I respect that. If you mainly
want to fix bugs, improve performance or extend existing features, I'd prefer
a pull request to another distribution of essentially the same project.
Improvements developed together reach more people.
What this is
An idea of how DOOM could have looked if id had kept iterating on this engine,
and if we still played on CRTs. It tries to look newer without looking modern.
Under the hood it is a port of id Software's 1997 DOOM source release to
Windows, macOS and Linux, with an optional GPU renderer that builds a 3D scene
from the loaded WAD while the game runs.
Everything the renderer adds is worked out from the original artwork, maps and
game state. It needs no replacement textures, models, authored lighting or
edited maps, so vanilla and limit-removing WADs get the effects without their
authors preparing anything. Sound works the same way. Every sound DOOM didn't
have, from a lamp's buzz to a window breaking, is synthesized by code when the
game starts, and where it plays is read from the map. The exceptions are
listed where they come up: one spoken word, the voices and cries of DERP
mode's monsters (generated with ElevenLabs), the kick's leg and the kneeling
soldiers' frames (generated with ChatGPT), the bundled SoundFont, and recorded soundtracks you supply
yourself.
Most effects are fake-modern: cheap tricks of the kind I liked in late-90s
games, chosen over the techniques a modern engine would use. Effects stay or
go based on how they look in the game, and the code is written for trying
ideas out quickly. It isn't meant as a reference engine or a library. I'd be
glad if some of the ideas end up in other projects.
Claude writes much of the code. I decide what DERP should do and how it should
look and sound, test the results in the game, and keep iterating until they
match what I had in mind. Without that workflow I wouldn't have the spare time
for a project like this.
The defaults are how I like to play. Nearly everything can be changed in the
settings panel, F4.
At a glance

3D renderer on SDL_gpu: Vulkan on Windows and Linux, Metal on macOS.
Native resolution, any aspect ratio, mouse look and free aim, movement
interpolated between game tics, optional MSAA and HDR output.
Classic renderer: the original 320×200 software view is one setting away.
No asset pack: the WAD's own textures, flats, sprites and palettes are
the source material.
Compatibility: vanilla and limit-removing maps with DEHACKED patches.
SIGIL plays as episode 5 of The Ultimate DOOM.
Three ways to play: Normal is DOOM's own game with DERP's look. DERP
mode, the default, is where the experiments live: monsters that take cover
and talk, a player who can crouch, slide and kick, slow motion that costs
something, and DOOM's first episode at night in the rain. Phobos plays the
first episode on a moon 22 km across, in vacuum.
Light: the level is lit as one model by its own lamps, screens, windows
and the light bouncing off them, baked when the level loads and re-baked
when doors open or lamps get shot out. Monsters block light and cast real
shadows.
Climate and weather: rain, snow, sand, ash, fog, dry ice, nukage rain or
a firestorm, at any hour, temperature and wind. The map's rooms are worked
out at load, the wind blows through them, and blasts, footsteps and doors
disturb what falls and lies.
Window glass that reflects and shatters, lights that can be shot
out, lamps that blink with DOOM's flickering sectors.
Combat: wound holes that follow the animation, blood that runs down
steps, ragdolls drawn back into sprites, gore, muzzle flashes and
explosions in four styles.
Skies with depth: painted mountains stand at their own distances, cloud
skies get volumetric clouds, Doom II's city becomes buildings.
Sound: room acoustics measured from the map, sound that finds its way
round corners and through doors, headphone output through a measured head,
and synthesized footsteps, sparks, breaking glass and ambience.
Music: a SoundFont synth with the bundled GeneralUser GS bank, an OPL FM
synth written from the chip's manual, the Mac's system synth, or recorded
soundtracks (PlayStation, 3DO, the 2024 re-release's) from packs you own.
Heretic runs as a second program on the same renderer and sound,
tuned for its fantasy world.
Controls: gamepads, gyro aim, rumble, rebinding, the Steam Deck.
For mappers: a DERPINFO lump sets a map's weather, wind, hour, sun,
distance fog and wall mirrors, or switches on Phobos physics. Other ports
ignore it.
Not supported: Boom, MBF21 and GZDoom maps, Hexen, DOOM 64, slopes, 3D
floors, model packs, ray tracing and multiplayer.

The Windows build gets the most testing. The macOS and Linux builds compile in
CI and have had less real play.
Download and play
Ready-to-play builds for Windows, macOS and Linux are on the
Releases page. Each includes
Freedoom, so it plays straight away.
Start the launcher: DERP.exe on Windows, derp on Linux, Play
DERP.app on the Mac. It lists the game WADs it finds in the wads folder
next to it, in DOOMWADDIR and DOOMWADPATH, and in DOOM and Heretic games
installed through Steam or GOG. Drop files on its window and each goes where
it belongs: game WADs to the games list, custom WADs and .deh/.bex patches
to the load list, soundtrack packs to the music, .sf2 files to the
SoundFont. Its Settings page has the same options as F4. It works with a
gamepad.
PLAY.md has the controls and more on the launcher and options.
The ambience is off by default (F4 → Sound → Made-up sounds), and quiet on
purpose when on; the music covers most of it. To hear the soundscape, turn the
music down or off in Options → Sound Volume.
Ways to play
F4 → Game → World → Gameplay picks one of three. Switching restarts a
first-episode map; you keep what you carry.
Normal
DOOM's own game. Every map looks the way DERP derives it from the WAD, sun and
all, and the rules are id's.
DERP mode
The default, and where most of the experiments go. It is unfinished: parts are
rough, some are half-built, and any of it may change or go away between
releases. Its rules apply on the maps id made and are off in demos and
netgames.
Monsters that think. Soldiers work as squads with jobs. They take cover
behind the map's corners, kneel behind low walls and stand to fire over them,
move one at a time while the others cover, hold doorways, guard keys,
switches and the pickups they were placed around, and fall back or set
ambushes after a lost fight. Word spreads: a soldier who hears gunfire or sees
a friend leave readies the room. A director keeps the pressure in check and
backs off when you are picking them off. Imps hunt as a pack: one holds your
attention while another goes round, they climb, hop across nukage, jump
through any window they fit (shattering the glass), and some hang from the
ceiling in dark corners and drop on your back. Pinkies smell you and charge.
Skill levels change how sharply they aim and how fast they spot you.
-derpai turns the AI on in any mode, for testing.
Monsters that talk. Soldiers shout what they are doing, pass on what they
know, chat when they think they are alone, and die mid-sentence. Each keeps
its own voice. Imps hiss and screech. The cries, pain and death sounds ship
with the game in derp-cries.wad; the spoken lines are a separate download,
derp-voices.wad, placed beside the game WAD. Without it the soldiers only
cry out.
A player with legs. You run at Quake's pace, 320 units a second, a
little over half of Doomguy's 583, so monsters that walk at a man's pace have
a fair chance. C crouches, and crouching out of a run slides. E is a
low jump and Q a kick; out of a slide the kick becomes a sweep. Kicked
soldiers go down and get up again with a kip-up. With Gore on, a severed head
can be kicked about too.
Slow motion that costs. The hourglass beside the status bar holds four
charges. It runs down while the world is slow, a kill refills half a charge,
and a headshot or a kill while sliding refills a whole one. The right mouse
button is the shootslide: a slide out of a run into slow motion for one charge.
See Slow motion.
Heads. Shots hit the head where the current frame draws it. A pistol
headshot kills quietly and the victim doesn't cry out.
Guns with jobs. Bullets have their own speed, spread and falloff per gun,
and a round that kills carries on through the body.
Looks picked by hand. DOOM's first episode lies at night in a downpour,
with some windows broken before you arrive. See
Rain, night and wear.
Rooms that ring as built. Room tails are traced from the map's real walls
at level start, and far rooms are heard ringing through their doorways. See
Room tails traced from the map.
Phobos
DOOM's first episode says it takes place on Phobos, a moon of Mars 22 km
across. Pick Phobos and the episode plays as if that were literally true.
It touches only the first episode (DOOM's or Freedoom: Phase 1's) and never
runs in demos or netgames.
Phobos pulls at 1/1700 of Earth's gravity, so walking doesn't work. Movement
keys give gentle hops that float for about twenty seconds, Use next to a wall
pushes you off along the floor, E jumps, and running fires the suit's
thrusters. Knockback and recoil are real; a barrel is 225 kg of
monopropellant. Every sector has an air pressure and air rushes out through
every opening: doors cycle as airlocks, a broken window vents a room, and
whatever isn't held down goes with the draft, monsters included. Outside is
vacuum under a black sky with Mars in it, and you and your rockets can climb
to about 900 m. Grav boots let you walk on ceilings, and Guns turn you
spins you into backflips.
F4 → Game → Phobos sets how much help you get (legs and guns only,
thrusters, or thrusters with grav boots), whether monsters wear mag boots,
and how hard decompression pulls. Mappers can switch Phobos on for their own
maps with phobos = true in DERPINFO.
See linuxdoom-1.10/p_phobos.c and
linuxdoom-1.10/p_boots.c.
Heretic
DERP plays Raven's Heretic on the same 3D renderer, lighting, sound and music,
again worked out from the WAD. Pick a Heretic WAD in the launcher and it
starts the Heretic program, derp-heretic, which ships next to the DOOM one.
You need your own copy: the 2025 Heretic + Hexen release has both the new
heretic.wad and the original DOS HERETIC.WAD, and both work.
The effects are tuned for a fantasy world. There is no window glass and there
are no lamps to shoot out. The Torch item is the light you carry, burning as a
flickering flame, and the hero light is on faintly by default. Torches,
chandeliers and serpent statues light their rooms, stained glass glints and
throws its colours onto the floor, water is clear and mirror-like, the Ice
Grotto's floor gets glassy streaks, and gloss comes from each texture's
material. Episodes 4 and 5 get skies of their own: hanging tendrils that move
one by one, and dead trees in fog. Where Heretic already has a sound of its
own, such as its wind and waterfalls, the game's sound is used and DERP's is
left off.
Heretic has had far less play than DOOM. heretic/README.md
has its controls and what does and doesn't work yet.
SIGIL
With The Ultimate DOOM loaded, John Romero's SIGIL (E5M1–E5M9) plays as
episode 5, with its own names, intermission and menu entry. Bring your own
SIGIL.wad.
Episode 0.5: SCP_7179_B
It's in the episode menu when you play DOOM II, TNT or Plutonia, and it is the
one place where DERP brings a map of its own. That is all this README says
about it. scp_7179_b/README.md has how to start it
and the credits.
Screenshots

The settings panel
F4 opens the settings over the paused game. Options are sorted into four
groups (Game, Controls, Graphics and Sound), each with tabs, and the
highlighted option's description is shown at the bottom. Options that only
refine another are greyed out while it is off.
Options that cost frame time carry bars: one green, two yellow, three red,
measured on E1M1 and E1M2. Options that cost only in some places say where
(near windows, near liquids, under open sky, in fights). F4 →
Graphics → Display → Preset sets all of them at once and leaves matters of
taste alone:

Preset
For

Lowest
Old or built-in graphics chips. Bump detail, bloom, fog, sky depth, reflections and monster shadows off; the light itself stays.

Handheld
The Steam Deck. Bloom, texel-aligned light and glass reflections off; monsters fall procedurally instead of as ragdolls.

Balanced
DERP as it comes.

High
Balanced with 2× anti-aliasing.

Everything
4× anti-aliasing and half-resolution liquid reflections.

Show FPS under Display has five levels. Full shows a frame-time graph,
CPU load, how frames reach the screen, the GPU, the version, the map and what
each running system costs, so a screenshot (F7) says what a bug report needs.
Full, with GPU times adds the GPU time of each part of the picture; it
waits on each part, so the game runs slower while it shows. The key left of
1 steps through the levels while you play.
Settings are saved in graphics.cfg. Each option's key is listed beside it in
platform/settings_panel.cpp.
What the graphics do
Light comes from things that look like lights
DOOM hints at its lighting through sector brightness, glowing textures and
flats, decorations, windows and the shapes of rooms. The renderer turns those
hints into light sources.
Lamp strips, computer panels, lava and other glowing artwork are recognised by
texture name and palette colour. Their bright pixels become glow masks and
light sources. Wall panels shine mostly forward, so they don't light through
their own wall, and lamps close by light the walls beside them at a raking
angle. Computer walls dotted with a few LEDs light the room only as much as
those LEDs would. Torches, candles and other glowing decorations cast light
sized to their artwork.
A lamp lights as strongly as its sector's light level says. The level is the
mapper's stand-in for the lamp's brightness, so a strip set only a notch above
its room stays a dim fixture: the strength rises with the square of the level,
from nothing at 96 to full at 208. Floor paint the mapper lit like a fixture,
such as FLOOR1_6, glows too.
Windows and other openings to the sky let the outdoor light in. A barrel's
slime glows on top.

See
platform/scene3d/bake_lights.cpp,
platform/emissive.h and
platform/surface_lighting.h.
The whole level is lit as one model
F4 → Graphics → Lighting → Lighting offers two models.
Whole level, the default, lights the level by its own lights: lamps,
screens, windows, the sky and what bounces off them, each reaching as far as
real light does. DOOM's sector light levels no longer light the rooms. Light
spills from a bright room into the dark one next door, daylight reaches into
rooms through their openings, and a room whose lamps are shot out goes black.
It is still being built and is finished only for indoor areas so far.
Two sliders tune it. Surfaces return light sets how much light a surface
bounces on. DOOM's textures are painted dark, as if already in dim light, so
taken as drawn a floor returns about a quarter and bounce dies at once; the
default counts them twice as light. Fill light lets a room its own lights
don't reach keep some of the light level its mapper gave it. It is off by
default. Light by logic is a test that ignores the mapper's light levels
entirely: every lamp shines in full by its artwork and daylight follows the
hour.
Classic is DOOM's own light level per sector with the baked lamps,
windows and bounce on top. It has its own options for spilling light through
doorways, darkening rooms that their lamps light well (so the light seems to
come from the lamps), and tinting a room by the colour of its bounced lamp
light.
See platform/scene3d/light_rooms.cpp,
platform/scene3d/room_fill.cpp and
platform/scene3d/bake_bounce.cpp.
Static light is baked when a level loads
The bake works on DOOM's 2D map and is far simpler than a modern lightmap.
It gathers light from lamps, glowing textures and liquids, decorations,
windows and the sky, with walls and closed portals blocking it. It adds
bounce, sky fill, sun shadows, ambient occlusion in corners and under ledges,
and shadows from decorations such as columns, trees and hanging bodies. The
result is snapped to the texture grid, so the light changes in steps of DOOM
texels.
Each wall texel and floor cell also stores the direction its light comes from,
in the way Half-Life 2 stored it. With Bumps in all baked light on, seams,
bricks and panel edges catch the baked light from the side it comes from and
fall into shade on the other.
Baking is fast enough to repeat. It runs on the graphics card by default (on a
Mac, whose processor is quicker at it, on the processor), stages whose inputs
haven't changed are taken from a cache on disk, and Quick sky and bounce
bakes trades a little evenness for several seconds on big outdoor maps.

See
platform/baked_lighting.h,
platform/scene3d/bake_basis.cpp,
platform/scene3d/bake_cache.cpp and
platform/scene3d/relight.cpp.
Light changes during play
Doors, lifts and lowering walls spill light through as they move. A door that
stays open, or a floor lowered for good, gets its light baked again in the
background once it stops. Doors that close again keep the spill only.
A lamp that is shot out takes its light with it. With Shot-out light at
once, the lamps near you are pre-baked as if already broken on helper
threads, so the room darkens on the frame the lamp breaks. It costs 50–150 MB
of memory. Quick uses three threads; Gentle uses two and dips the
frame rate about half as much. Re-bakes run on the graphics card by default,
or on the processor on a Steam Deck or a Mac.
A muzzle flash, a spark or an exploding barrel briefly lifts the light of the
room it goes off in, including the far side of a pillar but not the room next
door (Flashes light the room).
Eye adaptation meters the picture: a dim room opens up and its windows
burn out, and daylight reins it in.
Hero light (Off, Faint or Strong; off by default in DOOM) lifts what is
close to you and nearly black by a few steps, so you can make out walls and
monsters in the dark. Rooms lit by their own lights don't change, and nothing
shines, casts a shadow or glints from it.
See platform/scene3d/relight.cpp,
platform/scene3d/shot_lights.cpp,
platform/scene3d/room_pulse.cpp and
platform/scene3d/exposure.cpp.
Per-frame light work can move into the bake
Lamps near the player can also run as live lights for flicker, bump and gloss
detail, and every monster and item can trace rays to the baked lights each
frame. Two switches move that work to level load:

Bake-only static lights (Light sources): lamps and glowing textures stop
being live lights. Their flicker, bump detail and gloss come from the b

gh-1405928460.title: GitHub - Polocop/genewars: GWRecomp v1.2: Gene Wars (Bullfrog, 1996) as a native Win32/SDL2 program, statically recompiled from your own GW.EXE (1.1 patch). English/Spanish launcher, six game languages, widescreen, Zoom Out, 120 FPS, CD music. No game files included.
gh-1405928460.content:
GWRecomp — Gene Wars, natively on Windows

Mission 1 (Exceland) in widescreen 854×480: an extractor on the GOOP field, the next one being placed, animated sea

GWRecomp runs Gene Wars (Bullfrog Productions, 1996, version 1.1) as a native Win32 program, without DOSBox.
The original x86-32 DOS4GW executable is statically lifted to C and runs on a modern host layer (SDL2 video, audio
and input, DOS/DPMI services, a virtual Sound Blaster for the game's own Miles mixer, CD-DA playback). The game logic,
AI and mixer are the original code; the host only replaces the hardware and DOS around it.
It needs your own copy of Gene Wars 1.1: no game files are included (see Legal).
Download: latest release (GWRecomp-*-win32.zip, Windows,
ready to play with your own GENEWARS folder) · Descarga: última versión.
Screenshots

Zoom Out: the 1152×640 map canvas at 0.87×, sharp scaling
Classic 640×480, as in 1996

Native launcher (English / Spanish): start, continue, start-up options
Missions: pick any of the 24 missions

Graphics: view mode, resolution, 60/120 FPS, filter, water and GOOP
The original planet-system screen, with its sounds

The source lives in gwrecomp/. This repository started as a fork of
mefistotelis/genewars and is now a standalone project; that unfinished
engine re-implementation, with its history, stays in the source folders of this repository, untouched. Earlier
GitHub issues are kept in gwrecomp/docs/issues-archive.md.
Features

Native Win32/SDL2 build of the original executable: one gwrecomp.exe plus SDL2.dll, no DOSBox, no emulator.
Deterministic regression check: the A/B suite renders 56 frame captures at four points of mission 1 (after
the landing, before a creature is ready, during construction, extractor selected) and compares them with reference
hashes; v1.2 matches all 56 bit for bit. The presentation extras (interpolation, water, audio) never write game
memory, so they cannot change these frames.
Three view modes:

Classic 640×480 (the original frame),
Widescreen 854×480,
Zoom Out on a 1152×640 map canvas (wheel zoom 0.87×–2×, Home returns to 1×).

Sharp scaling to any window or monitor: supersampled sharp-bilinear (pixel interiors stay solid, only the seams
blend), exact nearest when the window is a whole multiple; F7 switches sharp / EPX / CRT.
120 FPS presentation with camera scroll interpolation; the simulation keeps the game's own tick rate.
Animated water and GOOP: sea ripples and drifting glints, soft highlights on GOOP, on ground pixels only and in
the presented frame only (units, buildings and HUD are never touched).
Complete audio:

Smacker video sound,
the original Miles sound effects through a virtual SB16,
automatic CD-DA music from your own .cue image,
stereo panning and distance fade calibrated to the visible map width,
subtle ±4.5 % pitch variation on effects (never on voices),
music ducking while a voice speaks.

Native graphical launcher in English and Spanish (ES / EN buttons; by default it follows the Windows
language): mission selector 1–24, Continue, view/resolution/filter/audio options, all saved in gwrecomp.ini.

Installation (English)

Version check. GWRecomp is built on the GW.EXE of the official 1.1 patch (built 26 Nov 1996). The European
CD itself, and the common "Genewars (Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It,Sv)" image, carry the original 1.0 GW.EXE (built
2 Sep 1996, 1,265,994 bytes), which GWRecomp refuses ("GW.EXE is not the Gene Wars 1.1 one..."): install the game
from the CD and apply the 1.1 patch first. Installs in English, French, German, Italian, Spanish or Swedish are
accepted (speech files of the six languages are known). Only the Spanish 1.1 TEXT.DAT has been seen so far; the
other languages' 1.1 TEXT.DAT is accepted when it has the 1.1 layout (627 texts), and that case has not been tested
with a real installation yet.

Have Gene Wars 1.1 (European edition) installed: the GENEWARS folder created by the original installer
(DATA, LEVELS, SOUND, INTRO, ANIMS, LDATA, S, SPEECH, SAVE and the loose files such as GW.EXE).
GWRecomp checks them with SHA-256 and only reads them.
Download GWRecomp-v1.2-win32.zip from Releases and unzip it anywhere you can write (saves and logs go next to the program).
Double-click gwrecomp.exe. In the launcher press CHANGE and choose your GENEWARS folder; the four marks
DATA / LEVELS / SOUND / INTRO turn green. The ES / EN buttons at the top switch the launcher's language.
Start the game, continue the last game, or pick a mission.

"Windows protected your PC": gwrecomp.exe is not code-signed, so Windows SmartScreen may stop it the first
time. Click More info → Run anyway. If Windows blocks the downloaded zip as a whole, right-click it before
unzipping → Properties → tick Unblock → OK. You can check the file against the SHA-256 published with
each release.
First start: the first time you enter the game, gwrecomp.exe prepares two files in work\ from your GW.EXE
(checked by SHA-256). It takes a moment and happens once. Those files come from your copy of the game: do not share
them.
gwrecomp.ini (the launcher writes it; gwrecomp.ini.example documents every key):

Key
Meaning

mode
classic, widescreen or zoomout

resolution, fullscreen
window size (auto, 1080p, 1440p, 2160p, WxH), borderless fullscreen

fps
presentation rate, 60 or 120

filter
sharp, epx or crt (also F7 in game)

water_effects
animated water and GOOP (1/0)

enhanced_audio
calibrated panning, pitch variation, music ducking (1/0)

language
launcher language: en, es or auto (Windows display language)

cd_cue
path to your own Gene Wars CD image .cue, for the CD music (launcher: PLAY → CD IMAGE)

data_dir
your GENEWARS folder (the launcher fills it in)

In game: F7 filter, F8 turbo 1×/2×/4×, mouse wheel zoom, Home zoom 1×, F10 release the mouse, WASD / arrows / middle
button scroll the map, ESC game options.
Building from source (Windows, MSYS2 mingw32, Python, LLVM clang) is described in
gwrecomp/README.md and gwrecomp/tools/rebuild/README_BUILD.md.
Instalación (español)

Comprueba la versión. GWRecomp está hecho sobre el GW.EXE del parche oficial 1.1 (compilado el 26/11/1996).
El CD europeo, y la imagen habitual «Genewars (Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It,Sv)», traen el GW.EXE original 1.0
(02/09/1996, 1.265.994 bytes), que GWRecomp rechaza («GW.EXE no es el de Gene Wars 1.1…»): instala el juego desde el
CD y aplica antes el parche 1.1. Se aceptan instalaciones en inglés, francés, alemán, italiano, español o sueco.
Del TEXT.DAT 1.1 solo se conoce el español; el de los demás idiomas se acepta si tiene el formato 1.1 (627
textos), y ese caso aún no se ha probado con una instalación real.

Ten instalado Gene Wars 1.1 (edición europea): la carpeta GENEWARS que crea el instalador original
(DATA, LEVELS, SOUND, INTRO, ANIMS, LDATA, S, SPEECH, SAVE y los archivos sueltos como GW.EXE).
GWRecomp los comprueba con SHA-256 y solo los lee.
Descarga GWRecomp-v1.2-win32.zip de Releases y descomprímelo en una carpeta donde puedas escribir (ahí se guardan partidas y registros).
Haz doble clic en gwrecomp.exe. En el lanzador pulsa CAMBIAR y elige tu carpeta GENEWARS; las cuatro
marcas DATA / LEVELS / SOUND / INTRO se ponen en verde. Los botones ES / EN de arriba cambian el idioma del
lanzador.
Inicia el juego, continúa la última partida o elige una misión.

«Windows protegió su PC»: gwrecomp.exe no está firmado digitalmente, así que SmartScreen puede detenerlo la
primera vez. Pulsa Más información → Ejecutar de todas formas. Si Windows bloquea el zip descargado, antes de
descomprimirlo haz clic derecho → Propiedades → marca Desbloquear → Aceptar. Puedes comprobar el archivo
con el SHA-256 que se publica en cada versión.
Primer arranque: la primera vez que entras al juego, gwrecomp.exe prepara dos archivos en work\ a partir de
tu GW.EXE (comprobado por SHA-256). Tarda un momento y solo ocurre una vez. Salen de tu copia del juego: no los
compartas.
Opciones: todo lo que cambias en el lanzador se guarda en gwrecomp.ini (modo de vista, resolución, pantalla
completa, 60/120 FPS, filtro, water_effects, enhanced_audio, language = es / en / auto). Para la música del CD, en la pestaña
JUGAR pulsa IMAGEN DEL CD y elige el .cue de tu propia imagen del CD (se guarda como cd_cue). gwrecomp.ini.example explica cada clave.
Legal
Gene Wars is © Bullfrog Productions / Electronic Arts. GWRecomp is unaffiliated with and unendorsed by the rights
holders.

This repository contains no game executable, data, video, audio, disc image or extracted game code. It contains
the host layer, the lifter and the tools that translate your GW.EXE at build time, plus a few screenshots in
gwrecomp/docs/screenshots/ that show the game's graphics for illustration only.
A built gwrecomp.exe is that translation compiled: it contains native code derived from the original Gene
Wars program. It contains none of the game's data (graphics, sounds, videos, levels, speech), which are always read
from your own GENEWARS folder. Whether a prebuilt binary may be redistributed is a question for the rights
holders; this project does not grant any such right.
License of GWRecomp's own work: MIT. It covers the code, scripts and documentation written
for GWRecomp under gwrecomp/ (host layer, runtime, lifter, tools, launcher, build scripts). It does not cover,
and grants nothing over: Gene Wars itself or any code derived from GW.EXE (including the lifted code inside a
built gwrecomp.exe), the game's graphics in the screenshots, the original function names and the short residual
byte patterns listed in PROVENANCE.md, the upstream re-implementation in the other folders
(GPL-2.0-or-later, as stated in its file headers), or third-party material, which keeps its own license
(THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES; SDL2: zlib; pcrecomp patch: MIT; DOSBox-X patch: GPL-2.0).

gh-1440988244.title: GitHub - timboat/demons-souls-recomp: Native Windows port of Demon's Souls (PS3, BLUS-30443) via ps3recomp static recompilation. Bring your own disc image; no game files included.
gh-1440988244.content:
A native Windows build of Demon's Souls (PS3, USA BLUS-30443 or Europe BLES-00932). The game's PPU and SPU code is statically
recompiled to C/C++ with ps3recomp and runs as a normal x64 program
on a PS3 runtime and a Direct3D 12 renderer. It is not an emulator.

No game files are included. This repo holds only tools, patches and build scripts. SETUP builds the game
on your PC from your own disc image.

Community Discord: discord.gg/gTvrZZ75G for questions, setup help and
screenshots. Bug reports with a REPORT.bat zip are best as a GitHub issue. Thanks to MrSuS60 for having me in their Discord, and a special thanks to zackage7 who has been an immense help in testing and polishing.
Status

The whole game is playable, with sound, music and movies, on keyboard + mouse or an Xbox controller.
60 fps is recommended (50 on a 100 Hz screen). 30, uncapped and any custom rate work too. Above 60 fps
there are still known bugs, such as the sound drifting out of sync.
No online play yet. Multiplayer comes once the game is optimised.
Plays smoothly on Windows, macOS and Linux. The Steam Deck is playable too: not perfectly optimised
yet, but very good in most areas. The full development log is docs/NOTES.md.
Android (arm64) is in an early phase. It boots into the game and plays at 30 fps on a Pixel 10 Pro XL,
with a controller or touch controls. The main target is the AYN Thor, which I don't own yet, so it is
untested there. See Android.

Hit a stutter or crash? Press F8 when it happens and run REPORT.bat afterwards
(details).
What you need

Windows 10/11 x64 with a Direct3D 12 GPU. AVX2 is used if your CPU has it (Haswell / Ryzen or newer).
About 14 GB free disk space.
Your disc image of Demon's Souls USA (BLUS-30443) or Europe (BLES-00932): a .iso, a Redump .zip, or a
dumped folder with PS3_GAME in it. An encrypted image also needs its disc key: the .dkey file from the
dump, or the "Disc Key" line on Redump's page for the disc (USA,
Europe). SETUP tells the two apart by itself. See
European disc.
Nothing else. SETUP downloads what is missing into deps\, with no installer or admin rights: portable
Python and Git, the PS3 keys for EBOOT.BIN (from RPCS3's public source, kept in
%LOCALAPPDATA%), and a portable LLVM compiler with Microsoft's SDK via
xwin. All downloads are checksum-verified. An existing Python 3.10+,
Git, or Visual Studio 2022 (Desktop development with C++) + LLVM 17+ is used instead.
A plain folder path: no [ ] or &.

Each release has one download per system: DemonsSoulsRecomp-<version>-Windows.zip,
DemonsSoulsRecomp_<version>-Linux.zip (plus the Linux setup AppImage) and DemonsSoulsRecomp_<version>-macOS.zip,
each with only what that system uses. Linux / Steam Deck and macOS (Apple silicon): see their install guides
below (Linux, macOS).
Build it (one time)

Download DemonsSoulsRecomp-<version>-Windows.zip from the newest
release (or git clone) and unpack it,
e.g. to C:\Games\DemonsSouls.
Start DemonsSoulsLauncher.exe, press PLAY, and answer Yes to run SETUP.bat.
Give it your disc image: drag it into the window and press Enter. If it needs the disc key, SETUP opens
Redump's page; copy the "Disc Key" line and paste it with Ctrl+V. Enter takes the suggested
answer to every other question.
Wait for All done, then press PLAY.

step
what SETUP does
time*

1
extracts and decrypts the game files into game/
2–5 min

2
decrypts EBOOT.BIN → EBOOT.elf and checks it is the tested version
seconds

3
fetches ps3recomp at the tested commit and applies this port's runtime patch
< 1 min

4
recompiles ~94,000 PPU functions + 12 SPU programs into port/
2–4 min

5
applies this port's edits to the recompiled code
seconds

6
compiles DemonsSoulsRecomp.exe and the launcher
10–30 min

* on a fast 16-core PC. The compiler's full output goes to logs\build_last.txt. If something fails, fix
what it says and run SETUP.bat again: finished steps are skipped.
Linux / Steam Deck
Recommended: the native Linux build, with its own launcher. The game as a Linux program drawn with Vulkan, with no Proton.
On the Steam Deck five of the seven archstones hold 60 fps; the two heaviest spots (Boletarian Palace 1-1 and
Latria's second archstone) run at 55-56, and Boletaria around 48 mid-fight
(frame rates).

Install: run linux/native/install.sh from a git clone (or from the release's Linux ZIP; the launcher's
Update button needs the clone). It opens a one-click installer window: your disc image, its disc key, then
Install.
Play: python3 linux/native/launcher.py opens the native launcher, which is confirmed to work great. It
keeps your settings, updates and rebuilds, adds the game to the applications menu, and Add to Steam makes a
shortcut for game mode (a controller works the launcher). linux/native/play.sh starts the game directly.

Details: docs/LINUX_NATIVE.md.
Alternative: the Windows build through Proton (Steam's compatibility layer), built on your PC from your disc image.
Use it if the native build does not work for you.
It plays on Ubuntu 24.04 and the Steam Deck; the Deck is not perfectly optimised yet, but very good in most areas. You need a
Vulkan GPU driver, about 25 GB free, and an internet connection for the first run.

Download DemonsSoulsRecomp-Setup-x86_64.AppImage from the newest
release (between releases: GitHub →
Actions → Linux AppImage → the newest run → Artifacts). Make it executable (chmod +x, or right-click →
Properties → Permissions → Is executable). On a Steam Deck, do this in desktop mode.
Run it. It asks for your disc image (a file picker, or drag the file in), then the disc key if needed,
and runs the same six steps as SETUP.bat into ~/DemonsSoulsRecomp (DS_HOME=/other/folder puts it
elsewhere, e.g. on an SD card). It asks before each download, including Microsoft's SDK license. The
first build takes 10–30 minutes on a desktop and 1–2 hours on a Steam Deck.
It offers to start the game; the first start sets up Proton (a few hundred MB). To play later, run the
AppImage again (it updates and rebuilds what changed) or ~/DemonsSoulsRecomp/linux/play.sh.

Settings are the same switches as on Windows, e.g. DES_FPS=60 ./DemonsSoulsRecomp-Setup-x86_64.AppImage play
(a Steam Deck defaults to 30 fps). Steam Deck game mode: add ~/DemonsSoulsRecomp/linux/play.sh as a
non-Steam game, with Start in set to ~/DemonsSoulsRecomp and no forced Proton version. From a git
checkout instead: install Python 3.10+, git, and clang + lld 17 or newer, then run
sh linux/setup.sh /path/to/image.iso and sh linux/play.sh. Troubleshooting: docs/LINUX.md.
macOS (Apple silicon)
A native arm64 build on Metal (by erikomis). It plays smoothly, but it is behind on updates: some of the
Windows and Linux features are missing.
You need about 14 GB free.

Install Apple's command-line tools (xcode-select --install), then with Homebrew:
brew install cmake ninja sdl2 glslang spirv-cross ffmpeg python@3.12 (FFmpeg is for the movies).
Get this repo (git clone, or the release's DemonsSoulsRecomp_<version>-macOS.zip) and, in its folder, run
DES_ISO="/path/to/Demon's Souls (USA).iso" mac/install.sh. A Redump image also needs
DES_KEY=<32 hex digits or the .dkey file>. It extracts the game, decrypts the EBOOT, recompiles and
builds; after a failure or a quit, run it again and it continues where it stopped.
Play with mac/play.sh. There is no on-screen keyboard yet: DES_NAME=<name> mac/play.sh names your
character. DES_FPS=30 gives the console's 30 fps (60 is the default).

mac/launcher/ has a desktop app that does all of this without a terminal (see its README). Controls,
settings and what is still missing: docs/MACOS.md.
Android (experimental)
Early phase. An arm64 build on the same Vulkan renderer as the native Linux build, packed as an APK.
It boots into the game and plays: on a Pixel 10 Pro XL (Android 17) it loads a save and holds 30 fps in game,
with a Bluetooth controller or the on-screen touch controls. The handheld it is meant for, the AYN Thor,
is untested because I don't own one yet, and other phones are untested too. No release: you build the APK
yourself, on a Linux PC or a Mac, from your own disc. Never share the APK: it contains the game's code.

Run the native Linux steps first (linux/native/build.sh venv game decrypt toolkit lift; on a Mac
mac/rebuild.sh venv game decrypt toolkit lift): they make the game files and the recompiled code from
your disc image.
Install the Android SDK with NDK r28 and a JDK 17, then run android/build_deps.sh (SDL2 + glslang for
arm64), android/build_so.sh (the game, ~10 minutes on an 8-core PC) and android/build_apk.sh install
(with the phone connected over USB, USB debugging on).
android/push_game.sh copies the game files (about 8 GB) to the phone. Then start
Demon's Souls (ps3recomp) from the app drawer.

It starts at 30 fps, with no movies, straight to the title screen. Not there yet: 60 fps, movies, the
on-screen keyboard (the character is named "Slayer"), and rumble. Details, measurements and the open points:
docs/ANDROID.md.
European disc (BLES-00932)
SETUP builds the European release too, from your own European disc image: it reads which disc it is and uses
patches/lifted-code-eu.patch, the port's edits carried over to the European EBOOT. The European game picks its
language from the system language: set PS3_LANG=fr (or de, es, it; anything else gives English) in the
launcher's Extra settings, or before PLAY.bat / linux/play.sh. Notes:

Use a separate folder for each release. Switching one folder from one disc to the other is not supported.
European saves are separate from US ones (the save folders are named after the disc, BLES00932...).
Tested on Linux through Proton: setup, a new character into the tutorial at 30 and 60 fps, and the French text.
Not tested on the European release yet: boss rush, the PC Remaster mod, and the native Linux, macOS and Android
builds.

Updating
Press Check for updates in the launcher. It downloads the newest release (no Git needed), rebuilds what
changed and reopens. Your game files, saves and settings are kept. Tick Keep my build after updates (or
set DES_NO_REBUILD=1) to play your current build and rebuild later with BUILD.bat.
Copies from before v2026.11.03.7, once: unpack the newest release ZIP over your folder, replacing files,
then press Play.
Play
Start DemonsSoulsLauncher.exe and press PLAY. It holds every option (frame rate, resolution, mods,
fullscreen, movies, god mode, recording, keys by letter, CPU pinning, GPU power smoothing) and saves them in launcher.ini.
Extra settings takes any NAME=value switch from this page or from an issue. --play starts the game
straight away, for a shortcut. Without the launcher, set the switches before running PLAY.bat.

launcher option
switch
what it does

Frame rate
DES_FPS=30|50|60|unlimited|31-240
Auto = an even rate for your screen: 60 on 60 / 120 / 240 Hz, 50 on 100 Hz, 72 on 144 Hz, 55 on 165 Hz, 75 on 75 Hz. Game speed is right at any rate. A rate that divides your refresh rate is perfectly even; others turn vsync off.

My screen has G-Sync / FreeSync
DES_VRR=1
lets a variable-refresh monitor follow the frames (vsync-off frames may tear, so the monitor shows each when it is ready); Auto is then 60 at any refresh rate. Leave it off on other screens: the picture would tear.

Resolution
DES_RES_SCALE=1.25|1.5|2|3|4
renders above 1280x720: 1.25 = 1600x900, 1.5 = 1920x1080 (a 1080p screen), 2 = 2560x1440; Sharper shadows = LD_RES_SCALE_SHADOW=1

Game
DES_GAME=game_remaster / game_mod, DES_BOSS_RUSH=1
the PC Remaster mod, your imported models (see below), or boss rush mode

Dump textures
LD_TEX_DUMP=1
saves every texture drawn, for texture packs

Skip the intro
DES_SKIP_INTRO=1
starts at PRESS START; story movies still play

Keep my build after updates
DES_NO_REBUILD=1
plays your current build instead of rebuilding

Smooth GPU power
LD_GPU_WARM=2 (1-4)
only if your PC switches itself off or restarts while the port runs (but not in other games): keeps the GPU's power draw steady between frames so a power supply does not trip. No change to the picture or frame rate; the card draws more power. If it still happens, LD_GPU_WARM=3 in Extra settings

Other switches: DES_MOVIES=0 skips movies, DES_CUT_BLEND=0 restores the original 30 fps cutscene camera,
DES_FULLSCREEN=1 starts fullscreen.
Controls
An Xbox (XInput) controller works when plugged in. A DualShock / DualSense needs Steam Input or DS4Windows.
Keyboard + mouse work alongside a controller; whichever you touch last takes over.

key
action

WASD
move

mouse (or IJKL)
camera (click into the game to capture the mouse)

left mouse / Shift
attack (R1) / strong attack (R2)

right mouse / Ctrl
block (L1) / parry (L2)

Space
roll / dash / back (Circle)

E
interact / confirm (Cross)

F / R
two-hand (Triangle) / use item (Square)

Tab / middle mouse
lock on (R3)

arrows
d-pad (switch items)

Enter / Backspace
Start / Select

Esc or F1
release the mouse (close the game with the X or Alt+F4)

Alt+Enter / F11
borderless fullscreen

F9
god mode (no death, HP/MP/stamina stay full)

Menus: the mouse is a pointer. Hover selects, left click confirms, right click goes back, the wheel
scrolls, and side buttons or PageUp / PageDown are L1 / R1. DES_POINT=0 turns pointing off;
PAD_MENU_MOUSE=0 turns the mouse off in menus.
Button icons show keys or PS3 buttons depending on what you used last (LD_TEX_KBM=0 = always PS3,
1 = always keyboard).
Mouse look follows the game's invert options. PAD_MOUSE_LOOK_SENS=0.0012 sets the sensitivity;
PAD_MOUSE_LOOK=0 restores the old stick-style mouse.
Keys go by position, so AZERTY uses ZQSD. PAD_KEYS_BY_LETTER=1 = by letter.
Change any key in the launcher: Controls, click a slot, press the key or mouse button (right-click clears
it). The button prompts and the title's PRESS ENTER KEY follow your keys.

Saves go to gamedata/, and logs to logs/; they grow ~600 MB an hour, and the previous run is kept.
Boss rush mode
Game: Boss rush in the launcher (or DES_BOSS_RUSH=1 linux/play.sh, or DES_BOSS_RUSH=1 linux/native/play.sh for
the native Linux build, DES_BOSS_RUSH=1 mac/play.sh on a Mac). Make a new character:
you skip the tutorial and start in the Nexus in soul form, with 7,000 souls and every trader there. Boldwin also
sells every weapon and shield, every armour piece and ring, every upgrade material, Turpentine and Firebombs,
priced by tier: the best weapons 40,000-75,000, top armour sets 30,000-50,000, rings 5,000-50,000, and items normal
shops sell at their usual price, so a run's boss souls buy a build but not everything.

Pick a boss: each world's archstone offers that world's next unbeaten boss and puts you at its fog gate.
After a kill: the boss's archstone offers the next boss (Fight the Tower Knight?) or Return to the Nexus?
Dying: you go back to the same boss's fog in body form.
The Nexial Binding takes you back to the Nexus and keeps your souls (its description says so too).
The run ends when King Allant dies; his fight and the ending are the game's own.
The timer at the bottom of the screen appears once you are in the game. It starts at the first fog and pauses
on loading screens, cutscenes and the title screen (and while the game is closed). Splits and the final time go to
bossrush\splits.txt and bossrush\results.txt.
Boss rush souls in the launcher (2x by default; DES_BR_SOULS=2, 3, 5 or 10): every enemy and boss gives that many times its
souls. The timer shows Souls x2 and so on when it is not 1x, so runs and videos say which they used.

It has its own saves in bossrush\, so your normal saves are never used. Play makes game_bossrush\ from your
game files the first time, in seconds and with no extra disk space (again when you change the souls setting).
Reporting stutters and crashes
Every run records frame timing (about 25 MB an hour, no visible cost; the last 10 sessions stay in perf\).

Press F8 right after a stutter or slowdown. Each press marks that moment.
After quitting or a crash, press Report a problem in the launcher (or run REPORT.bat). It packs
the session into one zip and opens GitHub's New issue page.
Pick the Stutter / slowdown or Crash / bug template, drag the zip in, and say where you were.

The zip holds a frame-pacing summary (report.txt), the recording (perf.txt), your system info
(system.txt) and the end of the game log (log_tail.txt). Your Windows user name is removed. Untick
Record frame timing (or set DES_RECORD=0) to play without recording.
Mods (optional)
PC Remaster mod by fromsoftserve (Nexus Mods, Demon's Souls mod 106): download its zip, then run the line
below. It makes game_remaster/ from hard links, so it uses no extra space and game/ is unchanged.
.venv\Scripts\python tools\install_remaster.py "path\to\the mod.zip" --apply
Texture packs:

Tick Dump textures and play; textures land in textures\dump\ as <KEY>_<w>x<h>_<format>.png.
Put an edited or larger file whose name starts with the same KEY in textures\replace\. .dds (DXT, BC7,
BC4, RGBA) loads faster than PNG.

Details are in textures\README.txt.
Models:

Export armour, weapons, characters or map pieces to glTF, edit them in Blender, and import them back.
Import writes game_mod\ from hard links; play it with Game: My models, and delete the folder to undo.
Edit the _l low-detail copy too. Rules are in models\README.txt.

.venv\Scripts\python tools\flver_tool.py export game\PS3_GAME\USRDIR\PARTS\bd_f_5010.partsbnd.dcx
.venv\Scripts\python tools\flver_tool.py import models\BD_F_5010\edited.glb game\PS3_GAME\USRDIR\PARTS\bd_f_5010.partsbnd.dcx

Packs and models are the game's art; share them only where that is allowed.
Repo layout
SETUP.bat / BUILD.bat one-time setup / rebuild
DemonsSoulsLauncher.exe the settings window (source in project/launcher/)
PLAY.bat / REPORT.bat start the game / pack a bug report
setup/ setup pipeline, toolchain finder, Linux cross toolchain
project/ CMake project
patches/ ps3recomp-local.patch (runtime, on ps3recomp @ 4e8f3ca) and lifted-code.patch (game code)
tools/ disc extraction, SPU lifting, perf report, mod installer, model tool
docs/NOTES.md development log: every fix, why, and how it was measured
linux/, mac/ Linux / Steam Deck kit and macOS build (docs/LINUX.md, docs/MACOS.md)
android/ Android (arm64) build: APK project, entry point, build scripts (docs/ANDROID.md)

Everything SETUP produces (game/, port/, deps/, .venv/, saves, logs) is git-ignored.
Never commit or share those: they are the game.
Troubleshooting

"could not get the keys … using RPCS3 instead":

The key download failed, so SETUP falls back to RPCS3; you can also run SETUP again later.
If RPCS3 then fails ("did not write EBOOT.elf"), close any open RPCS3 window and retry. Or decrypt
game\PS3_GAME\USRDIR\EBOOT.BIN by hand with RPCS3's Utilities → Decrypt PS3 Binaries; install the
firmware first if it asks.
In Windows Sandbox or a VM, RPCS3 can crash. Decrypt on another PC, copy EBOOT.elf into that folder,
and rerun SETUP.

"EBOOT.BIN is not the tested one": only the USA (BLUS-30443) and European (BLES-00932) discs, version
1.00 as on the disc, are supported.
Build tools not found: rerun SETUP or BUILD and allow the portable compiler download. Or install VS 2022
Build Tools with C++ and LLVM (winget install LLVM.LLVM), or set LLVM_DIR.
Setup seems stuck: one file can take a minute; see logs\build_last.txt. If nothing moves for many
minutes, press Enter once.
Black window or crash on start: check the end of logs\last_run_err.txt.
The game closes by itself with no message: run REPORT.bat right away. Its zip includes Windows' own
record of the crash (crash.txt), which the game's log cannot show.
Uneven frames at 100+ fps in busy areas: use 50 or 60 fps. On CPUs with two core complexes the game
pins itself to the one with the largest L3 cache; DES_AFFINITY=0 turns that off.
Something is briefly black or missing the first time you see it: its shaders are compiling in the
background. LD_PSO_ASYNC=0 waits instead.
"needs AVX2": the build was made on another PC. Run BUILD.bat on this one, or set DS_AVX2=0 b

1k61osi.title: Еще одна звонилка или как я создал Nimbo
1k61osi.content: Время чтения7 минОхват и читатели1.3KКейсДисклеймерОсновной код Nimbo писал ИИ. Я немного правил его ручками, но больше занимался тем, как всё должно работать: логикой, интерфейсом, выбором стека и архитектуры. Я рассматривал этот проект как возможность поэкспериментировать. Хотелось на чём-то живом понять, что вообще можно собрать таким способом и получится ли потом этим пользоваться.ПредисловиеВообще-то я хотел просто играть с друзьями. Нужны были голосовые комнаты, чат, возможность показать экран, нормальный шумодав — и чтобы к железу софт был нетребовательным.В Discord мне до сих пор нравятся голосовые комнаты, но, когда заходишь провести вечер с друзьями, ощущение, будто попал на китайский базар: тут реклама, там предлагают Nitro. Плюс без обходных путей он не открывается. Надоело каждый вечер запускать ещё и запрет, а потом разбираться, почему с ним не работает твич, хотя вчера всё было нормально (ни в коем случае не критика авторов запрета, ребятам суперлайк за то, что они делают! В таком мире мы живем). В TeamSpeak не справляется шумодав, друзья слышали много лишних резких звуков. В Mumble мне не хватало привычных фичей, например возможности показать экран.Я попробовал какое-то количество звонилок, хотя и каюсь, ничего кастомного я не разворачивал. Вполне допускаю, что кто-то уже собрал именно то, что мне нужно. Но у меня сошлись все звёзды: хотелось нормально созваниваться с друзьями и было желание собрать с помощью ИИ какой-то сервис и довести его до состояния, когда друзья скажут, что готовы в него переехать. Из этого выросла моя мысль — публичная репа с сервисом, который можно развернуть у себя. Исходники и готовый клиент для windows уже лежат на GitHub в публичном репозитории, который вы сможете посмотреть и при желании покритиковать.А затея вообще рабочая?Начал я сразу с Windows-клиента. Хотелось понять, смогу ли я вообще довести свою затею до работающего состояния. В качестве стека для Windows я выбрал C++ и Qt. Главный критерий был — оставить как можно больше ресурсов игре. У меня есть друзья со старенькими ноутбуками, для которых ещё одна небольшая программа на фоне уже проблема. А шумодав и так обрабатывается локально, значит, с оптимизацией придётся потанцевать с бубном. Впрочем, я ещё подумаю, как разгрузить и этот момент.Так или иначе, C++ давал возможность очень точечно управлять тем, когда программа занимает и освобождает память. Qt же отвечал за окна, кнопки, работу с устройствами и основу интерфейса. Базовое представление о C++ у меня было, и я понимал, что в разработке с ним придётся повозиться. Но ради лёгкого клиента решил нырнуть поглубже в этот омут.Первая проба получилась. Был локальный чат, история сообщений, можно было открыть микрофон и проверить звук. В любом случае собрать EXE я смогу, а вот продумывать на нём дизайн, механики и UX будет тяжеловато, и токенов это будет есть х3. После правок нужно ждать сборку, потом раскидывать друзьям новый файл и просить его запустить. Мне хотелось быстрее видеть результат и чаще его проверять. Поэтому я заморозил этот клиент, приняв тот факт, что пилот работает, а значит, с ним можно работать. Я ушёл в веб на Vue + TypeScript. Серверную же часть я решил делать на Go, а для передачи голоса, камеры и экрана взял готовый LiveKit.ДизайнКогда начинаешь сразу делать интерфейс без холста, очень быстро упираешься в проблему чистого листа. А здесь ещё нужно объяснить нейронке, что ты хочешь, когда сам не особо пока понимаешь.Сначала я перебирал готовые киты и фреймворки, но постоянно что-то не устраивало. Начинаешь дотачивать элемент под себя, сталкиваешься с ограничениями выбранной дизайн-системы, просишь переделать ещё раз. Попыток становится больше, токены уходят, а результат всё ещё не устраивает. Я подумал, что направить ИИ будет проще айдентикой, а не готовым китом или фреймворком. Собрал то, что нравилось по настроению, цветам и оформлению. Так оказалось проще передать свой вкус и получить первый экран, который было существенно проще править дальше.У такого подхода есть своя цена. ИИ чаще плавает в мелочах: отступы, скругления, бордеры, вечно появляющиеся дивайдеры и пр. — правил изначально нет, а значит мест для нейронки, где она может уползти куда не надо, много. Приходилось давать много корректировок и быть внимательным при тестировании. Но в итоге этот подход мне показался более контролируемым. Увидел, что не нравится, оставил комментарий. От референса может остаться совсем немного или вообще ничего. Но он сделал для нас самое важное — решил проблему чистого листа.Голосовая комната в веб-клиенте Nimbo. Камера + показ экрана одного участника.Profile.nimboЕщё с самого начала мне хотелось, чтобы Nimbo был самостоятельным у каждого, кто его развернул. Я не хотел брать на себя общую регистрацию пользователей, хранить их персональные данные и администрировать чужие компании друзей. Моя задача — дать код и клиент, а дальше человек сам решает, где поднять сервер и кого туда позвать.Отсюда и профиль в файле. У человека на устройстве лежат ник, настройки, список серверов, куда его пригласили, и тех, которыми он управляет. Для каждого сервера сохраняется свой ключ доступа. Профиль можно выгрузить в файл .nimbo, защитить паролем и открыть на другом устройстве в совместимом клиенте. Сохраняются и настройки, и доступы к знакомым серверам. Общей базы всех пользователей Nimbo — нет. Профиль защищён обязательным паролем, который мы устанавливаем при первом экспорте.На самом деле порог входа для владельца сервера всё ещё высокий. Сейчас нужно арендовать VPS, заплатить за него и разобраться с разверткой. Не у каждого есть навыки или нейронка, которая поможет поднять это чудо за тебя. Участнику же проще — получил приглашение, выбрал ник и зашёл. К тому, как упростить жизнь хозяину сервера, я ещё, конечно, вернусь.Как в тест шумодава попало яблокоСначала я остановился на шумодаве RNNoise. Это распространённый вариант, голос мне нравился, задержка крохотная. Но на первых игровых сессиях выяснилось, что моя мышка прекрасно слышна — буквально каждый клик. Открываю пакетик с орешками — тоже слышно. Часть шума фильтр убирал, но резкие, звонкие звуки он не осиливает.При поиске замены пробовал Speex и другие варианты. В конечном итоге остановился на GTCRN. По моим ощущениям, в наших звонках он лучше подошёл под бытовую возню. В полной тишине отдельный щелчок ещё можно заметить, а во время игры и разговора его не слышно (за редким исключением). Голос стал чуть глуше, задержка обработки немного выросла, но в игре эта разница вообще незаметна. Плюс отдельно пришлось разбираться с тем, чтобы обработка не съедала начало и конец фразы.Чтобы сравнить фильтры на одинаковом звуке, взяли готовые записи щелчков мыши, укуса и жевания яблока и просто фразу. Сначала дали каждому шумодаву звук отдельно, затем смешали его с речью. Получилась запись, на которой можно послушать и помехи в паузе, и голос одновременно с ними.Собственно, тесты. Чем выше число в децибелах, тем сильнее подавлена помеха.Запись без речиRNNoiseGTCRNSpeexМышь, запись 13,55 дБ19,21 дБ0,33 дБМышь, запись 215,19 дБ21,13 дБ0,93 дБМышь, запись 328,82 дБ27,66 дБ1,61 дБЯблоко0,35 дБ21,29 дБ0,17 дБRNNoise на трёх мышах повёл себя очень по-разному. На одной почти не помог, на другой даже немного обошёл GTCRN. Зато с яблоком разница была большой. В нашем тесте обработка добавляла около 21 мс у RNNoise и 32 мс у GTCRN. В итоге GTCRN стал режимом по умолчанию, но RNNoise пока оставил как альтернативу. Важным нюансом является то, что всё это обрабатывается на компьютере пользователя. И это один из вопросов к будущей оптимизации.QA наше всеПозже я перешёл к клиенту на Windows. Больше всего времени там съела работа с ОЗУ. Открыл текстовый чат, посмотрел ролик, вернулся, включил и выключил камеру. Приложение стало кушать больше памяти. Сделал ещё круг — потребление снова выросло.При работе с C++ это был, конечно, ожидаемый исход. Возможность управлять ресурсами у тебя есть, но нужно пройти буквально каждое действие. Пользователь поставил ролик на паузу — думай, как выгружать это дело из памяти и что там может еще остаться. Выключил камеру, продолжая говорить — что должно закончить работу, а что ещё нужно звонку? И так во всем. Например, показательный случай был с камерой и показом экрана. Пять раз включили и выключили их в одном звонке. После пятого раза потребление разрослось до 305,8 МБ. Видео давно выключено, а программа продолжает держать память, которая понадобилась для его отправки. Оказалось, что та часть, которая отвечает за сжатие видео перед отправкой, зависала в памяти. После фикса в том же сценарии получили 30,3 МБ.С роликами в чате тот же принцип. При воспроизведении память растёт, а на паузе клиент освобождает декодер и сохраняет позицию, чтобы потом продолжить. Поэтому расход снижается уже после паузы. Мне было важно, чтобы тяжёлая часть функции заканчивала работу вместе с действием пользователя. В какой-то момент я и правда превратился в тестировщика. Нон-стопом заходил, выходил, включал, выключал, смотрел на цифры и пытался вспомнить, после какого именно клика потребление ОЗУ не вернулось к исходным значениям. Потому что все эти сценарии ИИ за меня продумать не могла. Но может я плохо просил...Спустя некоторое время голосовой звонок вообще показывал 19,9 МБ. На стенде считали частный рабочий набор — физическую память, принадлежащую процессам Nimbo. Но в реальности, вне стенда, 25–30 МБ — это наверное то, чего стоит ожидать.Настало время всё ломатьПроверка безопасности оказалась для меня одним из самых интересных занятий за всю разработку сего чуда. Я вообще люблю искать какие-то обходные пути, хаки, разбираться, что-то поломать, найти лазейку. Часть моделей я запускал локально на своём компьютере. Знакомил с нужной частью архитектуры, придумывал конкретную цель и гипотезу обхода и отправлял пару бедолаг-агентов её проверять на тестовом стенде. Оперативки немного, поэтому работал небольшими задачами. Например, так я нашел что анонимный выход мог полностью перезаписать базу. Я думаю там еще много чего можно накопать в плане безопасности. И это уже лежит пачкой задач в моем бэклоге)Что хочу сделать дальшеПервым делом — рисование поверх демонстрации экрана, как это реализовано в Zoom. Когда объясняешь другу, что нажать, чтобы игра заработала, очень хочется просто обвести нужное место. Ещё нужен игровой оверлей, чтобы видеть, кто в комнате и кто говорит. Упрощение запуска своего сервера. Было бы здорово поднять его прямо из приложения на компьютере одного из друзей и собраться без аренды VPS если железо позволяет. Клиент для Mac, возможно, для Android и более удобный интерфейс на небольших экранах. Планов, собственно, масса, потому что как продуктом мне уже нравится этим пользоваться.Как использовать?Nimbo бесплатна. Сервер, веб и клиент для Windows лежат в репозитории Nimbo. Можно взять, развернуть у себя, изучать, переделывать и делать всё, что, собственно, хочется. Код проекта распространяется по MIT. Я делаю это в первую очередь для себя и для таких же компаний друзей. Если будете делать свой клиент, мне бы хотелось сохранить совместимость с профилем .nimbo, чтобы человек мог забрать свои настройки и доступы с собой и применить в другой компании.На этом спасибо, что дочитали. Буду рад критике, мыслям и впечатлениям — и от самого Nimbo, и от этой истории.
