gh-1440373375.title: GitHub - springah/zuma_recomp: Zuma (Xbox 360/XBLA) static recompilation for PC on the ReXGlue SDK -- boots to the title screen; no game data included
gh-1440373375.content:
⚠️ Disclaimer — built with heavy use of AI. The recompilation, port code,
tooling, and documentation in this repo were developed largely with the assistance
of AI coding tools (large language models). It's a hobby project: verify things
yourself before relying on them, and expect rough edges. No warranty.

A static recompilation of Zuma (PopCap / Oberon Media, Xbox 360 XBLA, 2005)
for native PC execution, built on the ReXGlue SDK
(a Xenia-derived runtime + PPC→C++ recompiler).
Status: early, but it plays. On Windows with the Xenos D3D12 renderer the
port boots to the title and runs past it. Tested so far (2026-11-20, keyboard
only):

Adventure: stage select, the instruction pages and the first level —
aiming, shooting, matches, scoring and losing a life all work.
Gauntlet: plays through to its Game Over screen.
Menus: the main menu, pause menu, Options (both volume sliders, which are
saved) and Help work; Return to Arcade closes the game cleanly.
Achievements: the menu entry opens the achievements list (the D-pad or
left stick scrolls, B closes it).

Not tested yet: finishing a level, anything after the first level, and a real
controller. Known gap: Leaderboards only shows the game's own "Xbox Live
members only" message.
Three bugs have been fixed on the way: an FP-exception crash on host-side
threads (SDK fork), a libjpeg setjmp/longjmp round trip (routed through the
SDK's host jmp_buf), and a crash on exit when the game quits itself (SDK
fork) — plus the host VSync fix shared with the sibling ports (present_vsync).
Latest release: v0.1.3 (Windows), a pre-release bundle attached to the
GitHub release.
It contains no game data: unzip it and follow RUN.txt inside to add your own
package. The older v0.1.1 crashes on the way out when you choose Return to
Arcade or start it without game files; use v0.1.3. See
CHANGELOG.md.
No copyrighted game files are included. This tree excludes the extracted game
directory, default.xex, images and build outputs — you supply your own legally
obtained Zuma XBLA package. See Legal below.
This is one of a family of Xbox 360 recomps built on the ReXGlue SDK; zuma pins a
tagged SDK release as a submodule, like its sibling ports (daytona, futari, gh,
guwange, sdoj, sotn). Per-OS build and packaging notes are in PORTS.md.
Prerequisites

Tool
Version
Notes

CMake
3.25+

Ninja
any
winget install Ninja-build.Ninja

LLVM / clang
20+
Standalone LLVM; zuma builds with the clang++ (GNU) driver targeting the MSVC ABI

Python
3
runs scripts/extract_game.py

Git + Bash
any
scripts/regen.sh is a bash script

Windows: the clang++ build targets x86_64-pc-windows-msvc, so it needs the
MSVC headers/libs + Windows SDK on INCLUDE/LIB (a "x64 Native Tools" command
prompt sets these, or let build.ps1 enter one for you).
Linux: Clang 20+, GTK3 dev headers (libgtk-3-dev / gtk3), and X11/XCB
interop (libx11-xcb-dev / libx11 / libX11-devel). The SDK renders via XCB;
on Wayland, XWayland must be running.
Game files
Zuma on Xbox 360 is an XBLA title delivered as a single LIVE/STFS content
package. On your console's storage it sits at
Content\0000000000000000\584107EF\000D0000\<40 hex digits> (a file with no
extension whose first four bytes read LIVE). Copy that file into game/ and
extract it from the repository root:
python3 scripts/extract_game.py
This unpacks the package into extracted/ (the runtime game data, passed via
--game_data_root) and copies the shell executable to assets/default.xex (the
codegen input). game/, extracted/, and assets/ are gitignored. On Windows,
dragging the package onto extract_game.bat does the same, except that it
unpacks everything into assets/ beside the executable (the release-bundle layout).
The package this tree was prepared against: title ID 584107EF, 27557888 bytes,
sha256 10026be53823dcf3bf9718850cfa1802a2b1c6430d1847e3c89c74371e1d45b6
(default.xex 4038656 bytes).
Build
The short road (Windows): build.ps1
git clone -c core.symlinks=true --recurse-submodules https://github.com/springah/zuma_recomp
cd zuma_recomp
.\build.ps1 -GameSource "D:\path\to\your\content\package" -Run
build.ps1 (or a double-click on build.bat) does steps 1–4 below in one go:
it fetches missing submodules and repairs libmspack's symlinks, installs any
missing tool through winget, enters the x64 developer environment, builds the
ReXGlue CLI, extracts your package into extracted/ + assets/default.xex
(skipped when both already exist), runs scripts/regen.sh, and builds the
win-amd64-release preset. -Config Debug or RelWithDebInfo picks another
preset; -NoInstall reports missing tools instead of installing them.
1. Clone (SDK included)
git clone -c core.symlinks=true --recurse-submodules https://github.com/springah/zuma_recomp
The ReXGlue SDK is a submodule at thirdparty/rexglue-sdk, pinned at a tagged
release (currently v0.9.2 plus six commits, branch zuma/fpscr-host-threads of the
springah/rexglue-sdk fork; see PORTS.md). To develop against a live SDK checkout
instead, set REXSDK_DIR at configure time; when unset, the build uses the submodule.

Windows: clone with -c core.symlinks=true (as above) or the SDK's
libmspack submodule checks out its symlinks as plain text files and the build
fails in lzxd.c.

2. Build the ReXGlue CLI (for codegen)
cmake --preset win-amd64 -S thirdparty/rexglue-sdk -B thirdparty/rexglue-sdk/out/build/win-amd64
cmake --build thirdparty/rexglue-sdk/out/build/win-amd64 --config Release --target rexglue
# -> thirdparty/rexglue-sdk/out/win-amd64/Release/rexglue.exe (regen.sh finds it
# automatically, falling back to a ../rexglue-sdk sibling build)
3. Regenerate the recompiled code
scripts/regen.sh
This runs rexglue codegen zuma_manifest.toml, emitting generated/
(rexglue.cmake + generated/default/ with the recompiled C++). zuma is a
single-module title, so this is one codegen pass. Function-entry seeds the
analyzer can't discover on its own go in zuma_functions.toml. generated/ is
gitignored.
4. Configure & build
cmake --preset win-amd64-release # or linux-amd64-release / mac-arm64-release
cmake --build --preset win-amd64-release
out/build/win-amd64-release/zuma.exe --game_data_root=extracted
A zuma.ini is written next to the executable on first run (display, graphics,
storage and log settings).
Legal
This repository contains no game data. The recompiled output in generated/ is
derived from your own copy of default.xex and is gitignored. Zuma is a trademark
of PopCap Games / Electronic Arts; this project is not affiliated with or endorsed
by PopCap, EA, Oberon Media or Microsoft. Port code is licensed under the
BSD 3-Clause License (see LICENSE).

tnsoc9.title: Experimental compound burns fat without sacrificing muscle
tnsoc9.content:
A new approach to weight loss could help the body burn more fat while preserving muscle, potentially overcoming one of the major drawbacks of existing obesity treatments. Researchers at the University of California, Berkeley, have identified a compound that increases the amount of energy the body uses rather than simply reducing how much food a person eats.
In experiments with mice, the compound improved blood sugar regulation, reduced harmful blood fats, and helped obese animals lose fat without a significant reduction in lean muscle mass. It also increased energy expenditure by up to 18%, even though the mice did not become more physically active or experience an increase in body temperature.
The findings, published in Science Advances, suggest a promising new direction for treating obesity, diabetes, and fatty liver disease. The experimental compound also appeared to enhance the benefits of popular weight-loss medications such as Ozempic and Wegovy when the treatments were used together. However, its effectiveness and safety have not yet been established in humans.
A Different Approach to Weight Loss Than Ozempic
Over the past five years, medications known as GLP-1 drugs have transformed the treatment of obesity and other metabolic conditions, including diabetes and fatty liver disease. Drugs marketed as Ozempic, Wegovy, Mounjaro, and Zepbound have helped many patients achieve substantial weight loss while improving their ability to regulate blood sugar.
Despite these benefits, the medications have important limitations. Nausea and other digestive problems can make treatment difficult for some patients. Because these drugs reduce appetite and food consumption, they can also increase the risk of inadequate nutrition and loss of muscle mass. Over time, losing too much muscle can contribute to weakness, frailty, and other health complications.
Berkeley researchers wanted to investigate a fundamentally different strategy. Rather than focusing on reducing calorie intake, they explored whether it would be possible to increase the amount of energy the body burns.

This process, known as energy expenditure, includes the calories used to maintain basic bodily functions, regulate metabolism, and support everyday activities. Increasing energy expenditure could potentially help people lose weight without relying exclusively on eating less.
"Body weight responds to two levers: taking in fewer calories, or spending more energy," said Anders Näär, a professor of metabolic biology and nutrition at UC Berkeley and senior author of the study. "GLP-1s work almost entirely on the first, so we went after the second."
A Compound That Burns Fat While Preserving Muscle
The researchers focused on a molecule called 5-tetradecyloxy-2-furoic acid (TOFA), which has an unusual combination of effects on the body's metabolism.
TOFA interferes with the production of lipids, a broad category of fatty substances that includes cholesterol and triglycerides. These molecules serve important functions, but excessive levels of certain lipids can contribute to metabolic disorders and cardiovascular disease.
At the same time, TOFA activates genes involved in taking up and burning fat for energy. This combination allows the compound to influence both how the body produces fat and how it uses fat as fuel.

In mice, treatment with TOFA produced several encouraging results. The animals became more sensitive to insulin, the hormone that helps move glucose from the bloodstream into cells. Improved insulin sensitivity makes it easier for the body to control blood sugar, an important benefit for people with diabetes or insulin resistance.
The compound also lowered triglyceride levels and improved characteristics of fatty liver disease, a condition in which excess fat accumulates inside liver cells and can eventually interfere with liver function.
Perhaps most notably, obese mice treated with TOFA lost weight primarily through reductions in body fat, without experiencing significant losses of lean muscle mass. This distinction could be especially valuable because maintaining muscle is important for strength, mobility, and long-term metabolic health.
How TOFA Increases Energy Burning by 18%
Although TOFA was originally discovered in the 1970s, the new research uncovered additional properties that could make it particularly useful for treating metabolic disease.
The compound belongs to a group of substances known as ACC inhibitors. These compounds interfere with enzymes that help the body manufacture fatty acids, effectively slowing the production of certain fats.
Other ACC inhibitors have previously advanced to mid-stage clinical trials, but none has been approved to treat metabolic diseases. One major obstacle has been an unexpected side effect: many of these compounds increase triglycerides in the blood, potentially raising the risk of heart problems.
The Berkeley team discovered that TOFA does more than inhibit ACC. It also activates two cellular receptors called PPARα and PPARδ, which help regulate the genes responsible for fat metabolism.
These receptors function as molecular switches. When activated, they stimulate processes that allow cells to absorb fatty acids and break them down to produce energy. In effect, TOFA simultaneously reduces the production of certain fats and encourages the body to burn fat that is already available.
In mice, this activity increased energy expenditure by as much as 18%, without requiring additional physical activity or raising body temperature. Unlike other ACC inhibitors, TOFA also did not cause triglyceride levels to rise, potentially because of its additional effects on fat metabolism.
"TOFA appears to engage a coordinated metabolic response," said study first author Justin Y. Lee, a postdoctoral student at UCSF who conducted the research as a Ph.D. student at Berkeley. "It is not simply blocking lipid synthesis. It is also activating energy expenditure pathways that may help the body handle excess lipid and glucose more effectively."
To understand whether these effects could be reproduced with separate treatments, the scientists gave mice a combination of two different compounds. One blocked lipid production, while the other stimulated energy expenditure.
Surprisingly, this two-compound approach was less effective at improving overall metabolic health than TOFA alone. The finding suggests that TOFA's ability to influence multiple metabolic processes through a single molecule may be an important part of its effectiveness.
Could TOFA Make Ozempic and Wegovy More Effective?
The researchers also investigated whether TOFA could improve the results of existing GLP-1 medications.
They tested the compound alongside semaglutide, the active ingredient in Ozempic and Wegovy, as well as tirzepatide, which is marketed as Mounjaro and Zepbound.
These medications primarily help people lose weight by reducing appetite and food intake. TOFA, by contrast, targets the other side of the energy balance equation by increasing how much energy the body expends.
When the researchers combined TOFA with these medications in mice, the results were more favorable than those produced by either treatment alone. The combinations led to greater improvements in body weight, blood glucose regulation, insulin levels, and triglycerides.
This suggests that treatments targeting calorie intake and energy expenditure could potentially work together to produce stronger metabolic benefits.
"In our combination experiments, TOFA worked additively or synergistically with the GLP-1 appetite-suppressing drugs, so we view it as complementary rather than as a replacement," Näär said.
In other words, the researchers do not necessarily envision TOFA replacing medications such as Ozempic or Wegovy. Instead, it could eventually become an additional treatment that helps address obesity and related metabolic conditions through a different biological mechanism.
A Promising Discovery, but Human Trials Are Still Needed
Despite the encouraging results, the researchers emphasize that TOFA remains an experimental compound. All the findings so far come from animal studies, and scientists have not yet established whether it is safe or effective in humans.
Further research will be necessary to determine whether the same metabolic improvements can be achieved in people and whether the treatment could offer meaningful advantages over existing medications.
To help move the research toward potential clinical applications, the Berkeley scientists have established a biotechnology company called ReRx Therapeutics. The effort has received support from the university's life sciences entrepreneurship network, including Nucleate and Berkeley SkyDeck.
If the findings eventually translate to humans, TOFA could represent an important addition to the growing range of treatments for obesity and diabetes. By encouraging the body to use more energy while helping preserve muscle, the compound points toward a potentially different way to achieve healthier weight loss.
The research was funded through discretionary resources provided by UC Berkeley, with additional support from the UCSF Liver Center and the University of Michigan Animal Phenotyping Core.
Additional authors include Chi Zhu, Melissa A. Boldridge, Rachelle L. Stark, Lei Xu, Federico Gonzalez, Xin Tang, Kaitlyn T. Dang and Kook Son of Berkeley; Gracia Bonilla, Kashish Chetal and Ruslan I. Sadreyev of Massachusetts General Hospital; Kosuke Watari and Michael Karin of the University of California, San Diego; Christina Papa and Bilal N. Sheikh of the Helmholtz Center Munich; Prabha Ibrahim of ReRx Therapeutics.

13n1evx.title: How to see if your bargain SD card or USB drive is fake on Ubuntu
13n1evx.content:
F3 (Fight Flash Fraud) is an open-source tool to check if a USB drive or SD card has the capacity it claims on the label. If you’ve used h2testw on Windows, this does the same thing on Linux.

Memory card and USB drive prices have more than doubled this year, and that makes cheaper listings more tempting. But buying low-cost storage has always carried a risk of fakes (not to mention low-quality or slow chips).

Dodgy brands and marketplace sellers often sell drives whose capacity is below what the labels says. Your computer falls for the trick, done in the storage device’s controller, and reports the falsified value, say, 512GB, even if it’s really only 32GB.

You only find out it’s fake when a file you thought you’d saved won’t open. Because most of these fake drives carry on accepting files even when it has nowhere to put them (it bins off what it can’t hold or writes over data it does hold), you won’t notice during transfer.

A Windows developer, peeved with countless counterfeit capacities, created h2testw in 2008 to help others detect the phoney flash.

If you need an h2testw alternative for Linux, F3 implements the same test algorithm in an open-source package, albeit lacking a GUI.

Install F3 on Ubuntu

F3 can be installed with one command on Ubuntu (Linux Mint, Zorin OS, et al):

sudo apt install f3

But as F3 is a set of command line utilities, not a desktop app with a GUI, you won’t find a shortcut for it in the application launcher.

F3 gives you two ways to check a drive.

You can use f3write and f3read in sequence. The first will fills your drive’s remaining free space with test files and the second verifies that all the data that should be there is. This method is a bit slower overall, and may increase write wear.

Working a bit faster is f3probe. This tests the drive directly, writing data in a different way to tell you if the capacity the controller reports is legit. This tool is more useful on larger storage devices (it can take a while to write 256 1GB files).

Regardless of which tool you try, if you are testing a device with contents you can’t afford to lose, copy off anything you want to keep before you begin – don’t just nod and think “sure”; do it just in case.

Do not COPY any example drive paths as yours will be different.

Run a quick check with f3probe

Checking for a fake USB drive on Linux

Plug your device in and make a note of its drive path via lsblk.

When using f3probe you need to pass it the full device path, not a partition mount, e.g., you’d give it /dev/sdb rather than /dev/sdb1 or /dev/sdb2.

sudo f3probe /dev/xyz

The process of checking can take up to 15 minutes depending on the memory’s write speeds, but in most cases it should be fairly brisk. Leave it to do its thing and, once it’s done…

If your device is all it should be, f3probe confirms this in the terminal with a “good news” string:

Good news: The device `/dev/xyz' is the real thing

If not, you’ll see a string that says:

Bad news: The device `/dev/xyz' is a counterfeit of type limbo

The counterfeit output will also show a command you can run to “fix” the drive, which creates a partition for its actual size, no the size the reprogrammed storage controller reports.

Run a fuller check to verify

Read and write is slower, but thorough

You can use f3write followed by f3read for a thorough test of your drive’s capacity. This writes to and reads out every available block.

When you use f3write and f3read you need to give it the drive’s mount point (the folder it shows up as in your file manager). This is often something like /media/username/DRIVE, and not the /dev/ path you use for f3probe.

As aways, you can look at the output of lsblk to see this.

Open your terminal and run:

f3write /media/device/

The device’s remaining free space is filled with 1GB files, named something like N.h2w. The CLI shows a progress bar so you know how long it’ll be before it completes. This method can be slower than f3probe on large capacity devices.

Once the writes are done, run f3read on the same mount point:

f3read /media/device/

Now, f3read reads those files back and checks them against what was written. Anything the drive discarded or overwrote to ‘pretend’ it’s larger than it is shows up as damaged or corrupted.

Once done, delete the test files off your device to get the space back.

And if the drive is fake?

If you see a different value to the one you’d expect… Well, I hope you kept the receipt or can claim a refund, as you haven’t received what you thought you’d bought.

If you want to keep the drive, but have its true value shown, the f3fix tool can create a partition that reflects the real capacity. The command to run for this is shown in the output of f3probe, but only if a counterfeit drive is detected.

Even so, it would be wise not to rely on a counterfeit card or stick if the capacity is off, as it’s more than likely the quality of the flash chips holding data is iffy too.

ave you been caught out by a fake-capacity drive or card? Drop what happened—and how you spotted it—in the comments

Jump over the fence, and either stealth around to the car, or start blasting.Whichever way you do it, once you have the ’82 Crawler, gun it through the gate, and head back to Moses.Once you get the car, head back to Moses and drop it off. That’s it! You’ve completed Daily Driver. This mission is an introduction to getting specific cars for Moses. As the game progresses, Moses will send you locations of special cars that you can steal and return to him.These cars never give much money, especially considering you have to break into somewhere secure in order to get them, but it’s still worth it during Chapter 2 when Lucia and Jason are down on their luck.This same mission format returns in the game’s next chapter, this time with supercars.

1hnb09q.title: Google’s 3D emoji has wild Android spec requirements: 10GB of free space, 6GB RAM
1hnb09q.content:
Google introduced 3D emoji on Pixel this year, and has just detailed the minimum specifications required to get them on your Android phone.

Noto 3D emoji goes from vector-based 2D emoji to a high-resolution bitmap font. This results in “high-resolution designs” for emoji “with more texture and dimension to characters and icons.” Google has an FAQ section about why the new emoji might look low resolution: 

Vector vs. bitmap rendering: Older Android emoji used 2D vector graphics, which scale infinitely to any size without losing resolution. The 3D emoji are bitmap graphics, which are pre-rendered pixel-based images. When these images are scaled up by an app or zoomed in, the pixels stretch, which can cause a softer or lower-resolution appearance.

The Google support article published this week lists the minimum specs your Android device must have to get 3D emoji:

Run Android 17 or later.

Be from supported manufacturers receiving system or Google Play services updates.

Have at least 6 GB of RAM

Have at least 128 GB of total storage & 10 GB of available space.

The last two bullet points are rather surprising. In fact, Google even lists instructions for checking how much memory and storage your device has: 

Check your RAM (Memory):

Open the Settings app and search for “RAM” or “Memory.”

Tap SystemDeveloper optionsMemory.

On some phones, you may have to tap Device care Memory.

Your device must have 6 GB of RAM or higher to use the 3D emoji.

Check your device storage:

Open the Settings app and search for “Storage.”

Tap Storage

Check your total storage and available space:

Total storage: Your device must have 128 GB of storage or higher

Available space: Your device must have at least 10 GB of available space

In terms of availability, Google says a supported device will “automatically download the 3D emoji when it’s on Wi-Fi and charging.”

At this time, there isn’t a way to force download the emoji.

Google announced 3D emoji in May, with the new design shipping on the Pixel 11 in August. It has since arrived on older Pixel devices.

In terms of OEM availability, Google explicitly says “Samsung devices use a proprietary emoji font and do not receive the 3D font update.” Additionally: 

This is also true for third-party messaging apps, such as WhatsApp, who use their own emoji fonts rather than relying on your device’s system font.

gh-1359485937.content:
The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+, playable in a browser tab.

This is the real Repentance+ game code, recompiled from the Windows executable
to WebAssembly. It's not a remake and not an emulator, so every item, synergy
and bug works the way it does on PC.
It runs on desktop and on phones, keeps your saves in the browser, and can
install mods from the game's own MODS menu.
On a phone

There are no extra buttons on screen; you play by touching the game.

Move, shoot
Left thumb, right thumb

Active item, card or pill, bomb
Tap it in the bar under the room

Swap items
Tap the small second item

Drop a card or trinket
Hold it

Map
Tap the minimap, or hold it to peek

Pause
The paper icon next to the map

Menus
Tap a row to pick it, tap it again to choose it; swipe to scroll

Back
The BACK note in the corner, or two fingers

Cutscenes
Tap to skip

Held upright, a pad under the picture also moves through the menus; tap it to
choose. Switching to another tab pauses the run.
Vibration follows the game's Rumble option.
On a keyboard

Key

W A S D
Move

← ↑ → ↓
Shoot

Space
Active item

Q
Card or pill

E
Bomb

Ctrl
Swap, hold to drop

Tab

Pause

F
Fullscreen

`
Debug console, in a run (the key left of 1), once it is switched on

The debug console is the game's own (stage 5, giveitem c1, debug 3...). It is
off until you ask for it: in the game's Options list, go down to Console and
turn it on like any other option. (It takes the place of Streamer Mode, which is for
online play and does nothing here.) With it on your save still earns its
achievements; a run in which you use it is the game's to judge, as on PC.
On a controller
Plug in a controller (USB or Bluetooth), press any button so the browser sees it,
and start the run with it: the game gives player one to whichever device starts
the run. Buttons are the Xbox layout, sticks are analog, and rumble follows the
game's Rumble option. On the MODS screen, X opens the mod browser.

Mods

Mods from the Steam Workshop run here too, Lua and all. Open the game's
MODS screen and click MOD BROWSER (press B, or tap it on a
phone): search the catalogue, read what each mod does, and install it. The game
restarts with the mod loaded. A mod you already have can be added from a
.zip.
Saves
Saves stay in the browser you play in. EDIT FILE on the file select screen
exports a save or imports one, including a .dat save from PC. Deleting a file
asks first.
Browsers
Chrome, Edge and other Chromium browsers, on desktop or Android. If your browser
can't run it, the page says so.

You need your own copy of the game; this repository has no game files in it.

y30rcm.title: How to make money in GTA 6
y30rcm.content: What is the best way to make money in GTA 6?GTA 6 is finally here and players around the world are getting a chance to jump in to the world of Grand Theft Auto 6 after 13 years. However in GTA 6, money isn’t easy to get early in the game, and as such players have been looking for a way to make money fast in GTA 6.In this guide we’ll list the best ways to make money and GTA 6 from early game stick-ups which you can do almost from the start of the game, to later-game bank robberies which will yield the highest rewards but are also the most difficult.If you are enjoying GTA 6 you should check out our GTA 6 Guides Hub and make sure you bookmark it. We will be updating that hub every day for the forseble future with new guides new walkthroughs and everything you need to know about Grand Theft Auto 6.Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to check out our complete walkthrough hub, featuring beginner tips, navigation experience explained, GTA 6 cheats, and more.How to make money in GTA 6Stick-UpsRobbing groceries stores in Grand Theft Auto 6 is one of the fastest ways to make money though you might not make a lot of it. Every groceries store in the game can be robbed. You can do this by going up to the cashier and sticking them up with a weapon. To do this approach, the cashier and hold the L2 button.This will aim your gun at the cashier without firing however at this point you can now interact with the cashier and threaten them which will cause them to open the cash register. You won’t get a lot of cash doing it this way, however there is little police response when you rob groceries stores. Some grocery stores also have a safe in the back room or you can access by kicking down the door or forcing the employee to open it for you.If that safe has a code you can often find the code on a post-it note located near the safe, or you can threaten the employee and you will get an option to ask them about the safe code. Eventually the police will be contacted and they will turn up at the store but by that point you should be long gone.It’s also worth noting that a lot of grocery stores have secret rooms of that sometimes include gang activity. you can tell if one of the grocery stores has a secret room by checking the minimap if there is a room that you haven’t accessed yet try picking the lock off the door or going back outside and checking another entrance.Gang Hideouts and DrugsWhen you first get the ability to sell drugs, you can start robbing gang hideouts which often contain large amounts of  various drugs that sell for a lot of money. This is by far one of the best ways to make money in GTA 6. The type of drug that the gang hideout is hiding has a huge effect on what it is worth for example things like weed are fairly cheap, but things like crystal and cocaine are far more expensive.You will know you are near a gang hideout because when will drive past and a yellow icon will appear on your map. At this point it is worth checking out what is there and if you check on the map you can also see the valuables that are available and that gang hideoutIf you steal drugs from a gang hideout you will have to physically take them to somewhere that you can sell them. However, later in the game if you do a lot of drug selling, some buyers will allow you to drop the drugs and a garage. Keep in mind, however, they will arrange a pick up and this means they will take a bigger cut of the money.Pawn Shops and Jewelry StoresRobbing jewellery stores and pawn shops is also a great way to make money in GTA 6. Howeverm these jewelry stores and pawn shops often have a high level of security so you are going to want to do some reconnaissance before you attempt to rob them.A lot of jewelry shops can be accessed from the back of the shop, where you will also be able to disable their security systems or if they have CCTV camera footage,  you can destroy it.  Doing this will delay the response time of the police, which is important because stealing from jewelry shops or pawn shops gets you a higher wanted level than stealing from a grocery store.Main Story MissionsOne of the best ways to make money and Grand Theft Auto 6 is by completing main story missions. Often these main story missions will give you a big chunk of cash, so it’s worth doing as many of them as you can.This also applies to side missions which often provide you with a lot of cash. Just remember to take it to the bank to put in your account or it could be a lost if you are arrested or die. If you don’t have a bank account yet, check out our guide to Buck Me. Selling CarsAnother great way to make money in GTA 6 is to sell cars. You will gain the ability to sell cars to Moses when you reach chapter 2 of GTA 6. He will take cars that do not have a tracker on them. On average you will get between $1000 and $5,000 dollars per car that you sell to Moses.After you sell a car to Moses there is a cooldown period where you can no longer sell cars to him however if you sleep at the safe house this cooldown period will elapse. Later in the game you can sell higher value cars to another prominent side character that is introduced and a later chapter .Bank RobberiesThe ultimate way to make money and Grand Theft Auto 6 is to rob a banks.  You won’t be able to rob banks straight away, in fact you will have to wait until you get the dye pack jammer during a mission where you rob a bank with a prominent side character. After this, you can rob banks whenever you like and it is by far the easiest way to make a huge amount of money in the game.Bank robberies are split up into several sections. There are basic cash drawers which you can get by threatening the tellers, there are safe which hide large numbers of marked bills, and then there are the bank vaults which house the largest amounts of money and in the game.With that being said, because of the amount of money you can get from robbing a bank, actually robbing a bank is also one of the most difficult things to do in the game. The police response is huge as soon as they are called so make sure you’re escape plan is well fought through because you will have a huge wanted level from the second that you leave the bank.

1h71w1r.title: GTA 6 Moses Mission Walkthrough
1h71w1r.content: Moses is the twenty-seventh mission in GTA 6.A Lucia solo mission, Moses allows Lucia to register her own car, now that Jason’s car is probably on fire, or at the  very least, being driven by Dolores. Moses also gives Lucia the Slim Jim, which is an item vital to stealing cars. So read on and find out all you need to know about Moses in GTA 6.This walkthrough is part of our GTA 6 Guide Hub. Walkthroughs, tips and tricks and much more can be found there.Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to check out our complete walkthrough hub, featuring beginner tips, navigation experience explained, GTA 6 cheats, and more.GTA 6 Moses WalkthroughThis mission kicks off with Lucia needing  to get a new car. While the game heavily implies that you should take the car outside the tech shop, you can actually get any car you want, as long as it doesn’t have a tracker.Pick a vehicle, and take it to Moses Watkins, who has a garage on the outskirts of the town. Once there, drive into the garage and speak to Moses. After the cutscene, you’ll head to the back of the garage, and learn how to scan cars using the WainkIt app.By doing this, you can find out if a car has a tracker, and how much it’s worth to the various garages that will buy cars. Moses won’t take a car that has an alarm. Later in the game you’ll unlock the ability to register cars with trackers, from another character.Then, grab a Slim Jim, which is an item for breaking into cars. After Moses gives you the Slim Jim, break into the Montagne XL. You’ll now be able to silently break into cars, as long as they aren’t keyless cars. Keyless cars are primarily high end supercars and hypercars.Follow Moses back into his garage, and he’ll register Lucia’s new car for her. He’ll also add the Scooter Bros app to your phone. With the Scooter Bros app, you can have any of the cars you have registered to you dropped off, as long as you are near somewhere with a road.That’s the end of Moses in GTA 6. Well, not the end of Moses, he’s still kicking a ball.

dsz7bn.title: Jennifer Hale says she ‘felt sad when BioWare was sold to EA’
dsz7bn.content: Jennifer Hale says she “felt sad” when BioWare was acquired by EA in 2007.Speaking with GamesRadar+, Hale reflected on her time with BioWare, and suggested she always thought the studio was a poor fit for EA.“I initially felt sad when BioWare was sold to EA because there was a spirit at BioWare that I believe endured for quite a long time, all the way till the theoretical closure,” Hale said. “But I missed the maverick. I missed the brave solo indie company that just kicked ass.”She added that she was amongst those worried for BioWare after EA was acquired by a group of investors, led by the Saudi Arabian investment fundHale went on to say that she would like EA to sell the rights to Mass Effect to a collective of fans, who could then open up the licence to third-party projects.“I think it would be incredibly smart on EA’s part to settle on a reasonable, fair price for the IP that respects the fact that it’s not a wealthy corporation buying it. It’s a collective,” Hale continued.“You know, EA, you can’t buy that kind of publicity. You cannot buy that kind of goodwill. The love that people and appreciation people would have for you for a long time, and the hats off to you would be invaluable.”Hale’s work with BioWare dates back to the late 1990s, as she first appeared in the original Baldur’s Gate. This began a long relationship with the Canadian studio, with Hale then appearing in most of BioWare’s major releases. Her roles include Bastila in Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic, Krem in Dragon Age: Inquisition, and, of course, female Commander Shepard in the Mass Effect trilogy.EA shuttered BioWare last month, cancelling a new Mass Effect game in the process. Since then, fans have been campaigning to save the series. Former figures from BioWare have expressed an interest in trying to secure their old IPs.

5xpwog.title: Meta’s new Muse Charm device may cost $300
5xpwog.content:
Meta plans to charge $300 for Muse Charm, its upcoming Tamagotchi-like AI device that was teased at the company’s Connect event earlier this year, The Information has reported.

When reached for comment by TechCrunch, a Meta spokesperson didn’t deny the claims, merely providing the following statement: “We’re charmed by the interest in our AI devices, and we’ll have more to share soon.”

So far, Meta has made a relatively successful push into consumer AI, launching Muse — its agentic helper — along with a variety of cute avatars that users can use to give the system more of a personality.

Muse Charm, the company’s push into AI hardware, will allow users to carry a physical personification of its software around in their pocket (or potentially wear it around their neck), talking to it, asking it questions, and giving it commands.

It remains to be seen whether customers will bite or not. AI wearables have had a rough go of it so far (here’s looking at you, Humane Ai pin), but companies continue to iterate on the concept in an attempt to break through to a broader audience.

Indeed, $300 is arguably a pretty steep price for a product the size of a keychain, although it’s also a price point that’s in line with what other companies have been charging. The wearable launched by Friend — the AI startup whose device lets you text and talk to an AI persona — is currently retailing for $250. On the other hand, Amazon’s all-new Bee Frontier wearable AI device — which transcribes conversations and tracks tasks — lists for $75 and is currently on a Black Friday, 30% off sale of $52.49. Even with its $99/year subscription to let it tie into a user’s apps (photos, emails, etc.), it’s still far less expensive than Muse Charm.

krr1mz.title: Valve Makes Steam Machine 512GB Available for Direct Purchase And Closes 2TB Waitlist - Steam Deck HQ
krr1mz.content:
If you haven’t yet, follow us on X (Twitter), Mastodon, or Bluesky to know when we post new articles, and join our Reddit or Subscribe to us on YouTube to check out our content and interact with our awesome community. Thank you for supporting us!

Valve, like most other tech companies, has been largely impacted by the hardware component shortages. Because of that, we have seen rises in prices for the Steam Deck and Steam Machine, as well as periods of time when hardware was sold out. And now, as prices continue to rise, it seems as though the Steam Machine is facing another hurdle, and it’s forcing Valve to change their plans for the machine.

In an update posted earlier today, Valve has mentioned that while they have fulfilled all the reservations for the 512GB model, they are continuing to encounter supply constraints for hardware components, which is severely impacting the 2TB model. Because of that, there are more people on the waitlist than units that are available. They mentioned again that being waitlisted doesn’t guarantee a unit, but because of the constraints, they’re closing the waitlist to additional sign-ups.

No, the silver lining is that we can directly purchase a 512GB model without needing to wait any longer. So, if you’re okay with less storage, you can switch over to the 512GB, but Valve also mentioned that even if they can start building again, it will be in smaller quantities than before. And as for the 512GB model, the waitlist has been eliminated completely. So, when the units are gone, it will show an out-of-stock notice rather than a waitlist.

As someone who purchased the 512GB model, I can’t say that it’s worth it. I really enjoy using the Steam Machine, and another one of our writers loved it so much that they decided to sell their RTX 5090 PC because of it. It is a shame that the component shortages and pricing increases caused by AI company demands are affecting this so much, but it’s an unfortunate, unavoidable circumstance that we can’t get around. So, if you still want a Steam Machine, I highly recommend picking up a 512GB model right now while the supplies last.

q17okn.title: 2027 Volkswagen Golf GTI Rabbit Edition Changes More Than Looks
q17okn.content: Volkswagen has announced a limited-production Rabbit Edition for the 2027 Golf GTI lineup. The special edition slots between the S and SE trims and gets DCC adaptive dampers, 19-inch wheels, and summer tires, in addition to its styling tweaks.The Rabbit Edition will be limited to the United States when it goes on sale in the second quarter of 2027, with exact pricing to be announced later. Do you ever find yourself yearning for the feeling you got the first time you drove the Mk 1 Volkswagen Rabbit? The diminutive VW helped usher the hot-hatch segment into the United States. Volkswagen can’t very well sell you a Mk 1 Rabbit any longer, so instead, the company unveiled a limited-production Rabbit Edition for the 2027 Golf GTI lineup.VolkswagenVolkswagenSpecifically, the Rabbit Edition is arriving for the 2027-½ model year as a sort of midyear update to the GTI lineup. The special edition will slot between the S and the SE in the GTI’s roster and will come with a handful of performance upgrades generally limited to the Autobahn trim. The Rabbit version adds DCC adaptive damping, rides on 19-inch wheels, and wears a set of summer tires, rather than the all-season tires that generally come with the S.As far as cosmetic changes go, the special edition opts for a blacked-out logo design over the Dark Moss Green Metallic paint, which includes a set of front and rear badges that VW pulled from the Golf R Black Edition’s parts bin. The logos are joined by a black grille, black headlight elements (which are typically red), black wheels, black mirror caps, and a black roof. The one badge that isn’t black is the chrome Rabbit badge on the rear, which serves as an homage to the original.VolkswagenThe Rabbit Edition will be limited to the United States when it goes on sale in the second quarter of next year. Exact pricing hasn’t been announced, but the Rabbit should cost somewhere between the $36,230 starting price of the S and the $40,420 starting price of the SE.➡️ Skip the lot. 1gldogo.title: What’s With All These Outages?
1gldogo.byline: Brian Barrett, Leah Feiger, Sophie Kleeman
1gldogo.content: Nov 19, 2026 4:57 PMThis week on Uncanny Valley, we discuss the outages that have swept digital life over the past week, where new money from Anthropic’s IPO is going, and the AI chip world post–Jensen Huang.Photo-Illustration: WIRED Staff; Getty ImagesMicrosoft, the FAA, Chase, United, the NSA, and Apple all went down within one week. Officials say none of the outages were cyberattacks, but the internet isn’t buying it. This week on Uncanny Valley, WIRED senior business editor Sophie Kleeman joins Brian Barrett and Leah Feiger to discuss what actually went wrong and why people jumped straight to blaming hackers and AI. Plus, Anthropic’s historic IPO at a reported $1.5 trillion, Nvidia’s first earnings report since Jensen Huang resigned, and the administration’s new rule to stop Chinese companies from renting AI chips just before Trump meets Xi.Articles mentioned in this episode:Anthropic’s Record-Breaking IPO Highlights the AI Giant’s Worst Enemy—ItselfFAA Grounds All US Flights Until Further NoticeThe Microsoft Outage Is a Warning for the WorldThe Bank Outage May Have Nothing to Do With Your BankHow to Tell If It’s a Cyberattack or Just an OutageInside Nvidia’s First Post-Jensen All-Hands: Pay Raises and More EquityEven His Own Officials Don’t Think Trump’s China Trip Will Lead to Progress on AIYou can follow Brian Barrett on Bluesky at @brbarrett, Sophie Kleeman on X/Twitter at @sophiekleeman, and Leah Feiger on Bluesky at @leahfeiger. rupndq.title: Нескучные тесты локальных LLM
rupndq.content:
Уровень сложностиПростойВремя чтения14 минОхват и читатели2.2KВам наверное очень интересно (нет) зачем нужно дома собирать мощный комп, особенно если это второй. Мне тоже, поэтому я решил обзавестись таким чтобы ответить на этот вопрос. И бонусом тут на Хабре объявили стихийно сезон сборок на старых видеокартах, поэтому я влетаю в него с опозданием! Однако вместо очередного скучного обзора на хуанан и V100 мы зададимся другим вопросом — что же со всем этим добром делать. Особенно если ты не программист и даже не байтослесарь. Пара слов о сборкеСборка следующая:ПозицияТипЦена (доставка и пошлина)ОткудаAMD EPYC 7452ЦП12 920AliexpressHUANANZHI H12D 8DМатеринская плата34 858 (2500)AliexpressDDR4 16GB 2400 x 4ОЗУ18 966AliexpressNvidia V100 16GB SXM2 x2ГП27 862 (2000)AliexpressSamsung PM9A1 1000 GBSSD13 999DNSDeepcool Matrexx 70Корпус0у другаGigabyte ud850gm pg5 v2БП5000у другаИтого113 105Ещё сверху водянка вышла в 50 к. Не повторяйте моих ошибок, если без кастомной воды можно обойтись — обходитесь. Цены указаны на момент покупки так что можно пускать слезу, ведь это было всего полгода назад. Сейчас ещё едет 128 ГБ оперативки, позволит гонять glm 5.3 flash чуть быстрее.С игровым цветом чёрного чаяКоротко что почему. Epyc потому что 128 линий PCIe 4.0 и 8 каналов DDR4, причем за копейки. HUANANZHI H12D 8D, это единственная материнка под Epyc 2/3 поколения с 4 x16 слотами и адекватной ценой. Из альтернатив Supermicro h11ssl‑i, но там только 3 слота, плюс для поддержки 7xx2 нужна последняя ревизия и обновленный биос. Остальные варианты идут от 70 к. SSD я просто увидел цену в DNS и сразу поехал брать. Остальное довольно тривиально. Оперативка кстати спокойно разогналась до 2933.Реальных альтернатив платформе в ультра бюджетном сегменте нет. Недорого можно собраться на Intel C612, поменьше каналов памяти, PCIe всего 3.0, зато есть AVX-512, возможно при оффлоаде моделей на CPU это даст преимущество, но это не точно.Динамический мир локальных LLMПока у меня был claude на этом добре гонялось CFD, Depth Anything, SionnaRT, и прочие мегапроекты с их использованием, которые я уже забыл. Однако теперь claude нет, запариваться с обходом лень, да и осадочек остался, поэтому самое время запускать там локальные LLM чтобы слоперировали уже они. Остается только понять, смогут ли они. Скучные тесты типа сделай клон Minecraft, интерфейс Windows 11 уже были, поэтому надо погонять тесты оригинальнее и поближе к вайбкод реальности.Что такое вайбкод? Да брось, все знают что это такое, скажете вы, и будете не совсем правы. При разработке с ИИ есть два подхода: агнентная разработка и вайбкод. В чем разница? В агентной разработке вы работаете с агентом как сеньор с джуном, описываете задачу, что делать, как, подробное ТЗ, модели остается только следовать инструкциям. В вайбкоде — как менеджер: идёт формулировка уровня «Сделай зае хорошо». И вот если с первым модели справляются неплохо, то как получится со вторым, мы сейчас и выясним.Мир локального ИИ разивается стремительно, изначальный вариант статьи предполагал примерно такой формат, я потестирую на 2–3 задачах следующие модели:Gemma 4 26B‑A4BMuse Spark 30BQwen 3.8 27BБудет простой вердикт типа Qwen 3.8 что‑то может, остальные для вайбкода вообще не, страдаем дальше и всё такое, но пока я прокрастинировал написание статьи, появились проекты Strata и Maya, что позволило запускать Qwen 3.8 flash next (125B), GLM 5.3 flash (320B) и даже deepseek flash v4.1 1017 (763B) на этом железе. Оба проекта нацелены на эффективное использование ОЗУ и стриминг весов с SSD для инференса MoE моделей, что получается у них весьма и весьма неплохо.Поэтому шорт лист моделей для тестов следующий:Huihui‑Qwen3.8–27B‑abliterated (Q4_K)Qwen3.8-Flash‑Next‑GSQ‑RCO‑IQ3_XXSGLM-5.3-Flash‑Maya‑S24-IQ2_XXS_SПроизводительность моделей приблизительно такая:МодельPrefillDecodeQwen 3.8 27B800–100050–70Qwen 3.8 flash next500–140050–70GLM 5.3 flash200–60015–20Deepseek v4.1 flash180–2507–15Декод сильно зависит от типа задачи, mtp даёт ощутимое ускорение при написании кода. Deepseek формально работает, но скорость делает его неюзабельным, в тестах поэтому он не участвует.Инференс и харнессВыше упоминались Strata и Maya, инференс Qwen 3.8 flash next — Strata, GLM 5.3 flash — Maya. Их настроить успел opus, поэтому приводить тут конфиг не буду, спросите вашего ИИ агента! Qwen 3.8 27B запускается llama.cpp следующими аргументами:GGML_CUDA_P2P=1 NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=0 NCCL_P2P_LEVEL=SYS GGML_CUDA_ALLREDUCE=nccl \
~/src/llama.cpp-20261006/build/bin/llama-server \
--host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080 \
-m ~/models/qwen38/Huihui-Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated-Q4_K.gguf \
--mmproj ~/models/qwen38/mmproj-F16.gguf \
-ngl 999 -sm tensor -fa on \
-ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0 \
-c 196608 -b 4096 -ub 512 --parallel 1 --jinja \
-t 4 -tb 8 \
--spec-type draft-mtp --spec-draft-n-max 3 \
--reasoning-budget 16384 --reasoning-effort medium \
--image-min-tokens 1024 --image-max-tokens 4096Вместо харнесса был opencode 1.19, веб поиск searxng с duckduckgo через mcp. Разумеется все тестировали на Windows 10.Непосредственно тестыМодели настроены, харнесс готов, переходим к тестам. Здесь задача проверить что‑то менее стандартное чем уже было на хабре. Плюс не давать четкий план модели, а посмотреть на то как у них получится работать с нечетким ТЗ, а также выполнять несколько задач последовательно. Я стремился сделать задачи one‑shot. Если итеративно что‑то делать с LLM то шансы на успех повыше, но у тогда сравнение не очень честное да и потребует много времени. Наши тесты стремятся быть максимально неадекватными, поэтому пристегнитесь! Во всех промптах орфография сохранена!Читалка чата на ANSI CНачинаем с самых простых задач. Здесь проверяем способность модели разведать эндпоинт, изучить его формат, написать код на ANSI C, отладить его, отладить кроссплатформерную сборку под винду. ПромптЗадача создать консольную читалку для кукарекалки Радио Анонимус. Адрес anon.fm. Тебе необходимо на странице самосотятельно найти «кукарекалку» определить эндпоинт и его формат. При выводе сообщений в консоль необходимо визуально индетефицировать пользователей — раскрашивать ники уникальными индивидуальными цветами. Читалка должна иметь два режима: постоянный — автообновление и выдача новых сообщений и «once» выводит последние n сообщений и завершается.Стек приложения: ANSI C (C89), WolfSSL. Остальные библиотеки, при необходимости, по твоему усмотрению.Сборка: cmake на WSL2 (Ubuntu на нашей системе). Кроссплатформерная сборка под linux и windows.Все комментарии в коде пишутся на simplified technical english (asd‑ste100). По готовности сделай к проекту README.md на русском языке Результат:Все модели тут справились хорошо. Код рабочий, 27B потребовалось указать вручную что на винде не работает, остальные справились с 1 промпта. Визуально мне понравилось, у обоих Qwen формат получился похожий, GLM сделал оригинальнее. Здесь в тесты попали ещё и gemma 4 и muse spark. Краткий сравнительный анализ от ИИ:🏆 TL;DR — таблица лидеров (кто не зря ел электричество)МестоПроектСобралось?ЭндпоинтWolfSSLВердикт одной строкой🥇glmaya✅✅✅ верный✅ по‑настоящемуСтрогий C89 -Werror, настоящий парсер, честный дедуп, тесты, CA из буфера, линки→URL.🥈27 b✅✅ верный✅ по‑настоящемуВзрослый проект. Настоящий JSON‑парсер, честный дедуп, ~2200 строк. Пара скелетов в шкафу, но работает.🥉next✅✅ верный✅ по‑настоящемуКрепкий середнячок. Чище всех грузит CA, но парсер на соплях и дедуп течёт в долгую.4-еmuse❌✅ верный⚠️ есть, но выключенЭндпоинт нашёл, поля разложил — и на этом всё. Не собирается, TLS проверку отрубил, стек на 3.4 МБ.💩gemma❌❌ не тот❌ нет вообщеСкелет в костюме проекта. popen("curl ...") вместо WolfSSL, не тот URL, нет даже README.Итог: до рабочего бинаря доехали трое — glmaya, 27 b и next. muse правильно понял что читать, но не смог это собрать. gemma не понял ни что, ни чем.Оптимизация инференса на... ESP32Окей, на сишке модели писать умеют, а как насчет немножечко эмбеда? ESP32 это вполне себе боевая классика, но обучающих данных по нему много, надо взять что‑то менее очевидное. О, точно, ESP32S3 это на самом деле не WiFi SoC, это секретный DSP, причем один из самых эффективных по цене. Про его векторные инструкции уже известно меньше, поэтому надо использовать их для оптимизиации инференс движка esp32-ai (прим. — где‑то до коммита 97018d5 движок был на чистом C). Fable 5 осилил дать тут аж под 22–31 т/с, а на что способны локальные модели? ПромптВ рабочей папке лежит проект esp32-ai. Это проект инференса малой языковой модели на ESP32S3. Твоя задача ускорить инференс. Движок инференса в референсном проекте написан на чистом C, проект на arduino. Необходимо изучить проект, докачать необходимое если отсутствует, понять каким образом устроен движок инференса. Переписать этот движок на esp‑idf с использованием векторных инстукций ESP32S3, библиотеки esp‑dsp. В системе установлен IDF v6.0.1. Среда включается следующей командой: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe ‑NoExit ‑ExecutionPolicy Bypass ‑NoProfile ‑Command «& {. 'C:\Espressif\tools\Microsoft.v6.0.1.PowerShell_profile.ps1'}»Для тестирования подключена отладочная плата с ESP32S3 на порту COM12. Взаимодействие с ESP32 по UART, не использовать WiFi. Сделать CLI интерфейс для работы с инференсом, простой, несколько команд позволяющих работать с инференсом и получать статистику.По результатам собрать README.md на русском с описанием того как был устроен изначальный инференс, что ты модифицировал для ускорения и сравнением скорости генерации. Результаты:Flash next тут не справился, где‑то застрял и после нескольких компактов так никуда и не продвинулся. 27B справился с задачей и получил ~13 т/с генерации, +30% прироста, используя функции библиотеки ESP‑DSP. GLM 5.3 получил ~20 т/с генерации, +100% прироста, уже используя PIE‑ассемблер. Оба проекта верифицированы, логиты байт в байт идентичны оригинальному движку. При разборе выяснилось что все модели оптимизировали head, причем у GLM 5.3 получились почти те же оптимизации что и у Fable 5, разница от того что Fable вдовесок оптимизировал attn. Тест на креативность — генератор никнеймовОтойдем от низкого уровня и посмотрим с совершенно другой стороны, насколько модели умеют в креативность. ПромптДавай сделаем генератор никнеймов. Нам нужно создавать интересные никнеймы на русском или английском языке. Принцип работы выбери самосотятельно. Для реализации используй Python. В конце сделай README.md, включающий в себя описание того как генератор устроен. Результаты:Оба Qwen сделали генераторы псевдослов, немного по‑разному, у GLM 5.3 — только генерация словосочетаний. Все приправили 1337 speak, xXx и прочими модными украшениями ников. Результаты совсем непримечательные, ну типа: ледянойщит9, обсидианель, рьяныйНеистовыйКвазар, supernovaRoot, буу, что это такое вообще, на дворе 2012? Этот тест меня скорее разочаровал, я бы конечно ожидал тут что‑то посложнее, ну хотя бы цепи Маркова. Но что есть, какое ТЗ такой результат, тест на креативность скорее провален чем пройден, а вот по техническому исполнению замечаний почти нет. Противоречивое ТЗ — рисуем фрактал Мандельброта на GPUПовышаем градус упоротости заданий. Этот промпт мне посоветовали в одном чате и, о, этот манёвр стоил нам 7 лет, застряли мы надолго, потому что фракталы пришлось рисовать всем, в том числе Claude пока он был. ПромптСделай анимацию пролёта фрактала Мандельброта. Сделай пролёт по известным красивым местам. Сделай чтобы это выглядело красиво. Вывод в видео, mp4 h264, 1920×1080 60 fps. Сделай на ANSI C (C89). Фрактал без зависимостей, никаких библиотек, кодировать видео можно ffmpeg. Для отрисовки используй GPU. Учитывай что у нас архитектура Blackwell. Тут есть несколько моментов. Во‑первых, C89 и GPU — не очень совместимый стек, CUDA это C++. Во‑вторых, красивые места это размытое понятие, хотя есть известные примечательные места в фрактале. Но мы же вайбкодеры, нас такие моменты не остановят, не так ли?Результаты:Вот тут разница уже налицо. 27B, как бы это описать, хотя бы смог нарисовать его.https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=YwhvV1z5tRMQwen 27B взял имевшийся в системе nvcc и по сути забил на требование ANSI C, хотя кроме CUDA библиотек в целом писал совместимый с ANSI C код.Qwen Flash Next интерпретировал иначе и вместо CUDA взял... compute шейдеры на OpenGL. Тоже не совсем ANSI C, но в целом пойдет. Результат уже заметно лучше, хоть и кривые движения слишком резкие, плюс разрешение так себе, сглаживания нет, цвета меняются скачком. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=B5sxcPkOZYk GLM 5.3 показал лучший результат. Сглаживания всё ещё нет, причем мерцание заметно даже после сжатия ютуба, зато какие цвета, какая плавность движения! Можно залипать с почти удовольствием. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Z0QGWEXhLnY Здесь по требованию ANSI C модель пошла ва‑банк, рендер написан на PTX с JIT компляцией так что CUDA Toolkit в рантайме не нужен вообще! И это локальная нейронка на топ железе 2018–2019 года.Для сравнения что сделал Opus 5 (там же есть пара видео от Fable):https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sjmIazhczZg Когда софт уже не вставляет — VerilogОкей, справились с графоном и программирвоанием под GPU, а давайте писать своё железо. Вот Verilog то мы уже не осилим? Ну ладно, чисто Verilog может осилим, но как насчет написать HDL, верифицировать, зашить на реальное железо и протестить? Дадим не слишком сложную задачку, сделем генератор ШИМ, то есть таймер. С управлением по UART. Под рукой была Tang Nano 9 k, так что... ПромптТебе дана заготовка HDL проекта, Gowin EDA, Verilog. Тестовая плата — Tang Nano 9 k. Constraints заданы, у нас 6 светодиодов, uart, reset и вход тактового сигнала 27 МГц. Необходимо реализовать логику, проект должен делать следующее. ШИМ контроллер с 6 выходами (светодиоды). Длительность импульса каждого канала настраивается индивидуально. Пределитель и счетчик общие. Все значения 16 битные. Проверки что длительность импульса меньше счетчика не требуется. Для управления сделать командный интерфейс UART. Через интерфейс должно быть доступно чтение и запись регистров. Формат уточни сам, примерно так:R,1 — прочитать регистр 1 W,1,2 — записать в регистр 1 значение 2 Интерфейс должен быть терминал совместимым, то есть loopback, рабочее стирание через backspace. Вместо мгновенной интерпретации команды необходимо ожидать перевода строки — это индикатор ввода. Команда чтения возвращает результат, записи K при успешной, E при ошибке. Неизвестные команды E.Инструменты: D:\Programs\Gowin\Gowin_V1.9.11.02_x64, в системе есть iverilog, python. Gowin programmer автоматически определит подключение плис, UART на COM37. При необходимости веб поиска используй mcp searxng с движком «ddg impersonate» Реализуй проект, отладь и протестируй.По готовности сделай к проекту README.md на русском языке. Результаты: 6 светодиодов с разной яркостьюК моему удивлению с этим справились все модели, даже 27B. В основном разница в том что Flash next и GLM догадались сначала уточнить полярность светодиодов у Tang Nano, 27B решил не запариваться этим, что, впрочем, соотвествует ТЗ. Verilog для меня всё ещё новая область поэтому качественно сравнить исполнение не могу, но если оно работает — оно работает. Более того, время, которое понадобилось тоже удивительное, 27B — около 1.5 часа, Flash next около получаса, GLM — около двух часов. Хм, а может попробовать навайбкодить GPS приёмник с поиском и слежением на ПЛИС и отладкой с помощью SDR? Как‑нибудь в другой раз. Когда Verilog недостаточно аппаратно — проектируем свою платуНедавно появился новый модный AI‑native софт для разработки печатных плат — tscircuit. Больше всего там интересно следить за разработкой автотрассировщика, по демонстрациям похоже что это что‑то уровня TopoR, не меньше. Opus конечно после двух часов с ним жалобливо попросил перейти в KiCad, но вдруг сейчас выйдет? Дам простую задачку, вот ну совсем простую, USB преобразователь термопары. STM32G491 (просто потому что я накупил себе пару десятков зачем‑то), элитный max31856, дальше додумать по ситуации. Промпт@tscirctuit Создай печатную плату преобразователя термопары. Используемые микросхемы: MAX31856, контроллер stm32g491ccu6. Для подключения термопары используй 2-контактный клемник с шагом 5 мм. У STM32 выведен USB, разъем USB‑C. Прошивка контроллера через DFU, необходима кнопка выбора режима загрузки boot0. Размер платы не более чем 30×50 мм. Минимум 2 крепежных отверстия под винт M3. USB разъем и клеммник должны быть расположены с разных сторон платы. У STM32 выведи 4 свободных GPIO пина на разъем с шагом 2.54. Печатная плата имеет 2 слоя. Результаты оставляют смешанные чувства. С одной стороны я удивлен что это вообще дало что‑то похожее на печатную плату, с другой, наконец‑то фейл, мы нашли что‑то чего локальные LLM пока что не могут сделать! Слева‑направо: Qwen 3.8 27B. Qwen 3.8 flash next, GLM 5.3 flashЗдесь прекрасно всё! Более‑менее получилось у, внезапно, flash next, это почти неплохая плата для новичка: usb смотрит в правильную сторону, компоненты не залезают друг на друга, плата имеет скругления углов. Да и рендеры нескучные, он сделал виды со всех сторон. Правда вот посадочное место max31856 неправильное, он шире. Qwen 27B зачем‑то вывел SWD хотя этого не требовалось, перепутал QFN48 и LQFP48, поставил USB смотрящим в сторону платы, на его посадочном месте скрыл под паяльной маской площадки для крепления разъема. GLM 5.3 flash сделал почти правильно, но посадочное место под STM32 неправильное, да и развернутый USB это конечно косяк‑косяк, в особенности цитируя CoT модели: Small note: the USB‑C model orientation — it faces up/out of board toward viewer, correct‑ish. The model might be slightly rotated vs pads? Looks fine. Тем не менее, по схемотехнике замечаний нет, я не изучал это дотошно, тем более что схемы, созданные в tscircuit обладают сомнительной читаемостью, но выглядит как будто нет серьёзных проблем по этой части. Что ещё?Пока я писал статью вышла ещё одна «компактная» модель Hy4 flash на 220B параметров. Движки под неё ещё не оптимизировали, но через llamacpp запустить можно, префилл ~200 т/с, декод 35 т/с. С первой задачей читалки на ANSI C модель справилась за всего 100 к токенов, похоже она перспективная для домашнего использования.Кроме агентной разработки относительной популярностью пользуются ИИ ассистенты. Вот этот сценарий я не особо понял. Я ставил Hermes agent, думал из него выйдет отличный кейс для статьи о том, как домашний ИИ это круто, но я просто не понял зачем он нужен, у меня не нашлось задач для него. Вместо итоговЕсли выбирать победителя, то я склоняюсь к Qwen 3.8 flash next. Ощутимо умнее 27B при той же скорости, сильно быстрее GLM 5.3 flash. Для отдельных задач GLM 5.3 flash имеет смысл применять, когда скорость не так важна. Конечно мегапроекты уровня тех, что делал Opus, пока локальные LLM не могут делать; особенно я не готов им доверить то, что вряд ли смогу проверить сам. Тем не менее, готовя эту статью, я не без удивления обнаружил, что всё таки локальные LLM могут делать что‑то реальное и инетресное, не очередную змейку в браузере, не очередной клон майнкрафта, а показывают себя в тех областях, которые полезны лично мне. Следущая отладочная плата на отечественном МК вряд ли будет сделана агентом на этих моделях, а вот инструменты и библиотеки к ней — очень даже возможно.

1tu1mbo.title: Зеленський: не впевнений, що є спільне бачення гарантій безпеки за зразком статті 5 НАТО
1tu1mbo.content:
Президент України Володимир Зеленський заявив, що Україна не має чіткого розуміння того, як працюватимуть гарантії безпеки за зразком 5-ї статті НАТО.«Вони (представники США – ред.) обговорювали це, як я зрозумів, з президентом (Трампом – ред), з російською стороною та з європейською стороною, що вони дійсно готові наблизитися до цього, наблизитися до реальних переговорів, до реальних результатів переговорів, так, щоб запропонувати Україні процес забезпечення безпеки на основі статті 5. Так, але я не впевнений, що ми маємо спільне розуміння винятку щодо статті 5, як ми це розуміємо», – сказав він під час спілкування з журналістами в Берліні.За його словами, стаття 5 передбачає присутність військових сил країн-партнерів в Україні. Зокрема, він порушив питання щодо можливого розміщення американських військових.«Я не виступаю ні за, ні проти. Звичайно, ми були б раді, якби наші американські партнери довіряли їм, якби їхні бази були в Україні, як на Близькому Сході. До речі, там країни не є членами НАТО, але там є певні бази», – зауважив президент.Він додав, що поки що немає відповіді, чи передбачатимуть гарантії присутність американських та європейських військових.«Сили Сполучених Штатів і європейських партнерів. Війська, бази. Без цього я не впевнений, що це 4-та, 5-та стаття тощо», – сказав Зеленський.Водночас головним питанням, за його словами, залишається те – якими діятимуть союзники у разі повторної агресії.

Раніше американський переговорник Джаред Кушнер заявив, що США вдалося досягти значного прогресу в обговоренні гарантій безпеки для України, зокрема зробити прийнятною для російської сторони концепцію гарантій, заснованих на статті 5 НАТО.Стаття 5 НАТО передбачає, що збройний напад на одного або кількох членів НАТО розглядається як напад на всіх. Водночас вона не означає автоматичного вступу всіх союзників у війну: кожна держава визначає необхідні дії для допомоги країні, яка зазнала нападу.Після переговорів з представниками США російський президент Володимир Путін заявляв, що присутність будь-яких іноземних військ на території України для РФ є «абсолютно неприйнятною», вони вважатимуться «законою ціллю».Минулого тижня президент України Володимир Зеленський повідомив, що під час переговорів із делегатами США у нього питали, чи Київ погодився б вивести свої війська з підконтрольних частин Донбасу в обмін на членство в НАТО.Читайте також: В ISW проаналізували заяви Путіна після переговорів в Абу-ДабіЗа спостереженнями американського Інституту вивчення війни, після чергових тристоронніх переговорів, що відбулися 12 листопада в Абу-Дабі, президент Росії Володимир Путін і члени російської делегації підтвердили «непохитну відданість» РФ своїм початковим територіальним вимогам до України, а також ультиматумам щодо демонтажу НАТО і європейської архітектури безпеки, що склалася після закінчення Холодної війни.

78l2ui.title: Низкий расход и богатое оснащение: совершенно новый Haval Jolion вышел на рынок
78l2ui.content: В Южной Африке стартовали продажи Haval Jolion Max PHEV – подзаряжаемой версии кроссовера, который хорошо знаком россиянам. Пока машина доступна в одной комплектации Super Luxury, и просят за нее 599,9 тысячи рэндов, то есть примерно 2,85 млн рублей.Haval Jolion Max PHEVЗа основу этой модели инженеры взяли Haval Xiaolong, показанный на домашнем рынке Китая еще в 2023 году. Мировую версию – собственно Jolion Max – концерн GWM вывел на международные рынки в начале 2026-го.Сначала покупателям предлагали бензиновый вариант, обычный гибрид и электромобиль. Теперь линейку дополнила plug-in-модификация: 1,5-литровый двигатель внутреннего сгорания на 150 лошадиных сил трудится в паре с электромотором на 177 сил. Суммарная отдача системы – 326 л. с. и 513 Нм крутящего момента, привод только передний.По габаритам новинка крупнее привычного Jolion: 4590 мм в длину, 1877 мм в ширину, 1675 мм в высоту при колесной базе 2710 мм. Разница со стандартной машиной, популярной в России, – плюс 118 мм, 3 мм и 94 мм соответственно. Узнать подзаряжаемую версию снаружи можно по закрытой решетке радиатора.Интерьер Haval Jolion Max PHEVНа фоне остальных модификаций PHEV заметно дороже. Бензиновый Jolion в ЮАР оценили в 429,9-494,9 тысячи рэндов (от 2,05 до 2,35 млн рублей), традиционный гибрид – в 469,9 тысячи (около 2,23 млн рублей).В список оснащения Super Luxury вошли 19-дюймовые колесные диски, шесть подушек безопасности, шесть динамиков и система голосового управления. В салоне – 14,6-дюймовый сенсорный экран и 10,25-дюймовая цифровая панель приборов, мультимедиа поддерживает Apple CarPlay и Android Auto, а передние кресла получили электропривод регулировки.О том, какие китайские модели пользуются в России наибольшим спросом, «За рулем» уже рассказывал.Понравилась публикация?Тогда добавьте «За рулем» в список интересных источников: 1. Откройте https://google.com... 2. Поставьте галочку напротив нашего изданияГотово – остаемся на связи! «За рулем» теперь можно смотреть на RuTube

gh-1434222699.title: GitHub - bbelgg/rs-rearmed: Native Apple Silicon port of Rocksmith 2014, recompiled from your own copy of the game. Mac and Learn & Play editions, offline, no game files included.
gh-1434222699.content:
RS Re-ARMed

A native arm64 port of Rocksmith 2014 for Apple Silicon Macs. Your own copy of the game is statically recompiled
to C at build time, and small native libraries replace what ties it to Intel Macs, Windows, Steam and online
services. It builds from either of two games:

The Mac game: the Steam macOS version of Rocksmith 2014 Remastered. Docs.
Learn & Play: a purchased edition that Steam offers for Windows only. Docs.

This project contains no game code or assets, so you need your own copy of the game. Not affiliated with or
endorsed by Ubisoft. Rocksmith is a trademark of Ubisoft.
Why it exists
Rocksmith on the Mac stands on ground that is going away: Apple is phasing out Rosetta and has deprecated OpenGL, and
Ubisoft no longer updates the game and never brought Learn & Play to the Mac. RS Re-ARMed keeps it playing and makes
it better. The priorities:

Future-proof, whatever Apple or Ubisoft do. Native code with no Rosetta, and Metal by default (the Mac game keeps
OpenGL as a choice and automatic fallback). Offline: no Steam client while you play, no Ubisoft sign-in, and every
connection that isn't local is refused and logged. The app has its own game files, so a Steam update or uninstall
can't break it; on the same disk the copy takes no extra space.
A better game on the Mac. It was always a bit laggy and buggy. Now it runs much smoother, without the stalls, at
your display's refresh rate, with the fixes from rs-mac-fixes and
RSBypass built in.
Proper support for external audio devices. Any interface, not only the Real Tone cable: Direct Connect in the
menus, every channel listed, calibration that can boost a quiet input, lower guitar latency, and multiplayer with
each player on their own input.
Quality of life. Custom songs out of the box, with no CDLC patch. ENUMERATE in the main menu adds new songs
without a restart. No intro screens. Mods load from a mods/ folder:
rearmed-mods has RSMods' features and more, with an app to set them up.

Your Steam saves are copied in once and never written, and stored Ubisoft credentials are never copied. Every fix can
be switched off, and the switches are set in the installer (Settings and switches…):
Mac, Learn & Play.
Requirements

A Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or later), macOS 12 or later.
Rocksmith 2014 (Remastered) for Mac or Learn & Play on your Steam account
(Mac, Learn & Play). Neither has to
be installed in Steam: the installer has Steam download it, and uses a Mac game that is installed as it is. No
Rosetta and no Windows PC needed.
A Real Tone cable or another audio input.

Install
Download RS.Re-ARMed.Installer.app.zip from Releases, unzip it
and open it. macOS refuses the first time, as it isn't notarized: click Open Anyway in System Settings,
Privacy & Security. Choose your game and click Build & Install; it tells you when it needs you. The installer
holds no game code: it builds the app on your Mac from your own copy. A built app contains the game's code, so it
can't be shared: never download one from anywhere. A first build takes about 15 minutes for the Mac game and about
25 for Learn & Play, on an M2.
Then start RS Re-ARMed or RS Re-ARMed Learn & Play from ~/Applications.
To build by hand: Mac, Learn & Play.
Mac and Windows compared
Both editions play. Learn & Play has had far less testing than the Mac edition.

which to build from.
Known issues

No online features.
Progress is kept separately and isn't copied back to your Steam saves.
Each edition supports one Steam build of its game.
With Metal, the first play of a song, venue or mode can stutter briefly in its first half-minute.
Mods that draw with OpenGL themselves show nothing on Metal: use the overlay API or the OpenGL renderer.

More: Mac, Learn & Play. Plans, with no
promise of when: Mac, Learn & Play.
FAQ
Is this an emulator?
No. The game's x86 code is translated to C once, at build time, and compiled into an arm64 app.
Does it need Steam, or change my Steam install?
Steam is needed only to install, and isn't used while you play. Your installed game and your Steam saves are
only read. What the installer changes in Steam's folder: Steam downloads into its own download folder there (a game
that isn't installed in Steam, and the DLC you own), and when you have Steam download to another disk, the installer
links that folder there.
Where are my saves and logs?
In ~/Library/Application Support/RS Re-ARMed/: saves in steam/<account>/221680/remote/, logs in logs/. Learn &
Play's are in the same places under learn-play/.
How do I add songs?
Put custom songs in the app's own dlc folder, ~/Library/Application Support/RS Re-ARMed/game/dlc
(…/RS Re-ARMed/learn-play/game/dlc for Learn & Play): Mac archives (*_m.psarc) for the Mac game, PC archives
(*_p.psarc) for Learn & Play. The game has them at its next start, or at once with ENUMERATE in the main menu.
For DLC bought since the install, click Refresh Game Files in the installer.
How do I update or uninstall?
To update, open the installer: it offers a newer release and replaces itself with it, and Build & Install then updates the game; your saves are kept. To uninstall, delete the app and the folder above, after
backing up steam/ if you want your progress: Mac,
Learn & Play.
How do I get the lowest guitar delay?
Set the game's audio engine setting to 1 and restart it (2 if the sound crackles), and listen through headphones or
a USB interface, not the built-in speakers: details.
My interface has several inputs, or the guitar is too quiet.
Set INPUT to DIRECT CONNECT in Path/Input and open Available Inputs. Play, pick the channel whose bar moves, then run
the game's calibration: details.
Where do I report bugs?
In GitHub Issues. First check that the original game doesn't do the
same (under Rosetta, or on Windows for Learn & Play).
