gh-1427712241.title: GitHub - tsapZ/ImaginatorsRecomp: Unofficial native Windows port of Skylanders: Imaginators (Xbox 360). Works with your real Portal of Power and figures, or without them. Recompiled with ReXGlue.
gh-1427712241.content:
Skylanders: Imaginators (Xbox 360, 2016) as a native Windows game: your real portal and figures or none at all, a controller, up to 3x the
console's resolution, 60 FPS, creation crystals, no emulator. You bring your own copy of the game;
nothing of it comes with this project.

Unofficial fan project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Activision or Toys for Bob.

Questions people ask
Can I use my real portal and figures? Yes. Plug it in: the game finds it by itself (F4 > Portal is Automatic), reads your figures and saves their progress on them, as on the console, and the portal menu still has the figures you don't own. Every figure you put on gets a backup file. Real USB portal only leaves the menu out. The PS3, Wii and PC portals work as they are, also with the WinUSB driver a Dolphin or Cemu setup gives them; an Xbox 360 portal needs WinUSB (Zadig), as for Xenia. If yours doesn't work, F4 > Game > Report a problem: its log says what the game saw.
Can I play without figures? Yes: without a real portal, a menu with every figure opens when the game asks for a Skylander. Their progress is kept in files in Documents\Skylanders\Figures, and one button swaps back to the Skylander you played before.
Can I play with a friend? Yes, two players on one PC, as on the console: the second player opens the portal menu on their controller (Guide, or Back + Start) and puts their Skylander on. L3 + R3 sorts out which controller plays which player. Online play isn't there yet.
Which game do I need? Does my Wii or PS3 copy work? Your own copy of Imaginators on Xbox 360: for now the European Xbox 360 disc (which one exactly), as an ISO or an extracted folder. The setup takes the game's data from it; nothing of the game comes with this. Wii, PS3 and other versions are different programs and don't work.
Is this an emulator? No. The game's code is recompiled into a Windows program, so it runs natively: higher resolutions, 60 FPS and more, a settings menu, the portal menu. Emulators like Dolphin or Xenia run the original game instead; both are fine ways to play.
Does it run on Linux, Steam Deck, Mac or Android handhelds? It's made for Windows (64-bit) and tested there. Wine / Proton may work but isn't tested much; Mac, Android and ARM handhelds aren't supported.
Is it safe? All of the source is here on GitHub. The setup isn't signed, so Windows may warn before it runs (what to click).
Was AI used? Yes, almost all of the code was written with Claude; see How it was made.
Getting started
The easy way: install Core of Light
and show it your disc. It downloads this game, sets it up and keeps it up to date, and does the same
for the other five games. It can also switch the game to English, German or French
(below).
On its own:

Download ImaginatorsRecompSetup-<version>.exe from the Releases page.
Run it and pick your disc, as an ISO file or an extracted folder. It checks the version and takes
what it needs.
Start the game from the desktop or the Start menu.

What you need:

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) and a graphics card with DirectX 12
your own Xbox 360 disc of the game (which one)
a controller (Xbox or compatible); keyboard and mouse work too. A real Portal of Power is optional.

Tested on a Ryzen 5 5600 with a Radeon RX 6800 XT (32 GB RAM, Windows 11): a steady 60 FPS at 2x (1440p). Without the frame cap the hub runs at about 140 FPS at 2x, with the native 3D picture on.
The setup isn't signed, so Windows may say "Windows protected your PC": click More info, then
Run anyway. No admin rights needed.

What you get

A sharper picture: 1x, 2x or 3x the console's 720p, the 3D scene drawn at the full 720p instead
of the console's smaller size, sharpening (AMD CAS, or FSR 1 when the window is bigger) and 16x
texture filtering, with the presets Performance, Quality, Best and As on the console.
Bloom and motion blur can be turned down.
60 FPS, or 30 as on the console, or 144 and more. The game keeps its normal speed.
Ultrawide: a wider window shows more to the sides, and the HUD moves out to the edges.
No portal needed: when the game asks for a Skylander, a menu with every figure opens by itself,
in the game's own look, creation crystals sorted by class. A real USB portal should work too
(not tried with this game yet).
A shorter Skylander intro when a figure comes in, if you like (in the settings).
Your figures keep their progress (level, gold, hats, upgrades) in files you can back up, and
each one is backed up before the game first saves over it: the portal menu puts an older version back.
Quick swap: one button puts the Skylander you played before back on the portal.
Skip any movie: Start ends the movie that is playing (F4 > Game: off, or A instead).
A settings menu in the game: graphics, frame rate, language, portal, controls, and Extras
(no health loss, full gold, always crit, elemental power everywhere, gold and XP multipliers; off
by default, and Show cheats hides the lot).
Achievements.
A Discord status: the game, your Skylander and the level, while the Discord app runs. F4 > Game turns it off.
HD texture packs work too (how).
Languages: the disc has Spanish and Italian; English, German or French come from your PS3
disc (below).

Its settings in Core of Light, the same pages as in the game's own menu (F4). The game's own pictures aren't shown here: they're Activision's.

Controls
The game plays as it always did. On top of that:

Controller
Keyboard

Portal menu (put figures and crystals on)
Guide, or Back + Start
F6

Take figures off
Back + Y
F5

Settings
Back + RB
F4

Achievements
in the settings, under Game
F7

Which controller plays which player
L3 + R3
F9

The settings menu shows the keyboard keys for the game itself under Controls.

How far it is
The opening cutscene and the first level play, and in automated test runs all 13 story levels load
without a crash. Nobody has played the whole game to the end yet. If something breaks further in,
please tell me.
What's tested (as of 2026-11-12):

Every story level loads
all 13, by script

Played by hand
the first level

Real USB portal
not tried with this game yet

Two players
not tried yet

Graphics
D3D12 and Vulkan, by script

What's being worked on, for all six games and the launcher: the roadmap
board, and docs/roadmap.md for this
game. Questions and ideas: Discussions. Known bugs and the details:
docs/STATUS.md.

Help
The setup says it's the wrong disc. This port is made for one version of the game (see
Which disc). If you have another one, open an issue with the message (it names the disc's title, region and hash).
The game is in Spanish. That's the disc; see
English, German or French.
It runs slowly. Press F4, go to Graphics and pick Performance, or a lower internal resolution.
Voices are missing with headphones. If Windows has your sound output set up as 5.1 or 7.1, the game sends surround sound, and voices on the center channel (in Spyro's Adventure all of the movies' voices) don't reach headphones. F4 > Game > Sound output: Stereo mixes everything down to two channels; so does setting the output to Stereo in Windows' sound settings.
Where are my saves and figures? Saves in Documents\Skylanders\Imaginators, figures in
Documents\Skylanders\Figures (shared by all six games). Core of Light can export all of it for a
new PC.
Why are there no screenshots of the game? They'd show its artwork, which belongs to Activision. The picture above is its settings page in Core of Light, the banner our own drawing.
Which disc
The European Xbox 360 disc with Spanish and Italian (PAL, title 41560930; the European 360 discs
of this game come in language pairs). Its SHA-256 is in
docs/game/default.xex.sha256; the setup, the game and the launcher
check it. A 360 disc with English and German isn't known to this port yet; if it has the same
code it works as well: the check also compares the code part of the file (docs/game/default.xex.code).

If you also own the PS3 disc of the game, the easy way is
Core of Light: Settings > Imaginators language,
pick English, German or French, then the PS3 disc. It puts that language's texts, voices and movies
into the installed game in about a minute, and can take them out again.
Without the launcher, tools/add_language.py does the same in your extracted 360 disc (rom/):
menus, texts and subtitles; with --voices the voices too, with --movies the story movies'
speech (the picture stays the 360's).

python tools/add_language.py --restore (back to the disc's Spanish)

It needs 7-Zip for the PS3 .iso (or the disc's extracted PS3_GAME\USRDIR folder), Python 3 and
about 2.3 GB of free space while it runs, and takes well under a minute. The title screen, the
licence agreement and the Xbox 360's own messages switch to that language too.
Reporting a problem
Open an issue with the Problem form:
what you did and what happened. It helps a lot to attach the report from Core of Light (LB, the
launcher's settings, > Report a problem, or the question it asks after a crash). That's one text
file on your desktop with the latest logs and settings, your Windows user name taken out. Without
the launcher, the logs are in the logs folder next to the game's exe.

Why this exists
I wanted to play the Xbox 360 Skylanders games on my PC with just a controller, no emulator, and
with a nicer picture. That's really all it is: a private fan project. It's public in case someone
else wants the same.
How it was made
To be upfront about it: almost all of the code here was written by Claude in
Claude Code, the recompile setup, the fixes, the portal menu, the launcher and the installer, and
most of the docs too. I decided what to build, said what was broken and played the games a lot. If
AI-made projects aren't your thing, that's fair.

For developers
The game's Xbox 360 code is recompiled to x86-64 with ReXGlue
(no CPU emulation); the graphics go through Xenia's D3D12 path. This repository holds only our own
code: the recompiled game code is made on your PC from your disc's default.xex when you build.
Building needs Windows, Visual Studio 2022 (C++ workload and C++ Clang tools), CMake, Ninja, just,
Git and Python 3, and the extracted disc in rom/ (rom/README.md). Steps:
docs/development.md, then just play-release. just package-installer builds
the setup. All docs: docs/README.md.
The banner and the button at the top are drawn by Core of Light's tools/make_banner.ps1.
Credits

The players who report bugs and bring ideas: many of them are in the games now. Who brought
what: Made with the players.
GiantsRecomp, SSARecomp
and SwapForceRecomp: this project is scaffolded
from them; app, portal, menus and tooling come from there.
GiantsRecomp by TheBiemGamer brought
Skylanders Giants to PC first and is the template these ports started from.
ReXGlue, the static recompilation SDK, here in a
fork with our fixes on top.
skylanders-portal by TheBiemGamer:
the portal (software and USB), its overlay and the figure catalog, here in a fork with the
shared portal and settings menus on top.
morpheus284: the stone frame around the menus, cut from his Core of
Light artwork, and the banner at the top, made from it (CC BY 4.0).
Laytonator2: the PlayStation button prompts, drawn in the PS3's
style (CC BY 4.0).
Figure save-data decoding builds on public reverse-engineering of the Skylanders NFC format,
among others SkyReader.
extract-xiso is included (prebuilt, unmodified)
for the installer (installer/extract-xiso.LICENSE.txt).

Skylanders is a trademark of Activision. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by
Activision.
License
The code and documentation in this repository are released under the MIT license. That
doesn't cover the game or its data, which you need to own and supply yourself, or the third-party
components in thirdparty/, which keep their own licenses.

For traps you need a Traptanium portal (the Xbox 360 one was tested by a player). If yours doesn't work, F4 > Game > Report a problem: its log says what the game saw.
Can I play without figures? Yes: without a real portal, a menu with every figure opens when the game asks for a Skylander. Their progress is kept in files in Documents\Skylanders\Figures, and one button swaps back to the Skylander you played before.
Can I play with a friend? Yes, two players on one PC, as on the console: the second player opens the portal menu on their controller (Guide, or Back + Start) and puts their Skylander on. L3 + R3 sorts out which controller plays which player. Online play isn't there yet.
How do traps and villains work without the toys? Through the portal menu too: when the game wants a trap, the menu opens on the right element, and the villain vault and swapping villains in work as on the console.
Which game do I need? Does my Wii or PS3 copy work? Your own copy of Trap Team on Xbox 360: for now the European Xbox 360 disc (which one exactly), as an ISO or an extracted folder. The setup takes the game's data from it; nothing of the game comes with this. Wii, PS3 and other versions are different programs and don't work.
Is this an emulator? No. The game's code is recompiled into a Windows program, so it runs natively: higher resolutions, 60 FPS and more, a settings menu, the portal menu. Emulators like Dolphin or Xenia run the original game instead; both are fine ways to play.
Does it run on Linux, Steam Deck, Mac or Android handhelds? It's made for Windows (64-bit) and tested there. Wine / Proton may work but isn't tested much; Mac, Android and ARM handhelds aren't supported.
Is it safe? All of the source is here on GitHub. The setup isn't signed, so Windows may warn before it runs (what to click).
Was AI used? Yes, almost all of the code was written with Claude; see How it was made.
Getting started
The easy way: install Core of Light
and show it your disc. It downloads this game, sets it up and keeps it up to date, and does the same
for the other five games.
On its own:

Download TrapTeamRecompSetup-<version>.exe from the Releases page.
Run it and pick your disc, as an ISO file or an extracted folder. It checks the version and takes
what it needs.
Start the game from the desktop or the Start menu.

What you need:

Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) and a graphics card with DirectX 12
your own Xbox 360 disc of the game (which one)
a controller (Xbox or compatible); keyboard and mouse work too. A real Portal of Power is optional.

Tested on a Ryzen 5 5600 with a Radeon RX 6800 XT (32 GB RAM, Windows 11): a steady 60 FPS at 2x (1440p). Without the frame cap the hub runs at about 133 FPS at 2x, with the native 3D picture on.
The setup isn't signed, so Windows may say "Windows protected your PC": click More info, then
Run anyway. No admin rights needed.

What you get

A sharper picture: 1x, 2x or 3x the console's 720p, the 3D scene drawn at the full 720p instead
of the console's smaller size, sharpening (AMD CAS, or FSR 1 when the window is bigger) and 16x
texture filtering, with the presets Performance, Quality, Best and As on the console.
Bloom and motion blur can be turned down.
60 FPS, or 30 as on the console, or 144 and more. The game keeps its normal speed.
Ultrawide: a wider window shows more to the sides, and the HUD moves out to the edges.
No portal needed: when the game asks for a Skylander, a menu with every figure opens by itself,
in the game's own look. A real USB portal works too, or both at once.
Traps without the trap slot: when the game wants a trap, the menu opens on the right element.
A caught villain talks from your PC's speakers, as from the Traptanium portal.
Your figures keep their progress (level, gold, hats, upgrades) in files you can back up, and
each one is backed up before the game first saves over it: the portal menu puts an older version back.
Quick swap: one button puts the Skylander you played before back on the portal.
A shorter Skylander intro when a figure comes in, if you like (in the settings).
Skip any movie: Start ends the movie that is playing (F4 > Game: off, or A instead).
A settings menu in the game: graphics, frame rate, language, portal, controls, and Extras
(no health loss, full gold, always crit, elemental power everywhere, gold and XP multipliers; off by
default, and Show cheats hides the lot).
Achievements.
A Discord status: the game, your Skylander and the level, while the Discord app runs. F4 > Game turns it off.
HD texture packs work too (how).
Languages: English and German; French, Spanish and Italian as well.

Its settings in Core of Light, the same pages as in the game's own menu (F4). The game's own pictures aren't shown here: they're Activision's.

Controls
The game plays as it always did. On top of that:

Controller
Keyboard

Portal menu (put figures and traps on)
Guide, or Back + Start
F6

Take figures off
Back + Y
F5

Settings
Back + RB
F4

Achievements
in the settings, under Game
F7

Which controller plays which player
L3 + R3
F9

The settings menu shows the keyboard keys for the game itself under Controls.

How far it is
Chapter 1 and the Skylanders Academy play, with traps, the villain vault and swapping villains in,
and in automated test runs all 26 story levels load without a crash. Nobody has played the whole
game to the end yet. If something breaks further in, please tell
me.
What's tested (as of 2026-11-12):

Every story level loads
all 26, by script

Played by hand
with a real portal (below); Chapter 1 by script

Real USB portal
an older portal from before Trap Team: the light, quick swaps, and the message to lift a figure off

Traps
the trap slot and the villain's voice with the built-in portal, by script; a player's Xbox 360 Traptanium portal

Two players
player 2 joins, by script

Graphics
D3D12 and Vulkan, by script

What's being worked on, for all six games and the launcher: the roadmap
board, and docs/roadmap.md for this
game. Questions and ideas: Discussions. Known bugs and the details:
docs/STATUS.md.

Help
The setup says it's the wrong disc. This port is made for one version of the game (see
Which disc). If you have another one, open an issue with the message (it names the disc's title, region and hash).
It runs slowly. Press F4, go to Graphics and pick Performance, or a lower internal resolution.
Voices are missing with headphones. If Windows has your sound output set up as 5.1 or 7.1, the game sends surround sound, and voices on the center channel (in Spyro's Adventure all of the movies' voices) don't reach headphones. F4 > Game > Sound output: Stereo mixes everything down to two channels; so does setting the output to Stereo in Windows' sound settings.
Where are my saves and figures? Saves in Documents\Skylanders\Trap Team, figures in
Documents\Skylanders\Figures (shared by all six games). Core of Light can export all of it for a
new PC.
Why are there no screenshots of the game? They'd show its artwork, which belongs to Activision. The picture above is its settings page in Core of Light, the banner our own drawing.
Which disc
The European Xbox 360 disc (PAL, title 41560911). Its SHA-256 is in
docs/game/default.xex.sha256; the setup, the game and the launcher
check it. Another pressing with the same code (another language set, for example) works as well: they also compare the code part of the file (docs/game/default.xex.code). Other regions usually have other code and don't work yet.
Reporting a problem
Open an issue with the Problem form:
what you did and what happened. It helps a lot to attach the report from Core of Light (LB, the
launcher's settings, > Report a problem, or the question it asks after a crash). That's one text
file on your desktop with the latest logs and settings, your Windows user name taken out. Without
the launcher, the logs are in the logs folder next to the game's exe.

Why this exists
I wanted to play the Xbox 360 Skylanders games on my PC with just a controller, no emulator, and
with a nicer picture. That's really all it is: a private fan project. It's public in case someone
else wants the same.
How it was made
To be upfront about it: almost all of the code here was written by Claude in
Claude Code, the recompile setup, the fixes, the portal menu, the launcher and the installer, and
most of the docs too. I decided what to build, said what was broken and played the games a lot. If
AI-made projects aren't your thing, that's fair.

For developers
The game's Xbox 360 code is recompiled to x86-64 with ReXGlue
(no CPU emulation); the graphics go through Xenia's D3D12 path. This repository holds only our own
code: the recompiled game code is made on your PC from your disc's default.xex when you build.
Building needs Windows, Visual Studio 2022 (C++ workload and C++ Clang tools), CMake, Ninja, just,
Git and Python 3, and the extracted disc in rom/ (rom/README.md). Steps:
docs/development.md, then just play-release. just package-installer builds
the setup. All docs: docs/README.md.
The banner and the button at the top are drawn by Core of Light's tools/make_banner.ps1.
Credits

The players who report bugs and bring ideas: many of them are in the games now. Who brought
what: Made with the players.
GiantsRecomp, SSARecomp
and SwapForceRecomp: this project is scaffolded
from them; app, portal, menus and tooling come from there.
GiantsRecomp by TheBiemGamer brought
Skylanders Giants to PC first and is the template these ports started from.
ReXGlue, the static recompilation SDK, here in a
fork with our fixes on top.
skylanders-portal by TheBiemGamer:
the portal (software and USB), its overlay and the figure catalog, here in a fork with the
shared portal and settings menus on top.
morpheus284: the stone frame around the menus, cut from his Core of
Light artwork, and the banner at the top, made from it (CC BY 4.0).
Laytonator2: the PlayStation button prompts, drawn in the PS3's
style (CC BY 4.0).
Figure save-data decoding builds on public reverse-engineering of the Skylanders NFC format,
among others SkyReader.
extract-xiso is included (prebuilt, unmodified)
for the installer (installer/extract-xiso.LICENSE.txt).

Skylanders is a trademark of Activision. This project is not affiliated with or endorsed by
Activision.
License
The code and documentation in this repository are released under the MIT license. That
doesn't cover the game or its data, which you need to own and supply yourself, or the third-party
components in thirdparty/, which keep their own licenses.

1ltpi00.title: У Land Rover Defender появится младший брат и станет самой дешевой моделью марки
1ltpi00.content: Компактный электрический «мини-Defender» появится на рынке в конце 2027 года – об этом сообщил генеральный директор Jaguar Land Rover Баладжи. Модель встанет ступенью ниже нынешнего Defender и окажется самым доступным автомобилем в линейке британской марки.Электрический «мини-Defender»В основе машины – модульная EMA, рассчитанная как на полностью электрическую версию, так и на гибрид. По предварительным данным, у «мини-Defender» будет два электромотора и привод на все колеса, а длина кузова превысит 4,5 метра.Официального имени пока нет: машина, по данным компании, находится на поздней стадии разработки. Окончательное название модели еще не утверждено.Китайские производители, кстати, резко сокращают циклы разработки – глава марки говорил об этом отдельно. Jaguar Land Rover тоже ищет способы ускориться, однако качеством жертвовать не собирается: каждому Defender положено минимум два зимних и два летних испытательных цикла. За последние два года инженеры закрепили жесткий стандарт, общий для всех моделей семейства.Электрический «мини-Defender»Из-за компоновки батареи и шасси у «мини-Defender», скорее всего, будет меньше хода подвески, чем у классического Defender. На деле это означает более скромный внедорожный потенциал.Тем не менее глава компании обещает, что новинка сохранит фирменную проходимость и будет лидировать в своем классе.Квадратный силуэт внедорожника отрицательно скажется на запасе хода. Зато «гены» Defender бренд сохраняет намеренно, чтобы машина не превратилась в обычный кроссовер.О том, какие Range Rover Sport сейчас продают в России и по каким ценам, «За рулем» рассказывал.Понравилась публикация?Тогда добавьте «За рулем» в список интересных источников: 1. Откройте https://google.com... 2. Поставьте галочку напротив нашего изданияГотово – остаемся на связи! «За рулем» можно читать и в MAX

dqxc4t.title: GTA 6 Coffee Break walkthrough
dqxc4t.content: Coffee Break is the thirty-first mission in GTA 6.GTA 6’s Coffee Break mission sees Jason and Lucia take a moment to plan their next move after their robbery spree in Port Gellhorn. The pair need to earn (or steal) some money before they head back to Vice City. Coffee Break will unlock multiple main and side missions in order to pull this off.For everything you need to know about GTA 6, bookmark our GTA 6 Guide Hub for walkthroughs, top tips and more.Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to check out our complete walkthrough hub, featuring beginner tips, navigation experience explained, GTA 6 cheats, and more.GTA 6 Coffee Break walkthroughCoffee Break is a very straightforward mission, with just a few things to do. From where you start the mission outside the Motel, walk with Lucia towards the motel kitchen, which is located in the southern corner of the property at the mission marker.As you walk to the kitchen, you’ll speak to Wyman, who mentions the Mud Club and its off-road dirt races. This introduces one of the activities you’ll be able to explore later, and point you in the direction of a significant side mission thread.Once you’re inside the kitchen, Lucia will sit down at a table. Head over to the coffee machine and purchase a coffee for Lucia. This starts a cutscene in which Jason and Lucia discuss their plans to leave Port Gellhorn and move back to the big smoke, Vice City, to do this, they’re going to need some serious cash.Here you’ll introduced to several potential jobs that can help the pair raise enough money for the move. Don’t worry about which one you select, as all four opportunities will be marked on your map and can be completed in any order. You can also earn cash via the methods you’ve already been using, like shopping shops, and selling cars.GTA 6 Coffee Break rewardsCompleting Coffee Break unlocks free character switching between Jason and Lucia, allowing you to play as either protagonist outside of specific mission restrictions. This also means that you can free roam as a pair. Alexa, play Hot Together.It also opens four follow-up missions that you can tackle in any order: Thrillbillies, Hit Avery Pawn, Hit Kingpin Bowling and Impounded Vehicle.These jobs will help Jason and Lucia raise the $15,000 they need to fund their move to Vice City.The next main story mission is Afternoon Delight, and it’s a belter.

1qvhai6.title: Cops Are Pushing Extremely Corny ‘Grand Theft Auto 6’ Slop
1qvhai6.content: Listening to the in-game radio stations while you cruise around in Grand Theft Auto VI, you might hear a recruitment ad for the Vice City Police Department, which makes no secret of the kind of maladjusted psychos it's looking for.“Have you always dreamed of abusing your power without consequence?” one spot begins. “Well, now you can, when you join the Vice City Police Department, VCPD. You’ll have fun learning the ins and outs of applying excessive force.” The commercial goes on to suggest that cadets will be trained in racial profiling and planting evidence.Given that blistering analysis of American law enforcement, you might imagine that actual cops aren’t big fans of the latest GTA title, which was released after a 13-year wait on Thursday. Yet as millions of gamers have started to explore every stash house and back alley in the sun-drenched wilderness of a fictionalized South Florida, even police departments have attempted to exploit this monocultural mania to elevate their public messaging or recruit new officers.It’s a curious strategy given that the series rewards theft and drug dealing while enticing you to run over pedestrians, but evidently the mere presence of law enforcement in the games (as the primary antagonists, mind you) was enough to inspire waves of AI slop celebrating the thin blue line.An Instagram channel of the San Diego Police Department, for example, on Thursday posted an AI-generated image of an SDPD cruiser set against a sunset over the San Diego Bay. Its neon pinks and purples match the saturated aesthetic of GTA, and in case there was any doubt what the department was going for, the nonsensical phrase “Join San Diego PD VI” appears at the top. “Want to drive a police car, we can make that happen!” reads the caption. “Apply Now!”Another police department in Washington state shared GTA-like imagery on its Instagram page, encouraging viewers to try “the real-life version” of GTA VI by pursuing a career in law enforcement. “No cheat codes,” the caption advertised. “No respawns. Just real people, real challenges, and a career that makes a difference.” A wave of self-serious GTA slop also flooded the feeds of police departments in Canada, from Edmonton to Toronto—though the Calgary Police Service tried something more lighthearted by having one of their traffic officers react to clips of dangerous and illegal driving maneuvers in the game.Among police departments that were not seeking to add to their ranks through GTA VI fever, many posted content aimed at reminding people that laws exist in real life. “Keep It In The Game VI,” advised a typical post on the Instagram account of the Glendale Police Department in California, complete with a GTA-fied police cruiser and view of the city. “Follow posted speed limits, respect the law, and keep your wanted level at ZERO!” the caption warned. The Denver Police Department, in similarly scolding fashion, informed followers: “Grand theft auto is still illegal.”The communications teams for these agencies should have perhaps reconsidered trying to farm engagement and clout from the massive success of GTA VI. As many commenters are noting, the game portrays cops as corrupt and quick to violence. Players have discovered that the Vice City squad will brutalize you if you start filming them during a questionable arrest. One clip showed a cop pulling his weapon on a character who had done nothing worse than stand in the street to take a selfie.A certain dose of this authoritarian cruelty ought to appeal to the right-wing cranks upset that GTA VI is too “woke” when it comes to gender, race, and politics overall. It’s a little different when the most visible villains of the game are choosing to overlook its vicious take on their profession in order to spam epic social media posts.Fox News, just for comparison, dutifully took the tired law-and-order line on GTA VI, with talking heads aghast at kids’ exposure to virtual gun violence (never mind actual gun deaths in the US) and an atmosphere of moral depravity. Elon Musk famously declared that he couldn’t play GTA games because they compelled you to shoot cops.Both stances, however insincere, suggest a modicum of regard for law enforcement that the police departments themselves immediately jettisoned in favor of GTA cringe. They of course won’t win any cool points for it, but at least this way they can pretend to connect with the general population.More baffling still is that the Russian army has generated its own GTA VI recruitment ads to blast out on its Telegram channel, and NATO has trumpeted its defensive security alliance with military-industrial GTA sludge, boasting that “even the best gamers would have a challenge” eluding fighter jets and submarines. Trying to parse Vice President JD Vance’s depiction of a Trumpian “golden age” with GTA graphics is a fool’s errand. In the most dystopian development of all, a US Army battalion in Georgia granted 43 eligible soldiers four days off to play the new GTA in return for reenlisting for another two years of service.What do any of these institutions or their missions have to do with a video game where you rob convenience stores in flip-flops? Doesn’t matter. When the zeitgeist is this all-consuming, you fire up ChatGPT and find an angle, no matter how confusing. Surely someone, somewhere, will be tricked into thinking you have anything to do with it.

gh-1463022818.title: GitHub - noxgp/fnaf1-ps-vita: Unofficial PS Vita port of Five Nights at Freddy's using data from the Android 2.0.7 release.
gh-1463022818.content:
FNaF 1 for PS Vita
An unofficial PS Vita port of Five Nights at Freddy's using the supported Android 2.0.7 data revision.
The port uses a game-specific native runtime written in C, with GXM rendering and a custom audio mixer. The Windows Data Tool prepares assets and compiles selected rules and layout data from your Android copy.
This repository contains no game files. You need your own legally obtained copy of the FNaF 1 Android APK.
Release: v0.1.0-beta.1 · Vita application version: 00.17 · Title ID: FNAFSCN01
Features

Nights 1–5, Night 6 and Custom Night
All four animatronics, the power outage and Freddy's outage attack, rare events and phone calls
Cameras with room effects and the office perspective effect
Subtitles in 11 languages, including Japanese, Chinese and Korean
Touch controls and physical buttons
Extras as local switches (no store purchases)
Saves to ux0:data/fnaf1/progress.sav

Controls

Where
Button
Action

Office
L / R
Left / right door

Office
Hold □ / ○
Left / right light

Office
D-pad ← / → or left stick
Look left / right

Office / Cameras
✕
Raise / lower the camera monitor

Cameras
D-pad
Switch cameras

Office / Cameras
△
Mute the phone call

During a night
Start
Open the pause menu

Office / Cameras
Select
Open controls help

Title screen
Select
Toggle the diagnostic HUD

Menus
D-pad / ✕ / ○
Move / confirm / back

The touch screen works for the doors, lights, camera map and monitor bar, and for Freddy's poster nose.
In Extras, Unlimited Power, Fast Nights and Radar disable progress and stars for that run. Plushies don't.
Installation
You need a Vita with homebrew support and VitaShell. You also need a Windows PC with Python 3.11+ and FFmpeg. Linux and macOS are not supported in this beta.

Get the APK. Use the FNaF 1 Android APK from your own purchase. Only one data revision is supported. The tool checks the SHA-256 of res/raw/application.ccn against this value:
70a1ec40284d4f5232d0ecedcbd94a68c51cd937983ad17d2cbf329aad35b6d4
Build the game data on your PC. Download the Data Tool ZIP from Releases, extract it and run:
py -3 -m pip install -r requirements-assets.txt
py -3 prepare_assets.py --apk "C:\Games\your-copy.apk" --ffmpeg "C:\Tools\ffmpeg.exe"
If FFmpeg is on your PATH, you can also drag the APK onto Prepare-Game-Data.cmd. The tool needs about 2 GB of temporary space and the Windows fonts consola.ttf, tahoma.ttf, YuGothM.ttc, simsun.ttc and malgun.ttf (use --font-dir if they're elsewhere). It creates prepared/fnaf1/.
Copy the data to the Vita. Copy the fnaf1 folder to ux0:data/, so you end up with ux0:data/fnaf1/game.version, ux0:data/fnaf1/public-ui.version and ux0:data/fnaf1/ui/subtitles.idx. Watch out for a nested fnaf1/fnaf1 folder.
Install the VPK. Install the VPK from the Releases page with VitaShell. The first launch prepares sounds and textures, so give it a moment.

The prepared folder contains the game's files. Keep it for yourself. Don't upload it or attach it to anything.
Upgrading from the private 00.16 build
Keep ux0:data/fnaf1/progress.sav and progress.bak, and don't uninstall the game. The public build loads its menu graphics from the data folder, so prepare a UI-only update into an empty folder:
py -3 prepare_assets.py --apk "C:\Games\your-copy.apk" --ui-only --output "prepared-ui/fnaf1" --ffmpeg "C:\Tools\ffmpeg.exe"
Merge it into ux0:data/fnaf1/, then install the new VPK.
Known limitations

Beta. The 00.17 build has passed the local tests and full data preparation, but hasn't been tested on a real Vita yet. See testing.
AI and RNG. Starting AI levels come from the supported game data. Edge cases and balance still need comparison with Android.
The perspective effect is a native approximation.
Menu labels are in English.
Loading. The first time a camera is opened, its image depends on memory card speed. A jumpscare may briefly wait to load the first time.
No vibration on the handheld, because the Vita has no rumble motor. Vibration targets supported paired controllers.

Building from source
The build needs a native Windows VitaSDK with libvita2d, libogg, libvorbis and zlib. Run prepare_assets.py with your APK first, because the build uses headers generated from your game data (Git ignores them).
py -3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt
./scripts/build.ps1 -SdkPath "C:\VitaSDK"
The script runs the Python tests and the ARM core, renderer, reader, audio and UI checks, then writes the VPK to out/. The VPK only contains files from an allowlist: the executable, Vita app metadata, original launcher artwork and license notices. The Python format tests work without game data.
Source layout

Night simulation, animatronic behavior, doors, lights, power and save format

Rare events, hallucinations, poster encounter

Scene data access and partial Fusion event interpreter

src/game_view.c, src/gpu_renderer.c
Drawing and GXM GPU rendering

src/asset_stream.c
Background file-reader thread

src/audio_cache.c, src/game_audio.c
Sound caching and mixing

src/android_menu.c
Menus built from the original Android layout

src/scene_probe.c
Vita frontend and entry point, including input, timing and save I/O

prepare_assets.py
APK → Vita data, with hash and checksum verification

scripts/decode_scenes.py, scripts/compile_scenes.py
Decode Fusion build 296 data and compile it into C tables

scripts/prepare_game.py
Generate game rules (including starting AI levels) from your data

Full notices are in third_party/licenses/ and inside the VPK. See CREDITS.md for details and development references.
Credits

Port code is under the MIT license.

Report bugs in Issues with the app version, night/camera, Vita firmware and steps to reproduce. Never attach game files or save files.

hs4yq6.title: GTA 6 Breakfast Run walkthrough
hs4yq6.content: Breakfast Run is the thirtieth mission in GTA 6.In this Breakfast Run, Jason (who is finally out of bed) and Lucia embark on a seemingly chill breakfast trip that quickly turns into a robbery spree across Port Gellhorn.This guide, like all our GTA 6 walkthroughs, is totally spoiler free. We’re just here to describe mechanics. Cool momments, needledrops and more will be left for you to find out.Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to check out our complete walkthrough hub, featuring beginner tips, navigation experience explained, GTA 6 cheats, and more.GTA 6 Breakfast Run walkthroughTo start Breakfast Run, you first need to complete the Slam Dunk mission in Chapter 2: Paradise Lost.Once you’ve finished, wait for Jason to call. This can take around half a day of in-game time, you can either skip time, by going back to the motel, or simply explore the area, there are plenty of side missions you can pick up during this time.Eventually, the icon at the motel will light up, meaning you can begin the mission by returning to Jason.After a cutscene showing Jason recovering from his injuries, the pair decide to head out for breakfast. Your first destination is Hank’s Waffles. But, sadly, you aren’t going there for something to eat.Kick down the door and draw your weapon and aim it at the staff to threaten them. They’ll open the cash register and place the money on the counter. Move around the diner to threaten all the patrons, if you don’t they can attack you during this sequence. Collect all the cash you can and continue to the next robbery before the time runs out.The rest of this mission is a montage of Jason and Lucia turning over businesses around the area. Their next stops are a liquor store and a thrift store. Each of these areas follow the same idea: threaten the staff, collect the money from the register and return to the car. There’s a timer in each of those, too, so keep an eye on them.During one of the robberies, the person behind the counter will attempt to shoot Jason, at which point you’ll have to make it out of the shop alive. He simply can’t spend any more time in bed.After all this carnage, it’s time to escape the police. You only have a two-star wanted level, so this shouldn’t be too hard. Once you’ve escaped, a cutscene takes you and Jason back to the Motel.GTA 6 Breakfast Run rewardsCompleting Breakfast Run unlocks the Trust trophy.After Breakfast Run, you can once again play as Jason in the open world.This leads directly into Coffee Break, the next mission in GTA 6’s second chapter. This mission doesn’t have a mission title pop up the corner, but the in-game mission list does count it.

1oghamr.title: 'Forever' chemicals? Don't be so sure, says engineer
1oghamr.content:
Mohammed Almafrachi Ph.D. '26, water system treatment manager for Baltimore City's Water Facility Division, leads UMD engineering students on a tour of the Ashburton filtration plant, which processes up to 165 million gallons of drinking water a day. The city has partnered with UMD researchers to test different methods of lowering PFAS levels in the water. Credit: John T. Consoli

Inside the disinfection room of Baltimore's Ashburton water filtration plant, 14 University of Maryland students clad in hard hats peered up at six towering vats of bleach used to treat water that flows from the distant Liberty Reservoir into the facility, killing bacteria and other pathogens before it's routed to the region's kitchen sinks.

But bleach can't conquer per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances—commonly called PFAS—a class of synthetic chemicals. Resistant to grease and water, they gave us nonstick cookware, waterproofing technology, durable medical devices and firefighting foam. But these substances' ironclad chemical bonds, which earned them the nickname "forever chemicals," have a darker side linked to deadly cancers, infertility, and immune and developmental damage to infants and children.
They might also be called "everywhere chemicals" because they are widely found in basic items like clothes, cosmetics and pizza boxes, as well as soil, air and drinking water.
"PFAS—this guy doesn't care about anything," said Ashburton plant manager Mohammed Almafrachi, Ph.D. '26, as he led the UMD students through the facility last Tuesday. "We can add whatever chemicals we want to the water, but he's going to stay here."

Guangbin Li, UMD assistant professor of civil and environmental engineering, and Deneen Gordon, division chief of the Baltimore City Department of Public Works Laboratory Operations Division, investigate water samples at the Ashburton filtration plant. Credit: University of Maryland

A research partnership targets PFAS
Not if Guangbin Li, UMD assistant professor of civil and environmental engineering, has anything to say about it. Although one government study detected PFAS chemicals in nearly half of the nation's tap water, the PFAS expert envisions a day when the stubborn chemicals can be curbed to the point of eliminating health risks.
For the past two years, he and his students have collaborated with Baltimore's Department of Public Works, which oversees the city's water system, to study PFAS interventions; city officials have provided water samples and data to Li's team, while he has shared his technology with water engineers.
"People call it forever chemicals, but scientifically it's not forever," Li said. "We still have a ways to go, but we have the technology to destroy them."

A sponge for stubborn chemicals
While many scientists have attempted to lower PFAS by converting it with aggressive heat or electricity to carbon dioxide—nontoxic, but still a gas that contributes to climate change—Li's method uses micrometer-sized adsorbents like carbon that soak the PFAS up like a sponge and lock it in place. The resulting solids either remain safely buried in soil for years or can be removed from treated water after a few hours to a few days.
By experimenting with different chemical combinations with which to arm the adsorbents, Li's aim is to build a kind of super sponge that ensnares not one but the majority of the most dangerous PFAS and converts them into recyclable materials.
At the same time, his research has led him to question the promises of other scientists using similar methods. While some claim that current soil-based adsorbents can trap certain PFAS for up to 100 years, Li has found that the true number could be less than 20 years.
"We should be prepared for a future of these chemicals coming back to us sooner than we think," said Li, who recently published his findings in Environmental Science & Technology.
Bringing lab research to Baltimore's plants
The Ashburton plant, a large, labyrinthine building erected in 1956, processes up to 165 million gallons (625 million liters) of drinking water a day for consumers stretching from Towson to Columbia, Maryland, but it was never designed to treat PFAS. Li is working with Almafrachi—his former student who runs the Ashburton facility as well as the city's other two filtration plants—to identify opportunities for modifications and pilot programs introducing new adsorbents.
"He has all the scientific and engineering knowledge of PFAS, and we have the operational knowledge," said Almafrachi, who as a UMD doctoral student designed a chemical catalyst that adsorbs PFAS. He calls the collaboration between the university and his team "Terps helping Terps."
Meanwhile, through his connections to Almafrachi and other Baltimore engineers, Li appreciates the chance to expose his students to the real-world infrastructure challenges facing the city, which houses one of the nation's oldest filtration systems.
"We have fancy technology in our lab, but it's still a lab," he says. "There's a gap, sometimes huge, between it and the real, full-scale system that students see on the tour."

Publication details

5cig9c.title: Как я свой терминал делал с блэкджеком и двумя Fable
5cig9c.content: Уровень сложностиСреднийВремя чтения9 минОхват и читатели1KКейсВсем привет! Эта небольшая статья будет про то, как я делал свой терминал с Fable (точнее, с двумя Fable) и что из этого получилось.Спойлер №1: прогресс от 5.1 до 5.2 действительно есть, но всё ещё не ван промпт, а скорее несколько суток работы.И спойлер №2: терминал здесь разрабатывается не сам по себе, а как часть тулзы Slightly Parallel (MIT, opensource), которая предназначена для ведения нескольких проектов с помощью мультиагентной разработки.Статья про неё, если кому интересно, здесь, гитхаб здесь: Slightly Parallel.ОглавлениеСначала плохая новость, или обычное воркфлоуТерминал и его разработкаFable 5.1 vs Fable 5.2Сколько терминал естСколько времени заняло и сколько стоило?Что в итоге получилосьВот итоговый терминал:Терминал Slightly Parallel в работе: команды оболочки, переключение проектов и группировка вкладокЕстественно, доступный в разных скинах:Nord, Gruvbox Dark, SP Paper -> Rosé Pine, Solarized Light, SP Paper (на гифе, а так значительно больше)Окно терминала Slightly Parallel в разных цветовых темахОбычное воркфлоу, или Плохая новостьЗачем всё это понадобилось? Всё дело в том, что моё обычное воркфлоу выглядит вот так:(Скриншот реальный от Fable 5.2)Ладно, шутка:), на самом деле всё немного оптимистичней :) Обычно я работаю над несколькими проектами сразу, но над ограниченным числом фичей / задач в каждом: мне это кажется оптимальнее, чем до бесконечности пытаться распараллеливать один проект.Если представить это всё визуально, получится как-то так: неуправляемый хаос слева превращается в частично контролируемый хаос справа.Как Slightly Parallel связывает проекты и чаты агентовОрганизуется всё это через Slightly Parallel: в нём можно накапливать идеи / задачи / правила / скилы «не отходя от кассы», т. е. прям в терминале с помощью команд, а ещё есть достаточно удобный графический интерфейс.В целом работает всё уже неплохо, но обычный терминал не умеет в интеграцию с SP, что убивает огромное количество потенциальных возможностей, а заменять терминалы большими окнами GUI с чатом мне тоже не хотелось.Поэтому я и решил сделать свой терминал с глубокой интеграцией в SP и фокусом на агентную разработку. Терминал и его разработкаСобственно, ТЗ предельно простое :) Терминал должен был:быть быстрым;потреблять адекватное количество памяти;быть мультиплатформенным;быть интегрированным с SP и оптимизировать агентную разработку.И если бы не последнее требование, ничего делать бы не пришлось: классных терминалов, которые отвечают первым трём условиям, уже очень много.Fable 5.1 vs Fable 5.2Первая попытка была сделана более месяца назад, ещё с фейблом 5.1.Обычно я не использую фейблт. к. для большинства моих задач мне хватает Opus, но терминал это сложная задача, потенциально с бесконечным количеством багов, поэтому сразу решил использовать топовую модель для «максимизации шансов на успех».Вместо тысячи слов одна картинка:Первый прототип: Fable 5.1 встроил терминал в веб-страницу Slightly ParallelНа первый взгляд, неплохо, однако я им не пользовался (за месяц, что прошёл, было не более трёх запусков).Основные причины:я недостаточно чётко понимал, что мне нужно, и в итоге согласился на слопно-унылые предложения Fable 5.1.терминал был реализован в браузере, что делало его громоздким и убивало весь смысл.очень низкая вариативность предложенных опций (обычно, когда я не знаю на 100%, чего хочу, я прошу сделать несколько вариантов / прототипов и потом выбираю). Тем не менее, когда вышел Fable 5.2, я решил посмотреть, как он справится с этой задачей.Особых надежд у меня не былоКаждый выход любой топовой модели сопровождается массовой хайп-кампанией с тысячей роликов в X о том, как модель всё порешала, Photoshop навайбкодила, всю еду в торговом автомате продала, в Minecraft все алмазы нашла и т. д. и т. п. (попутно решив пару задач века, своровав решения прям из чата математиков, которые решили обсудить идею с ИИ 🤡), но, несмотря на столь разительный прогресс, часто оказывается, что для многих задач соотношение цена / качество у рабочей модели существенно лучше, чем у распиаренного топа.Однако уже через 40 минут у меня было шесть вариантов, и все они были действительно разные (ниже гиф с шестью полученными вариантами). Шесть вариантов интерфейса терминала, предложенных Fable 5.2Скажу честно — варианты были не 100% то, что нужно, но в них было достаточно оригинальных идей и примеров, которые можно было переиспользовать. (Креативность Fable 5.2 существенно выше, чем у Fable 5.1.)Впрочем, тут стоит сделать поправку :) С 5.1 я хуже понимал, чего хочу, поэтому «креативнее» — моё впечатление от этих попыток; честные тесты двум моделям я не устраивал.После того как дизайн и функционал определились, пришлось выбрать, на чём это собрать.Сначала я не стал вмешиваться в работу Fable 5.2 (понадеявшись на хайп SOTA-модели), но итог получился достаточно печальным, хоть и ожидаемым.Как говорится, «родила царица в ночь не то сына, не то дочь». В общем, продукт оказался абсолютно нерабочим, лагучим чудовищем. После чего фейбл, видно, испытывая гордость родителя, старательно пытался меня убедить, что данный выбор технологий — это точно топ для нашей задачи, а все, что мне нужно, — это просто потестировать вот еще вот эту фичу руками. Руками, Карл!, отправить ему фидбек, и уж тогда-то все точно заработает.Матерный фидбек про сожжённые токены и потраченное время я ему, конечно, отправил, но потом мне пришлось погрузиться несколько глубже и потестировать, что на самом деле будет работать.Шаг 1 — нужно было найти то, что в идеале будет работать сразу на трёх системах (т. к. SP работает на линуксе, винде и маке), без запредельного уровня боли.Варианты стека для кроссплатформенного терминалаСамый симпатичный и идейно правильный вариант из всех возможных — это сделать что-то полностью с нуля на Rust. Но после короткого размышления я понял, что это будет оверкилл для MVP (грубая оценка — до реально рабочей версии минимум 7+ дней работы и прорва токенов), поэтому я посмотрел в сторону более реалистичного сценария и выбрал Electron.Electron: за и против👍 Официально работает во всех трёх системах; внутри у него свой Chromium, поэтому окно должно везде выглядеть и вести себя одинаково.👎 Жирный минус — для установки Electron на машине нужен Node 20+, что ограничивает круг пользователей. Но с минусом я смирился, т. к. терминал — это дополнительная фича Slightly Parallel, который может спокойно работать и без терминала, поэтому кто может — поставит с фичей, а кто нет, тот нет. Тем более если станет популярней, то всегда можно собирать готовые установщики или переписать с нуля. (В целом был бы рад услышать ваши мысли про оптимальный стек для опенсорса такого типа.)Сколько терминал естВсе мы знаем, что лень и обжорство одни из смертных грехов, поэтому следующий шаг был - убедиться, что терминал им не будет подвержен (т. е. нужно было оценить скорость и базовое потребление памяти).«Обжорство», фрагмент картины «Семь смертных грехов и четыре последние вещи», Иероним Босх, 1510-20Чтобы это сделать, нужны были тесты, которые позволят сравнить производительность и прожорливость разных конфигураций. Первые тесты я делал на своём ноуте (Core Ultra 5 225H, Ubuntu 24.04.5, 31 ГБ оперативной памяти, графика Intel, GNOME на Wayland), а последующие на виртуалках гитхаба.Тест был такой: 20 МБ цветного вывода (280 тыс. строк) в окне 1000×640, с историей 10 000 строк. Один и тот же поток прогонял через разные движки и смотрел время, прокрутку и память.Сравниваемые конфигурации:VTE (родной виджет GNOME Terminal);сам GNOME Terminal;Chromium + xterm.js (то, на чём работает Electron);WebKitGTK + xterm.js (то, на чём на линуксе работает Tauri и на чём Fable 5.2 изначально собрал окно);для обоих веб-движков ещё и вариант с WebGL-рендером xterm.js. Скорость вывода и расход памяти у VTE, GNOME Terminal, Chromium и WebKitGTKВыводы:WebKitGTK в 4 раза медленнее Chromium и в 10 раз медленнее родного терминала, а по памяти выигрыш небольшой (по отношению к Chromium).WebGL не помог ни одному движку (фейбл утверждал, что будет топ).Родной терминал быстрее всех, но тогда интерфейс под три системы пришлось бы писать три раза.Поэтому Chromium прошёл второй «отборочный этап», и теперь нужно было оценить, сколько памяти всё это будет занимать под нагрузкой.Адекватное потребление памяти для нормальной работы я оценил как 500–1000 МБДо начала эксперимента я заложил 500–1000 МБ оперативки на стандартный сценарий работы. Это существенно больше, чем у нативных вариантов, но в принципе приемлемая плата за удобство.Как мерил: главное окно и отдельные окна того же приложения (как когда открепляешь чат в своё окно), в каждом живой терминал, в который перед замером выведено 12 000 строк (история 10 000 строк). то же самое для вкладок в одном окне. Всё в двух режимах: с tmux (история живёт в tmux, так по умолчанию на линуксе и маке) и без (историю держит само окно, так всегда на винде).Каждая точка измерялась три раза, в таблице медиана. Расход памяти на окна и вкладки Electron с tmux и без него в сравнении с GNOME TerminalРезультат:одно окно: 222 МБ с tmux, 281 МБ без;каждое следующее окно: около 44 МБ с tmux, около 64 МБ без; отдельно сервер tmux растёт примерно на 18 МБ на терминал.Итого 20 окон: 1 051 МБ с tmux, 1 501 МБ без против 343 МБ у родного GNOME Terminal. В целом ок, поэтому остановился на следующей конфигурации терминала:окно — Electron, терминал в окне — xterm.js, сервер — Slightly Parallel.Подробнейна линуксе и маке сессии живут в tmux и переживают закрытие окна и перезапуск сервера;на винде используется ConPTY, tmux там нет, поэтому терминалы закрываются вместе с сервером;оболочка на винде: PowerShell 7, если его нет — Windows PowerShell, если и его нет — cmd.Последний шаг — убедиться, что чудесные цифры — это не works on my machine only.Для этого всё поднималось через GitHub Actions на трёх виртуалках (благо, для публичных репо они бесплатные, хоть и с лимитами): Ubuntu, macOS и Windows.Схема GitHub Actions: тесты и бенчмарки терминала на Ubuntu, macOS и WindowsНа схеме тесты и замеры (бенчмарки) разделены. В ci-terminal запускаются тесты, которые чекают работоспособность терминала. А бенчмарки гоняются на другой ветке (ci-bench), чтобы не создавать конкуренцию за macOS-машину, которая для бесплатного гитхаб акшенс доступна в количестве одной штуки.Итог теста:память ведёт себя одинаково на всех трёх системах: растёт по прямой с числом окон (примерно +140–220 МБ working set на окно). Вкладки значительно дешевле: 20 вкладок занимают на 60–160 МБ больше, чем одна;вывод 20 МБ через оболочку: линукс — 0,9 с с tmux и 1,8 с без tmux; мак — 3,8 с с tmux и 10,7 с без tmux; винда — 17,2 с.Расход памяти и время вывода 20 МБ на виртуальных машинах Ubuntu, macOS и WindowsP.S. Числам потребления памяти при разном числе окон (левый верхний график) ужасаться не стоит. На ноутбуке я считал PSS всего дерева Electron (что соответствует реальной работе), а на виртуалке приведена сумма working set процессов.Завышение потребления памяти можно оценить как минимум в два разаНапример, в одном Linux-замере CI те же 20 окон с tmux — это 1 219 МБ PSS и 4 272 МБ working set.Working set повторно учитывает общие страницы, поэтому числа получаются существенно больше, а выбрать его пришлось для единообразности на маке, винде и линуксе.По скорости (левый нижний график) в целом видно, что линукс и мак ок, а винда — аутсайдер.Это происходит из-за медленной консоли (ConPTY), если же пустить те же 20 МБ прямо в окно, то это займёт только 2,0 с.Так что это явный задел на будущее: если прогой будут пользоваться — винду явно придётся переписывать 😂Итог: 👍 скорость и потребление памяти я счёл приемлемыми (для типичной работы хеви юзера): должно умещаться в 1500 МБ, для обычного пользователя — существенно меньше (до 700–1000 МБ). Поэтому приступил к шлифовке и доработке терминала.P.S. Скорость работы можно оценить прямо на своём ноутбуке, бенч лежит в репозитории.Как запуститьЕсли терминал уже собран из исходников, зайдите в папку desktop и запустите npm run bench. Если интересует только скорость вывода, хватит npm run bench -- -g speed. Бенч поднимет свой сервер на свободном порту. Таблица с результатами и JSON со всеми повторами появятся в desktop/e2e/bench/out/.Сколько времени заняло и сколько стоило?Первый терминал: 26 коммитов, 3 114 добавленных строк кода и 535 строк тестов. За месяц я открыл его раза три :) Сколько на него ушло токенов, уже не скажу: в чатах первой попытки расход не сохранился.Для второго терминала фейбл выдал первые 6 макетов за 41 минуту. А от постановки задачи до последнего коммита по терминалу 20 ноября прошло 4 дня 8 часов 50 минут. За это время набралось 186 коммитов. В них 16 321 добавленная строка кода, а тестов почти столько же: 16 055 строк.Агенты суммарно отработали 54 ч 53 мин. Из них 25 ч 52 мин пришлось на сабагентов. У Claude Code было 44 помощника, у Codex ещё 27.По тарифам API разработка второго терминала обошлась бы примерно в $550. Вместе с сопутствующими задачами получилось бы $927.На GitHub Actions тоже набежало: 58 запусков, из них 35 в ветках для проверки винды. Суммарно виртуалки отработали 29 ч 12 мин.Разработка терминала в цифрах: коммиты, время работы агентов, прогоны CI и стоимость по тарифам APIЧто в итоге получилосьПо размеру и ощущению скорости работы терминал не уступает нативному терминалу.Минимализм — есть возможность схлопывать и настраивать верхнюю полоску.Сворачивание верхней строки терминала в узкую полоску и её разворачивание3. Проектное управление: можно переключаться от воркспейса (воркспейсы определяются проектами) к воркспейсу + можно группировать вкладки.Переход из чата к обзору рабочих пространств и переключение между ними4. В левом сайдбаре можно увидеть все текущие проекты и их терминалы.Левая панель терминала со списком проектов и открытых чатов5. Есть возможность быстрого возобновления работы.6. Можно усыпить воркспейс — в этом случае все агенты засыпают, серверы продолжают работу. Потом также можно разбудить одной кнопкой.7. В правом сайдбаре можно увидеть запиненные сообщения и таски, над которыми работали в этом чате.8. Идея запиненного сообщения — некоторые сообщения важнее других, теперь их можно не терять.9. Также в правом сайдбаре есть небольшой текстовый редактор, чтобы не переключаться с одной вкладки на другую.Правая панель терминала с закреплёнными сообщениями, задачами и редактором заметок10. 💪 Таймер, который позволяет следить за здоровьем: он отслеживает, сколько времени прошло, и подсвечивает терминал жёлтым и красным, когда нужно сделать перерыв (естественно, всё настраиваемо).Таймер перерыва меняет цвет индикатора в окне терминала (таймер в левом нижнем углу это не часть терминала - он нужен, чтобы показать, сколько времени прошло :)) 11. Всякие мелочи, скины, индикаторы ресурсов компьютера, индикаторы, сколько всего времени вы работали, сколько времени работали над этим проектом, быстрые клавиши и т. д. и т. п.12. Нативная интеграция с СП. Собственно, цель достигнута — теперь таски, заметки, сделанные скилы и т. д. и т. п. можно смотреть прям из терминала, не переключаясь.Просмотр записей Slightly Parallel прямо в окне терминалаВот и всё! Всем спасибо за прочтение!Если хотите использовать Slightly Parallel, он лежит на GitHub.Если есть вопросы по использованию, идеи фичей или вы заметили баги, самый простой способ — написать мне в LinkedIn (буду рад коннекту) / здесь в комментариях или в дискуссиях на гитхабе.

English

Projeto de fãs, sem fins lucrativos. Castlevania é marca registrada da Konami; este projeto não tem relação com a Konami. Este repositório não contém o jogo: você precisa da sua própria cópia do DVD (a versão americana, SLUS-20733).

English summary below
O que é
Um port nativo do Castlevania: Lament of Innocence (PlayStation 2, 2003) para Windows. Não é um emulador: o código do jogo é traduzido para C++ e compilado para x86-64 (recompilação estática), com o motor PS2 próprio do projeto (Otavix).
Como o código do jogo não pode ser distribuído, o seu PC gera e compila a parte do jogo a partir da sua ISO. Um comando só faz tudo.
Estado atual: beta
O jogo roda do começo: abertura, vídeos, menus e jogo, a 60 FPS num PC atual (testado num Ryzen 7 9800X3D). A parte gráfica do console (GS) roda na placa de vídeo (OpenGL 4.3). Os microprogramas de geometria do VU1 são traduzidos para C++ na sua máquina, a partir do executável do seu disco (a etapa "VU1" do gerador).
É a primeira versão: o jogo ainda não foi jogado até o fim no port. Relate pelo launcher o que encontrar.
Opções
Pelo Otavix Launcher, no menu de opções do jogo: janela ou tela cheia (no jogo, F11 ou Alt+Enter alternam), tamanho da janela, resolução interna (1x, 2x ou 4x), escalonador (bilinear, AMD FSR 1 ou NVIDIA Image Scaling) e a nitidez dele, anti-serrilhamento FXAA e predefinições. A imagem fica em 4:3 (tela larga e modo 30 FPS ainda não existem neste jogo). Sem o launcher, as mesmas opções são variáveis de ambiente: PS2X_TELA_CHEIA=1, PS2X_JANELA_TAM=1920x1080, PS2X_RESOLUCAO=1|2|4, PS2X_ESCALA=nenhum|bilinear|fsr|nis, PS2X_NITIDEZ_PCT=0..100, PS2X_FXAA=1.
Teclado e mouse
O teclado e o mouse funcionam junto com o controle. As teclas são trocadas na página Controles do
Otavix Launcher, que também liga ou desliga o teclado e o mouse e ajusta a sensibilidade. Teclas padrão:

Sem o launcher: PS2X_TECLADO=0|1, PS2X_MOUSE=0|1, PS2X_MOUSE_SENS=5..200 e PS2X_TECLAS="cross=space;square=mouse1 j;lstick_up=w" (botão=teclas, separados por ;).

Requisitos

A sua ISO do Castlevania: Lament of Innocence, na versão americana (NTSC-U) (SLUS-20733). O gerador confere o executável e, se não bater, diz se é outra edição (outra região ou versão) ou o mesmo disco com o executável modificado.
Memória: o gerador usa uns 3 GB de RAM por compilação em paralelo e escolhe o paralelismo pela memória livre; com pouca RAM funciona, só demora mais.
Disco: alguns GB livres para os arquivos do disco, o código traduzido e a compilação.
AVX2 não é obrigatório: o gerador detecta a CPU e usa as bibliotecas AVX2 ou SSE4.

Problemas conhecidos

Primeira versão: o jogo ainda não foi jogado até o fim no port.
Sem tela larga (16:9) e sem modo 30 FPS por enquanto.
Esta é a versão americana (NTSC-U) apenas (SLUS-20733); outras regiões e versões são recusadas pelo gerador, com o motivo.

Como gerar
Pelo Otavix Launcher
O Otavix Launcher lista este port: ele baixa o port, pede a ISO, gera o jogo e abre.
À mão
1. O que você precisa ter: a sua cópia do Castlevania: Lament of Innocence americano (SLUS-20733, "Castlevania - Lament of Innocence (USA)") como imagem .iso do DVD (ou .bin/.img de setores brutos). O gerador confere o executável do jogo pelo hash: outras versões não servem, porque o mapa de funções é o da americana.
2. Instale as ferramentas (uma vez só), num terminal:
winget install Microsoft.VisualStudio.2022.BuildTools --override "--quiet --wait --add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Workload.VCTools --add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.CMake.Project --add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Llvm.Clang --includeRecommended"

O resto o gerador baixa sozinho: o motor do port (pacote pronto, conferido pelo SHA-256) e o FFmpeg (LGPL). Não precisa de Python nem de Git.
3. Baixe este repositório (botão Code > Download ZIP, ou git clone) e extraia numa pasta sem espaços no caminho, por exemplo C:\castlevania-loi. Deixe uns 15 GB livres nesse disco (os arquivos do disco, o código traduzido e a compilação).
4. Clique duas vezes em gerar.cmd e escolha a ISO. Ele:

confere a ISO e extrai os arquivos do disco para trabalho\disc;
baixa o motor do port (pacote pronto, conferido pelo SHA-256);
traduz o código do jogo e os microprogramas do VU1 para C++ (só no seu PC);
compila o código do jogo (de 5 a 30 minutos, conforme o PC; precisa de 16 GB de RAM ou mais).

5. Jogue com jogar.cmd. O jogo lê os arquivos de trabalho\disc e a ISO no lugar onde ela estava na geração (se mudar a ISO de lugar, rode gerar.cmd -RefazerDe 2).
Depois de atualizar o port, gerar.cmd -RefazerDe 3 baixa o motor novo, retraduz e recompila sem extrair o disco de novo.
Perguntas frequentes
Este repositório tem o jogo? Não. Você precisa da sua própria cópia do DVD; o gerador monta o port no seu PC a partir da sua ISO.
Roda no Linux ou no SteamOS? Ainda não: só o port de God of War: Ascension tem versão Linux (beta). Este roda no Windows.
O gerador disse "executável modificado" ou "edição diferente". E agora? "Edição diferente" é outra região ou versão do disco; "executável modificado" é o mesmo disco com um executável alterado (patch, tradução, hack ou outra tiragem). Use uma cópia original sem modificações (SLUS-20733).
Saiu uma atualização do port. O que faço? Atualize pelo launcher e gere de novo (gerar.cmd -RefazerDe 3 à mão): ele baixa o motor novo, retraduz e recompila sem extrair o disco de novo.
Onde relato um problema? No launcher, em "Reportar problema" na página do jogo.
Como funciona

O motor (tradutor MIPS R5900 → C++ e runtime: GS, VU1, DMA, IOP, áudio SPU2, cartão de memória) é próprio do projeto e vem pronto (bibliotecas compiladas); o seu PC só traduz e compila o código do jogo.
O mapa de funções (jogo\ghidra_funcoes.csv) veio de uma análise com o Ghidra e a extensão ghidra-emotionengine-reloaded: são só endereços e nomes, nada do código do jogo. jogo\entradas_extra.txt lista funções chamadas só por ponteiro e alvos de tabelas de salto que a análise não marcou.
A receita do VU1 (jogo\vu1_receita.json) diz onde os microprogramas de geometria ficam no executável (offsets e tamanhos, conferidos por SHA-1) e como montar a memória de código do VU1.
O ritmo do jogo segue o relógio do PC (PS2X_RELOGIO_REAL=1 no jogo\jogo.json): o jogo espera por tempo em laços, e sem isso ficava abaixo de 60 FPS.

Licença e créditos

O nosso código (gerar.ps1, gerar.cmd): MIT.
O motor do port (pacote otx-motor-ps2, baixado pronto pelo gerador) não é coberto pela licença MIT; os avisos de terceiros dele (raylib e glfw: zlib; FFmpeg: LGPL, DLLs à parte) estão no TERCEIROS.txt do pacote.
O NIS vem do NVIDIA Image Scaling SDK (MIT) e o FSR 1 do AMD FidelityFX FSR (MIT).
O ícone vem da capa do jogo no libretro-thumbnails.
Castlevania é marca registrada da Konami. Este é um projeto de fãs, sem fins lucrativos, sem relação com a Konami nem endossado por ela.

English summary
A native PC port of Castlevania: Lament of Innocence (PlayStation 2, 2003) made by static recompilation with the project's own PS2 engine. Beta, first release. It runs from the start (intro, videos, menus and gameplay) at 60 FPS on a current PC; it has not been played to the end in the port yet. The console's graphics chip (GS) runs on your GPU (OpenGL 4.3). Options in the launcher: window or fullscreen (F11 / Alt+Enter), window size, internal resolution (1x, 2x or 4x), upscaler (bilinear, AMD FSR 1, NVIDIA Image Scaling) and sharpness, FXAA. The picture stays 4:3 (no widescreen or 30 FPS mode yet). Keyboard and mouse work alongside the controller.
Platforms: Windows 10/11 only for now (Linux is not supported yet; only the God of War: Ascension port has a Linux beta). Easiest: the Otavix Launcher.
Bring your own game: no game code or data here, only the function map (addresses), translation settings and the VU1 "recipe" (offsets and sizes in your executable). You need the US release (SLUS-20733, Redump "Castlevania - Lament of Innocence (USA)") as an .iso. Install Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools with C++, CMake and Clang (commands above), download this repository to a path without spaces with about 15 GB free, double-click gerar.cmd (it checks your ISO, extracts the disc files, downloads the prebuilt engine package (no Git needed), translates the game code on your PC and builds it, in 5 to 30 minutes; 16 GB of RAM needed), then play with jogar.cmd.
License: our scripts are MIT; the engine package is not covered by it, and its third-party notices are in its TERCEIROS.txt. Castlevania is a trademark of Konami; this is a non-commercial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Konami.

1. O que você precisa ter: a sua cópia do Castlevania: Curse of Darkness americano (SLUS-21168, "Castlevania - Curse of Darkness (USA)") como imagem .iso do DVD (ou .bin/.img de setores brutos). O gerador confere o executável do jogo pelo hash: outras versões não servem, porque o mapa de funções é o da americana.
2. Instale as ferramentas (uma vez só), num terminal:
winget install Microsoft.VisualStudio.2022.BuildTools --override "--quiet --wait --add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Workload.VCTools --add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.CMake.Project --add Microsoft.VisualStudio.Component.VC.Llvm.Clang --includeRecommended"

O resto o gerador baixa sozinho: o motor do port (pacote pronto, conferido pelo SHA-256) e o FFmpeg (LGPL). Não precisa de Python nem de Git.
3. Baixe este repositório (botão Code > Download ZIP, ou git clone) e extraia numa pasta sem espaços no caminho, por exemplo C:\castlevania-cod. Deixe uns 15 GB livres nesse disco (os arquivos do disco, o código traduzido e a compilação).
4. Clique duas vezes em gerar.cmd e escolha a ISO. Ele:

confere a ISO e extrai os arquivos do disco para trabalho\disc;
baixa o motor do port (pacote pronto, conferido pelo SHA-256);
traduz o código do jogo e os microprogramas do VU1 para C++ (só no seu PC);
compila o código do jogo (de 5 a 30 minutos, conforme o PC; precisa de 16 GB de RAM ou mais).

5. Jogue com jogar.cmd. O jogo lê os arquivos de trabalho\disc e a ISO no lugar onde ela estava na geração (se mudar a ISO de lugar, rode gerar.cmd -RefazerDe 2).
Depois de atualizar o port, gerar.cmd -RefazerDe 3 baixa o motor novo, retraduz e recompila sem extrair o disco de novo.
Perguntas frequentes
Este repositório tem o jogo? Não. Você precisa da sua própria cópia do DVD; o gerador monta o port no seu PC a partir da sua ISO.
Roda no Linux ou no SteamOS? Ainda não: só o port de God of War: Ascension tem versão Linux (beta). Este roda no Windows.
O gerador disse "executável modificado" ou "edição diferente". E agora? "Edição diferente" é outra região ou versão do disco; "executável modificado" é o mesmo disco com um executável alterado (patch, tradução, hack ou outra tiragem). Use uma cópia original sem modificações (SLUS-21168).
Saiu uma atualização do port. O que faço? Atualize pelo launcher e gere de novo (gerar.cmd -RefazerDe 3 à mão): ele baixa o motor novo, retraduz e recompila sem extrair o disco de novo.
Onde relato um problema? No launcher, em "Reportar problema" na página do jogo.
Como funciona

O motor (tradutor MIPS R5900 → C++ e runtime: GS, VU1, DMA, IOP, áudio SPU2, cartão de memória) é próprio do projeto e vem pronto (bibliotecas compiladas); o seu PC só traduz e compila o código do jogo.
O mapa de funções (jogo\ghidra_funcoes.csv) veio de uma análise com o Ghidra e a extensão ghidra-emotionengine-reloaded: são só endereços e nomes, nada do código do jogo. jogo\entradas_extra.txt lista funções chamadas só por ponteiro e alvos de tabelas de salto que a análise não marcou.
A receita do VU1 (jogo\vu1_receita.json) diz onde os microprogramas de geometria ficam no executável (offsets e tamanhos, conferidos por SHA-1) e como montar a memória de código do VU1.
O ritmo do jogo segue o relógio do PC (PS2X_RELOGIO_REAL=1 no jogo\jogo.json): o jogo espera por tempo em laços, e sem isso ficava abaixo de 60 FPS.

Licença e créditos

O nosso código (gerar.ps1, gerar.cmd): MIT.
O motor do port (pacote otx-motor-ps2, baixado pronto pelo gerador) não é coberto pela licença MIT; os avisos de terceiros dele (raylib e glfw: zlib; FFmpeg: LGPL, DLLs à parte) estão no TERCEIROS.txt do pacote.
O NIS vem do NVIDIA Image Scaling SDK (MIT) e o FSR 1 do AMD FidelityFX FSR (MIT).
O ícone vem da capa do jogo no libretro-thumbnails.
Castlevania é marca registrada da Konami. Este é um projeto de fãs, sem fins lucrativos, sem relação com a Konami nem endossado por ela.

English summary
A native PC port of Castlevania: Curse of Darkness (PlayStation 2, 2005) made by static recompilation with the project's own PS2 engine. Beta, first release. It runs from the start (intro, videos, menus and gameplay) at 60 FPS on a current PC; it has not been played to the end in the port yet. The console's graphics chip (GS) runs on your GPU (OpenGL 4.3). Options in the launcher: window or fullscreen (F11 / Alt+Enter), window size, internal resolution (1x, 2x or 4x), upscaler (bilinear, AMD FSR 1, NVIDIA Image Scaling) and sharpness, FXAA. The picture stays 4:3 (no widescreen or 30 FPS mode yet). Keyboard and mouse work alongside the controller.
Platforms: Windows 10/11 only for now (Linux is not supported yet; only the God of War: Ascension port has a Linux beta). Easiest: the Otavix Launcher.
Bring your own game: no game code or data here, only the function map (addresses), translation settings and the VU1 "recipe" (offsets and sizes in your executable). You need the US release (SLUS-21168, Redump "Castlevania - Curse of Darkness (USA)") as an .iso. Install Visual Studio 2022 Build Tools with C++, CMake and Clang (commands above), download this repository to a path without spaces with about 15 GB free, double-click gerar.cmd (it checks your ISO, extracts the disc files, downloads the prebuilt engine package (no Git needed), translates the game code on your PC and builds it, in 5 to 30 minutes; 16 GB of RAM needed), then play with jogar.cmd.
License: our scripts are MIT; the engine package is not covered by it, and its third-party notices are in its TERCEIROS.txt. Castlevania is a trademark of Konami; this is a non-commercial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Konami.

2cwm9q.title: GTA 6 PC release date: Is Grand Theft Auto 6 coming to PC?
2cwm9q.content: Is GTA 6 on PC? It’s the biggest game in the world, and PS5 and Xbox Series X, leaving PC players wondering when they’ll get in on the fun.In this GTA 6 PC version guide, we’ll explain what Rockstar has said about the PC version, when to expect it, and the history of how long it took to release the PC version of older Rockstar Games.If you’re playing GTA 6 on console, check out our GTA 6 guide hub for top tips, secrets and full mission walkthroughs.Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to check out our complete walkthrough hub, featuring beginner tips, navigation experience explained, GTA 6 cheats, and more.Is GTA 6 available on PC?No, GTA 6 is not available on PC.GTA 6 is only available on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S natively. Xbox One players can play GTA 6 via Cloud Gaming.Has Rockstar confirmed a PC release date?A PC version of GTA 6 has not been announced by Rockstar.How long after GTA 5 did it come to PC?GTA 5 came to PC two years after the game was first released on console.The console release dates for GTA 5 were:September 17, 2013 – PS3, Xbox 360November 18, 2014 – PS4 and Xbox OneApril 14, 2015 – PCWhat has Rockstar said about a PC version?Rockstar hasn’t mentioned a PC version of the game.Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick mentioned in an interview that the games come to console first because that’s where GTA’s “core audience” is.Former Rockstar developers have shared their opinion on why the PC version of Rockstar games are usually released later.In an interview with the Kiwi Talkz podcast, John Ricchio – who was a producer on Red Dead Redemption, Max Payne 3 and Grand Theft Auto 5 – was asked about whether making GTA 5 for Xbox 360 and PS3 hardware led to Rockstar being limited in what it could do with the game.Ricchio replied that Rockstar’s policy is to concentrate on the console versions first, because then the hardware’s limitations are known to the developers, and then worry about making a PC version later – as opposed to making the PC version first then trying to figure out how to get it working on potentially less powerful hardware.
