gh-1466225474.title: GitHub - alexheidl/rusty-eichhof: The Last Eichhof, the 1993 Swiss freeware DOS shoot-'em-up by ALPHA-HELIX, ported to Rust: play it on Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and the web
gh-1466225474.content:
The Last Eichhof — for today's computers, phones and browsers
A faithful port of The Last Eichhof, the 1993 freeware DOS shoot-'em-up by the Swiss group
ALPHA-HELIX: you fly the Eichhof beer bottle through five levels of enemies, and between levels
you spend your earnings on weapons at the bar. This port plays the original game's own pictures, sprites, fonts, sounds,
music and levels; only the program around them is new, rewritten in Rust so the game runs on
Windows, macOS, Linux, Android and in web browsers.

The original game and its creators
The Last Eichhof — "An Alpha Helix Production, (c) copyright 1993" — was made by:

Tritone
programming, sound effects and level design

Tweety
graphics and fonts

Zynax of Dark System
additional programming and music

All the art, music, sound and level design you see and hear in this port is their work, used
unchanged. ALPHA-HELIX released the game as freeware and asked players to pass it on — the game says
"This game is FREEWARE. Please copy like crazy. If you like it, just send a postcard to
ALPHA-HELIX", and its release notes end with "PLEASE copy it to all your friends." Thank you, Tritone, Tweety and Zynax. Ein Prosit auf
ALPHA-HELIX!
The full list of original files and what the port uses them for is in CREDITS.md.
Download and play
Download the zip for your system from the Releases page, unpack it and start
last-eichhof. The original game data is built in, so nothing else is needed.

Windows, Linux: start the program.
macOS: the program isn't signed, so the first time right-click it and choose Open.
Web: the page has to come from a web server (browsers don't load WebAssembly from a file),
e.g. python3 -m http.server in the unpacked folder, then open http://localhost:8000.

Playing

Action
Keyboard
Touch screen

Move the bottle
arrow keys
drag on the right half of the screen (the bottle follows your finger's movement)

Fire
hold Space
touch and hold the left half

Pause
P
tap the top-right corner

Back / give up
Esc
tap the top-left corner

Menus
1–6, or arrows + Space/Enter
swipe up/down, tap to choose

Keys can be changed in Options → Choose keys, like in the original. A new player starts with the
game's own high-score table (ATOMMUELL … TRITONE). Settings and high scores are saved in the original
CONFIG.HIG format: in ~/.config/last-eichhof/ or %APPDATA%\last-eichhof\ on computers, in the
app's private storage on Android and in the browser's local storage on the web.
The original cheat still works: start the program with the argument 007.7.
How the port was made
The game rules were re-implemented by studying the original program (BEER.EXE, Borland C++,
16-bit DOS); every speed, price, hit point and timing taken from it is listed in
MECHANICS.md. The file formats inside BEER.DAT are described in
docs/FORMATS.md. New compared to the original: touch controls, window scaling,
and builds for modern systems.
The original source code, released around 1995 by Dany Schoch and now kept at
ForNeVeR/the-last-eichhof, turned up after the port
was written. A line-by-line comparison found the port about 90–95% identical, and the differences a
player could notice were fixed in version 1.2. What remains is on purpose or never happens in play:
at the end of a level's enemy list the original reads past the end of its data (the port stops
there), and a few cases the original leaves undefined. Details in MECHANICS.md.
Building from source
Needs Rust. The original data in data/ is built into the program.

Desktop (Windows, macOS, Linux): ./build-desktop.sh (or cargo build --release).
Web: ./build-web.sh, then serve the web/ folder with any web server.
Android: ./build-android.sh (uses macroquad's build container through Docker).

Checks: --screenshot <file.png> saves a picture of the window after about 120 frames;
--self-test <file.json> plays the first level with scripted keys and reports whether moving,
shooting and the status bar work. --scene <name> (menu, store, menucard, sell, place, hs, title,
story, gameover, victory, intro:N, play:N:ticks) jumps to one screen.
cargo build --release --no-default-features makes a build without the built-in data; it looks for
BEER.DAT next to the program instead.
How releases are made: RELEASING.md.
Project files

Path
What it is

src/
the Rust program (macroquad)

data/
the original game's BEER.DAT, CONFIG.HIG and READ.ME, unchanged (only BEER.DAT is built in)

MECHANICS.md
every rule and number taken from the original program

docs/FORMATS.md
the original file formats

tools/
Python helpers used to study the data (datdump.py, eich.py, contact.py)

web/
the page and loader for the browser version

PLAYERS.md
the short guide included in each download as README.txt

Credits
The Last Eichhof © 1993 ALPHA-HELIX (Tritone, Tweety, Zynax of Dark System), freeware.
Original source released by Dany Schoch; thanks to Friedrich von Never for keeping it available.
Port built with macroquad (MIT/Apache-2.0).
Details in CREDITS.md.
License
The port's own code is released under the MIT License. This does not cover the
original game's files in data/: The Last Eichhof and everything in BEER.DAT remain © 1993
ALPHA-HELIX, freeware, included unchanged as the authors invited ("Please copy like crazy"). See NOTICE.

1f95sh4.title: Водители Mercedes смогут убирать руки с руля на скорости 130 км/ч
1f95sh4.content: Компания Mercedes-Benz представила новое поколение электронных ассистентов. Часть задач водителя они берут на себя: машина сама перестраивается на магистралях, выбирает нужную полосу, проходит перекрестки и останавливается у светофоров. В отдельных ситуациях руки с руля можно убрать – правда, не всегда и не в любых условиях.На трассах заработает функция Hands-free Assist. Она позволяет не держать руль при скорости до 130 км/ч. Вместе с ней включается Proactive Lane Change Assist: автомобиль сам начинает и выполняет перестроение – например, чтобы обогнать или заранее занять полосу перед съездом с автомагистрали.Для города и движения по всему маршруту предназначен комплекс MB.Drive Assist Pro. Он помогает менять полосы, выбирать направление на перекрестках, поворачивать, тормозить и трогаться на светофорах. Запуск – кнопкой на руле, но только при включенной навигации.За работу системы отвечают 27 датчиков: десять камер, пять радаров и 12 ультразвуковых сенсоров. Поток данных обрабатывает высокопроизводительный компьютер – до 254 трлн операций в секунду.Ограничения, рынки и срокиПолноценным беспилотным управлением новинку Mercedes-Benz не называет. Ответственность за автомобиль остается на водителе: нужно следить за дорожной обстановкой и быть готовым вмешаться в любой момент. Даже если руки не на руле, отвлекаться от дороги нельзя.Первыми функции получат Германия и США. MB.Drive Assist Pro выйдет на этих рынках в первой половине 2027 года. В Китае похожая система уже доступна на новом Mercedes-Benz CLA.В декабре 2026 года компания начнет предварительное тестирование технологий с отдельными клиентами в Штутгарте, Мюнхене и Калифорнии. Потом помощники будут постепенно добавлять в разные модели Mercedes-Benz. Владельцы совместимых машин смогут получить их по воздуху – через обновление программного обеспечения. Какие именно модели и сколько будут стоить опции, производитель объявит позже.Ранее «За рулем» уже рассказывал, что Lamborghini отказалась от выпуска электрокаров к 2030 году. Понравилась публикация?Тогда добавьте «За рулем» в список интересных источников: 1. Откройте https://google.com... 2. Поставьте галочку напротив нашего изданияГотово – остаемся на связи! «За рулем» можно читать в ВКонтакте

5zn0bl.title: "Купил жене цветы после GTA VI": игроки считают, что новая игра Rockstar учит мужчин лучше заботиться о женщинах
5zn0bl.content:
Grand Theft Auto VI неожиданно стала предметом обсуждений не только из-за криминального сюжета, перестрелок и огромного открытого мира, но и благодаря отношениям главных героев — Джейсона и Люсии. Игроки заметили, что новая игра Rockstar Games фактически учит мужчин быть настоящими мужчинами — проявлять внимание и заботу о своих девушках. И многие уже начали переносить полученный в виртуальном мире опыт в реальную жизнь.
В отличие от предыдущих частей серии, GTA VI уделяет особое внимание романтическим отношениям. Игроки могут покупать Люсии цветы и подарки, проводить с ней время, заниматься домашними делами и другими повседневными заботами. Такие действия помогают укреплять эмоциональную связь между персонажами.
Интересные обсуждения развернулись во всех сетях, где пользователи начали делиться собственными историями о том, как GTA VI повлияла на их отношения в реальной жизни.
Чувак, сегодня жена смотрела, как я играю, и спросила, почему я отношусь к своей виртуальной девушке лучше, чем к ней. Надо было купить цветы, когда заезжал в магазин за продуктами,
— рассказал один из участников обсуждения.
Другой пользователь признался, что игра уже повлияла на его поведение:
Сегодня по дороге домой я купил жене цветы. Она сказала, что ей нравится, когда я играю в GTA VI, потому что я стал внимательнее к ней.
Некоторые комментаторы даже начали шутить, что Rockstar создала своеобразный симулятор идеального парня.
Игра действительно кое-чему тебя учит, чувак. Купи ей цветы и почини чёртов забор. На следующий день она сама оформит тебе предзаказ GTA 7,
— пошутил ещё один игрок.
В другом обсуждении пользователи и вовсе назвали GTA VI «психологической операцией, заставляющей полюбить собственную жену». Один из комментаторов сравнил романтические механики игры с троянским конём, который незаметно учит людей быть лучшими партнёрами.
Впрочем, подобные нововведения понравились далеко не всем. Некоторые игроки считают бытовые задания скучными и жалуются, что вместо привычного криминального экшена им приходится заниматься отношениями. Другие, напротив, приветствуют такой подход, отмечая, что повседневные занятия делают персонажей более живыми, а их историю — убедительной.

vx9zzf.title: За добу на фронті стались 203 зіткнення, найбільше - на Покровському напрямку
vx9zzf.content:
На фронті минулої доби, 20 листопада, були зафіксовані 203 бойові зіткнення Сил оборони України з російськими загарбниками.

Як передає Укрінформ, про це ідеться у повідомленні Генерального штабу Збройних сил України у Фейсбуці про ситуацію станом на 8:00 суботи, 21 листопада.

Ворог завдав трьох ракетних та 78 авіаційних ударів, скинувши 242 керовані авіабомби. Крім того, російські загарбники застосували 6224 дрони-камікадзе та здійснили 1976 обстрілів.

Під російськими артилерійськими ударами перебували Лужки, Кореньок, Яструбщина, Суми, Юнаківка, Мала Корчаківка, Андріївка, Могриця та Храпівщина Сумської області. Авіаційних ударів зазнали Вакалівщина, Гришине, Хотінь, Яструбщина і Писарівка.

Авіація, ракетні війська та артилерія Сил оборони уразили два райони зосередження особового складу та один командно-спостережний пункт росіян.

На Північно-Слобожанському напрямку українські підрозділи відбили дві атаки армії РФ у напрямках Безсалівки і Нової Січі.

На Південно-Слобожанському напрямку Сили оборони відбили сім атак ворога в районах Тихого, Нововасилівки, Синельникового і Рубіжного.

Читайте також: Екіпажі «Ахіллеса» уразили на Вовчанському напрямку російський плавучий транспортер

На Куп’янському напрямку російські війська здійснили одну атаку в районі Глушківки.

Шість ворожих спроб просунутися вперед зупинені на Лиманському напрямку у районах Колодязів та Лимана.

На Слов’янському напрямку російські загарбники здійснили п’ять атак у районах Кривої Луки і Ямполя.

На Костянтинівському напрямку зафіксували дев’ять атак. Війська РФ вели штурмові дії в районах Костянтинівки, Новоселівки і Новопавлівки.

На Покровському напрямку українські підрозділи зупинили 26 атак. Росіяни атакували у районах Софіївки, Новогришиного, Новопавлівки, Торецького, Кучерового Яру, Білицького, Вільного, Добропілля, Чернігівки і Сергіївки.

На Олександрівському напрямку російські загарбники здійснили одну атаку в районі Січневого.

На Гуляйпільському напрямку Сили оборони відбили шість ворожих атак у районах Нового Запоріжжя, Тернуватого і Різдвянки.

Читайте також: Росіяни почали застосовувати на фронті новий ударний дрон

На Оріхівському напрямку війська РФ здійснили одну атаку в районі Новоданилівки.

На Краматорському і Придніпровському напрямках армія РФ активних дій не проводила.

На Волинському і Поліському напрямках ситуація без суттєвих змін. Ознак формування наступальних угруповань РФ не виявлено.

Як повідомляв Укрінформ, загальні бойові втрати російських військ від початку повномасштабного вторгнення в Україну, з 24 лютого 2022 року по 21 листопада 2026 року, становлять близько 1 634 860 осіб, зокрема 1 730 осіб – за минулу добу.

gh-1376255525.title: GitHub - wie-project/PS4Recomp: Experimental static recompiler from PS4 to macOS Apple Silicon
gh-1376255525.content:
A macOS Apple Silicon ahead-of-time (AOT) static recompiler that translates PlayStation 4 (x86-64 ELF) binaries into native ARM64 executables and standalone .app bundles. No JIT, virtual machines, or MoltenVK required.

Highlights

Native ARM64 Assembly AOT: Direct AMD64 to ARM64 assembly translation with parallel Clang assembly and x86 Total Store Order (-tso) acquire/release memory semantics.
Metal 3 / 4 Graphics Backend: GCN bytecode to MSL translation via gcn-recompiler and SPIRV-Cross, direct Metal render/compute pipelines, frame pacing, and zero-copy UMA physical direct memory aliasing.
Orbis Kernel & Subsystems: Multi-module TLS, fiber-aware pthread synchronization primitives, event queues (libkernel equeues), asynchronous I/O, and virtual filesystem virtualization (/app0).
Media & Hardware Integration: 48 kHz multi-channel host audio mixer (libSceAudioOut), ATRAC9 audio decoding (libSceAjm), VideoToolbox hardware H.264 cutscene decoding (libSceVideodec), and native GameController support (libScePad).
macOS Bundle Packaging: Automatic generation of self-contained macOS .app bundles with resource staging and ad-hoc code-signing.

Compatibility Status

PS4Recomp operates exclusively on decrypted and extracted game folders (eboot.bin and assets). For dumping/extracting PKG files on macOS using ps4-pkg-tools

Quick Start
Prerequisites

macOS: Apple Silicon (M1 / M2 / M3 / M4)
Go: 1.27.1+
Xcode Command Line Tools: xcode-select --install
Build Tools & Libraries:
brew install cmake ninja freetype ffmpeg

Build from Source
# 1. Clone repository with submodules
git clone --recursive https://github.com/wie-project/PS4Recomp.git
cd PS4Recomp

# 2. Build standalone ps4-recomp binary
./scripts/build.sh
scripts/build.sh automatically checks submodules, builds required C/C++ static libraries (gcn-recompiler, spirv-cross, libatrac9), embeds runtime assets, and produces a single self-contained executable at bin/ps4-recomp.

Usage
Analyze an Executable or Game Folder
Inspect CFG, control flow, instruction compatibility, and referenced PRX modules:
./bin/ps4-recomp analyze path/to/game
# or directly on eboot.bin:
./bin/ps4-recomp analyze path/to/game/eboot.bin
Recompile & Build Game
PS4Recomp automatically finds eboot.bin and game assets in the provided game directory:
# Basic compilation to native ARM64 macOS .app bundle:
./bin/ps4-recomp build path/to/game -o path/to/build

# Fully standalone macOS .app bundle (bundles all game assets and dylibs for distribution):
./bin/ps4-recomp build path/to/game -o path/to/build --standalone

# Compile and immediately run the game:
./bin/ps4-recomp build path/to/game -o path/to/build -run
Once built, launch the game by double-clicking <GameName>.app in Finder, or run from terminal:
./build/ps4_app
Key CLI Options

Flag
Description
Default

-o, -out <dir>
Output directory for generated code, runtime, and .app bundle
"build"

-e, -elf <file/dir>
Path to input PS4 ELF binary or extracted game directory
Positional

-c, -compile
Compile emitted assembly to native ARM64 binary with Clang
true

-j, -jobs <num>
Number of parallel Clang assembler workers
NumCPU

-O, -opt <level>
Clang optimization level (0, 1, 2, 3, s, z)
"2"

-r, -run
Run the compiled binary after successful compilation
false

--standalone
Create a self-contained macOS .app bundle with bundled dylibs and resources
false

--tso
x86 Total Store Order memory model (acquire/release semantics)
true

--app-dir <dir>
Host directory mapping to /app0 for game assets
Auto-detected

--asan
Compile runtime with AddressSanitizer and LeakSanitizer
false

--patches <xml>
shadPS4-format patch XML applied to the executable before analysis
—

--patch <name>
Name (Metadata Name) of a patch set in --patches to apply; repeatable
—

Game Patches
build can apply game patches written in the shadPS4 patch XML format. The selected patch sets are written into the executable's ELF image before anything reads it, so patched code is discovered and lifted like any other code and patched data lands in guest_image.bin. Nothing is patched at run time.
./bin/ps4-recomp build path/to/CUSAxxxxx -o path/to/build \
--patches path/to/CUSAxxxxx.xml \
--patch "Skip Intro" --patch "60 FPS"

Only the sets named with --patch are applied, in that order; the XML isEnabled attribute is ignored.
The build fails unless the file's <TitleID> contains the game's TITLE_ID, each set exists exactly once for the game's APP_VER (both from sce_sys/param.sfo), and its AppElf names the binary being built.
Addresses follow shadPS4: a line at Address writes guest address (p_vaddr) Address - 0x400000. Every line must fall inside the file-backed part of a loadable segment (not .bss, not unmapped space), must not overlap another line or a relocation target, and must use a supported type: bytes (hex string), byte, bytes16, bytes32, bytes64 (integer, 0x hex or decimal, little-endian), float32, float64 (little-endian) or utf8 (NUL-terminated). Pattern-scan types (mask, mask_jump32) and utf16 are rejected.
The applied writes (patch address, guest address, file offset, old and new bytes) are recorded in patch_report.txt in the output directory, and with --json the done event lists the applied set names.

Controls & Input Mapping
PS4Recomp provides native game controller support via Apple's GameController framework (DualShock 4, DualSense, Xbox Wireless, and Nintendo Switch controllers are detected automatically over Bluetooth or USB). A DualShock 4 or DualSense touch pad reports its click and up to two finger positions, like the PS4 pad (1920x943, each new finger gets a new id).
When playing without a physical controller, built-in keyboard emulation is active whenever the game window is focused:

Project Structure
├── cmd/
│ ├── ps4-recomp/ # Main CLI entry point
│ └── lifter-difftest-asm/ # AMD64 vs ARM64 differential test harness
└── pkg/
├── analyzer/ # Reachable CFG & instruction coverage analyzer
├── disasm/ # Instruction decoder & jump-table recovery
├── elfloader/ # ELF64/PRX parser & multi-module TLS linker
├── lifter/ # AMD64 to ARM64 assembly lifter (TSO, SIMD, FPU)
├── emitter/ # Assembly partitioner, bridge trampolines & NID shims
└── runtime/ # Host runtime & Orbis/POSIX kernel ABI
├── core/ # Guest context & Mach-O crash handlers
├── kernel/ # Direct memory, sync pools, threading, VFS
└── modules/ # HLE modules (VideoOut, AudioOut, GnmDriver, Pad, etc.)

Contributing Guidelines

English only: All code comments, documentation, and commit messages must be written in English.
Strict verification: All modifications must pass go test -count=1 ./... and go vet ./... cleanly with zero regressions. No artificial stubs returning 0 where honest implementation is required.
Clean code & low allocations: Profile with Go analysis tools to ensure minimal allocations and memory safety.

Credits & Acknowledgements
Special thanks to the open-source PlayStation emulation and research communities:

OpenOrbis — Open-source PS4 toolchain and reverse engineering.

gh-1450907077.title: GitHub - RodoLy/HarvestMoonAnimalParadeRecomp
gh-1450907077.content:
Harvest Moon: Animal Parade – native PC port
Español

A native PC port of Harvest Moon: Animal Parade (Wii) by static recompilation: the game's
PowerPC code is translated to C++ and compiled for your computer, and the Wii it expects is
provided by WiiCompiled's runtime. There is no emulator.
It follows the same path as the Magical Melody recompilation
(HMMMGC).
This repository contains no game data. You need your own disc: Harvest Moon: Animal Parade (USA), ID RBIEE9, revision 1 (sys/main.dol SHA-1
6ca574d26858941bfd1404b0293ef84bd821ddd0).
WarningExperimental. This port is still in an early stage. Graphical glitches can happen, above
all with the free camera and the wide picture, and some scenes have not been tried yet. If
something looks wrong or the game stops, please
open an issue with a
screenshot and the newest folder in UserData/Logs.

What this port adds
Out of the box the game looks and plays as it did on the Wii: 4:3 picture, 30 frames per
second, English. Everything below except fast loading is a choice in the launcher or in the
F10 menu inside the game.

Native on Windows x64 and Windows on ARM
Two packages: x86-64, and ARM64 for Snapdragon X laptops, so the game runs natively instead of through x86-64 emulation.

Linux, macOS and Android
Packages for Linux (x86-64 and ARM64, which includes a Nintendo Switch with switchroot Linux) and Macs with Apple Silicon, and an Android app (a phone, a tablet, or a Switch with switchroot Android) with an on-screen Classic Controller. Early work: see below.

Wide picture
F10 > Graphics > Picture > Wide fills a widescreen window: the 3D cameras see more at the sides, and the menus and text keep their shape in the middle.

Frame interpolation
The game runs at 30 FPS; F10 > Graphics > Frame interpolation shows 60, 120 or 180 FPS by inserting frames in between. The game's own speed does not change.

Fast loading
Always on: the change of area (the fade to black, the loading and the place sign) runs up to eight times faster, as fast as the PC allows, and so do the other black screens. While the screen is black the 3D world behind it is not drawn, so even a slow PC gets through it quickly. Holding Tab (or any key or controller button you choose) fast-forwards everything (off by default; turn it on in the launcher or F10).

Free camera
A mod, off by default (launcher > Mods): outdoors the right stick turns the camera all the way around the player and tilts it, R3 puts it back. See below.

Romance for everyone
A mod: any of the twenty marriage candidates, the Harvest Goddess and the Harvest King included, can be courted and married whatever the player's sex. See below.

Quality of life
Mods for no area sign when loading (see below) and for faster walking and faster actions (×1.25 to ×3). See docs/MODS.md.

Cheats
Infinite stamina, money, lumber, stone and feed, and stop time, in the launcher and in F10 (see the questions below).

Five languages
English, Spanish, French, German and Italian from the same US disc (see below).

Direct3D 12 or Vulkan
F10 > Graphics > Graphics API. Automatic picks Direct3D 12.

No Wii Remote needed
An emulated Wii Remote with Nunchuk driven by any connected controller (Xbox, PlayStation and others) or the keyboard; the mouse is the pointer. A real Wii Remote can be paired instead.

Original (4:3)
Wide

Shorter loading screens
On the Wii every change of area takes a while: the screen fades to black, the next area loads,
and then a sign with a picture of the place and its name fades in, stays and fades out before you
can move again. In this port the fade and the loading run up to eight times faster, always. And
the No area sign when loading mod (launcher > Mods, off by default) takes the sign away: the
new area appears as soon as it has loaded.

The sign the mod takes away

Free camera
On the Wii the camera outdoors follows the player from one fixed angle. With the Free camera
mod (off by default: turn it on in the launcher's Mods tab) the right stick, or J L I K on
the keyboard, turns it all the way around the player and tilts it from near the ground to high
above, and R3 (or U) puts it back where the game had it. It stops in front of walls, looks
over fences, and in talks the game's own camera shows. Its keys and buttons are chosen in the
launcher's Controls tab. How it works: docs/FREE_CAMERA.md.

The game's camera
Free camera

It is the newest part of the port: expect a glitch now and then (the camera comes in close by
the sea, where the game has an invisible wall).
Romance for everyone
With the Romance for everyone mod (launcher > Mods) any of the twenty marriage candidates,
the Harvest Goddess, the Witch Princess, the Harvest King and the Wizard among them, can be
courted and married whether the player is a man or a woman. Their heart events, the confession
and the proposal play as in the game; the lines that spoke of a husband or a wife fit the couple,
the wedding photo stands two brides or two grooms side by side, and the children come by
adoption: a baby from the Harvest Goddess. Details: docs/MODS.md.

Languages, and why the US disc has them
The US disc already carries the game's text in five languages: files/msglang/, talk_la/,
event_la/, param_la/ and cg_la/ each have eng, spa, fre, ger and ita folders
(plus bri, British English). The European and US releases share that text; the US game
just never uses it, because its function that picks the language (0x8010FF04) always answers
English. The port answers it, and the Wii's own SCGetLanguage, with the language you choose
in the launcher (Language) or in F10 > Graphics > Language. In F10, restart the game after
changing it.
Known issue: in any language other than English the title screen shows the Japanese logo. The
US disc only has the Japanese and the English logos; the European logo is not on it.
Play on Windows

From Releases, download
HarvestMoonAnimalParade-windows-x64.zip or, on a Windows on ARM PC (Snapdragon X),
HarvestMoonAnimalParade-windows-arm64.zip. They have no game data.
Unzip it to a short folder, such as C:\HMAP.
Double click play.cmd. The launcher opens: choose your disc image (.rvz, .iso or .wbfs),
then Prepare the game. The first time it extracts the disc, translates the game and
compiles it, which takes several minutes; after that, Play starts it right away.

The full steps are in packaging/windows/README.txt. Settings,
saves and logs are in UserData\.
Play on Linux or macOS
The packages are HarvestMoonAnimalParade-linux-x86_64.tar.gz, -linux-aarch64.tar.gz (a
Raspberry Pi 5, a Nintendo Switch with switchroot Linux) and -macos-arm64.zip (Apple Silicon).
Unpack one, start AnimalParadeLauncher (on a Mac, Animal Parade.command); it opens in the
browser and works as on Windows. Linux needs the C library's headers (libc6-dev) and a Vulkan
driver; macOS needs Apple's command line tools (xcode-select --install). The steps are in
packaging/unix/README.txt.
Play on Android

From Releases, download
the APK (HarvestMoonAnimalParade-Android.apk) and install it. Android 11 or newer, 64-bit,
with Vulkan; a Nintendo Switch with switchroot Android counts.
Open it and choose your disc image (.iso, .rvz, .wbfs, .wia or .ciso). The app unpacks it once,
which takes a few minutes and about 5 GB, and starts the game. The APK carries the game's code
translated to ARM64 and none of the disc's files: those come from your disc.

Without a controller the screen shows a Wii Classic Controller: the sticks at the sides, the
D-pad, A B X Y, L and R, and − HOME +. A finger anywhere else is the Wii Remote pointer, and ≡
opens the F10 menu. With a controller connected the drawing hides after ten seconds without a
touch, and touch_controls = false under [input] in UserData/Config.toml turns it off.

How the APK is made from a disc is in
packaging/android/README-Android.txt and
android/README.md. The Android version has not been tried on many devices
yet.
The launcher
The launcher prepares and starts the game and holds its main settings: the language, the
picture, frame interpolation, resolution, fullscreen and the graphics API. Controls shows on
top whether a controller is connected (and which), and gives every Wii Remote and Nunchuk button,
and fast-forward, any key or controller button, in two columns; real Wii Remotes are set up there
too. It speaks English or Spanish, and is driven with the mouse, the keyboard or a controller
(D-pad, A, B, LB and RB).

Game
Options
Controls

In Mods each mod is a switch, all off until you turn them on, so out of the box the game is
the original; the speed mods have a bar from ×1.25 to ×3.

Frequently asked questions
The first start takes several minutes. The first time, play.cmd extracts the disc,
translates the game's code and compiles it. Later starts only build what changed.
The game runs slowly on a Windows on ARM laptop (Snapdragon X). Use the ARM64 package. The
x64 package also works there, but through x86-64 emulation, which is slower.
The picture is split down the middle, or things blink (Snapdragon X / Adreno GPU). That is
an old Adreno graphics driver with Direct3D 12. Update the driver with the Snapdragon Control
Panel app (Microsoft Store) or your laptop maker's support app.
Vulkan stops with "Device lost", runs slowly or shows wrong colors. Some GPUs, Adreno among
them, only give Vulkan a reduced mode. Switch to Direct3D 12 (Automatic in
F10 > Graphics > Graphics API) and restart.
The FPS counter says 30. The game runs at 30 frames per second, as on the Wii. Turn on
Frame interpolation in F10 to see 60, 120 or 180 FPS.
With frame interpolation the counter stays under the chosen FPS in some areas. In heavy
areas, when a frame of the game is late there is no frame to insert for it. The game's speed
does not change; lower the interpolation or the resolution if it bothers you.
Something looks wrong at the edges, or a menu looks stretched, with the wide picture. The
game was made for 4:3. Choose Original (4:3) in F10 > Graphics > Picture and please report
where it happened.
I changed the language and nothing changed. Restart the game: it reads the language once,
while it starts.
The title screen shows the Japanese logo. In any language other than English the US disc
only has the Japanese logo to show (see Known issue above).
How do I use the Wii Remote pointer? With the mouse: it is the pointer, left click is A and
right click is B. Controller and keyboard buttons can be changed in the launcher's Controls tab or in F10.
Where are my saves? In UserData\NAND\, next to the settings (UserData\Config.toml).
Copy the whole UserData folder to keep them.
The game closed with a message. The message says why. Please open an issue with it and the
newest folder in UserData\Logs.
Are there cheats? Six, in the launcher's Cheats tab and in the game's F10 menu (Cheats, where
they can be turned on and off while playing), all off until you turn them
on: infinite stamina, infinite money (it stays at 999,999 G), infinite lumber, infinite material
stone, infinite feed (fodder and bird feed) and stop time (sleeping still goes on to the
next day). How they work: docs/MODS.md. Codes that change the game's
instructions (Gecko, Action Replay) cannot work in a recompiled game.
Does it work with RecompLauncher? Yes. Every desktop package carries a recomplauncher.json:
RecompLauncher asks for your disc, checks it, builds the game with no window, and its Play starts
the game; the mods and cheats show on the game's page. See
docs/RECOMPLAUNCHER.md.
For developers
You need Python 3.11+.
python3 -m pip install -r requirements-dev.txt # capstone, pytest, ruff

# 1. Extract your disc into orig/RBIEE9 (in Dolphin: right-click the game →
# Properties → Filesystem → right-click the data partition →
# Extract Entire Partition) and check that it is the target binary
python3 tools/check_disc.py

# 2. Regenerate the function map and run the tests
python3 tools/analyze.py
python3 -m pytest

# 3. Read any function
python3 tools/disasm.py OSInit
On Windows use py instead of python3. On a PC with an ARM processor, install the x64
Python: capstone publishes no prebuilt package for Windows ARM64.
How the port works: docs/NATIVE_RUNTIME.md (the runtime and every
change made for this game), docs/FUNCTION_MAP.md (the function map,
17,142 functions) and docs/PLAN.md.
Related repositories

HMMMGC: the tools in tools/ and the tests come
from there. They worked unchanged on this game.
The Animal Parade research repository (decompilation): the disc layout, the original
file and class names, and the hidden developers' menu.

License
GNU General Public License, version 3 or later (GPL-3.0-or-later), like HMMMGC, ModernGekko
and DolRecomp. The full text is in LICENSE. The game is not included or
distributed; the screenshots are from the port running a legally owned disc.

ltia0w.title: Чё, когда GTA 7? — издателя Grand Theft Auto 6 уже спрашивают о продолжении
ltia0w.content:
Grand Theft Auto VI ждали 13 лет и, наконец, она вышла — с отличнейшими оценками критиков и продажами. Take-Two Interactive рада, Rockstar рада, индустрия рада, геймеры устраивают оценочные войны — всё прекрасно.
Так что, когда GTA 7? — спросили главу Take-Two Штрауса Зельника в одном из свежих интервью. Конечно, задавший вопрос сразу уточнил, что это шутка (прим. — верим, верим). Но Зельник нашёл, что ему ответить.
«Вот когда проведёте несколько сотен часов за лучшим в вашей жизни удовольствием — тогда и зададите этот вопрос снова», — с улыбкой ответил Зельник.На этом история не закончилась. В ходе интервью ведущие вновь подняли тему GTA 7, упомянув, что в следующей части теоретически могут представить полноценную цифровую копию всего реального мира.
Услышав это, Зельник сверился с часами (прим. — верим, верим), увидел, что релизный день GTA 6 ещё не завершился и напомнил об этом своим собеседникам.
«Мы в Take-Two вот только выпустили GTA 6, 19 ноября. Постойте, сверюсь с часами… О, всё ещё 19 ноября! А вы уже спрашиваете о GTA 7».Обзор Grand Theft Auto VI — шедевр, любовь и иммерсивность в Вайс-Сити

gh-1415797237.title: GitHub - tmcleroy/recomp-common: Code shared between recomp ports (native ports made by static recompilation): an in-game overlay menu with no dependencies
gh-1415797237.content:
Code shared between recomp ports (native ports of games made by static recompilation): an
in-game overlay menu and the small bitmap text it is drawn with, the settings rules a
launcher and its game must agree on, and the launcher itself.

The menu knows nothing about any game, console or windowing library. A port tells it what rows to
show, hands it button presses, and gets back what the player chose; it draws itself into a buffer of
32-bit pixels over a copy of the game's picture. The same menu, with the same look and rules, then
works in every port that takes it.

src/ is C++17 with no dependencies beyond the standard library. No SDL.
C interfaces (menu_c.h, settings_c.h) for ports written in C.
launcher/ is a program of its own (SDL 3 and Dear ImGui, fetched by its build).
Nothing from any game is in this repository, and nothing from a game is needed to build or test it.

Who uses it

Project
What

cps2recomp
A toolkit for native ports of Capcom CPS-2 arcade games; keeps a copy in recomp-common/

satrecomp
A toolkit for native ports of Sega Saturn games; keeps a copy in recomp-common/

Vampire Savior Recomp
A native port of Vampire Savior (CPS-2) with a full training mode, made with cps2recomp: the menu and launcher you see there are this library's (download)

To play a game, download a port; this repository is for people making ports.
What the menu does

A first page in groups with a line between them: save states (save, load, a slot from 1 to 9),
what the game offers (the port's own rows, the game's speed, slower or faster than full, a row for each
page of optional features), and leaving (reset, quit, resume).
A page per category of the game's optional features (cheats, training aids, picture options) and
commands, built from one list the port hands over. A feature is on or off, or a choice of several
named things.
A description of the chosen row, a line for messages ("Nothing is kept in slot 3."), and a hint
line naming the buttons as this console calls them.
Six buttons: up, down, left, right, confirm, back. The port maps its own onto them.
Any picture size: sizes follow the picture's height, and where the rows do not all fit, the ones
about the chosen row are shown.
In the player's language: English, Brazilian Portuguese or Spanish, chosen in the launcher (or the system's), in
the menu and the launcher alike (i18n.h). A port adds tables for its own words; a text no table has stays in
English. The menu's font has the accented letters.

The launcher

One launcher for every port: a Game page (the player's own game file, which is only ever read; the
picture's options; the sound's, with folders the port lets the player choose, such as a custom soundtrack's; Play; and, for a port with online play, an Online card: Host, with the addresses this machine can be joined at, and Join, with the host's address, or the code the host's game shows for a game that gives one; and for a game with a lobby, a switch to list the matches you host under your name, and the open matches other players have listed, to join with a press), a Features page (the presets Pure, Enhanced and Custom, a search box, and a switch or
a choice for each feature the game lists; for a long choice the game marks kFeatureMenuChoices, which of its
choices the game's own menu goes through, so the player's favourites make a short list there), and a Controllers page (connected gamepads, a tester, and a
key and a gamepad button for each of the game's buttons, for each of its players, up to four). All of it can be used with a gamepad alone,
or the arrow keys with Space or Enter, as well as with the mouse. A port adds one file that describes
itself: the words for its game file and the check of it, what the game is started with, which
buttons can be chosen. A port that is not about one game file can add pages of its own and leave
the Game page out. The launcher and the game read and write the same settings.ini by the same
rules (src/settings.h), so they cannot disagree about what a line in it means.
A collection: one launcher for several games, each a program of its own beside it (a toolkit's ports, say;
LAUNCHER_COLLECTION and launcher::describe_collection() in launcher/src/launcher.h). Its Games page finds
each game's file in a folder the player chooses (or one dropped on the window) and has Play beside each; its
Features page has the features more than one game has, under the same name and with the same choices, set for
all of them at once (a game marks one of its own that only shares a name: kFeatureOwn), and a feature changed
in a game's own menu is set for the others when it ends; its Controllers page sets the keys and buttons of every
game, or a game's own layout for a game given one (Collection::bindings is every game's table, a game's
Description::bindings its own, with its own names for its buttons); and each game whose file is chosen has a page with its Display switches, Play, and the features only it
has. The player puts the games in their own order by dragging a game's row in the sidebar (or with Move up and Move
down on its page; kept in launcher.ini), and the Games page lists them the same way. For a player who has only one or two of the games, Only the games you have (a switch on the Games page, once one game is set up; launcher.ini [games] installed_only) leaves the others out of the Games, Features and Controllers pages; Choose folder… still finds them. Its games can run at once, one of each, and a game that needs another's file too is given the one chosen on that game's page (Launch::file_of). Every game keeps its own folder and a complete settings.ini, as a launcher of its own would, and takes
over the file chosen there. --play ID starts a game straight away, --play ID -- ARGS gives the game more
arguments after the launcher's own, and --page ID opens at a game's page. A collection may have modes that play
several of its games one after another (Collection::multi, MultiMode): a Multi game page where the player chooses
which games, in the sidebar's order or shuffled, and the mode's own choices; Start starts each in turn with the mode's
arguments, and a game that ends with the mode's exit code (next_code) has had its turn, so the next one starts (after
the last, the first again); quitting one stops the run. A mode can name the keys and buttons that work while its games play (MultiButton), shown on its card and while it plays. --page multi opens there. A collection with online play's lobby (Collection::lobby) has an Online page, second after Games: every game's open matches first, then Join with a code (any game's: Collection::code_lookup says which game it is for), the player's name (with one, a match they host is listed in the lobby), a match to host in any of the games, and the features about a match (Collection::online_features); each open match has Join; a match in a game whose file isn't chosen yet is greyed, with Add… to choose it, and one in a game the collection hasn't is greyed under the game's name, with Update… (--page online). A port's own launcher is unchanged:
its pages are the same pixels as before.
Updates (optional: LAUNCHER_UPDATE_REPO and LAUNCHER_VERSION in the port's launcher/CMakeLists.txt;
launcher/src/update.h): the launcher looks at the port's GitHub releases when it opens (a switch turns that
off) and, when there is a newer version, offers it at the top of its first page. Update downloads that system's
archive from the release (the same file a player downloads by hand), checks it against the manifest the port's
release script puts beside it, unpacks it, checks every file that changed, and only then puts them in place,
taking away the files the new version no longer has; if anything fails nothing is changed. Then the new launcher
starts. A release so carries only its archives and one small manifest per system. A copy that is not a release's
download (a build) is only told of the new version. Downloads go through the system's curl, unpacking through
its tar (ditto on macOS). On Windows the launcher makes curl's requests itself, with WinHTTP
(src/winhttp_curl.h), instead of starting a hidden curl.exe, which antivirus programs take for a downloader.
Android (launcher.cmake with the NDK): the launcher is a library (lib<exe>-launcher.so) that the port's
activity, an SDL activity, loads, and so is each game (lib<exe>.so), which runs in a process of its own. What the
launcher does elsewhere with programs it asks of its activity instead, through JNI: startGame and gameResult
(a game's start and how it ended: src/game_process.cpp), importFiles and importResult (the system's picker,
whose documents are copied into the launcher's folder, roms/: Choose… and Add ROM sets…) and curl (the online
requests, from curl's arguments: src/run_program.cpp). A game's --list-features is asked of its library:
char *RecompListFeatures(void). The player's folders are in the app's folder on the shared storage, a folder for
each name. A finger dragged scrolls a page, and Back is Esc. No updates there: the system installs the app.
Portable mode (src/folders.h): a file named portable.txt beside the launcher (on macOS beside the app,
which is never written to; beside the AppImage for one) keeps the player's folders, settings, saves and logs, in
user/<name>/ there instead of the system's folder for them, so the whole thing can be carried on a drive. The
first time, the launcher offers to copy what the system's folders have (it never moves or writes over anything);
a folder it cannot write to is said, and it stops rather than keep things elsewhere. Taking portable.txt away
goes back to the system's folders as they were. Updates keep portable.txt and user/: they are not a release's
files. The first page's Your files card shows the folder and opens it. A port's game that finds the launcher's
launcher.ini itself asks recomp::PortableFolder too.
Its look, and the files that make it, come from the launcher of
wiiparty-recomp by arelkair; see
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md.
Try it
make test # the menu's rules, and the C interface compiled as C
make example # build/shot: a host with no game
build/shot menu.ppm ddddar # press Down x4, Confirm, Right; write the picture
examples/shot.cpp is a complete host in about a hundred lines and is the place to start reading.
make launcher # build/launcher/example-launcher, with a stand-in for the game (needs cmake; SDL 3 is fetched if absent)
make launcher-shots # its three pages as pictures, with no window shown
launcher/example is what a port's own launcher folder looks like.
Using it in a port
The library is not installed and has no package: a port keeps a committed copy of src/ and
launcher/ and compiles it with the rest of its code, so the port builds from a fresh clone with nothing else
present. tools/sync-common.sh makes the copy, records which commit it came from, and (with
--check) fails if anyone changed the copy by hand.
docs/USING.md has the steps, the interface in full, and the rules a port is
expected to follow (what opens the menu, what "Quit game" means, the order of the first page).

File
What

src/menu.h, menu.cpp
The menu.

src/menu_c.h, menu_c.cpp
The same menu for hosts written in C.

src/settings.h, settings.cpp
The settings file and the rules for features: presets, values, choices.

src/settings_c.h, settings_c.cpp
The same rules for hosts written in C.

src/folders.h
Where the player's things are: the folder a download was unpacked to, and portable mode.

src/gamepads.h
Mappings for controllers SDL doesn't know, from a gamecontrollerdb.txt (needs SDL).

launcher/
The launcher: launcher.cmake (what a port includes), src/ (launcher.h is what a port fills in), example/.

src/text.h
A 5x7 dot-matrix font on a canvas of 32-bit pixels; usable on its own for a port's readouts.

tools/sync-common.sh
The script a port keeps to take and check its copy.

examples/shot.cpp
A host with no game.

tests/
make test.

Status
Version 0.5.0 (see CHANGELOG.md). The interface may still change before 1.0; a
port is never changed under its feet, because it only moves to a new version when it runs the sync
script.
Contributing
Bug reports and pull requests are welcome: see CONTRIBUTING.md. The one hard
rule: nothing from any game, and no keys, ever go in this repository.
License
GNU General Public License v3.0 (GPL-3.0-only). A project that includes the copy must
itself be distributed under terms compatible with it, keep the notices at the top of the files, and
ship the license text. THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md says where everything came
from.

gh-1415313946.title: GitHub - jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile: Open-source compatibility layer for Diablo II: Resurrected with the Reign of the Warlock expansion. Runs your own Switch copy natively on iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android and HarmonyOS — full touch controls, 60 fps, new endgame modes. Bring your own game files. 开源的《暗黑破坏神 II：狱火重生》术士君临 iOS / macOS / 安卓 / 鸿蒙兼容层
gh-1415313946.content:
An open-source compatibility layer for Diablo II: Resurrected with the Reign of the Warlock expansion, for iOS, macOS, Android and HarmonyOS. It brings the Nintendo Switch release you bought, expansion included, to iPhone, iPad and Mac in full: the original game code runs natively, every control is rebuilt for touch, the frame rate holds at 60 fps, and you are in a game one second after the main menu. There is now a native macOS version as well (first version): on an Apple silicon Mac it starts on double-click and works with keyboard, mouse and gamepad. Since v2.0 there is an Android version (community port): the same game program executes natively on ARM64 Android phones, with the graphics reimplemented on Vulkan; on a Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1 phone the camp and the Den of Evil and Cow Level fights all run at a median 60 fps (see "Android" below); a HarmonyOS version runs on the same engine (community port: an unsigned shell from the Releases page that you re-sign yourself, nothing to build; see "HarmonyOS"). Apple TV 4K (3rd generation, A15) has a community port (developer preview) that has reached the character-selection screen only on its author's device; see the device table below. This is not a tech demo that "sort of runs". It is a mobile version polished for daily play, from your first character all the way through the endgame. Platforms: iPhone / iPad (iOS 26 and later; iOS 18 – 25 with the older-API build) · Mac (Apple silicon, macOS 26 or later; macOS 15 – 25 with the older-API build) · Apple TV 4K (3rd generation, A15; community port, developer preview) · Android phones (ARM64, Android 12 or later, Vulkan 1.1; community port) · HarmonyOS phones (HarmonyOS NEXT; community port, unsigned shell from the Releases page that you re-sign yourself) · Game version: Switch release with Reign of the Warlock, 1.0.34.0 (corresponds to PC version 3.3.94012) · English / 中文 / Español / Русский / 한국어 · License: MIT · Bring your own game files 中文: README.zh-CN.md · Español: README.es.md 100% 60 fps about 1 s about 3.8 W The original gameplay, because it is the original program Steady, with no drops once the device warms up From the main menu into a game Whole-device power draw at 60 fps What it is, and what it is not It is: The game's own aarch64 program, executing directly on the device, with no emulated CPU. iPhone and Switch use the same class of processor; only the handful of instructions that cannot run unchanged under Apple's kernel are rewritten, and every other byte of the program is left exactly as shipped. Every class, every Runeword, Terror Zones, bosses, drop rules and quest flow are identical to the original. The platform services the game expects — system calls, the file system, the graphics API, audio, input — provided by a small host written for Apple platforms. The graphics API is reimplemented entirely — on Metal on Apple devices, on Vulkan on Android — with no emulation layer in between, and the shaders are translated offline from the game's originals. A port built for phones, and taken all the way: a complete touch control scheme, edge-to-edge iPhone and true full-screen iPad display, controller support, a power saver mode, save sync, six languages (English, Chinese, Spanish, Russian, Korean and Portuguese), and a whole set of endgame modes and quality-of-life features the original never had. It is not: An emulator, cloud gaming, or streaming. A source of game content. It contains none and distributes none. There is no game program, art, text, data table or shader in this repository; all of that is generated on your own machine from your own files (see docs/GAME_FILES.md). What the repository does carry is the interface information we recorded to make the port work — shader interface descriptions, the graphics API function table, addresses inside the program and the like — listed item by item in docs/DERIVED.md. Online. There is no multiplayer; the game runs fully offline and needs no online account. Battle-tested All 44 iPhones and iPads in the closed beta — 35 devices registered for direct install (25 iPhones and 10 iPads), plus 9 TestFlight accounts with one device each — completed Normal, Nightmare and Hell with multiple characters, and the experience was excellent. From an iPhone 14 Pro Max with 6 GB of memory to the latest iPad Pro, not one device fell behind. Models iPhone 14 Pro Max, 15, 15 Pro, 15 Pro Max, 16 Plus, 16 Pro, 16 Pro Max, 17 Pro Max and more iPad iPad Air, iPad mini, iPad Pro 11-inch and 12.9 / 13-inch (including M2 and M4) and more Lowest model tested iPhone 14 Pro Max (A16, 6 GB): a flawless 60 fps iPhone and iPad share a single install package. Fast, smooth, and easy on the battery Measured on a real device (iPhone 17 Pro Max): Item Reading In-game frame rate 60 fps, steady, with no drops once the device warms up App launch 0.15 s To the main menu about 1 s From the main menu into a game about 1 s Quick Restart, back in a game about 1.2 s Longest frame when changing acts about 0.1 s Whole-device power, 60 fps about 3.8 W (in camp, 50% brightness): nearly 5 hours of continuous play on a full charge Whole-device power, power saver mode at 30 fps about 1.85 W, about half the 60 fps figure, for about twice the battery life Measurement conditions: power is whole-device power measured on 2026-10-10 on an iPhone 17 Pro Max, standing in the Act I camp at 50% brightness, with 60 fps and power saver mode measured in the same scene; battery life is calculated from the measured power and the battery capacity, not by playing from full to empty. Launch and game-entry times were measured on the same model in 2026-10; frame rate and act-change readings were taken on the same model on 2026-10-12 while moving through areas and changing acts after entering a game. The install package is only a little over 100 MB. The game resources (about 5.6 GB) are placed on the phone separately, and updating the app touches neither your saves nor the resources. Why it is this fast: the program executes natively, and not a single instruction goes through emulation; graphics go straight to Metal; every shader is translated offline and compiled ahead of time, so nothing is compiled when you enter a new scene. Older chips (A16 and earlier, such as the iPhone 14 family and iPhone 15) do not support the game's original compressed texture format; they need an extra texture pack made from your own game files, and then run at full frame rate too — see docs/LEGACY_DEVICES.md. Redesigned for fingers This is not a gamepad pasted onto the screen. Every panel and every action was rebuilt for fingers under one design principle: keep the original interface language, and use gestures instead of adding buttons to the screen. Text sizes and tap targets are sized for fingers. You know how to play the moment you pick it up, and it stays comfortable over long sessions. Move: a virtual stick with precise diagonals; tap an NPC or the ground to path there automatically; doors, portals and cave entrances are tappable across their whole surface. Fight: press a skill button to cast, hold to keep casting, drag to aim at any angle; nearby monsters are targeted automatically. Two skill sets. Skills on your secondary weapons cast with one tap — the game swaps weapons, casts, and swaps back — and the button shows the charges remaining. Boss health bar: pinned to the top of the screen, showing the percentage remaining. Items: tap, double-tap, long-press and drag and drop all track your finger. Double-tap gear to equip or unequip it; drag an item anywhere onto the vendor panel to sell it; on a stack, double-tap takes 1 and long-press takes 3; long-press an empty inventory slot to sort everything. Text: typed with the system keyboard. Character names can be in Chinese; leave the name blank for a random one. Screen: on iPhone the 19.5:9 display is filled edge to edge, clear of the notch and rounded corners; on iPad the game fills the entire screen, and the interface centers itself when you open a panel; the 3D picture can be brightened. Controller Connect a controller and press any button: the interface switches to the original controller layout, with button prompts at the bottom of every panel. Touch the screen and you are back in the touch interface instantly. Inventory, stash, skill tree, Chronicle and settings are fully controller-navigable, with the same button mapping as on Switch. With an Xbox controller the layout switches automatically to the PC / Xbox one (bottom confirms, right goes back) and the prompts show Xbox button icons; there is nothing to turn on. With a PlayStation controller (DualSense or DualShock 4) the prompts switch to the game's own PlayStation button icons (✕ confirms, ○ goes back), contributed by @Ti800 (#119). New ways to play, on top of the original Finishing the original game is only the beginning. Without touching the original rules, we added a full set of endgame content that keeps you farming. Greater Rift Enter through the red portal in Harrogath after completing Hell. There are 100 levels, and the monsters grow stronger with each one; fill the progress bar and slay the Rift Guardian within 15 minutes to clear a level. Every 2 levels cleared grants +1 Skill Point and +5 Stat Points, and the skill level cap rises from 20 to 40. Every 10 levels has a first-clear reward, and clearing level 10 unlocks six new equipment slots for your mercenary. Endgame Boss Rush, Elysium mode, and the Kill Board Endgame Boss Rush: unlocks after completing Hell, with 12 stages; stage 11 is Diablo Clone, and stage 12 is the three Uber bosses. Elysium mode (chosen at character creation): Unique ×5, Set ×3, Runes ×5; the "no drop" chance is cut to a tenth, and bosses always drop as on a first kill. Kill Board: for every boss, the number of kills, the time of the first kill, how many Unique and Set items it has dropped, and your best and average kill times. Storage: a collector's paradise Chronicle stash: every identified Unique and Set item has its own fixed slot, shared by all characters, searchable, with deposit and withdraw; the Deposit button sends the Unique and Set items in your inventory and Horadric Cube there in one tap. Stash: widened to 14 columns, with 5 personal pages and 5 shared pages. Trove: the gem, rune and material pages merged into one, with the Horadric Cube's crafting grid in the middle, so finding things and crafting no longer means flipping between pages. Runes, gems and materials you put into the personal or shared pages are filed here automatically. Pouch: an extended inventory. Runes and gems found in the field go into it automatically and take up no inventory space. Effortless farming Auto-recast buffs Buff skills you have learned do not need a slot on the skill bar: when a buff runs out, it is recast the moment you stand still; buffs that come from your secondary weapons (such as Battle Orders from Call to Arms) swap weapons, recast and swap back on their own Potions and belt Auto-drink has two tiers: a healing potion below 50% Life, a rejuvenation potion below 30%; your mercenary is fed automatically by the same rule. Potions on the ground are picked up automatically when the belt has room; double-tap an empty belt slot to refill the whole belt Loot filter From Nightmare on, the original loot filter is switched on automatically to hide clutter: light filtering in Nightmare, heavy in Hell Auto-pickup Low runes and gems go straight into the Pouch; the high ones are left for you to pick up yourself Valuable drop alerts High runes and Unique items raise a light beam and land with a different drop sound; the phone vibrates at one of three strengths — light, medium or heavy — according to value Runeword helper Long-press a socketed base to list the Runewords it can make and their stats; once you have the runes, socket them all in one tap Minimap guidance Every map marks its Waypoint and exits, labelled "Waypoint" and with the name of the area each entrance leads to (iOS / Mac); every quest goal is on the map; when a target is off screen, its name is written along the screen edge Chores removed Free identification, free Town Portal with no scrolls needed, spawning right beside the Waypoint, Quick Restart, refreshable vendor stock, free and unlimited respecs at Akara Saves Saved immediately when you switch apps, swipe the app away or quit; iCloud sync across devices (requires signing with a paid developer account) Entertainment mode (experimental) Over-the-shoulder and first-person camera: drag the right half to look around, arrows for monsters off the picture, a facing pointer on the map (details; contributed with @yyan160, #165) Most features can be toggled one by one in game under Options → Custom. English, Chinese, Spanish, Russian, Korean and Portuguese The whole game switches between English, Chinese, Spanish, Russian, Korean and Portuguese under Options → Custom (six options in two rows of three); after a restart, the interface is in the language you chose. On first launch it follows your device language (Spanish from Spain uses the game's esES text, other Spanish regions use the Latin American esMX text; Portuguese uses the game's ptBR text). In English, Spanish, Russian, Korean and Portuguese, items, skills and monsters use the original Diablo II wording, and everything we added — Greater Rift, Chronicle, the settings page, gesture prompts, map name plates — is translated too (item notes are translated for Chinese and Spanish only). Russian is the game's single ruRU text, Korean its koKR text and Portuguese its ptBR (Brazilian) text, with no regional variants. Voice acting: Chinese UI gets Chinese voices; Russian, Korean and Portuguese get the original voices when your game files include them (a package built from the complete game data does), otherwise English; everything else is English. Korean was contributed by @soulsakura (#118). How it works flowchart LR G["Your game files
(program + resources)"] --> P["Rewriter
changes only a few instructions"] G --> S["Shader translation
original → Metal"] P --> H["Host
system services"] S --> X["Graphics layer
the graphics API on Metal"] H --> A["iOS app
touch and interface"] X --> A Loading Part Where What it does Program rewriter dm/tools/patch_nso.py Rewrites only the few instructions that cannot run unchanged under Apple's kernel (thread-pointer registers, system calls, timers) and leaves the rest of the program byte-for-byte as shipped Host dm/host Loads the rewritten program and provides the platform services it calls Graphics dm/gfx Implements the game's graphics API on Metal; shaders are translated offline from the game's originals iOS app dm/ios The app shell, touch controls and interface Android app dm/android The Android shell, touch overlay and Vulkan presentation HarmonyOS app dm/harmony The HarmonyOS shell (ArkTS + N-API), sharing the host and the Vulkan engine with Android Vulkan graphics dm/gfx/vulkan The same graphics API on Vulkan (shared by Android and HarmonyOS; the engine comes from the HarmonyOS port) Verification dm/verify Checks that the rewritten code behaves exactly like the original, plus the regression gates every change goes through Why you can trust it: the stability is not luck. The test and verification tooling is part of the project — unit tests for the host and graphics layers, an equivalence check for every rewritten instruction, scripted walkthrough regression for the touch interface, and on-device smoke tests. Start with make -C dm/host/tests run, make -C dm/gfx/tests run and dm/verify/regress.sh (run them inside the Python environment prepared in step 2 below; regress.sh also needs brew install llvm). How to contribute is in CONTRIBUTING.md. Android (new in v2.0) Android phones use ARM64 processors just like the Switch, so, as on Apple devices, the game's own program executes directly on the phone with no CPU emulation. This release brings the whole host — system calls, file system, audio, input, saves — to Android unchanged and swaps the graphics layer for Vulkan: the NVN-to-Vulkan replay engine comes from @biglawine's HarmonyOS port, and the Android app, touch controls, Vulkan presentation and a full round of performance work, each step measured on a phone, are by @yyan160 (#113). The Apple and Android versions share the same host code, so future changes benefit both. Measured by the port's authors on their phones (product defaults: 3D render scale capped at 0.85 and lowered dynamically when frames drop): Phone Result Redmi K50 Ultra (Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1, Adreno 730, Android 15) Camp, Den of Evil fight, Cow Level fight: median 60 fps, GPU about 14–15 ms a frame OnePlus 13 (Adreno 830) Playable; when one particular light effect appears in the camp, small black squares occasionally flash for an instant (under investigation) Minimum: ARM64, Android 12 (API 31) or later, and a GPU with Vulkan 1.1. How to use it today: install D2RMobile-android.apk from the release page (it contains no game content). On a computer, run python3 dm/tools/d2rm_android.py on your own game files to make the import pack (an android folder with the rewritten game program, every Vulkan shader bundle, the touch overlay and a few data tables), and copy it together with your game resources (the data folder) to Download/S2X/D2R Mobile/ on the phone. The App imports it with a progress screen when you open it. No adb, and no need to build the APK yourself. The full steps are in docs/ANDROID.md. The touch controls are drawn the same way as on iPhone (button sockets, silver skill silhouettes, joystick), and no virtual pad buttons cover open panels. Compared with the iOS version, a few touch details are still unfinished: the empty-skill-slot menu, the stat-point overlay, and the item image that follows your finger while dragging in a shop. Progress, the measurements from every round and the remaining work are in docs/ANDROID_COLLABORATION.md and docs/android-notes/. The HarmonyOS version is in the next section. HarmonyOS (new in v2.0) The HarmonyOS NEXT app (dm/harmony) is by @biglawine (#114) and uses the same host and the same Vulkan engine as Android. Measured by the author on a Mate 90 Pro Max (Maleoon 955): 59.7 fps holding the joystick in the Rogue Encampment, display interval p50 16.6 / p99 18.1 ms. How to use it: the same idea as the iOS shell. The Releases page has an unsigned install package that contains no game content (D2RMobile-harmony-shell-unsigned.hap). HarmonyOS NEXT only installs apps signed with your own developer certificate, so you re-sign it with your own debug certificate and install it; you do not build the app yourself. Then, on a computer, run python3 dm/tools/d2rm_android.py --target ohos on your own game files to make the runtime pack, put it with the game resources in a "D2R Mobile" folder on the phone, open the app and pick that folder to import. The full steps are in docs/HARMONYOS.md. The author ran the whole chain (re-sign → install → first import → into a game → save and exit) on a Mate 90 Pro Max, with three cold starts in a row working; you need a Huawei developer account (DevEco Studio can generate the debug certificate and register the device for you). Which devices are supported Minimum: an A14 / M1 chip or later — the graphics layer needs Metal 3, which Apple supports from A14 / M1 on (see Apple's Metal support on Apple devices and Metal Feature Set Tables). Device Playable? How How sure we are iPhone / iPad, A17 Pro and later (iPhone 15 Pro and later, iPhone 16 and later, iPads with M-series chips) Yes iOS 26 or later: the default shell / default build; iOS 18 – 25: the iOS 18 shell / older-API build Main devices, played daily iPhone Duo (foldable) Yes; the picture resizes when you unfold or fold The shells on the Releases page are built with Xcode 27.1; when building

vzmlum.title: Откуда поисковому агенту знать слово “ужинатор”?
vzmlum.content: Откуда поисковому агенту знать слово “ужинатор”?Уровень сложностиПростойВремя чтения4 минОхват и читатели1KКейсВозьмём вымышленный проект “Меню на неделю”. С пятницы хотим продавать ужины сразу на семь дней. Можно уже запускаться? Открываю эпик в трекере. Все задачи в нём закрыты, в последнем комментарии написано “обсудили в чате”. Ищу в чатах “Меню на неделю”. Пусто. В каком чате-то?Дёргаю разработчика и слышу в ответ удивлённое “Так в Ужинаторе же”. Нахожу чат “Ужинатор”. Там ребята обсуждают заказы и делятся ссылкой на требования в Confluence. Открываю, а у страницы заголовок “Недельная подписка на еду”. Так проект называли продакты ещё до того, как завели эпикМеню на неделю или Ужинатор?Три имени одного проекта. Это алиасы. Внутри команды всё понятно, а мне понадобился живой разработчик, чтобы вообще найти нужный чатЕсли у агента есть только название из трекераТеперь тот же вопрос задаю агенту. По запросу “Меню на неделю” он находит закрытые задачи и план с пятничной датой. У него уже есть всё, чтобы ответить “Да, в пятницу выпускаем” и приложить пару настоящих ссылокМне повезло, я знал, у кого спросить. А с чего начать агенту? У эпика есть номер MENU-42. Ищу его в текстах страниц Confluence. Под требованиями к “Недельной подписке на еду” написано “Задачи разработки по MENU-42”. Нажимаю и попадаю обратно в наш эпик. Сами требования тоже про ужины на семь дней. Беру заголовок страницы как ещё одно имя для поискаИщу по этому имени в Telegram. В четверг продакт согласовал текст письма про “Недельную подписку на еду” и подтвердил отправку в пятницу. Пока всё сходитсяА кто ещё делился самими требованиями? Ищу в чатах адрес страницы. В ответе разработчика только ссылка. Открываю ветку и смотрю, на какой вопрос он ответилА ужинатор в воскресенье вообще должен кормить?По номеру эпика находим требования, по их адресу находим ответ разработчика, а в вопросе к нему видим слово "ужинатор"Что нашлось по слову “ужинатор”В Slack нахожу вчерашний отчёт тестировщикаПрогнали ужинатор. В корзине опять шесть. Воскресенье съелосьВдруг у соседней команды тоже есть свой “ужинатор”? Открываю начало ветки. Разработчик кинул ссылку на задачу “Проверить корзину на семь дней” и попросил ещё раз прогнать сценарий. В трекере у задачи родитель MENU-42. Теперь понятно, чьё воскресенье съелосьПробую то же слово в Telegram. В пятницу утром в чате про релизы спросили “Ужинатор оставляем в письме?” К вопросу приложили ссылку на тот самый отчёт тестировщика. Продакт ответил прямо под нимПереносим запуск на следующую неделю. Сегодня письмо не отправляемПо старому имени я нашёл вчерашнее “отправляем”. По прозвищу добрался до сегодняшнего “не отправляем”. Теперь у меня есть и ответ про пятницу, и ссылка на решение продактаА если вбить просто “подписка”, в соседнем чате найдётся и “поправили подписку”. Какую подписку? В ветке ни ссылки на наши задачи, ни слова про заказы на неделю. Для ещё одного запроса слово годится. Записывать его как имя проекта пока раноКогда слово попадает в карточку проектаЯ делаю VibeCBS, платформу для работы с корпоративными данными. Поиск алиасов я вынес в отдельный этап. Чтобы попробовать слово “ужинатор” в поиске, достаточно одной реплики. Модель предлагает следующий запрос и показывает, откуда взяла слово. Запрос попадает в очередь проекта. Код запускает поиск, узнаёт уже просмотренные записи по их идентификаторам и отдаёт модели новыеА вот чтобы записать слово в карточку как имя проекта, нужны независимые подтверждения. Модель оценивает, насколько каждое из них связывает слово с проектом. Код проверяет, хватает ли оснований. Достаточно трёх независимых подтверждений с оценкой выше 0,8 у каждого или двух, если обе оценки не ниже 0,95. Пороги настраиваются. Когда правило выполнено, платформа записывает имя в карточку вместе со ссылками на источникиУ “ужинатора” есть две ветки для проверки. В одной на вопрос с этим словом разработчик ответил ссылкой на требования. В другой тестировщик так назвал заказ, который проверял по задаче из MENU-42. Если модель даст каждому из этих подтверждений хотя бы 0,95, имя попадёт в карточку. В Telegram лежит ссылка на тот же отчёт тестировщика. Сколько его ни пересылай, отчёт всё равно один. А если мне нужно подтвердить перенос запуска, я открою ответ продактаСколько документов это даёт на реальных проектах21 ноября я взял на проде VibeCBS 300 крупных эпиков за 2026 год. У 217 из них нашлись алиасы. Для каждого эпика отдельно посчитал, сколько разных “документов” вернул поиск. Документом может быть и задача в трекере, и страница с требованиями. По одним названиям эпиков в сумме получилось 4 741. Добавил к запросам только подтверждённые алиасы из карточек и получил 13 178Сумма по 300 эпикам. По одним названиям 4 741 документ, по названиям и подтверждённым алиасам 13 178. Для каждого эпика документы посчитаны без повторовДесять упоминаний одного эпика на странице дают этому эпику один документ. Если на странице обсуждают два эпика, в общую сумму она попадёт дваждыВыдача выросла почти в 3 раза!Зачем искать алиасы до первого вопросаСлово “ужинатор” агент берёт из карточки проекта, которую VibeCBS собрала ещё до его вопроса. Можно поручить первому агенту разобраться и сохранить имена для следующего. Тогда первый человек будет ждать, пока его агент ходит по задачам и чатам. Я переношу эту работу на бутстрап. При первом разборе всего корпоративного корпуса платформа ищет алиасы для всех проектов и сохраняет подтверждённые имена вместе со ссылками. Это и есть прекомпьют. По мере того как приходят новые сообщения и меняются задачи, платформа обновляет карточкиВ одном среднем эпике код сделал 76 обращений к источникам, чтобы собрать материалы для одной карточки. При повторном запуске он увидел, что сбор закончен, и сделал ноль новых обращенийРасход модели я отдельно посмотрел на проде. На разбор материалов одной карточки ушло 7 вызовов модели, в сумме около 250 тысяч токенов. Платить за знакомство с тем же проектом каждый раз, когда кто-то открывает новый чат, мне жалко. А так же я получаю детерменнированный результат, который всегда одинаковый для всех агентовЯ даю своему агенту ссылку на MENU-42 и спрашиваю про запуск. Коллега из маркетинга прикладывает тот же эпик в своём диалоге и спрашивает про письмо. В нашем примере нам доступны одни и те же ветки. Кто бы ни спросил первым, оба агента возьмут “ужинатор” из общей карточки и смогут сразу искать, что команда решила к пятницеПеред отправкой письма я всё равно проверю, что продакт написал последним в ветке про рассылку. Если в поиске видна переписка только по четверг, придётся открыть сам чат или сказать коллеге, по какой день у меня есть данныеА ведь у первого ответа “Да, в пятницу выпускаем” тоже были настоящие ссылки. Я бы открыл план, сверил дату, посмотрел закрытые задачи и со спокойной душой пошёл выпускать меню на неделю. С понедельника по субботу)

images.alt: В машинку с надписью "Ужинатор" вставлена карточка "Меню на неделю"
По номеру эпика находим требования, по их адресу находим ответ разработчика, а в вопросе к нему видим слово "ужинатор"
Сумма по 300 эпикам. По одним названиям 4 741 документ, по названиям и подтверждённым алиасам 13 178. Для каждого эпика документы посчитаны без повторов

gh-1429046152.title: GitHub - dlprentice/onslaught-ce: Onslaught CE: a native Linux and Windows port of Battle Engine Aquila (2003), built from its source. Bring your own copy of the game.
gh-1429046152.content:
Status: preview. From 0.1.8 on it updates itself; from 0.1.7 or earlier, download the latest release once by hand.
Last updated: 2026-11-14
Summary: the native Battle Engine Aquila port: how to install, play, update, report a problem and build it, and where the project's other repositories are.
This README follows this source branch, which can describe work that is not in the latest download. The README
packaged with your download and the release notes
describe the version you installed. Versions 0.1.8 and later have a signed-update path; versions 0.1.0 through
0.1.7 require the one-time manual migration below. On Linux, if you still use 0.1.8 or 0.1.9, check the
0.1.13 or
0.1.12 release notes for their 32-bit
dependency caveat.
The published release is 0.1.13. The newer source features described here have not been released as a new
package. Experimental features remain opt-in; a source build or an isolated test does not establish that every
feature works on both platforms.
Onslaught CE is a native port of Battle Engine Aquila (Lost Toys, 2003) for Linux (i686) and Windows (i686), built
from the game's source code. You need your own copy of the game.
Questions, feedback, or bug reports? Start a thread in Discussions or open an issue via Report a problem (see CONTRIBUTING.md for where to file work across the project repositories).
Contents

your own copy of the game.
