ybyjah.title: Mahershala Ali Says Oscars Hasn’t Guaranteed Him Success in Hollywood
ybyjah.content:
Mahershala Ali got candid about the impact — or lack thereof — his two Oscar wins have had on his career in Hollywood while appearing on a recent episode of Carmelo Anthony and Kazeem “Kaz” Famuyide’s “7PM in Brooklyn” podcast.

The actor, who took home trophies for best supporting actor for both 2018’s “Greenbook” and 2016’s “Moonlight,” asked the hosts about the meaning of an Oscar, and if it really validates whether someone is “a good actor” or not. “There’s more good actors than there is good material,” he said. “It’s not even that all these people are competing for these same spots. It’s just that out of all the material made, there’s only a handful of them that check certain boxes.”

He continued: “The vast majority of projects that get greenlit, there are not roles for me in those. You gotta think that way, you know what I mean? So, it doesn’t matter if I got 17 Oscars. If someone is not writing something for you or greenlighting something with you in mind, you’re like everybody else waiting and looking and searching.”

While the star noted that actors could produce their own projects, the timeline is usually as least a “three to five year” journey. When asked by Famuyide if an Oscar win validates Black actors, Ali responded: “It’s kind of just talk. It doesn’t translate to anything real. You don’t want to find yourself in a situation where, oh, that’s ‘the diversity project.’ You just want to do great material as a Black person. You’re not thinking of yourself as this exotic other, per se. You just are living your life.”

Most recently, Ali starred in Bassam Tariq’s “Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother,” which hit theaters on Sept. 25. Tariq was also the original director of Marvel’s failed “Blade” movie, in which Ali was set to star in the title role, which he recently discussed in an interview with The New Arab.

“It was funny and strange to start casting and building without a proper script,” Tariq told interviewer Hanna Flint about his short-lived Marvel career. “You’re sitting there and explaining to actors what their role will be, and they just have to believe you. That’s also very dangerous because if the text comes and it doesn’t add up to what you were saying, your credibility gets completely shot. All I have is my integrity, and I’ve been thinking about that a lot.”

“If you’re the bearer of bad news to your actors, but you’re not the one making any of these decisions — and it’s actually coming from a corporate entity — that’s not a great way to be a director,” he continued. “I know some people can take that and run with it, but I learned I was losing credibility with my actors, and it wasn’t a healthy way to operate as a filmmaker. Life’s too short to make shit films, so that was my big lesson: I have to have full control over my script. If we disagree, it’s between them and me. It’s quite sad because we had such high hopes for what we wanted to build.”

Speaking of the film’s inability to get made, Marvel Studios president Kevin Feige had previously said he felt “like a gigantic loser and failure,” a statement that Ali agreed with in a GQ interview in the months following. “To this day, I don’t know why it didn’t happen. I just know that it was—Kevin, he said it was the biggest failure of his career and I agree,” said Ali.

17uhj1j.title: Chris Harrison’s ‘The Vow’ Star Apologizes For Grabbing Contestant’s Butt: “I Made A Mistake”
17uhj1j.content:
As Chris Harrison leaves the Bachelor Mansion behind for Fox Nation‘s The Vow, the dating show’s first eligible Christian is facing some judgment.

Jace Cates, the star of the new faith-based dating show, apologized for obliging contestant Sierra Wood’s request to “grab my ass” on the third episode “Enter Into Temptation.”

“I think it’s no secret that Sierra and I had an initial connection right from the beginning. And what doesn’t really get talked about is, that’s a long day of shooting, and when that moment happened with Sierra, it was at the end of the day. I was trying to be very intentional with every single girl that day,” he told the California Post. “And me and Sierra were having our moment, and it was a very romantic setting. I was in the moment with her when she made that request and I acted on it.”

Cates added, “So, that’s where my mindset was. It’s just really difficult because you have your faith at the forefront and you have your intention at the forefront, and then you’re also trying to build a relationship with people you see a future with. I think I made a mistake in that moment. I was in there, I’m not perfect. And what I’m happy with is that I apologized to the women, I took accountability. And I tried to make sure they know I want to be respectful.”

Although they’d never met before, Cates and Wood are both members of Rose Church in Portland, Oregon, where he was asked if their pastors have seen the on-air moment. “They’re going to find out very soon if they haven’t seen the episode yet,” he said.

Harrison’s new dating show comes after he parted ways with the Bachelor franchise in June 2021, following his support for a contestant amid controversy over a racist photo she previously posted.

Warner Bros. previously hit The Vow with a cease-and-desist over alleged copyright and trademark infringement. “You can’t put a cease and desist on love,” Harrison told Deadline in response.

“I’ve been away for five years. There have been dozens of other dating shows. They’ve come after one very publicly. Is it a coincidence? I don’t think so,” he said. “On the flip side, there are many friends of ours on that show still, people I care about, and this business is hard. I don’t wish anybody to lose their jobs. There’s enough room for everybody to be successful.”

gh-1465891069.title: GitHub - KevinL50-sysadmin/F1-05-PC: Native Windows port of Formula One 05 (PS2, PAL) by static recompilation. Coming soon: work in progress, no download yet. Free fan project, not affiliated; bring your own disc.
gh-1465891069.content:
Fan project. Not affiliated with, endorsed by or connected to Sony Interactive Entertainment, SCE Studio Liverpool,
Formula One Group, the FIA or any other rights holder. No game data is distributed: you need your own copy of the
game. Español más abajo.

F1 05 PC turns the European PlayStation 2 release of Formula One 05 (PAL, SCES-53033) into a native Windows
program. This is not an emulator running the disc: the game's MIPS code is translated ahead of time into C++ with
PS2Recomp and compiled into a normal .exe, together with a runtime that stands
in for the PS2 hardware (EE, IOP, VU1, SPU2) and draws the GS graphics on your graphics card through
paraLLEl-GS (Vulkan).
It is the sibling of F1 06 PC, on the same foundations, but with a
different goal: the original PS2 game, as it is on the console. There are no PC extras inside the game: no new
options in its menus, no photo mode, no online play. What the port adds is only what a PC needs: a window or full
screen, rendering on your graphics card, controllers, keyboard and wheel, and settings in a file (or on the game's page
in RecompLauncher).

Screenshots are in-game captures from the game's own data; the trademarks and logos visible in them belong to their
owners.
What you get

The PS2 game running natively on Windows, built by static recompilation.
GPU rendering (paraLLEl-GS over Vulkan, gs = gpu, the default) with supersampling and double resolution, and a
software renderer (gs = cpu) as a fallback when Vulkan or pgs_puente.dll is missing. Graphics already prepared
for your card are kept in cache\, so there is less stutter the next time.
Display: window, borderless or full screen, window size, aspect ratio (4:3, 16:9, console pixels), scaling
filter (nearest, bilinear, sharp pixels, AMD FSR 1, CRT), V-Sync and an FPS counter.
Controls: controller, keyboard and steering wheel, with vibration.
Memory cards in saves\mc0 and saves\mc1.
Crash reports with the log attached (see Reporting a problem).

Requirements

Windows 10 or 11, 64-bit.
A graphics card with Vulkan for the normal (GPU) mode; without it the game draws in software mode (much slower).
Your own copy of Formula One 05 for PS2, European PAL version (SCES-53033): the Redump "Europe, Australia
(v1.02)" dump, as an .iso file made from your own disc. Other regions and versions are not supported.
About 3.6 GB of free space for the game data copied from your ISO.
CPU: the game's speed depends mostly on the speed of one processor core. When the CPU cannot keep up, the game does
not skip frames: it runs in slow motion.

How to get it
Download one of these from the latest release. What
changed in each version is in CHANGELOG.md.

Installer (F1-05-PC-vX.Y.Z-setup.exe): creates "F1 05 PC" shortcuts in the Start menu and on the desktop;
uninstall from Settings > Apps (it asks whether to also delete your saves and options). One installer page lets you
choose your ISO (already filled in if one is found in your Downloads or on your Desktop) and copies the game data
during the installation; leave it blank to do it on the first run instead.
Portable (F1-05-PC-vX.Y.Z-portable.zip): unzip the folder anywhere and open F1-05.exe. Everything is saved
inside that folder, so you can move it or carry it on a USB stick.
RecompLauncher: add F1 05 PC and choose your ISO once. The launcher checks it
against the known good dump, copies the game data and then starts the game with Play. The display and graphics
settings also appear on the game's page in the launcher.

Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" (SmartScreen) because the .exe is not signed: click More info and
then Run anyway.
Dump your own disc: the project will never tell you where to download a game image, and does not ship one.
First run
If the game data is not there yet, the game asks once for your Formula One 05 ISO. It offers an ISO found in your
Downloads folder, on your Desktop or next to the .exe (or lets you browse for one; the SYSTEM.CNF of an already
extracted disc folder also works), checks that it is the PAL version (SCES-53033), copies the game files to data\
with a progress bar that can be cancelled, and starts. The ISO is only read, never changed. After that you just play.
If the copy is interrupted or cancelled, nothing is left half done and the game asks again. From the command line,
F1-05.exe --extraer-iso "path\game.iso" copies the disc without opening the game and F1-05.exe --comprobar-iso "path\game.iso" only checks it (exit codes: 0 done or already there, 1 wrong usage, 2 not Formula One 05 PAL, 3 read,
write or space error, 4 cancelled).
Controls and settings

Controller, keyboard or wheel. Buttons and keys are set in config\controls.ini, which is explained inside.
F11 switches between window and full screen, F10 changes the aspect ratio (4:3, 16:9, console pixels).
Close the window (X or Alt+F4) to quit.
The PC settings (window mode and size, aspect ratio, scaling filter, supersampling, double resolution, V-Sync, FPS
counter, volume, audio latency and mono, vibration strength, graphics renderer) are in config\settings.ini, each
one explained inside (in Spanish). Delete the file to go back to the defaults. With RecompLauncher you can change
them on the game's page.
Supersampling and double resolution only load the graphics card: raise them if it has room, lower them if it is
very busy. On a slow CPU they do not help.

Where everything is

What
Portable
Installed

Game data copied from your ISO
data\
data\ next to the .exe (%LOCALAPPDATA%\F1-05\data if the game folder cannot be written)

Settings (settings.ini, controls.ini)
config\
Documents\My Games\F1-05\config

Memory cards (your saves)
saves\mc0, saves\mc1
Documents\My Games\F1-05\saves

Log
logs\F1-05.log
%LOCALAPPDATA%\F1-05\logs\F1-05.log

Graphics cache (can be deleted)
cache\
%LOCALAPPDATA%\F1-05\cache

The portable version is portable because of the portable.txt file next to the .exe. Copy saves\ to back up your
saves.
Known limitations

With 20 cars at the start and in the pit lane the frame rate can dip briefly below 50; the first race after
installing also compiles the graphics for your card once (the cache avoids it next time).
With the software renderer (gs = cpu) the pause menu sometimes does not appear: the picture stays on the last
frame of the race. It does not happen with the GPU renderer, the default.
The executable is not code-signed, so SmartScreen warns on first run.

Reporting a problem

With RecompLauncher: if the game closes because of a failure (it then exits with
a code other than 0), the launcher offers to send the report with F1-05.log already attached.
Otherwise: open an issue at https://github.com/KevinL50-sysadmin/F1-05-PC/issues (you need a free GitHub
account), say what you were doing and attach F1-05.log (see the table above for where it is).

Each start replaces the log; the previous session stays in F1-05.anterior.log, so attach that one if you opened the
game again after the problem. If the game freezes, wait about 10 seconds before closing it: the log then records
where it got stuck (that wait is vigilante in config\settings.ini). The log holds the game version, your Windows,
CPU, RAM, graphics card and game settings, plus folder paths that can include your Windows user name; nothing else
from your PC.
Legal notice
Formula One 05 is © its respective owners. "Formula One", "Formula 1", "F1", "PlayStation", "PS2" and related marks
are trademarks of their respective owners and are used here only to describe what the project is compatible with.
This is an independent, non-commercial fan project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by Sony
Interactive Entertainment, SCE Studio Liverpool, Formula One Group, the FIA or any other rights holder. No game
assets, ISO images or BIOS files are distributed. Making a personal backup of a game you own is treated differently
from country to country, so check your local law. If you are a rights holder and have a concern, please open an issue.
Credits and third-party software

PS2Recomp: the PlayStation 2 static recompiler and runtime this port is
built on (GPL-3.0). This project's changes to it are kept as patches in parches/.
paraLLEl-GS: GS rendering on the GPU with Vulkan (LGPL-3.0
or later), with Granite (MIT), volk (MIT) and Vulkan-Headers
(Apache-2.0 or MIT). Their source and licenses ship in the package's licenses\ folder.
raylib (zlib) and Dear ImGui (MIT),
pulled in by PS2Recomp's runtime; other PS2Recomp build dependencies: fmt, ELFIO, toml11, libdwarf, rabbitizer,
nlohmann/json (each under its own license).
AMD FidelityFX Super Resolution 1 (EASU and RCAS, MIT), adapted to GLSL for the FSR scaling filter.
FFmpeg DLLs for the game's videos (LGPL).
Built on the work done for F1 06 PC.
Thanks to SCE Studio Liverpool for the original game, and to the PS2 preservation and recompilation communities.

Project license: GNU GPL-3.0, the same as PS2Recomp, which the runtime derives from. The license covers the
port's own code only; Formula One 05 and its data belong to their owners and are never included.
Building from source (developers)
The repository holds only the project's own work: src/ (game-specific overrides), parches/ (patches over
PS2Recomp), gpu/pgs_puente/ (the paraLLEl-GS bridge DLL), config/recomp.toml, scripts/ (build, packaging and
analysis tools; comments in Spanish) and the root .cmd build scripts. It never contains game data, the game's
executable or the C++ code generated from it.
Outline (Windows, from the project root):

Clone PS2Recomp into third_party\PS2Recomp, check out the base commit
2c5fbb9389e11dd95693385969490c9e8e6f57b4 and apply parches\*.patch on top of it in numeric order (for example
git apply --whitespace=nowarn for each one, from 0001 up).
Put portable MSVC, Windows SDK, CMake and Ninja in tools\ (entorno.cmd sets up a console with them).
compilar-ps2recomp.cmd builds PS2Recomp in build\ps2recomp.
Extract your own disc into juego\ (scripts\iso_ps2.py), then recompilar.cmd translates juego\SCES_530.33 to
C++ and builds the executable (compilar-runner.cmd rebuilds it after changes in src\).
scripts\obtener-parallel-gs.ps1 fetches paraLLEl-GS at the pinned commit and builds pgs_puente.dll.
ejecutar.cmd runs the development build; scripts\empaquetar.ps1 makes the portable package and the installer.

Español

Proyecto de fans. Sin relación con Sony Interactive Entertainment, SCE Studio Liverpool, Formula One Group, la FIA
ni ningún otro titular de derechos, ni respaldado por ellos. No se distribuye nada del juego: necesitas tu propia
copia.

F1 05 PC convierte la edición europea de PlayStation 2 de Formula One 05 (PAL, SCES-53033) en un programa nativo
de Windows. No es un emulador que lee el disco: el código MIPS del juego se traduce de antemano a C++ con PS2Recomp y
se compila en un .exe normal, con un runtime que hace de hardware de la PS2 y dibuja los gráficos en tu tarjeta
gráfica con paraLLEl-GS (Vulkan). Es el hermano de F1 06 PC, pero
con otro objetivo: el juego original de PS2, tal como es en la consola, sin extras de PC dentro del juego (ni
opciones nuevas en sus menús, ni modo foto, ni juego en red). Solo añade lo que necesita un PC: ventana o pantalla
completa, dibujo por GPU, mando, teclado y volante, y opciones en un archivo (o en la ficha de RecompLauncher).
Requisitos: Windows 10/11 de 64 bits, tarjeta gráfica con Vulkan (sin ella, modo Software, mucho más lento), unos
3,6 GB libres y tu propia copia de Formula One 05 PAL (SCES-53033), el volcado Redump "Europe, Australia (v1.02)",
en una .iso hecha de tu disco. Lo que más cuenta es la velocidad de un núcleo de la CPU: si no llega, el juego va a
cámara lenta (no se salta fotogramas).
Cómo conseguirlo: descarga el instalador o el .zip portable de
la última versión, o añádelo en
RecompLauncher y elige tu ISO una vez. El instalador crea los accesos "F1 05 PC" y puede
copiar los datos de tu ISO durante la instalación. Si no, la primera vez el juego te pide la ISO una sola vez (te
ofrece la que encuentre en Descargas, en el Escritorio o junto al .exe, o la buscas tú), comprueba que es la PAL
(SCES-53033), copia los datos a data\ con una barra de progreso que se puede cancelar y arranca. La ISO solo se lee.
Si Windows avisa con SmartScreen ("Windows protegió su PC"), pulsa "Más información" y "Ejecutar de todas formas".
Vuelca tu propio disco: el proyecto no dice dónde descargar imágenes de juegos ni las distribuye.
Controles y opciones: mando, teclado o volante, con vibración; botones y teclas en config\controls.ini. F11
pantalla completa o ventana, F10 aspecto (4:3, 16:9, píxeles de la consola). Para salir, cierra la ventana. Las
opciones de PC (ventana, tamaño, aspecto, filtro de escalado, supersampling, doble resolución, sincronización
vertical, contador de FPS, volumen, latencia y mono del sonido, vibración y dibujo por GPU o CPU) están en
config\settings.ini, explicadas dentro; bórralo para volver a las de serie. Con RecompLauncher se cambian en la ficha
del juego.
Dónde está todo: en la portable, todo dentro de la carpeta del juego (data\, config\, saves\mc0 y
saves\mc1, logs\, cache\). Instalado: opciones y partidas en Documentos\Mis juegos\F1-05, y el log y la caché en
%LOCALAPPDATA%\F1-05.
Limitaciones conocidas: con 20 coches en la salida y en boxes las imágenes por segundo pueden bajar un momento
de 50; con el dibujo por CPU (gs = cpu) el menú de pausa a veces no se ve (con la GPU, la de
serie, no pasa); el .exe no está firmado.
Cómo enviar un fallo: si juegas con RecompLauncher y el juego se cierra por un fallo, el lanzador te ofrece enviar
el informe con F1-05.log ya adjunto. Si no, abre un issue en https://github.com/KevinL50-sysadmin/F1-05-PC/issues
(hace falta una cuenta gratuita de GitHub), cuenta qué estabas haciendo y adjunta F1-05.log: logs\F1-05.log en la
portable, %LOCALAPPDATA%\F1-05\logs\F1-05.log instalado. Cada arranque lo sustituye: la partida anterior queda en
F1-05.anterior.log. Si el juego se congela, espera unos 10 segundos antes de cerrarlo: así el log anota dónde se
quedó parado. El log puede llevar tu nombre de usuario de Windows en las rutas.
Aviso legal: proyecto de fans independiente y sin ánimo de lucro. Formula One 05 y las marcas "Formula One",
"F1", "PlayStation" y relacionadas pertenecen a sus dueños y solo se nombran para describir la compatibilidad. No se
distribuyen recursos del juego, ISO ni BIOS.
Créditos y licencia: PS2Recomp (GPL-3.0), paraLLEl-GS (LGPL-3.0+), Granite, volk y Vulkan-Headers, raylib, Dear
ImGui, AMD FSR 1 y FFmpeg; detalles en la sección en inglés y licencias en licenses\ del paquete. Licencia del
proyecto: GPL-3.0, solo para el código propio del port.

gh-1162467026.title: GitHub - themuffinator/openD3: openD3: DOOM 3 on the openQ4 engine. A source port that is GPL end to end, engine and game code alike, running the original 2004 game from your retail files with OpenGL or Vulkan rendering. Early development; Windows x64 only so far.
gh-1162467026.content:
DOOM 3 on a modern open-source engine.
A GPL engine and game-code replacement that runs the original 2004 game from your own retail files.

Quick start · Features · Platforms · Guides · Help · Build from source

What is openD3?
openD3 replaces Doom 3's engine and game binaries with its own, built from id Software's GPL source on top of the openQ4 engine. The campaign and multiplayer maps load from your retail game files, with openQ4's window handling and a choice of OpenGL or Vulkan rendering.
NoteopenD3 does not include any Doom 3 game data. You need your own copy of Doom 3 (2004). Doom 3: BFG Edition's data is a different format and is not supported.

ImportantopenD3 is in early development and has no release. It has just moved onto the current openQ4 engine, and so far only the first campaign map and a dedicated-server start have been run on it. Read Features before expecting to play through the game.

About the name
openD3 is named for its family: openQ4, openPREY and openD3 share one engine, and the name says which one it is built on. In openQ4 and openPREY the engine is GPL but the game code comes from SDKs under their own licences. Doom 3 is the one title in the family whose game code id Software released under the GPL, so openD3 is the only member that is open source end to end (LICENSING.md).
"Open" names the family; it doesn't claim to be the only open Doom 3. Other open-source Doom 3 ports, among them dhewm3 and RBDOOM-3-BFG, came first; openD3's difference is the openQ4 engine underneath. "D3" abbreviates Doom 3 the way "Q4" abbreviates Quake 4, and keeps the trademark out of the project's name. It has nothing to do with the D3.js library or with Diablo III.
Quick start
There is no release yet, so you build openD3 yourself:

Install Doom 3. Leave it where it is; openD3 keeps to its own folder.
Build and stage openD3 with BUILDING.md. The staged package lands in .install/.
Launch openD3-client_x64 (.exe on Windows) from .install/ with +set ui_retained 0.
openD3 finds your Doom 3 install on its own. If it doesn't, see If auto-detection fails.

TipDon't copy retail .pk4 files into baseod3/. That folder is for openD3's own files.

Updating? Rebuild and stage the whole package rather than single files, and expect saves from an older build not to load. Getting Started explains why.
Features
What has been run so far, on Windows x64 against the Steam release of Doom 3:

💿 Finds and checks your game files. Startup locates the install, verifies pak000–pak004 by checksum and ignores the retail game binaries.
🗺️ Loads the campaign's first map. game/mars_city1 loads, plays its opening cinematic with working in-world screens, and autosaves.
🎨 OpenGL and Vulkan. The same map renders on the default OpenGL renderer and on the native Vulkan renderer (+set r_renderApi vulkan).
📺 Doom 3's own menus. The original main menu starts and plays the intro video.
🖥️ Dedicated server. openD3-ded_x64 starts a deathmatch map; see Server Setup.

Not yet checked, so don't rely on it: playing beyond the first cinematic, loading saves, level changes, a client joining a multiplayer server, and every platform other than Windows x64.
Not working yet:

Resurrection of Evil. +set fs_game d3xp loads the expansion's game module, but no expansion map has been run yet. See Campaigns.
The retained menus and HUD. Only the start-up screen, the title screen, the pause menu, the message box, the death screen, the level loading screens, the in-game multiplayer menu and the Load Game, Save Game, Controls, Game Options, System, Mods, Credits, Game Browser, Create Server and Multiplayer Settings pages have Doom 3 pages so far, as a preview behind ui_retained 1; openD3 uses Doom 3's own menus, which is why you launch with ui_retained 0.

Release status puts this in player terms. The rebase record is the detailed and current statement of what has been verified and what is open.
Platforms and requirements
Only Windows x64 has been built and run. The openQ4 engine underneath also supports Linux, Steam Deck, macOS and Android, but openD3 has not been tried on any of them.

No memory or performance minimums have been measured yet. Details are in Getting Started.
Player guides
These guides follow the current source tree. Start with release status for what has been run and what has not.
Set up

Getting Started: what you need, first launch and where your files go
Client Settings: launch options, the renderer choice and where settings are saved

Play

Campaigns: starting Doom 3's levels, and the state of Resurrection of Evil

Look and feel

The renderer and display features inherited from openQ4 (shadow maps, light grids, post-processing, presets, controller support) are described in openQ4's guides. None has been checked with Doom 3 yet.

Host and create

Server Setup: starting a dedicated server (startup only has been run)
Mods: what a mod folder needs

Compatibility

openD3 runs the official retail Doom 3 assets with its own engine and game modules.
Mods that ship their own game DLL built for the original gamex86 interface won't load. Content-only mods need a mod.json; see TECHNICAL.md.
Retail Doom 3 clients and servers are not expected to join openD3 games, or the other way round, and nothing of the kind has been tried. Use matching openD3 builds on every client and server.
openD3 is in early development: most of the game has not been run yet.

Getting help

Something broken? Open an issue with your setup and a log: launch with +set logFile 2, reproduce the problem and attach the log from your save folder.
Crashed on Windows? Attach the log and minidump from the crashes/ folder beside the executable.
Want to chat? Find us on the DarkMatter Discord.

For developers

BUILDING.md: build and stage openD3
TECHNICAL.md: layout, modules, configuration and dependencies
AGENTS.md: project rules and the debug loop
The rebase record: how openD3 moved onto openQ4, the engine/game contract and the open items
Game source provenance: where the game library came from
UI visual design and the Interface Atlas: the measured Doom 3 interface and the contract for the new one
TrueType font system: the faces rebuilt from Doom 3's bitmap fonts and how the engine draws with them

Credits
themuffinator leads openD3's development, with stewardship from DarkMatter Productions. openD3 stands on id Software's Doom 3 and its GPL source release, and on the openQ4 engine, which brings the work of everyone credited there with it.

Full credits and third-party software

DarkMatter Productions: project stewardship and website
id Software: Doom 3, Resurrection of Evil (with Nerve Software) and the GPL source release openD3's game modules are built from
openQ4: the engine openD3 is built on; its history is merged into this repository
openPREY: source of the Doom 3-lineage engine layer (particle and FX declarations, Doom 3 map formats, game API bridging) that openD3 adapted
Emile Belanger (emileb): original author of the Android port, SigmaTouch integration, OpenGL ES 3.0 renderer and GLES shader variants carried with the openQ4 engine; see CONTRIBUTORS.md
Justin Marshall: Quake4Doom, the base of the openQ4 engine

Robert Beckebans: renderer modernisation reference work, including RBDOOM-3-BFG
Raven Software: the Quake 4 engine lineage behind openQ4
The Noto fonts (Google, SIL Open Font License 1.1): donor glyphs for the scripts Doom 3's bitmap fonts never covered, in the TrueType faces rebuilt from those fonts
Ronald Rivest and RSA Data Security, Inc.: the MD4 Message-Digest Algorithm behind the PK4 checksums; notice
The RmlUi Team and contributors: MIT-licensed layout library behind the engine's retained interface; notice
The JsonCpp authors: JSON parser, used under its MIT option; notice
Mikko Mononen, Eric Veach and the libtess2 contributors: SGI-B-2.0 polygon tessellator; notice
Sam Lantinga and the SDL contributors: window, display and input support
Chris Robinson and the OpenAL Soft contributors: the OpenAL runtime
Xiph.Org Foundation: libogg and libvorbis
Sean Barrett and the stb_vorbis contributors: Vorbis decoding
The GLEW team: OpenGL extension loading
The Khronos Group and contributors: glslang, the OpenXR loader and the OpenGL ES headers

Licence
openD3, engine and game code alike, is licensed under the GNU General Public License v3.0. Files that keep Doom 3 or Doom 3 BFG Edition headers also keep their upstream notices and Additional Terms. LICENSING.md covers each component, including third-party libraries.
Doom 3's game assets remain the property of their rights holders and are not included. openD3 is an independent project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by or sponsored by id Software, Bethesda or ZeniMax Media. DOOM is a trademark of ZeniMax Media Inc.

1h6tti6.title: GTA 6 Meet the Heders walkthrough: Find and open the SCOOP container
1h6tti6.content: Meet The Heders is the thirty-eighth mission in GTA 6.GTA 6 Meet the Heders mission sees Jason and Lucia meet Brian and Lori Heder for dinner before Lucia leaves to  take on a risky vehicle theft job in Vice City.Here’s how to complete Meet the Heders in GTA 6, including where to find the SCOOP container and how to escape with the car.For complete walkthroughs of GTA 6’s missions, safe codes and much more, check out our GTA 6 Guide Hub.Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to check out our complete walkthrough hub, featuring beginner tips, navigation experience explained, GTA 6 cheats, and more.GTA 6 Meet the Heders walkthroughStraight after Dealer’s Choice, you’ll swap to Lucia who will be at the apartment. Cal will arrive, and you’ll discuss what’s the latest on the mysterious harddrive that has caused so much fuss. Following this, Brian will eventually contact you about meeting him and Lori for dinner. Head to the bedroom in the house and interact with the bag of clothes to begin the mission.Drive to the restaurant on the eastern side of Vice City and take the elevator up to the rooftop bar. On the way up, Lucia will make a joke about you getting the Surf N Turf. Remember this. You’ll find Brian and Lori waiting. Speak to them before following them to their table. When ordering food, choose Surf N Turf. Doing so provides a small relationship bonus.After dinner, Lucia will dissappear, so as Jason follow Brian to the balcony. He’ll offer you a cigar, which you can either accept or decline. It doesn’t really matter which of these options you pick. Once the conversation end, switch to Lucia when prompted.As Lucia, drive across the bridge to the nearby car park and locate the white van. Get out and interact with its rear doors. Lucia will change into a disguise before taking control of the vehicle. Drive south towards the docks entrance and wait for security to let you inside. She will make a joke about having to move containers around, a clear joke about GTA 5‘s infamous containers mission.Park the van and begin searching for the yellow shipping containers marked SCOOP. The container you need for this mission is positioned on top of the middle stack. You can break into the other SCOOP containers, but they won’t move the mission forward.How to open the SCOOP containerApproach the container and use the Cut-off Tool to break through its lock.Hold R2, keeping the cutting indicator aligned with the highlighted section to cut through the lock. You need to use the adaptive triggers if you want to do this quickly, or you can just hold it and it’ll eventually do it itself.After opening the correct container, a cutscene will play. In it, a group of gang members will move it onto a trailer. Once this is finished, jump onto one of the nearby motorbikes and chase the truck. Get close to the back of the container and use the jump prompt to climb aboard. Once inside, get into the car and reverse out the back of the truck.Escape everyon who chases after you, then drive to the lockup in the north of the city and park inside to complete the mission.GTA 6 Meet The Heders mission rewardsCompleting the mission unlocks the Cut-off Tool for both Jason and Lucia.You can now open orange SCOOP containers scattered throughout GTA 6, giving you access to additional loot and rewards, including collectables.That’s everything you need to know about completing Meet the Heders in GTA 6.

1svwgu4.title: Кузова автомобилей будут делать из ананасов: представлена прорывная технология
1svwgu4.content: Кузовная панель из переработанных ананасовых листьев – совместный проект Nissan и японской компании Food Reborn. Подробности технологии автопроизводитель раскрыл в пресс-релизе на своем сайте.В основе материала – натуральный пластик, армированный волокнами. Сырьем служат ананасовые листья, которые в сельском хозяйстве обычно идут в отходы. Волокна соединяют со смолой, и на выходе получается композит для наружных кузовных элементов.По заявлению Nissan, на растяжение новый материал держится крепче традиционных композитов на основе льна. Правда, у существующих натуральных армированных материалов, которые применяют в том числе в автоспорте, есть два минуса – высокая цена и ограниченные объемы поставок.Тацудзо Томита, руководитель Nissan, отвечающий за развитие технологий, описывает разработку так: «Мы разработали новый армированный волокном композитный материал, в котором используются листья ананаса – побочный продукт, который обычно не используется и выбрасывается».В Food Reborn, участвовавшей в проекте, тоже видят смысл в повторном использовании сельскохозяйственных отходов. Генеральный директор Эцуко Уда говорит, что превращение ананасовых листьев в высокопрочные материалы открывает новые возможности для автомобильной промышленности и производства спортивного оборудования.Nissan оценивает мировой объем выбрасываемых ананасовых листьев более чем в 50 млн тонн ежегодно. Переработка такого сырья дает материал для композитов, не затрагивая выращивание продуктов питания.Однако пока речь идет о демонстрационной технологии. Появится ли материал на серийных автомобилях, автопроизводитель не сообщил.О том, какие технологии определят будущее автопрома, «За рулем» уже рассказывал.Понравилась публикация?Тогда добавьте «За рулем» в список интересных источников: 1. Откройте https://google.com... 2. Поставьте галочку напротив нашего изданияГотово – остаемся на связи! «За рулем» можно читать и в MAX

gh-1465996825.title: GitHub - t3chnaztea/sonic-cd-saturn: Unofficial native Sega Saturn port of Sonic CD (1993), built with Yaul. No game data included; build from your own disc.
gh-1465996825.content:
A native Sega Saturn port of Sonic CD (1993). The game logic is reimplemented in C and runs on the Saturn's SH-2 CPUs. There is no Sega CD emulation. It follows the 1993 Sega CD release, not the 2011 remaster.
ImportantThis repository contains no SEGA art, audio, level data, program files, disc images or BIOS files, and no playable image will be distributed. The game logic is reimplemented in C; like the decompilation it follows, it keeps some of the original's numeric tables, and the test tools find code on your disc by short byte patterns. To build it you need your own U.S. and Japanese Sonic CD discs. Do not share the images you build. If you do not own the game, it is sold in Sonic Origins.

Status
The current candidate is V0.082 (build label 2026-11-17). Its software regression finished on 2026-11-19: 215/215 checks, 347/347 matrix windows, and 70 art cases with zero misses. The tested game source is 49bfd89643b2a77962964a988e87b75a46e9b7a6. I tested it on my Saturn with a SAROO on 2026-11-21, and it works. These counts do not establish a percentage of all paths through the game. See V0.082 release notes for the exact image hashes and evidence. Version history is in CHANGELOG.md.
There is no release download yet. A public patcher that takes all game data from your own discs comes first. Until then, the only way to get a playable image is to build it from source with your own discs (see Building).
web/patcher holds the browser patcher's code only. It has no payload. The bundle I test it with contains converted game data, so it stays private and is not in this repository.
What works in the emulator:

All 7 zones, each in 4 eras (Present, Past, Good Future, Bad Future), with time travel through time posts. 70 act/era variants in total.
All seven bosses, Metal Sonic, Amy, and both endings.
Special stages 1 to 8, entered from the big ring.
Title screen, New Game, Continue, RAM Data and Time Attack.
D.A. Garden, with its track list and looping music.
Visual Mode: the opening, both endings and the pencil-test movie.
The staff roll, the end screens, the "Thank You" screen and the Special Stage 8 credits. Each is compared with the original, picture by picture (credits audit).
Backup-RAM saves for progress, Time Stones and future flags. RESET is held off while a save is written, the two progress slots and the Time Attack record files are written in turn so a power cut keeps the previous save, and a slot that cannot be read is never overwritten (V0.080).
The five secret sound-test pictures, from your disc (V0.080).
The Japanese soundtrack, copied from your disc without resampling.
An optional CD++-style preset (see below). Classic is the default.

V0.082 ran on my Saturn with a SAROO on 2026-11-21, and it works. That report is short. I did not log which zones, acts, eras, special stages or modes I played, so no single path is confirmed on hardware by name. The console-tested build before it was V0.065 (2026-09-26), which covered Palmtree Panic, Collision Chaos and Tidal Tempest.

Each zone has 10 act/era variants: Acts 1 and 2 in four eras, Act 3 in both futures. "Retail match" replays a recorded controller route on the original Sega CD program and on the port, and compares nine state fields. "Campaign" plays from New Game through to the Good Future. All results are from the V0.080 BIN, SHA-256 7bbce369…5338. Evidence is in RELEASE-NOTES-V0.080.md and QA-PLAN.md.
CD++ preset
An optional preset adds five moves from the 2009 Sonic CD++ hack: the Sonic 2 spin dash, no air speed cap, an air roll, a homing attack and the mini Sonic spin dash. Switch it in RAM Data (MODE CLASSIC / CD++). The setting is saved in its own backup file, and Time Attack keeps separate CD++ records. The moves are written from scratch from public references. No CD++ code, patch data or sprites are used. Some values are this port's own choices, so it does not claim to match the hack frame for frame. Details are in docs/CDPP-PRESET-SPEC.md.
How this was checked

Game logic follows the Sonic CD C decompilation and is checked against scddisasm, the disassembly of the Sega CD original. Where they disagree, the original wins.
Retail match: the original Sega CD program runs in an offline emulator core with a recorded controller route. The Saturn build replays the same route in Beetle Saturn, and the two runs must agree on nine state fields. Each zone has 10 of these routes.
Many objects, bosses, menus and movies are also compared picture by picture or state by state with the original. Examples: the credits audit, D.A. Garden, Visual Mode and the special stages.
Player physics has its own trace test (tools/test-player.sh). The Classic traces must stay identical when the CD++ code is built in.
The V0.080 full QA run has 201 steps and takes about 3.5 hours. All 201 passed, including 42 special-stage and front-end cases.
None of this replaces a console test. Only a test on my own Saturn counts as "works on hardware". The last one was V0.082 on 2026-11-21, a short report with no per-path log.

Related project
orca_earth_md is making a separate Sonic CD port for the Saturn (r/SegaSaturn post). It was shown running on real hardware in September 2026. The two projects are independent. This one is a C reimplementation of the game logic that is tested against the original Sega CD program, and it is built only from your own discs.
Known issues

Lost rings can bounce one update apart from the original after the Sega CD lags. The port does not copy Sega CD slowdown (lag note).
Quartz Quadrant Act 1 Present: an era-sign timing difference reported in V0.078 is not reproduced on the current routes. It stays open until a route shows it or it is ruled out.
Tidal Tempest Act 3 has no water-entry splash (it does not fit the sprite memory).
Collision Chaos checks object touches in four passes where the original uses one loop that stops at the first overlap.
Stardust Speedway special-stage jump headroom still needs a console check.

Screenshots
V0.078 in Beetle Saturn, 2x nearest-neighbor. Console photos will follow the SAROO test.

Compatibility

Target
State

Beetle Saturn (libretro)
All automated tests run here. V0.082 passes.

Real Saturn + SAROO
Main target. V0.082 works on my console (2026-11-21). V0.066 to V0.081 untested.

Used for manual play during development.

Yaba Sanshiro, Kronos, SSF
Untested.

Burned CD-R, other ODEs
Untested.

The disc header lists every Saturn region (IP_AREAS JTUBKAEL), but only my console has run it. I have not yet recorded its model, region, video mode or SAROO firmware. PAL timing is untested.
The build produces one BIN/CUE with 42 tracks (one data track plus CD audio). Load the CUE. The ISO under dist/iso/ has no music.
Requirements

Input
Path
Used for

Sonic CD, U.S. disc, CHD

Game programs, sound effects, Past music driver, demos, movies

Two discs are needed because the port uses the Japanese soundtrack, while the game data and sound driver come from the U.S. disc. The tools are verified against one U.S. disc image; other U.S. revisions are untested. The Japanese disc is checked by its header and track layout. The build stops if a source is missing or does not match.
The build also downloads scddisasm, the Sonic Retro disassembly, at a pinned commit. Stage art, layouts, palettes and mappings currently come from it. That repository contains SEGA-owned data and is not redistributed here. A later version will read these assets from your disc instead. See THIRD-PARTY.md.
Do not post disc images, BIOS files, built images or links to them in issues or pull requests. They will be deleted.
Building
Only tested on Apple Silicon macOS. Linux and Intel Macs have not been tried.
You need the Xcode command-line tools, Homebrew, Python 3.12+, Git, ffmpeg and chdman (brew install ffmpeg rom-tools), plus about 6 GB of disk space. The bootstrap script runs brew install make xorriso gmp mpfr libmpc isl, then builds a pinned toolchain (binutils 2.44, GCC 13.4.0 sh-elf, Yaul 0.3.1) inside the repo. It applies the fixes in tools/patches/ to the pinned Yaul. Source revisions are pinned in sources.lock.json.
git clone https://github.com/t3chnaztea/sonic-cd-saturn.git
cd sonic-cd-saturn

# Your own dumps (see Requirements)
mkdir -p assets/private
cp /path/to/your/sonic-cd-us.chd assets/private/sonic-cd.chd
cp /path/to/your/bios_CD_U.bin assets/private/bios_CD_U.bin
ln -s "/path/to/Sonic the Hedgehog CD (Japan).cue" assets/private/sonic-cd-japan.cue
cp /path/to/your/mpr-17933.bin assets/private/mpr-17933.bin # emulator tests only

# Toolchain and pinned sources (--emulator also fetches Beetle Saturn for tests)
bash tools/bootstrap.sh --emulator

# Extract, convert and build the disc
bash tools/build.sh
This writes dist/sonic-cd-saturn-prototype.cue and its .bin. On an M-series Mac the toolchain build takes about 10 minutes and the first tools/build.sh about 20 minutes. The same source and discs give the same .bin from any checkout directory: ISO dates come from IP_RELEASE_DATE in the Makefile (or SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH), and no build path is compiled in. Everything stays in .toolchain/, .deps/, build/ and dist/, all ignored by Git. Japanese disc setup is covered in JAPANESE-MUSIC.md.
To play on a Saturn, copy the .bin and .cue into a folder on the SAROO SD card and pick the game from the SAROO menu. To play in Mednafen with your Saturn BIOS, run bash tools/run-emulator.sh.
Tests:
python3 tools/qa-loop.py fast # quick gates
python3 tools/qa-loop.py full # every step (201 in V0.080), about 3.5 hours on my Mac
bash tools/test-player.sh # player physics trace comparison
Technical notes
Game logic is ported from the Sonic CD C decompilation (CC0) and checked against scddisasm. Where they disagree, the Sega CD original wins.
VDP1 draws sprites and VDP2 draws terrain and parallax. Stage data is loaded from disc per act. Music is streamed as CD audio from the Japanese tracks. The Past music is rendered offline from the original Z80/PCM driver. Sound effects come from the original sound bank and play on the SCSP.
For testing, the original Sega CD program runs in an offline emulator core with recorded controller input, and the Saturn build replays the same input in Beetle Saturn. A test passes only when state and pixels match.
Hardware reports
Console results are the most useful contribution. Use the hardware test form and include the BIN SHA-256, Saturn model, region, video mode, SAROO firmware and what you saw. A photo or video helps. See CONTRIBUTING.md.
Credits

Sonic Retro and the scddisasm contributors, for the disassembly every behavior is checked against.
nfroggy and the Sonic CD C decompilation (CC0), the game-logic reference.
Yaul by Israel Jacquez and contributors (MIT), the Saturn SDK.
PoneSound by ponut64 (MIT), the Saturn sound driver.
SAROO by TPU, the optical drive emulator used for console tests.
Beetle Saturn (Mednafen authors and libretro, GPL-2.0+) and Genesis Plus GX (Eke-Eke and contributors), used only for testing and audio rendering. Neither is linked into the game.
qiuu and snkenjoi for Sonic CD++ (2009), with small spin dash sprites by MKAmeX, which inspired the CD++ preset. Christian Whitehead and SEGA for the 2011 remaster's spin dash option.
Sonic Team and SEGA, for Sonic CD.

Full notices are in THIRD-PARTY.md.
AI use
This port was developed with heavy use of Claude Code (Anthropic's coding agent) under my direction. I set the goals, made the design decisions and run every console test. Each feature is checked against scddisasm with the trace and emulator tests in QA-PLAN.md. Hardware results decide what counts as working.
Legal
This is a non-profit fan project. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by SEGA or Sonic Team. Sonic the Hedgehog, Sonic CD and all related names, characters and marks belong to SEGA and are used here only to describe what this software works with. The repository contains no SEGA program files, graphics, music, sound or level data. The project does not accept donations.
License
The port's own source code is under the MIT License. It grants no rights to Sonic CD or any SEGA content. Third-party components keep their own licenses (see THIRD-PARTY.md). See also CONTRIBUTING.md, the Code of Conduct and SECURITY.md.

5g174r.title: Ferrari 296 Challenge Stradale Is the Purest Prancing Horse in Years
5g174r.content:
Like its 360 Challenge Stradale predecessor, the 296 CS is a track-focused road car that shares more with the new 296 Challenge Evo race car than it does with the Ferrari 296GTB.Ditching the standard 296GTB's hybrid system, the 296 CS's twin-turbo V-6 makes 670 horsepower. The 296 Challenge Stradale is expected to go on sale in the U.S. in the third quarter of 2027, with a price of around $320,000.Nostalgia must be in the air in Maranello. A few months ago, Ferrari unveiled the 12Cilindri Manuale, reintroducing a (simulated) six-speed manual transmission to its model lineup purely for the sake of driver involvement. And now, the Challenge Stradale badge returns to the rear engine mesh of a Prancing Horse for the first time since the 360 CS was discontinued in 2004. Simply put, it's a good year to be a sentimental Ferrarista.In the same vein as its predecessor, the 296 Challenge Stradale is a road car that shares its fundamental philosophy with the new 296 Challenge Evo racecar, which will debut in the single-marque Ferrari Challenge racing series next year. Parked side by side at their reveal at the Circuit de Barcelona-Catalunya today, we would excuse a gentleman driver for confusing the CS with his new track-only machinery.For Sale Near YouSee all results for near 94402FerrariThere have been several limited-edition, track-focused mid-engine Ferraris since the 360 Challenge Stradale—including the F430 Scuderia, 458 Speciale, and 488 Pista—but the 296 Challenge Stradale goes the furthest of all of them in emulating its racecar counterpart, both aesthetically and mechanically.While previous track-centric Ferraris have been somewhat demurely styled, the 296 CS puts its aerodynamic elements on full display. The carbon-fiber rear wing, dive planes, adjustable front splitter, and vented hood are essentially a copy-paste job from the Challenge Evo, with concessions made for road legality. Up front, twin vents positioned in the hood just before the windshield channel hot air expelled from two under-hood radiators over the windshield and towards the rear of the car, reducing the aerodynamic variations caused by changing ground clearance.Other aero features are hidden out of sight. The CS's underbody has been smoothed to better feed the rear diffuser and work with three pairs of vortex generators at the front and two at the rear to generate additional downforce. With all of the aerodynamic elements colluding, the 296 Challenge Stradale makes 1360 pounds of downforce at 155 mph. That's a 72-percent increase over the base 296GTB's peak figure.FerrariBig changes have been made to the CS's powertrain. You won't find any orange high-voltage wiring snaking around under the glass of its mid-mounted hood like you would in a 296GTB or 296 Speciale, as the 5-kWh battery pack and rear-mounted axial-flux electric motor have been removed entirely. The twin-turbo 3.0-liter V-6 operates unassisted and supposedly sounds better than ever courtesy of a reworked twin-exit exhaust system.For Sale Near YouSee all results for near 94402Overall firepower has decreased to 670 horsepower—149 ponies less than the standard 296GTB's. The upside is a notable decrease in mass, with Ferrari claiming that the removal of the plug-in-hybrid componentry played a major role in shedding 328 pounds from the 296GTB's dry weight. A lightened transmission flex plate, driveshaft, and timing cover were also developed to make the CS's powertrain as featherweight as possible. Without an electric motor present to fill in any thrust gaps left by turbo lag, the V-6 has been retuned to increase low-end grunt, although peak torque remains 546 pound-feet delivered at 8250 rpm.As to be expected, yanking out an integrated powertrain system comes with some unique challenges that affect more than just the engine itself. For example, Ferrari was forced to enlarge the 296 CS's rear carbon-ceramic brake discs and the ventilation ducts that cool them to compensate for the lack of regenerative braking. The decreased weight in the rear also shifted its weight distribution 1.5 percent to the front, which was addressed with suspension design and geometry changes.FerrariThe CS's newly developed suspension is derived directly from the 296 Challenge Evo and features semi-active dampers and a dual-spring design that improves rebound response. The result is reduced body roll, which helps the performance of the specially developed Pirelli P Zero R tires, measuring 245/35R20 in the front and 305/35R20 in the rear. The 20-inch forged wheels can be ordered in Matte Grigio Corsa, Matte Nero with a diamond-cut finish, or Matte Bianco Fuji.The 296 Challenge Stradale's cockpit is very similar to the one found in the 296 Speciale. While niceties like climate control and a stereo remain, carbon-fiber door panels and a lack of armrests and storage pockets are a clear indication of the CS's weight-saving mission. For true gluttons for punishment, an even further stripped interior spec is available that removes the trim from the area beneath the seats and the lower section of the carpets beneath the center console, leaving part of the chassis exposed.FerrariFerrari is adamant that the 296 CS isn't a replacement for the 296 Speciale and will not cannibalize that model's customer base, as the two are intended for different buyers. Besides being geared less towards outright track duty, the 296 Speciale is a part of Ferrari's special series, meaning that customers need to have an "existing relationship" with the brand in order to get an allocation. The 296 Challenge Stradale is a standard range model, meaning anyone can walk into a dealer and order one, existing relationship or not. Ferrari says that it wants to court new Ferrari buyers interested in experiencing the purest driving experience that the prancing horse has to offer, and the 296 CS is the first step in that direction.U.S. pricing has not been announced, but in its home market, the 296 Challenge Stradale costs 291,000 euros, or the equivalent of about $320,000. Stateside deliveries of the new CS are expected to begin sometime in late 2027. As a non-Speciale model, CS production numbers aren’t limited, which presents a unique opportunity to buy a special new Ferrari without already owning one.➡️ Skip the lot. Let Car and Driver help you find your next car.Austin's car fixation began at a young age and at 1:64 scale. Eventually, Hot Wheels weren't cutting it anymore, so he developed an obsession with his father's full-sized 1965 Ford Mustang instead. Desperate to break into the automotive industry, he bartered his way into a job at a local BMW dealership by promising to stop hurling nerdy technical facts at the salesmen who came into the neighboring coffee shop where he worked.

That was also around the time when he started writing automotive reviews, news articles, and technical guides for a number of local and international publications. Now at Car and Driver, Austin brings more than 10 years of experience in the automotive industry and an all-so-common love-hate relationship with German engineering to the table.

1q5bmol.title: Украинские беспилотники для ВСУ начнут производить в Великобритании
1q5bmol.content:
Великобритания и Украина заключили соглашение, согласно которому украинские беспилотники для ВСУ начнут производить на территории Соединенного Королевства при финансовой поддержке Лондона, сообщили министерства обороны двух стран в субботу, 21 ноября.

"Великобритания усилила поддержку Украины, подписав новые соглашения, которые позволят производить в Великобритании ударные дроны украинской разработки для Вооруженных сил Украины", - говорится в пресс-релизе на сайте британского Минобороны. Об усилении промышленной поддержки в ходе своего визита в Украину объявил министр обороны Уэс Стритинг. На встречах со своим украинским коллегой Евгением Хмарой и главой государства Владимиром Зеленским он обсудил продолжение поддержки Киева Лондоном "на фоне продолжающегося пятый год жестокого вторжения России".

"Заключенные сегодня промышленные соглашения означают, что Украина сможет создать производственные мощности в Великобритании, что позволит увеличить объемы производства и повысить устойчивость", - указано в сообщении. Лондон подтвердил, что военная помощь в объеме 3 млрд фунтов стерлингов в год будет выделяться Киеву "столько, сколько потребуется".

Великобритания выделяет ракеты для Украины

Минобороны Украины, в свою очередь, рассказало в Telegram, что британская сторона "стала одной из первых" передавших Киеву "ракеты LMM (многоцелевые ракеты. - Ред.) со своих складов в обмен на будущие поставки".

"Такие средства критически важны для противодействия реактивным "шахедам", - пояснили в украинском военном ведомстве.

96ba09.title: Kaitlan Collins Notes ‘Real Time’ Absence Was Due To White House Press Conference
96ba09.content:
Skip to main content

November 21, 2026 1:54pm

Kaitlan Collins attends The New York Times Celebrates 175 Years of Independent Reporting on Sept. 17, 2026 in New York City.
Bryan Bedder/Getty Images for The New York Times

The Season 24 finale of Real Time with Bill Maher featured a last-minute guest change as Kaitlan Collins was held up in Washington DC.

Although she was scheduled to appear on the HBO talk show alongside newly elected Texas Democratic congressman Bobby Pulido, the CNN anchor explained she was covering a White House press conference with Donald Trump amid a report that she was “quietly dropped” from the show’s lineup.

“Yes, because I was….at the White House for a press conference with the president,” she wrote on X in response. “But Maher’s team was gracious and understanding and I can’t wait to watch the season finale!”

The reporter then shared a clip from the press conference of herself grilling Trump about his friendship with Vladimir Putin and whether he considers the Russian president an ally of the United States. “Anyways here’s my Q&A,” she wrote following Trump’s previous attempts to ban her and CNN from White House press briefings.

In Collins’ place, NBC News and MS NOW’s Jacob Soboroff appeared on the panel for Friday’s Real Time season finale, with mentalist Oz Pearlman as Maher’s interview guest.

Real Time‘s Season 24 finale comes after HBO gave the show another two-season renewal earlier this year, with its Season 25 return set for Jan. 15.

m3fmv2.title: Генштаб ЗСУ: від початку доби на фронті було 116 боїв, на Покровському напрямку – 30 атак
m3fmv2.content:
Від початку доби 21 листопада на фронті відбулось 116 бойових зіткнень, повідомляє у вечірньому зведенні Генеральний штаб ЗСУ.За даними Генштабу, на Північно-Слобожанському та Курському напрямках від початку доби відбулося три бойові зіткнення. Сили РФ завдали двох авіаударів, скинули п’ять керованих авіабомб та здійснили 45 обстрілів позицій ЗСУ і населених пунктів.На Південно-Слобожанському напрямку армія РФ два рази намагалась просунутися в бік Охрімівки.На Костянтинівському напрямку українські воїни відбили десять атак сил РФ у районі Костянтинівки та в бік Новопавлівки. Одне зіткнення триває досі.«Тринадцять атак здійснив ворог на Покровському напрямку. Окупанти намагалися просунутися неподалік населених пунктів Вільне, Добропілля та в бік населених пунктів Кучерів Яр, Чернігівка, Святогорівка, Мирне, Сергіївка, Новопавлівка. Три ворожі штурми тривають», – повідомили у Генштабі.

На початку листопада американський Інститут вивчення війни (ISW) заявив, що війська РФ продовжують утримувати найвищий темп наступу на Покровському напрямку, принаймні з 1 серпня 2026 року цей напрямок залишається ділянкою фронту з найвищою інтенсивністю бойових дій.Аналітики зазначають, що війська РФ зберігають ініціативу лише в безпосередній близькості до Добропілля (Донецька область), де зосереджена основна частина їхніх наступальних операцій. Натомість українські сили перехопили ініціативу на Куп’янському, Лиманському та Олександрівському напрямках, а також ведуть боротьбу за неї в західній частині Запорізької області.Командувач Десантно-штурмових військ Збройних сил України Олег Апостол заявив 13 листопада, що за результатами двох наступальних операцій українські військові відновили контроль загалом над понад 800 квадратними кілометрами території. Про які саме напрямки йдеться, він не уточнив.

15pp1ud.title: MANGMI представляет игровой КПК Air X Pro, но характеристики обещают показать позже
15pp1ud.content:
Компания MANGMI анонсировала Air X Pro - новый компактный игровой контроллер на базе существующей серии Air X. 19 ноября компания опубликовала тизер, в котором подтвердила, что скоро будут опубликованы технические характеристики, особенности и информация о выпуске.

Анонсирован новый портативный игровой КПК MANGMI Air X Pro, который станет преемником Air X на базе Snapdragon 662
На тизере изображена передняя часть контроллера, дизайн которой похож на оригинальный Air X. Судя по всему, он сохранил раскладку ABXY в стиле Nintendo, крестовину и два аналоговых джойстика с подсветкой. Устройство также немного шире своего предшественника, хотя компания MANGMI не подтвердила его размеры.
Оригинальная модель MANGMI Air X была выпущена в 2025 году и оснащена процессором Qualcomm Snapdragon 662, 4 ГБ памяти LPDDR4X и 64 ГБ встроенной памяти eMMC. Она оснащена 5,5-дюймовым IPS-дисплеем с разрешением 1920 × 1080 и частотой обновления 60 Гц. Среди других характеристик - аккумулятор емкостью 5000 мАч, джойстики на на датчиках Холла и операционная система Android 14. В настоящее время портативка продается по цене $99,99 в официальном магазине MANGMI.

Ранее в этом году компания MANGMI представила модели Air Y и Air Y Pro. В модели Pro используется более быстрый процессор Snapdragon 865 с объемом памяти до 8 ГБ и накопителем на 128 ГБ. Это может указывать на то, какое аппаратное обеспечение MANGMI может использовать в Air X Pro, хотя компания не подтвердила, будет ли использоваться тот же процессор.
Air X Pro выйдет на рынок, где уже представлены Retroid Pocket 6 и другие компактные игровые устройства на базе Android. Компания MANGMI не объявила ни характеристики процессора, ни параметры дисплея, ни конфигурацию памяти, ни цену, ни дату выпуска.

1a5jirw.title: Signal restricts mobile screenshots as it confronts ‘existential threat’ of AI surveillance
1a5jirw.content:
Signal announced Friday that it’s limiting users’ ability to take screenshots within the secure messaging app — a response to what President Meredith Whittaker described as the “existential threat” of operating systems that integrate agentic AI.

Whittaker wrote that by giving AI agents the ability to “scan” the information on users’ screens, Windows, Android, and macOS/iOS “are undermining Signal’s ability to independently guarantee privacy.”

“Now, in service of AI agentic capabilities, your sensitive data is being captured, stored, and made accessible to whatever local database or remote server an OS-level AI agent is using at that moment,” she said. “All of this is outside of Signal’s control once the data has been captured, and imperils the privacy of all the participants in a conversation.”

Signal already sought to limit these risks by blocking screenshots of its Windows app by default. Now it’s adding similar restrictions in Android and iOS.

That said, users can disable this setting if they wish, which Whittaker said would “break our privacy guarantees.” She also admitted this is an “incomplete” solution, as it doesn’t “address other more sneaky ways AI agents could potentially access application data.”

172pmc5.title: GIGABYTE выпускает блок питания AORUS за $640 с ЖК-дисплеем
172pmc5.content:
Блок питания AORUS P1600W от GIGABYTE наконец-то поступил в розничную продажу в Китае. Компания впервые продемонстрировала блок питания мощностью 1600 Вт на выставке Computex 2026 и официально анонсировала его в августе, но тогда еще не поступало сообщений от компании о ценах и о датах поступления в розничную продажу.

AORUS P1600W с 4,3-дюймовым ЖК-дисплеем теперь доступен в Китае
Одна из самых необычных особенностей блока питания - встроенный 4,3-дюймовый ЖК-экран, который больше, чем 3,5-дюймовый дисплей оригинального iPhone от Apple 2007 года. На дисплее Edge View отображается информация о потребляемой мощности, силе тока, температуре и скорости вращения вентилятора. Он также поддерживает пользовательский текст, изображения, GIF-файлы и видео в формате MP4 через GIGABYTE Control Center.
AORUS P1600W (GP-AP1600TM PG5 AI TOP) - это полностью модульный блок питания стандарта ATX 3.1 с поддержкой PCIe 5.1 и сертификатом 80 PLUS Titanium. В нем используются GaN-транзисторы, японские конденсаторы и цифровая схема питания. Несмотря на мощность 1600 Вт, блок питания имеет размеры всего 150 × 160 × 86 мм, то есть его длина составляет 160 мм.
GIGABYTE включает в комплект два штатных 16-контактных кабеля PCIe, каждый из которых обеспечивает мощность до 600 Вт. Также в комплект входят два кабеля с 8-контактных на 16-контактные разъемы, что позволяет блоку питания поддерживать до четырех видеокарт мощностью 300 Вт каждая. Эта конфигурация предназначена для рабочих станций с несколькими графическими процессорами и локальных систем искусственного интеллекта, хотя общая мощность в 1600 Вт по-прежнему актуальна.

Поддерживает 2 графических процессора мощностью 600 Вт или 4 × 300
Охлаждение обеспечивается 140-миллиметровым вентилятором на двойных шарикоподшипниках с полупассивным режимом работы. Вентилятор также поддерживает реверсивное вращение для удаления скопившейся пыли, которое может быть активировано автоматически при запуске или вручную с помощью программного обеспечения. GIGABYTE предоставляет 10-летнюю гарантию на блок питания в Китае. Блок питания AORUS P1600W уже доступен на JD.com по цене 4599 юаней (640 долларов США).
