niw5lc.title: Jeff Goldblum, Marion Cotillard Dine With Morocco Prince at Royal Dinner
niw5lc.content:
Jeff Goldblum, Marion Cotillard, John Turturro and more stars got the royal treatment on Saturday night at a glitzy dinner hosted by Morocco’s His Royal Highness Prince Moulay Rachid and Her Royal Highness Princess Lalla Oum Keltoum during the Marrakech Film Festival.

Held at the 16th-century El Badi Palace — known for its stunning architecture and dramatic ruins — guests were greeted with fresh passion fruit and strawberry juice (and by the palace’s resident orange tabby cat) before being ushered into the glass-walled hall for dinner.

Raised above dozens of meticulously-set tables was a large head table, decorated with a smattering of colorful flowers, where the guests of honor took their seats. The entire room rose to its feet as HRH Prince Moulay Rachid and HRH Princess Lalla Oum Keltoum arrived, joining Marrakech Film Festival jury president Cotillard as well as Goldblum and Turturro, who are both receiving career tributes. The festival was created by HRH Prince Moulay Rachid’s brother Mohammed VI, the King of Morocco, 23 years ago, with the entire royal family still heavily involved in the black-tie affair.

Other guests seated at the head table included Cotillard’s fellow jury members Emma Mackey, Vicky Krieps, Claes Bang, Gilles Lellouche, Kaouther Ben Hania, Andrew Haigh, Ramata-Toulaye Sy and Saïd Hamich Benlarbi, as well as festival director Melita Toscan du Plantier. There were plenty of bold-faced industry names seated throughout the room, including Francesca Scorsese, daughter of director Martin Scorsese, who is a friend of the festival, and Mubi CEO Efe Cakarel.

While a live orchestra played famed scores from throughout cinema history, attendees were served a traditional Moroccan feast including lamb tagine, a mound of couscous and pastillas, which was, of course, accompanied by plenty of mint tea.

As the dinner wound down, guests got up out of their seats to mingle and migrate to a more intimate room. Red velvet couches invited guests to settle in, while photos of famous faces who had graced the festival throughout years past dotted the walls. Goldblum and his wife, Emilie Goldblum, chatted animatedly to Mackey while Krieps — who was sporting a chic headscarf printed with red roses — caught up with Cakarel.

The Marrakech Film Festival runs through Nov. 28, when Cotillard and her jury will award one of the 14 competition films — consisting of first and second features — the prestigious Étoile d’Or.

gu738w.title: Rockstar выделила на музыку для GTA 3 $600 тысяч, но не потратила ни цента благодаря неожиданной сделке с Sony
gu738w.content:
Компания Rockstar Games предусмотрела бюджет в размере 600 тысяч долларов на музыкальное сопровождение Grand Theft Auto III, однако в итоге разработчикам не пришлось потратить ни цента. Об этом рассказал бывший руководитель Take-Two Келли Самнер, раскрывший подробности необычной сделки с Sony, благодаря которой игра получила лицензионную музыку совершенно бесплатно.
Историей Самнер поделился в интервью журналисту Кристоферу Дрингу из The Game Business, посвящённом соглашению об эксклюзивном выпуске GTA III на PlayStation 2. По его словам, сотрудник маркетингового подразделения Rockstar Терри Донован сумел связаться с Томми Моттолой, который в то время руководил Sony и являлся одной из самых влиятельных фигур музыкальной индустрии. Моттола лично приехал в офис компании, расположенный в нью-йоркском районе Сохо, где стороны заключили выгодное соглашение.
Мы передали им права на выпуск компакт-диска, а музыку получили бесплатно,
— вспоминает Самнер.
По его словам, сделка оказалась не только коммерчески выгодной, но и позволила Rockstar получить музыкальные композиции, которые разработчики считали необходимыми для создания внутриигровых радиостанций.
Музыка впоследствии стала одной из визитных карточек серии Grand Theft Auto. В частности, радиостанция Flashback FM в GTA III полностью состояла из композиций из саундтрека к фильму «Лицо со шрамом». В последующих играх серии также появились многочисленные известные хиты, включая I Ran (So Far Away) группы A Flock of Seagulls и Rhythm of the Night исполнительницы Corona.
Традиция использования лицензированной музыки сохранилась и в недавно вышедшей Grand Theft Auto VI. Помимо радиостанций с известными композициями, игра получила отдельный музыкальный альбом с участием таких исполнительниц, как Лана Дель Рей и Cardi B.

1ke2acy.title: Digital Foundry протестировала мод с аппаратной трассировкой лучей для Red Dead Redemption 2
1ke2acy.content:
Пока Grand Theft Auto 6 остаётся в центре внимания, моддеры продолжают экспериментировать с другой игрой Rockstar Games. Энтузиаст под ником BadassBaboon выпустил Reality Redemption 2 — модификацию для Red Dead Redemption 2, которая добавляет поддержку аппаратной трассировки лучей и улучшает освещение.

Модификация включает три основные технологии: трассировку солнечных теней, трассировку окружающего затенения и трассировку глобального освещения. Последняя отвечает за отражённый свет и способна заметно преобразить интерьер помещений, хотя на открытых пространствах иногда делает картинку слишком яркой или плоской, особенно на рассвете и закате.
В Digital Foundry отметили, что наиболее удачно реализовано трассируемое глобальное освещение. RTAO также хорошо справляется с затемнением участков под навесами и в углах зданий, однако требует настройки интенсивности, чтобы избежать чрезмерно тёмных областей и неестественных ореолов. А вот трассировку солнечных теней пока рекомендовать сложно: она обеспечивает лишь незначительные визуальные улучшения при ощутимом снижении производительности.
За улучшенную графику приходится дорого платить производительностью. По замерам Digital Foundry, при включении всех трёх эффектов FPS снижается примерно на 65%. Отдельно трассировка солнечных теней отнимает 19–29% производительности в зависимости от сцены, RTAO — около 44% в нативном 4K, а RTGI практически вдвое сокращает частоту кадров. Использование FSR вместо нативного разрешения помогает компенсировать потери.
Пока Reality Redemption 2 работает только с версией игры на DirectX 12. При этом лучше всего модификация показала себя на видеокартах AMD Radeon RX 9070 XT: во время тестирования на NVIDIA RTX 4060 возникали графические ошибки и вылеты с сообщениями о нехватке видеопамяти.
Разработчик также обсуждал возможное добавление трассировки отражений и поддержку Vulkan. В Digital Foundry считают, что модификации ещё есть куда развиваться: сейчас это скорее любопытный эксперимент, чем обязательное дополнение для всех игроков.

1chv41x.title: Atmospheric organic nitrogen emerges as a major nutrient source for global oceans
1chv41x.byline: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology
1chv41x.content:
Using cross-latitudinal marine aerosol samples, together with novel measurement and modeling approaches, the study reveals that 12.8 million tonnes of organic nitrogen are deposited from the atmosphere to the global oceans annually, accounting for approximately 27% of total nitrogen deposition. Credit: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

A research team has quantified an important component of the global nitrogen cycle.

The study reveals that 12.8 million tonnes of organic nitrogen (ON) are deposited from the atmosphere into the global oceans annually, constituting approximately 27% of total nitrogen deposition. In nitrogen-limited waters such as the central Atlantic Ocean and the Indonesian seas, ON contributes around half of total nitrogen deposition. These new findings reshape the understanding of marine nutrient supply and its impacts on ocean ecosystems and climate.
The paper, titled "Atmospheric Organic Nitrogen is a Major Nutrient Source to Global Oceans," is published in the journal Science. The researchers were co-led by Yu Jianzhen, chair professor in the Department of Chemistry and the Division of Environment and Sustainability at The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (HKUST), and Fu Tzung-May, professor in the School of Environmental Science and Engineering at the Southern University of Science and Technology (SUSTech).
Airborne nitrogen deposited into the oceans supports marine life, yet the contribution of ON to this flux has remained unclear due to its chemical complexity and long-standing measurement challenges.
To address this knowledge gap, the research team, in collaboration with researchers from Nanjing University of Information Science and Technology, East China Normal University, Ocean University of China, South China University of Technology and HKUST (Guangzhou), combined an innovative atmospheric ON measurement method with extensive open-ocean and polar marine observations and a global atmospheric chemistry model to quantify ON deposition.
Yu stated, "Our study demonstrates that atmospheric ON is far from a minor player in marine ecosystems. Rather, it is a vital nutrient source for global oceans that has often been overlooked. Through an innovative measurement method, coupled with cross-disciplinary collaboration among researchers in atmospheric observations, atmospheric modeling, marine science and polar research, we were able to quantify this crucial biogeochemical link between the atmosphere and marine ecosystems."

Nitrogen measurements from 418 marine aerosol samples collected during 21 research cruises: concentrations of (A) ON, (B) ammonium N (NH₄⁺-N) and (C) nitrate N (NO₃⁻-N); and (D) the ON fraction of total nitrogen (TN = ON + IN). R1–R5 denote five marine atmospheric regions defined by aerosol ON concentrations and geographical location. Credit: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

Overcoming observational barriers across global waters
Traditional methods measure ON by subtracting inorganic nitrogen (IN) from total nitrogen—an error-prone and laborious approach that has left major gaps in global data sets. To address these gaps, the team previously developed a high-sensitivity analytical method capable of simultaneously measuring both aerosol ON and IN.
In the present study, the team applied this method to 418 marine aerosol samples from 21 research cruises, including multiple expeditions to the Arctic and Antarctic. The samples spanned a wide range of oceanic regions, from the tropical to the polar oceans, including the Arctic and Southern oceans, producing the most comprehensive ON data set to date.
The results revealed that aerosol ON concentrations varied by over three orders of magnitude, ranging from below 0.01 μg N m⁻³ over the remote Southern Ocean to above 10 μg N m⁻³ over the Yellow Sea along the western margin of the Pacific Ocean. On average, ON accounted for 30% of total aerosol nitrogen.

Observed versus modeled marine aerosol concentrations of (A) ON, (B) NH₄⁺-N, (C) NO₃⁻-N and (D) IN. R1–R5 correspond to the five marine atmospheric regions shown in Figure 3. Monthly model results for 2016–2023 were compared with observations for the corresponding months. Credit: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

Tracking global sources and closing a knowledge gap
The team used these extensive measurements to constrain a three-dimensional atmospheric chemistry model of ON, quantifying ON deposition into the global oceans at 12.8 million tonnes per year. The analysis identified the three largest sources of ON to the oceans as biomass-burning emissions (4.8 million tonnes annually), marine aerosol emissions (3.9 million tonnes annually) and imines produced chemically in the atmosphere (2.2 million tonnes annually). Together, nonmarine sources, such as wildfires and human activities, contribute 8.9 million tonnes of ON annually, representing 70% of total ON deposited into the oceans.
Fu explained, "These terrestrial sources act as an important external nutrient input that can stimulate open-ocean productivity, and changes in these emissions may affect marine nutrient dynamics."

Publication details
Xu Yu et al., Atmospheric organic nitrogen is a major nutrient source to global oceans, Science (2026). DOI: 10.1126/science.aeg4265

94d9so.title: Russian vessel hit by suspected Ukrainian drone at Libya’s Benghazi port
94d9so.content:
There was no immediate reaction from Russia, and no one has claimed responsibility for the suspected attack.A suspected sea drone attack has hit a Russian vessel in eastern Libya, causing an explosion and a brief fire, according to the North African country’s eastern-based government.Local sources told Al Jazeera late on Sunday that an unknown number of Libyan and Russian nationals were killed in the attack at dawn, adding that the ship was moored inside the civil sea port of Benghazi, close to a naval base.
Recommended Stories list of 4 itemslist 1 of 4Drone attacks kill four near Sudan’s capital, damage UN buildinglist 2 of 4Dozens drown as boat capsizes in Nigeria en route to funerallist 3 of 4Can we build a more ethical AI future?list 4 of 4Canada’s PM appears next to Trump impersonator at press dinnerend of listThe sources said the ship was carrying weapons, ammunition and drones in its cargo. Local sources quoted residents as saying that they saw three drones attack the vessel.Satellite imagery provider Vantor said imagery showed the vessel was the Merkury, a Russian Navy corvette, or small warship.Imagery taken on Sunday showed that most of the vessel ‌had capsized and sunk, with only its bow still visible above water. Smoke was also visible rising from part of the ship’s superstructure, with significant debris scattered along the pier.The Benghazi-based administration earlier said the vessel had docked to refuel and take on supplies under a cooperation agreement between Russia and Libya’s eastern government.A satellite image shows smoke rising from a fire after an explosion aboard a Russian ship docked at Benghazi port, Libya, November 22, 2026 [2026 Planet Labs PBC/Handout via Reuters]Late on Sunday, the AP news agency quoted unnamed sources as saying that several Ukrainian sea drones were launched at the ship from a base run by Ukrainian forces in western Libya.Also on Sunday evening, another sea drone hit a Malta-flagged commercial vessel off the port of Benghazi in a separate attack. The Benghazi-administration’s Health Ministry said all crew members “who were injured when a merchant vessel was targeted this evening by explosives-laden sea drones off the coast of Benghazi” had been rescued and were receiving treatment.No further details were given. The Almasar satellite television channel said that naval and air forces destroyed at least 12 other sea drones off the Mediterranean city.‘Exporting international conflicts’The Benghazi-based administration said it had launched a joint investigation with Russia to “uncover the circumstances of the attack, its source, and the party behind it”.The government said the fire had been brought under control and the site secured, while it condemned the suspected strike as a violation of Libya’s sovereignty and a threat to maritime safety.“The Libyan government will not allow Libyan ports, territory or territorial waters to be turned into an arena for settling scores or exporting international conflicts,” it said, adding that Libya was “not a party to the Russian-Ukrainian war”.Since Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022, Ukrainian forces have repeatedly used naval drones and missiles to target Russian warships and naval facilities in the Black Sea.On Saturday, a drone struck a Russian cargo ship in the eastern Baltic Sea near Finnish waters. Finland’s border guard attributed the strike to Ukraine.A Russian liquefied natural gas carrier sank off the Libyan coast in March after an attack that Russian President Vladimir Putin blamed on Ukraine, while last December, Ukraine said it had used aerial drones to strike a Russian-linked oil tanker in the Mediterranean.Libya has been divided since a NATO-backed uprising toppled longtime leader Muammar Gaddafi, who was later killed, in 2011.A United Nations-recognised government is based in Tripoli and a rival administration is in the east. The oil-rich nation remains a focal point for a long-running rivalry between Russia and the West.(Al Jazeera)

11za2ay.title: Tom Jackson Dies: Broncos Alum & ESPN Hall Of Fame Broadcaster Was 75
11za2ay.content:
Tom Jackson, a former Denver Broncos player and an NFL analyst for ESPN, has died. He was 75.

Jackson’s family told ESPN that he passed on Friday, in what his longtime co-host Chris Berman called an “unexpected” death, having previously spoken “at length” with Jackson on Tuesday.

“He was a vital 75,” said Berman on ESPN‘s Sunday NFL Countdown. “Tom was poignant. He was active. This is a shock.”

Berman added in a statement released by ESPN, “All of us are stunned. I’m stunned, we’re stunned and you’re stunned. We’ve lost one of the best human beings ever to walk the planet, Tom Jackson.

“I was fortunate to work side by side with Tom for 30 years, primarily on NFL Primetime and Sunday NFL Countdown,” he added. “It was a labor of love for our whole team, both in front of the camera and behind it. We always hoped our viewers enjoyed the shows as much as we did bringing it to them every week.”

RELATED: ‘Madden’ Sparks Backlash From Raiders Owner Mark Davis Over Father Al Davis’ Portrayal: “That Hurts”

In honor of the Broncos “Orange Crush Defense” linebacker, the entire Countdown crew wore orange ties during Sunday’s show.

Born April 4, 1951 in Cleveland, Ohio, Thomas Louie Jackson was recruited by University of Louisville head coach Lee Corso, playing college football for three seasons from 1970-72, during which he was a two-time Missouri Valley Conference player of the year.

RELATED: NFL 2026 Schedule With Time, Dates & Where To Watch & Livestream All Football Games

During the 1973 NFL Draft, Jackson was selected 88th overall by the Broncos, where he played a 14-year career as linebacker, helping lead the team to play Super Bowl XII and Super Bowl XXI.

Jackson went on to work for ESPN Studios in 1987, paired with Berman on Sunday NFL Countdown and NFL Primetime. His years of broadcasting experience as an NFL analyst earned him the 2015 Pete Rozelle Radio-Television Award from the Pro Football Hall of Fame.

2fvetj.title: Стало відомо, чого Польща очікує від зустрічі НАТО після вторгнення російських ракет
2fvetj.content: НАТО має посилити протиповітряну оборону Польщі та східного флангу після вторгнення російських ракет у повітряний простір країни.Про це сказав у ефірі Polsat News заступник міністра оборони Павел Залевський перед вильотом до Брюсселя, передає "Європейська правда".Політик представлятиме Польщу на засіданні Північноатлантичної ради у понеділок.За його словами, Польща не має наміру подавати пропозицію про застосування 4-ї статті НАТО, яка передбачає спільні консультації держав-членів, коли, на думку будь-якої з них, її територіальна цілісність, політична незалежність або безпека перебувають під загрозою."Немає потреби застосовувати цю четверту статтю. Ми саме в рамках Північноатлантичної ради хочемо обговорити те, що сталося. Ми хочемо представити військові подробиці подій п’ятниці", – пояснив політик.Північноатлантична Рада – найважливіший орган прийняття рішень НАТО. До її складу входять представники всіх держав-членів Альянсу (зазвичай це посли при НАТО, але за потреби також міністри закордонних справ, оборони або глави держав і урядів)."Ми хочемо представити нашу політичну інтерпретацію цих подій, а також викласти пропозицію щодо того, як НАТО має посилити дії на східному фланзі та як має зміцнити протиповітряну оборону Польщі та східного флангу", – додав заступник міністра оборони."НАТО має посилити протиповітряну оборону Польщі та східного флангу. Це головна мета, заради якої ми попросили скликати цю раду", – наголосив він.На запитання про те, яке посилення може бути запропоновано в Польщі, заступник міністра згадав нещодавні слова міністра оборони Владислава Косіняка-Камиша." Ми говоримо тут про літаки AWACS (літаки раннього попередження – ред.), ми говоримо тут також про дуже серйозні авіаційні можливості, але не тільки про це. Про деталі, крім тих, які представив прем’єр-міністр Косіняк-Камиш, я наразі не хочу говорити", – пояснив Залевський.Він, однак, визнав, що необхідно переглянути чинні норми щодо дій бойових літаків. Йдеться про те, щоб пілоти НАТО могли швидше приймати рішення про збиття небезпечних об’єктів.Як повідомлялося, 20 листопада на тлі інциденту з порушенням повітряного простору Польщі уламки невідомих об’єктів виявили в трьох місцях в Люблінському і Підкарпатському воєводствах.За даними воєводи Підкарпатського воєводства Терези Кубас-Хул, 20 листопада під час російських ударів по Україні до Польщі залетіла одна крилата ракета та два реактивні дрони, хоча раніше посадовці повідомляли про падіння двох ракет та одного безпілотника.Згодом стало відомо, що пілот шведського винищувача Gripen, який патрулював небо над Польщею під час порушень повітряного простору у п’ятницю, отримав дозвіл на збиття російської ракети, але не зміг цього зробити через складні погодні умови.Підписуйся на "Європейську правду"!Якщо ви помітили помилку, виділіть необхідний текст і натисніть Ctrl + Enter, щоб повідомити про це редакцію.

22213s.title: Russia Starts Towing Ship Hit by Drones in Baltic, Finland Says
22213s.content:
Nov. 22, 2026

Finnish Border Guard

A Russian rescue vessel on Sunday began towing a Russian-owned cargo ship that was struck by drones in the Baltic Sea out of Finnish waters after two days of firefighting, Finland's coast guard said.
The Finnish military has said the strike on the Sparta II on Saturday was likely carried out by Ukraine and that the vessel later drifted into Finnish waters.
The 16 crew members were evacuated onto a nearby Russian ship. One crew member was slightly injured.
"Thermal cameras show that some containers are warm, but the vessel is stable enough for towing to begin," Finland's coast guard said in a statement. It said that responsibility for the rescue will transfer to Russia once the ship leaves Finnish waters.
Pictures and video released earlier by the Finnish coast guard showed several vessels spraying the Sparta II with water cannons during the night in a bid to put out the flames and cool down containers stacked on its deck.

In a rare instance of cross-border collaboration, out of the seven vessels helping to fight the fire, two were Russian, two were Estonian and the rest were Finnish. Preparations were also underway to make it possible for Russian vessels to tug the Sparta II away.
Estonia and Finland are members of NATO and steadfast supporters of Ukraine and often at odds with Moscow on other issues. Finland shut all of its land border crossings with Russia in 2023. Estonia will shut its own from Dec. 1, for six months, on security grounds.
Bound for Kaliningrad
The ship, bound for the Russian exclave Kaliningrad, was damaged in international waters west of Russia's Gogland island, Finland's Defense Forces have said, corroborating an account by Russian officials.

"Smoke is still coming from the vessel, and there is clearly still heat on board," Jukka-Pekka Lumilahti, Sea Safety Officer and Commander of the Maritime Rescue Sub-Centre in Helsinki for the Finnish Border Guard, told a press conference on Sunday.
New drone attacks possible 
Kyiv has sent waves of military drones towards the Leningrad region on Russia's northwest coast this year, including some that strayed into the airspace of nearby Baltic countries, leading to fears that the war was spilling onto NATO territory.
The risk of further attacks in the Gulf of Finland, a narrow arm of the Baltic Sea, cannot be ruled out, Estonian Navy Commander Ivo Vark told public broadcaster ERR on Sunday.
Finland's military said last week it had detected a strike on a Russian warship in the same area during Ukrainian drone attacks.
The Sparta II is a 121-meter Russian-flagged cargo vessel owned by Russian shipping company Oboronlogistika that left St. Petersburg on Friday, according to LSEG data.

Oboronlogistika provides logistics services for the Russian Defense Ministry, according to the company's website.
The vessel is subject to U.S. sanctions, according to the U.S. Treasury Department.
Lumilahti said one concern was the weather, with rain, sleet, and stronger winds expected on Sunday night and Monday.

112ljva.title: Путин согласен на гарантии безопасности Украине по образцу пятой статьи устава НАТО, пишет WP
112ljva.content:
Президент РФ Владимир Путин в частном порядке согласился, чтобы США и европейские страны предоставили Украине гарантии безопасности по образцу статьи 5 Североатлантического договора. Об этом в воскресенье, 22 ноября, сообщил колумнист американской газеты The Washington Post Дэвид Игнатиус со ссылкой на источник, близкий к переговорам. При этом Путин выдвинул условие, что войска НАТО не должны размещаться на территории Украины.

Россия в рамках такого потенциального соглашения получит ослабление санкций, однако ограничения будут восстановлены, если Москва вновь сосредоточит войска для возможного вторжения, пишет WP. По информации издания, Вашингтон в обмен на отказ от размещения баз НАТО в Украине предложил Москве отвести свои силы от границы после прекращения огня. Если же российские войска вновь перейдут в наступление, силы альянса немедленно войдут на территорию Украины.

Собеседник журналистов также рассказал, что представители США и Европы обсуждали механизмы контроля за соблюдением Россией договоренностей и способы организации оперативной связи на случай нового кризиса. Российские власти пока не комментировали публикацию The Washington Post.

Разногласия США, РФ и Украины вокруг статьи 5 НАТО

19 ноября спецпредставитель президента США Дональд Трампа  Джаред Кушнер сообщил, что Вашингтону удалось добиться от Москвы согласия на предоставление Украине гарантий безопасности по модели статьи 5 Североатлантического договора. После этого замминистра иностранных дел России Сергей Рябков заявил, что в Кремле не согласятся ни на какие договоренности, предусматривающие фактическое или частичное членство Украины в НАТО. "Поиски какого-то, в кавычках, креативного решения в этой сфере - это неприемлемый для нас вариант", - подчеркнул российский дипломат.

Статья 5 Североатлантического договора гласит, что вооруженное нападение на одного члена НАТО должно рассматриваться как нападение на всех членов и приводит в действие обязательство каждого члена оказать ему помощь. Ранее президент Украины Владимир Зеленский выражал сомнение, что Киев и Вашингтон одинаково трактуют содержание этой статьи. По его словам, она предполагает присутствие на украинской территории определенных сил стран-партнеров.

g1gy4g.title: Interstellar solar sails hit a bizarre problem at 75% of light speed
g1gy4g.content:
Reaching another star will require spacecraft capable of traveling far faster than anything humanity has built so far. Conventional rockets powered by chemical fuel simply cannot achieve the enormous speeds needed to cross the distances between stars within a practical amount of time. One promising alternative is the solar sail, a vast, lightweight reflective surface that uses the momentum of light to propel a spacecraft through space.
Some proposed interstellar missions would take this concept even further by using powerful lasers to push sails to extraordinary speeds, potentially reaching a substantial fraction of the speed of light. However, new research suggests that this approach comes with an unexpected complication. At extreme speeds, some of the very light driving the spacecraft forward could begin acting against it.
In a recent paper available on arXiv, Chao Shen and Jiaze Li of the Harbin Institute of Technology investigate how light interacts with a rapidly accelerating solar sail. Their findings reveal a surprising source of resistance that emerges as the spacecraft approaches 75% of the speed of light.
How Light Can Push a Spacecraft Through Space
Although light has no mass, it carries momentum and can transfer that momentum to objects it strikes. This creates a tiny pushing force known as radiation pressure. Under ordinary conditions, the effect is extremely weak, but in the vacuum of space, a large reflective sail can gradually build up speed as light continues to strike its surface.
For spacecraft traveling between stars, powerful lasers could provide a much more concentrated source of light than the Sun. By directing an intense beam at a sail, engineers hope to accelerate extremely small probes to speeds that conventional propulsion systems cannot approach.
The researchers examined three ways that photons, the individual packets of energy that make up light, transfer momentum to a sail. These interactions are incident light (that raw momentum of the photons hitting the sail), specular reflection (momentum imparted when photons bounce perfectly off the sail), and diffuse scattering (momentum from photons that are absorbed by the sail then reemitted in random directions).

According to the study, these three contributions affect the sail's motion with different levels of efficiency. Incident light provides the strongest contribution in the researchers' breakdown, followed by specular reflection and then diffuse scattering.
A Strange Problem Emerges Near the Speed of Light
The situation becomes considerably more complicated once a solar sail reaches relativistic speeds, meaning speeds high enough that the effects predicted by Einstein's theory of relativity become important.
As the sail accelerates away from its laser source, it experiences an increasingly strong Doppler effect. This is the same basic phenomenon that changes the apparent pitch of a passing ambulance siren, except that light experiences a change in frequency rather than sound.
For the accelerating sail, the incoming laser light becomes progressively redshifted, meaning its frequency decreases from the sail's perspective. As a result, the light transfers momentum less effectively, reducing the thrust generated by all three contributions examined in the study.
In other words, the faster the spacecraft travels, the less effective its laser propulsion becomes. Even with a powerful beam continuously striking the sail, gaining additional speed becomes increasingly difficult.

Various concepts for interstellar exploration have been proposed over the years, including Breakthrough Starshot, which envisioned using powerful lasers to accelerate tiny spacecraft toward nearby stars. The new findings highlight another challenge that such ambitious missions would need to consider.
At 75% of Light Speed, Light Starts Working Against the Sail
The researchers identified an especially unusual effect once the sail reaches approximately 75% of the speed of light.
At this point, a phenomenon known as relativistic light aberration changes how the scattered light is distributed. Relativistic aberration describes how the apparent directions in which light travels are altered by motion at speeds approaching the speed of light.
From the viewpoint of an observer at rest on Earth, the diffusely scattered light becomes increasingly concentrated in the spacecraft's forward direction. Because emitting light carries momentum, the sail experiences a corresponding recoil in the opposite direction.
This means that diffuse scattering (admittedly the weakest of the three forces) begins producing drag rather than helping propel the spacecraft forward.
The result is a striking paradox: some of the light intended to accelerate an interstellar spacecraft actually begins resisting its motion.
Importantly, this does not mean the spacecraft suddenly stops accelerating or that its entire propulsion system begins pushing backward. The laser still generates a positive overall force, allowing the sail to continue gaining speed. However, the additional resistance reduces the efficiency of the system, making further acceleration more challenging.
Advanced Materials Could Help Overcome the Challenge
The study focuses specifically on the forces produced by light and does not attempt to model every obstacle a spacecraft would encounter during an interstellar journey.
For example, the researchers do not include resistance from interstellar gas and dust, which could become important at extreme velocities. They also leave out the thermal challenges associated with directing extremely powerful lasers at a thin sail. If the material absorbs too much energy, intense heating could damage or even melt it.
Another important simplification is that the calculations treat the sail as an idealized mirror. Real spacecraft would need materials capable of reflecting laser light efficiently while remaining lightweight, durable, and stable under extreme conditions.
Engineers are already exploring advanced metamaterials and photonic crystals that could help address these demands. These specially engineered materials can be designed to interact with particular wavelengths of light in ways that ordinary reflective surfaces cannot.
Intriguingly, such materials might even turn some of the relativistic effects identified in the research into an advantage. By carefully controlling how light scatters from the sail, future designs could potentially generate forces that automatically correct its orientation and position, helping it remain aligned with the laser beam throughout acceleration.
The Long Road to Interstellar Travel
Despite the promise of laser propulsion, humanity remains far from building and testing a complete solar sail system capable of reaching another star.
The physics becomes increasingly complicated over such enormous distances and at such extraordinary speeds. Additional effects, including the curvature of spacetime, would also need to be considered in a more complete description of an interstellar journey. These effects were simplified out of the new analysis.
Nevertheless, understanding how light behaves when it interacts with a spacecraft traveling at a significant fraction of light speed is an important part of making interstellar exploration possible.
If humanity eventually sends robotic probes to another star, success will depend on solving countless engineering and physics challenges. Knowing that light itself can become an unexpected source of resistance gives researchers one more piece of the puzzle, and potentially a better understanding of how to design spacecraft capable of making the journey.

gh-148203956.title: GitHub - ArnoAnsems/CatacombGL: CatacombGL is a source port with OpenGL graphics for Catacomb 3D (1991), The Catacomb Abyss (1992), The Catacomb Armageddon (1992) and The Catacomb Apocalypse (1993).
gh-148203956.content:
Introduction
CatacombGL is a source port of Catacomb 3D and the Catacomb Adventure series. These games were originally developed for MS-DOS. Catacomb 3D: The Descent was developed by Id Software in 1991. The Catacomb Adventure series was developed by Softdisk Publishing in 1992-1993 and consists of The Catacomb Abyss, The Catacomb Armageddon and The Catacomb Apocalypse. The original games visualized their 3D graphics in 16 colors and a 320x200 pixels view window. The main goal of the CatacombGL source port is to utilize OpenGL to improve the visual presentation of the Catacomb 3D games.
Main features:

Runs native on Windows 7/8/10/11 and Linux.
Hardware accelerated 3D rendering via OpenGL, supporting widescreen resolutions, a customizable field of view and an uncapped frame rate.
Player, projectile and monster movement with floating point precision.
Configurable mouse and keyboard controls.
Supports all four Catacomb 3D games as included in the Catacombs Pack from GOG.com.
Supports The Catacomb Abyss version 1.13 (shareware).

Current limitations as of version 0.5.7:

No support for game controllers.
No backwards compatibility with saved games from the original DOS game.

How to install
CatacombGL does not run standalone, but requires the original game data (levels, pictures, sounds, etc) to be present on the system. The Catacomb Abyss game data can be obtained legitimately and free-of-charge by downloading the 1.13 shareware version. Various websites offer the shareware version for download, see for example https://archive.org/details/TheCatacombAbyss. Alternatively, the game data can also be obtained by buying the Catacombs Pack from gog.com, see https://www.gog.com/game/catacombs_pack. The differences between the shareware and commercial versions are purely cosmetic. The Catacombs Pack is required in order to run Catacomb 3D (The Descent), The Catacomb Armageddon or The Catacomb Apocalypse.
The CatacombGL.exe (Windows) or CatacombGL.a (Linux) can be run from any location. When started, a selection screen with an overview of all the supported games is shown. In case the Catacombs Pack was installed via the GOG installer (Windows), the game data will be auto-detected. Otherwise, it is possible to manually browse to the folder which contains either the Catacombs Pack or the shareware version.
How to build on Linux
With the following steps, CatacombGL was built on Ubuntu 26.04 LTS:

sudo apt-get update
sudo apt-get install build-essential cmake cmake-data
sudo add-apt-repository universe
sudo apt-get install libsdl3-dev

Ccmake gui is optional (sudo apt-get install ccmake-curses-gui)

General Linux compilation instruction:
git clone https://github.com/ArnoAnsems/CatacombGL
cd CatacombGL
mkdir build
cd build
cmake ..
make -j3

With the following steps, CatacombGL was built on RaspberryPi:

sudo apt-get install git build-essential cmake-curses-gui libsdl3-dev
git clone "https://github.com/arnoansems/catacombgl"
ccmake
Configure and generate the build via the CMake GUI
make -j3

Controls
The keyboard and mouse controls for moving, shooting, etc. can be customized via the in-game menu. The following keys are reserved and cannot be customized:

ESC - open/close the menu
Function keys - various shortcuts, such as F3 for saving the game and F4 for restoring the game
Numerical keys - read scrolls
Backspace - cheat codes in Armageddon and Apocalypse
Tilde (~) - show log

Command line parameters

--descent Skips the game selection screen and starts Catacomb 3-D THe Descent.
--abyss Skips the game selection screen and starts Catacomb Abyss (registered version).
--armageddon Skips the game selection screen and starts Catacomb Armageddon.
--apocalypse Skips the game selection screen and starts Catacomb Apocalypse.
--abyss_sw13 Skips the game selection screen and starts Catacomb Abyss shareware v1.13
--ini Loads the ini file from the specified location.
--log Stores the log file into the specified location.

Additional notes

The original Catacomb 3D allowed the player to reconfigure movement and action keys, but CatacombGL ignores those settings. Instead, CatacombGL has its own keyboard/mouse configuration, which is shared across all four games.
High scores achieved in Catacomb 3D are not stored in the GOG folder, to avoid file access issues. Instead, CatacombGL stores the high scores in %appdata%\CatacombGL\CONFIG.C3D (Windows) or ~/.config/CatacombGL/CONFIG.C3D (Linux).
To aid in navigating through narrow corridors, CatacombGL allows the player to slide along walls in Catacomb 3D.
The automap can be opened via a configurable key, with the default being the 'O' key. The automap can be visualized in four different styles, which is configurable via the Video menu. The "original" style is based on the Catacomb 3D debug automap. Pressing the Ctrl key in the original style automap will cycle it through several different view modes, just like in the original Catacomb 3D. Only locations that were visited by the player are shown on the automap. The automap can also be opened via a cheat code, which is F10+O in Catacomb 3D and Abyss, or Backspace+O in Armageddon and Apocalypse. When this cheat code is used, then all locations are shown immediately.

License
CatacombGL is licensed under the GNU GPLv3 license. See gpl3.txt for details.
CatacombGL would not have been possible without reusing code that was generously made available by various other projects, namely:

Catacomb 3D, developed by Id Software. The source code was published by Flatrock Software under the GNU GPLv2 license, see gpl2.txt (https://github.com/CatacombGames/Catacomb3D).
The Catacomb Abyss, developed by Softdisk Publishing. The source code was published by Flatrock Software under the GNU GPLv2 license, see gpl2.txt (https://github.com/CatacombGames/CatacombAbyss).
The Catacomb Armageddon, developed by Softdisk Publishing. The source code was published by Flatrock Software under the GNU GPLv2 license, see gpl2.txt (https://github.com/CatacombGames/CatacombArmageddon).
The Catacomb Apocalypse, developed by Softdisk Publishing. The source code was published by Flatrock Software under the GNU GPLv2 license, see gpl2.txt (https://github.com/CatacombGames/CatacombApocalypse).
ReflectionHLE, developed by NY00123, released under the GPLv2 license, see gpl2.txt (https://github.com/ReflectionHLE/ReflectionHLE).
Nuked-OPL3-fast, developed by Tony Gies, based on the Nuked OPL3 emulator by Nuke.YKT, released under the LGPLv2.1 license, see lgpl2.1.txt (https://github.com/tgies/Nuked-OPL3-fast).
Simple DirectMedia Layer, developed by Sam Lantinga. See SDL3.txt for license details. (http://www.libsdl.org/)
GoogleTest, developed by the GoogleTest team. See GoogleTest.txt for license details. (https://github.com/google/googletest).

Tools
The following software tools have proven to be very helpful in the development of CatacombGL.

Microsoft Visual Studio 2019 (https://visualstudio.microsoft.com/downloads/)
Wolf3D Data Compiler, by Adam Biser (http://winwolf3d.dugtrio17.com).
Dr. Memory, Memory Debugger for Windows, Linux, and Mac (https://drmemory.org/)

Credits
CatacombGL is developed by Arno Ansems.
Special thanks goes to:

Id Software and Softdisk Publishing for developing the Catacomb 3D games.
Flatrock Software for releasing the source code of the Catacomb 3D games.
GOG.com and catacomb.games for providing a platform to obtain the Catacomb 3D games.
Roland Ansems for playtesting every level and reporting various bugs.
NY00123 for developing the ReflectionHLE source port. The part of ReflectionHLE that handles music and sound effects is reused in CatacombGL.
GoGoOtaku for porting CatacombGL to Linux and CMake.

8f2lqk.title: Delta Sets New Business Class Offerings With Collectible Missoni Kits, Wagyu Burgers and Blanton’s Bourbon on Board
8f2lqk.content:
If you purchase an independently reviewed product or service through a link on our website, The Hollywood Reporter may receive an affiliate commission.

Missoni pillows, a dark chocolate square and a pour of Blanton’s single-barrel bourbon isn’t just reserved for hotel turn-down service anymore — it’s also the new standard for Delta travelers flying in the airline’s Delta One cabin.

The U.S. airline unveiled its so-called “next era” of Delta One last month, with food and hospitality offerings that aim to position Delta as the “industry’s most premium end-to-end travel experience,” according to a release.

The new offerings include a reimagined Delta One menu, with a wagyu brioche burger among the highlights, along with a Hong Kong-style sea bass, Japanese grilled salmon and a “seasonally rotating” risotto dish, all served on new Delta-branded tableware. The airline is also touting its “fresh cracked pepper service,” with flight attendants coming by with a pepper grinder similar to top restaurants and steakhouses.

Delta

Dessert now includes the passenger-favorite ice cream cart, with the added option of a fruit sorbet paired with a splash of Taittinger Champagne. And the wines and spirits list has been fully updated with sommelier-approved bottles, including a Silver Oak Cabernet Sauvignon from Napa, which often retails for upwards of $200 in stores.

Travelers can now also request Blanton’s Single Barrel Bourbon on board, with the beloved Kentucky straight bourbon whiskey served in mini versions of its iconic decanter-style glass bottles with horse and jockey stopper. New Delta One flights to and from Tokyo-Haneda airport, meantime, will have a sake program designed by renowned sake brewer Dassai 45 from Japan’s Yamaguchi Prefecture. The menu on the U.S. to Japan flights will also feature regional cuisine designed in collaboration with Michelin-starred chef, Norio Ueno.

Delta

The most visible upgrades begin as Delta One customers arrive to their seats. While Delta’s next-generation Delta One suites will start rolling out next year, with longer lie-flat seats, larger TV screens and even a glasses hook, the current suites feature new amenity kits from Missoni along with a mini Missoni pillow and compression socks from Bombas. That’s in addition to the existing Missoni bedding and an over-the-seat mattress pad which adds about a quarter-inch of extra cushioning.

The amenity kits have already drawn comparisons to KLM’s keepsake Delft Blue ceramic houses as “in the know” collectibles for frequent fliers. Delta says it’s working with Missoni to release different prints each season, following the vein of the Italian fashion house’s runway collections each year (the Missoni-print pillow is not a take-home accessory unfortunately).

Delta

Delta says the new enhancements were “informed by two decades of customer insights” and part of the airline’s larger $1 billion investment into upgrading its fleet.

Stephanie Laster, Delta’s Managing Director of Onboard Experience, likens it to a “hotel and restaurant [experience] in the sky,” noting that a number of hours were spent perfecting even the tiniest details, like “getting the hot towel right with the temperature and moisture and consistency,” to selecting the “right whipped cream at altitude for our ice cream sundaes.”

The Delta One Wagyu burger, meantime, came from the success of the Delta One Burger in Delta One Lounges across the U.S., and from customers craving some “comfort food” in the air. And the Champagne Sorbet offers a lighter, dairy-free addition to the dessert cart. As for the Blanton’s offering: a Delta rep says whiskey is Delta’s top-consumed spirit category, and after doing customer research on various brands, Blanton’s was rated “most-premium” of all the bourbons surveyed.

Laster says non-drinkers will also have increased options, including new mocktail creations. And with flyers valuing flexibility more and more, Delta has rolled out a “Lighter Later” option, with the ability to pre-select meals that fit your diet (I.e. gluten-free dishes or protein-added salads) and even skip a full breakfast in favor of a to-go coffee and croissant, just before landing (all the better to get some extra shut eye).

Delta SkyMiles Gold American Express $0 intro annual fee for the first year, then $150 ▶ 80,000 bonus miles▶ 2x miles on dining and groceries▶ $200 Delta flight credit▶ Priority boarding and free checked bag

The new overhaul has launched on transoceanic Delta One routes departing from Los Angeles International Airport, and will expand across the full global network in 2027. As for what passengers in premium economy and economy can expect? Laster says the goal is to provide a “premium for all” experience when flying Delta, with the airline hoping to eventually unveil upgrades to the rear cabins as well.

“Luxury is about having the experience designed around you — today’s premium traveler values choice as much as quality,” says Kristen Manion Taylor, SVP – Brand Experience, in a release. “These enhancements offer greater flexibility, ensuring every Delta One customer can enjoy the journey in the way that suits them best.”
