1mb2e78.title: Мадьяр впервые в роли премьера Венгрии посетил Украину
1mb2e78.content:
Премьер-министр Венгрии Петер Мадьяр 24 ноября впервые на этой должности посетил Украину с официальным визитом и провел встречу с украинским президентом Владимиром Зеленским.

Политики возложили венки на кладбище в Ужгороде, где похоронены погибшие на войне в Украине  солдаты. По словам Мадьяра, там также покоится этнический венгр, погибший в начале полномасштабного вторжения РФ.

"Наша возможность жить в свободной стране, а также безопасность наших соседей и всей Европы обходятся огромной ценой - ценой, которую Украина платит каждый день. Наш долг - помнить всех, кто отдал жизнь в этой борьбе", - написал Зеленский в соцсети X.

Президент Украины также поблагодарил Мадьяра за то, что тот начал свой визит с "уважения к украинцам, которые защищали наше государство".

Совместные инфраструктурные проекты

Зеленский уточнил, что стороны уже достигли договоренностей в сферах политики, энергетики и инфраструктуры.

По словам украинского лидера, в ходе беседы обсуждались поставки газа и дизельного топлива в Украину, совместные проекты, включая прямое железнодорожное сообщение между двумя странами, а также разминирование территорий, передало агентство dpa. Для реализации договоренностей были созданы рабочие группы.

Венгерское меньшинство в Украине

За несколько дней до визита Петер Мадьяр говорил, что хочет обсудить с Киевом вопрос о соблюдении культурных прав венгерского меньшинства, проживающего в Украине. До начала войны число этих жителей составляло около 130 000, но, как сообщается, с тех пор сократилось.

Премьер Венгрии сообщил, что обратится к Зеленскому с просьбой ускорить сроки выполнения законодательства в отношении венгерского меньшинства и сделать это до конца этого года или в начале следующего.

Зеленский 23 ноября говорил, что встреча с Мадьяром важна как для двусторонних отношений, так и для вступления Украины в Европейский Союз. "Делаем все необходимое для открытия кластеров в переговорах о вступлении Украины в Евросоюз", - подчеркивал он.

Ранее, 12 октября Верховная рада приняла законопроект об обеспечении прав нацменьшинств и коренных народов на образование. Это стало одним из ключевых шагов для разблокирования Венгрией дальнейшего продвижения в вопросе переговоров о вступлении Украины в ЕС.

qze5r1.title: GTA 6: Full Vice City retro easter egg walkthrough, all rewards
qze5r1.content: Grand Theft Auto 6 is hiding a Vice City easter egg that will feel massive for those of us nostalgic for older GTA games.By completing a few – reasonably complex – tasks in a specific order, you can access a retro version of Vice City that feels straight out of the PS2. You’ll also earn Tommy Vercetti’s shirt and an exclusive Malibu motorcycle.This easter egg was brought to our attention by Memeio on X (formerly Twitter), and just might be the craziest secret in Grand Theft Auto 6. For everything you need to complete it, just follow the steps in this guide.Guides: If you're playing Grand Theft Auto 6, make sure to check out our complete walkthrough hub, featuring beginner tips, navigation experience explained, GTA 6 cheats, and more.Vice City retro easter egg explained – GTA 6Essentially, there are 12 substations run by LPL – Leonida Power and Light, the state’s electrical company – dotted around Leonida, and by first flicking a power switch in Key Lento, you give yourself the ability to enter a retro PS2 cheat code by going between each of the power substations.Each substation is marked with letters, and when put together, they spell out “Life Is Passing Me By”, which is the name of a famous Vice City cheat code. With that knowledge, we can enter that retro cheat code by visiting each substation in the correct order.Inside each substation, you’ll find several pressable buttons, with tape and a message next to them like “Press A” or “Press D”, etc. They are in reference to the original cheat code. Make sure to only press the correct button in each substation — we’ll list each button alongside each substation location below.It will be a lot of work to locate each substation and figure out the correct order by yourself, which is why we’re breaking down the information you need in the guide below. This is important to note: fast travelling using the RydeMe service or auto-driving with Jason or Lucia will break this easter egg, making it invalid. That’s a big catch, so be prepared for a lot of long, manual drives down familiar roads.How to start the Vice City easter egg – GTA 6Starting the easter egg is pretty simple. There’s a radio tower in Key Lento – the tallest tower in the area – with a switch in a room near the top. You’ll know you’re in the right place because of the “LPL” and “JoySystem” posters.First, flip the lever on the power box in the corner to ensure it is in the “on” position. The TV should display no signal, with a static image. Pressing a button on the switchboard to the left of the TV will begin to play a neon retro signal with the word “Malibu” on it. This is your signal that the easter egg is now active, and you can begin to visit the LPL substations.All LPL Substation locations and what to press – GTA 6Again, you’ll need to visit 12 different LPL electrical substations dotted around the map in a specific order, and pull a specific switch. Doing any of this out of order may result in you needing to restart the entire easter egg process. As mentioned above, you’ll also need to avoid using RydeMe fast travel or auto-driving to substations, as the easter egg will break, forcing you to restart.LPL employees will be in each substation, and they will call the cops if you trespass for too long. Getting arrested or wasted will almost certainly reset the easter egg, so don’t let that happen. The door leading to the switches will always be in a larger building on the substation grounds, and the door will be marked outside by the letters we describe below.L Substation location #1, Vice City, DowntownLetter: LButton: Press DThis is located in the heart of Vice City, below the large overhead intersection. At night, you’ll see the double doors on the large building lit up, with the letter “L” outside. “Press D” here before leaving.iF Substation location #2, Vice City, BalseroLetter: iFButton: Press DThe second substation is located within the Vice City limits, near the border with South Kelly County, next to a Ron Gas and Ron Stop’N’Snack. If you’re driving by at night, it’ll be hard to miss the illuminated “LPL” signs on the main building. “Press D” in here before heading to the next substation.Ei Substation location #3, Key LentoLetter: EiButton: Press •This one is located in Key Lento, North of Kenton’s scuba shop where he buys treasures you find. You’ll need to break into this one, which will set an alarm off, bringing the police. Quickly find the button marked “Press •” and flee to the fourth substation.S Substation location #4, Vice Beach, Washington Beach, Penmarch IsleLetter: SButton: Press AThis substation has a small building on the North side of Penmarch Isle marked with an S. Head inside, “Press A”, and then head on to the next substation.P Substation location #5, Vice City, CrosstownLetter: PButton: Press •This substation is technically in the Crosstown part of Vice City, in the Northern part which extends under the highway. It’s found Northeast of Tyrone.You’ll find the P on the side of this building. While there is a door you can enter to see a normal switch panel, none of the buttons will be pressable, and entering will cause an alarm that will summon the police. Skip all of that hassle — look for the P on the side of the building first. You’ll see three electrical boxes with levers attached, and each of these is marked with the usual “Press •” tape. Yes, you should “Press •” and move on before the police arrive.A Substation location #6, Kelly County, Port GellhornLetter: AButton: Press AYou’ll find the sixth substation two blocks to the North of Moses’ workshop in Port Gellhorn. The building with an A painted on it is in the South corner of the fenced-off substation, and it’s another outdoor lever. You’ll need to “Press A” here before moving on.Ss Substation location #7, Vice Dale County, HamletLetter: SsButton: Press ASubstation number seven is in Hamlet, on the Eastern edge of the town, behind the Big Shots gun store. You can see a single small building to the East of the substation. Inside, press the “Press A” button on the switchboard and leave.iN Substation location #8, Vice City, Gloriana KeyLetter: iNButton: Press AThe eighth substation, marked iN, is within a water treatment facility in Vice City’s Gloriana Key. To get in, you’ll need to drive through the fence and find the small electrical building on the Southeast side of the facility. Security and cops will be called pretty quickly, so get in, “Press A” on the electrical switchboard in the small building, and get out.G Substation location #9, Vice Dale County, HamletLetter: GButton: Press •The G substation is located on the West side of Hamlet, just North of the Boone Speedway. The G is on the front of the building, but this one has outdoor levers to flip, which you’ll find around the back. “Press •” and move on.Me Substation location #10, Kelly County, GellhornLetter: MeButton: Press WThe Me substation is just outside of the grounds of the Gellhorn Raceway, a touch Northwest of the Whisler Motorsport mod shop. It appears as an L-shaped building on the map, and you need to “Press W” using the outdoor levers.B Substation location #11, Vice Dale County, HamletLetter: BButton: Press DThe third and final substation you need to visit in Hamlet; this is on the Southern edge of town, west of Hamlet Thrift and Hamlet Pawn. This LPL substation is in a small walled-off area, and the lever is on the exterior of the building. “Press D” and continue to the final substation.Y Substation location #12, North Mariana CountyLetter: YButton: Press WWe’re finally onto the twelfth substation, and this one is located in North Mariana County, South of Breakwater Quarry. There are no real identifiable landmarks nearby, so search for the substation and the white building with a blue stripe, which are LPL’s trademark colors. The “Press W” outdoor lever is just below the Y.If you receive a text message from “Unknown,” you can now fast-travel and auto-drive again safely. If you do not receive a text message, you likely missed a step or messed something up. Return to the radio tower, and if the TV is off, you need to start again.T.H. Power Station Reactor 2 location, accessing the retro portal – GTA 6With the radio tower and 12 substations activated in the correct order – with no RydeMe or auto-drive – you will get a text message from “Unknown” which reads “U-235 REACTOR2 19-06”. This message is basically telling you to go to Reactor 2 between 7 PM and 6 AM — remember, the time can be checked on your phone’s home screen. Note that you must go to Reactor 2 with only a single protagonist — we are unsure if Lucia is eligible for the portal to open, but approaching as Jason solo definitely works.The T.H. Power Station (Turtle Head Power Station) can be found on an island East of Hamlet. Wait outside the station, where security won’t bother you, until 7 PM. At that time, infiltrate the power station – I recommend either grabbing a helicopter from the nearby helipad or jumping the fence to the rear East of the power station – and you’ll see electrical sparks jumping from Reactor 2.Approach the large door, flip the lever to the left of it, and you will finally have achieved the Vice City easter egg in Grand Theft Auto 6. Behind the bar in this retro easter egg, you’ll be able to meet Kent Paul, who is once again played by eccentric Eastender Danny Dyer.After returning to the “real world,” you’ll get a phone call from “Unknown,” and it’ll be Kent Paul, who has apparently been brought into Leonida with you and is enjoying himself.All Vice City easter egg rewards – GTA 6You’ll receive Tommy Vercetti’s iconic Hawaiian shirt and his motorcycle – the Malibu Zombie Bobber – as a reward, which you can register at a Pay ‘n’ Spray. Registering the motorcycle will rename it to just Zombie Bobber, but it’ll keep the iconic American flag design.

3ftfku.content:
Третий сезон сериала "Властелин колец: Кольца власти" от Amazon завершится 25 ноября 2026 года выходом двух финальных эпизодов. Впрочем, те, кто успел посмотреть седьмую серию в кинотеатрах, уже знают, чем все закончится. Перед тем как по экранам пойдут титры, Amazon объявила: поклонников ждет продолжение - шоу официально продлено на четвертый сезон.
Третий сезон "Колец власти" стал своего рода мягким перезапуском шоу. Он начался с временного скачка на пять лет, а повествование стало ближе к тому, что зрители могли знать по кинотрилогии Питера Джексона. Главная сюжетная линия сезона была посвящена попытке Саурона наконец выковать Кольцо Всевластья.
Шоураннеры и исполнительные продюсеры Дж. Д. Пейн и Патрик Маккей вернутся к работе над четвертым сезоном, приближаясь к завершению заявленного пятисезонного плана. Как сообщает Deadline, четвертый сезон уже находится на стадии препродакшена, а съемки начнутся весной на студии Shepperton в Великобритании. Несмотря на не самые выдающиеся рейтинги, Amazon, похоже, намерена продолжить рассказывать эту историю.

gh-1413279818.title: GitHub - pablocpas/OpenCMR2: Native SDL3 port of Colin McRae Rally 2.0 built from the CMR2Decomp decompilation. No game data included.
gh-1413279818.content:
OpenCMR2 is a work-in-progress native port of Colin McRae Rally 2.0 (PC, 2000)
to modern platforms, built on the CMR2Decomp
decompilation. It runs the original game code natively on Linux, Windows,
macOS and Android. There is no emulation and no Wine or DirectX wrapper: DirectDraw,
Direct3D 7, DirectSound, DirectInput, DirectPlay and Bink are replaced with
SDL3, the SDL GPU API (Vulkan, Direct3D 12, Metal) or OpenGL 3.3 and the
port's own code.

opencmr2-raw-20261102-123220-github.mp4

Colin McRae Rally 2.0 running on Linux with OpenCMR2.
WarningThis repository contains no game assets. You need your own copy of the
original PC version of Colin McRae Rally 2.0 to play.

Status
Everything tested so far works: the intro videos, the menus, the stages and
network races over LAN and the internet. The project is still in development, so you may find
bugs. If you do, please report them.
The game code follows CMR2Decomp, and its progress is brought into the port
as it is made.

Platform
Architecture
Status

Linux
x86-64
Plays stages and matches the original physics

Linux
i686
Plays stages, reference build with the original memory layout

Linux
ARM64
Builds and passes the tests, gameplay not yet tested

Windows
x86-64
Plays stages and matches the original physics (tested under Wine)

macOS
ARM64
Builds and passes the tests, gameplay not yet tested

Android
ARM64, x86-64
Plays stages with on-screen controls (Android 10 or later, Vulkan)

Other platforms
A friend's fork, OpenCMR2-3ds, runs
the game on the Nintendo 3DS, as a CIA or a Homebrew Launcher application,
with its own guide. It follows an October 2026 version of OpenCMR2 and is not
maintained here: the 3DS is a delicate target for this code. It is there for
anyone who wants to try it.
Other ports people have asked for, such as WebAssembly or the Xbox 360, are
not planned. Feel free to fork the project and make one.
Features

Native SDL3 platform layer for windowing, input, audio and files, with saves
and settings in the user directory
SDL GPU renderer (Vulkan, Direct3D 12, Metal) reproducing the Direct3D 7
fixed-function pipeline in shaders, and an OpenGL 3.3 renderer with the same
shaders for GPUs without Vulkan or Direct3D 12 (Linux and Windows)
Fullscreen on the desktop resolution or a resizable window, switched with
Alt+Enter
Keyboards, gamepads and wheels through SDL3, with every driving action
bindable to keys, buttons, triggers, sticks or pedals, gamepad rumble and
wheel force feedback, and on-screen controls on Android
Bink intro and country videos with a built-in decoder
Multiplayer over LAN and the internet using UDP instead of DirectPlay
Folder dialog on first launch to locate the game installation
Menus and in-race HUD scaled with the screen and kept at its edges on wide
screens, with configurable sizes
Text drawn from outlines, and the co-driver arrows, menu icons, flags and
arcade maps traced from the originals, so they stay sharp when enlarged
The whole stage drawn on wide screens, with the scenery fading into the
backdrop at the view distance instead of popping in
Fixes for some original bugs, such as German in the language menu loading
Spanish

The improvements of SilentPatch
are built in as well:

Widescreen resolutions up to the desktop resolution, with the correct
perspective instead of a stretched picture
Configurable field of view
High and variable frame rates without changing the game speed or the
physics, verified against the original game

Approach
The game code in game/ comes from CMR2Decomp and is kept as close to the
original as possible. Every change the port needs is marked with a PORT:
comment. The rest of the port (src/) implements the platform APIs the game
expects on top of SDL3.
Accuracy is tested against the original executable rather than assumed:

The fixed-point helpers are compared with the original x87 assembly
The startup math tables (16,896 entries) are compared with dumps from the
original game
500 vehicle updates of a Finland stage, driven by recorded input, are
compared field by field with the original game + SilentPatch at 30, 60,
120, 144 and 240 FPS and at a variable frame rate. All of them match bit
for bit (details).

Enhancements that change the original look, such as the outline text or the
scaled menus and HUD, can be turned off in the settings. Those that only
sharpen the original's images when they are enlarged are always on: at their
own size, the icons, flags and maps keep the original's pixels.
Running
Download the package for your platform from
Releases:

Platform
Package

Windows x64
OpenCMR2-Windows-x64.zip

Linux x86-64
OpenCMR2-Linux-x86_64.tar.gz

Linux ARM64
OpenCMR2-Linux-arm64.tar.gz

Linux 32-bit
OpenCMR2-Linux-i686.tar.gz

macOS (Apple silicon)
OpenCMR2-macOS-arm64.zip

Android
OpenCMR2-Android.apk

Extract it and run opencmr2. On first launch, choose the folder of your PC
installation. The installation itself, a folder inside it or a parent folder
all work. The location is checked and remembered, and the game files stay
where they are.
On Arch Linux and its derivatives, the community package
opencmr2-git, maintained by
sxdot, builds the latest source: yay -S opencmr2-git, paru -S opencmr2-git,
or makepkg -si in a folder with its PKGBUILD.
If you have the CD or an ISO, install the game or extract it first: OpenCMR2
reads the installed folders Game, FrontEnd, Sounds, CountrySpecific
and SetupRep, and does not start when one of them is missing.
Keyboards, gamepads and wheels work in the menus and on the stages. Every
connected controller drives player 1, together with the keyboard; when two
players race, the second controller connected is player 2's, with the
numeric keypad. Controllers connected or disconnected while the game runs
are taken at once; losing the controller a player drives with pauses the
stage. A player switches between keys and an axis freely, for the steering
and for the pedals apart: keys, buttons and a D-pad steer progressively, as
the original's keyboard did, and the triggers and pedals stay analogue.
Without a physical keyboard, and always under Steam (Steam Deck Game Mode),
the on-screen keyboard opens only to type a name.
The default controls are the original's keys (cursor keys, Space for the
handbrake, ] and [ for the gears, C for the camera, R to look back,
Escape to pause) and, on a gamepad, the left stick to steer, the right and
left triggers for throttle and brake, A for the handbrake, the shoulder
buttons for the gears, Y for the camera, B to look back and Start to pause
and to resume.
A gamepad's stick turns the wheels at the car setup's steering speed, about
as fast as the keys do; followed directly, as the original did with any
joystick, the wheels would jump to the stick's angle in one physics step.
The stick reaches full lock before its end (the last 5% of its travel, as
many sticks stop short of it) and also when the thumb drifts up or down
while pushing to the side (its round gate is read as a square for this).
The faster the car, the more of the stick's travel goes to small angles, in
proportion to how often drivers use each angle at that speed (fitted on the
recorded runs of the super specials, driven with keys): from linear in slow
corners to a square at top speed. The end of its travel still gives full
lock at any speed.
Wheels steer with their first axis, followed directly, and their pedals are
found from where their axes rest: the first centred axis steers, the axes
resting at an end are pedals (of three, the first is taken for the clutch,
which the game has no use for). Pedals, a shifter or a handbrake connected
on their own neither steer nor move through the menus. Every axis counts
from where it rests, so a pedal or clutch resting at one end gives nothing,
and a device becomes the one used only when one of its inputs moves.
The force feedback and the rumble go to the controller the player steers
with, never to separate pedals.
Options > Controllers chooses the bindings to edit: player 1's keys,
player 2's keys, the gamepads' (while one is connected) or those of a
connected joystick or wheel. It opens on those of the device used last.
This only chooses what to edit: every connected controller drives player 1
unless two players race.
Configuration binds each driving action to the next key, button or axis
given (Escape gives up waiting for a controller's); an input already bound to
another action trades places with it, and a stick or wheel given for one
steering direction steers both ways. Delete, Backspace or a gamepad's west
button (X, Square) leaves the action under the cursor unbound. A bar under
each action shows what its inputs give, to try them. The page also sets a
controller's deadzone, steering curve and vibration, whether a joystick or
wheel is used and the player it belongs to, and the strength of a wheel's
force feedback (100% is the original's, up to 200%; changing it plays a
short sample on the wheel), and Default
restores the bindings of the device chosen. OK saves, Back drops the changes.
The bindings are kept in controls.ini in the user directory,
written with the defaults and an explanation on first launch: each action
lists the keys, buttons and axes bound to it, with a section for each
keyboard player, for gamepads, for other joysticks, and for each model of
wheel or joystick connected, which also sets its deadzone, its saturation,
a steering curve for finer corrections around the centre, the strength of a
gamepad's rumble and the player it belongs to. The keys of an older
Controller.rcf are taken when controls.ini does not exist yet.
Gamepads rumble on the stages, the one the player steers with: lightly on the high frequency motor with the
roughness of the surface under the front wheels, more with speed, and with
impacts on the low frequency one. Wheels and joysticks with force feedback get the game's
own forces. Both go to the controller the player steers with, so a wheel
does not turn by itself while a gamepad drives and separate pedals never
take them; before the player steers, a wheel with force feedback does.
A wheel without the spring the game centres it with (Logitech's on Linux
have only a constant force and an autocentre) gets it as its autocentre,
and a negative damping, which the original can ask for and a strong modern
wheel would follow by pushing itself along, is left out. A wheel's degrees
of rotation are set in its own driver, as for the original. The log lists
the effects each wheel has, and those it refused.
On Android, install the APK and copy the installation folder to the
device first. On first launch, choose it in the system's folder picker: the
game files are copied into the app once (about 700 MB), as Android gives
apps no direct access to other folders. The on-screen controls press the
default keyboard keys, so they work in the menus and on the stages whatever
the keyboard is bound to, and
hide while a gamepad is used, external or built into a handheld. Start pauses
the game. The launcher has a
Controls screen, usable by touch before starting the game, to test a pad and
correct individual buttons, sticks or triggers. These corrections are saved by
device and preserve the rest of SDL’s automatic layout and analog input.
Restore automatic mapping removes the corrections. You can also keep the
touch controls visible, turn off their vibration or choose to play with touch
controls only. Android Back
pauses the game; a controller’s Back/Select follows its SDL mapping.
Controller firmware must expose its input to Android; buttons intercepted by
system shortcuts cannot be mapped by the app.
The saves, settings and log are kept in the app's own storage. The launcher's
Saves and settings opens that folder in the system Files app, where it is
also listed as OpenCMR2, to back it up or bring saves from another device. Apps that
pick files or folders through the system can use it too. Android's own app
backup includes it, without the copied game files.
In the game's Options > Controllers the touch controls are listed with
nothing to change: they are set up in the launcher, and each button shows the
action it presses. They steer as keys do, with the car's progressive
steering. The keyboard players are listed only while a physical keyboard is
connected, and gamepads while one is.
The touch controls use one layout for the menus and the stages. The left group
has Left and Right, with Confirm and Back/Pause above them. The right group
puts brake and accelerate next to each other on the bottom row, with the
handbrake above and smaller gear and camera buttons around it; accelerate and
brake also move up and down through the menus.
In Controls > Edit touch controls, drag either half of the preview to move
its group, pinch to resize, or twist to rotate the auxiliary buttons.
Adjustments sets the size, position, auxiliary-button angle and opacity of
each side, plus camera cutout avoidance. Test buttons checks simultaneous
presses without starting the game. Save keeps the layout; Cancel
discards edits, including a reset. The editor uses the same RadialGamePad views
as the game, following the approach of
Lemuroid's control editor.
The Linux packages are built on Ubuntu 24.04 and need a distribution of
similar age or newer. The macOS package is not signed: after extracting it,
run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine OpenCMR2-macOS-arm64 once.
Command-line options:

Option
Description

--data <dir>
Use this game installation and skip the folder dialog

--user-dir <dir>
Keep saves, settings and logs in this directory

The installation can also be set with the OPENCMR2_DATA environment variable
or [paths] data in opencmr2.ini, or copied into a Data folder next to the
executable, which is found without asking.
Cheats
The original's cheat codes are typed as a driver's full name: create a new
driver profile, enter any initials, type the code as the name and confirm it.
The game accepts the code and returns to the profile menu without creating
the profile. Entering the code again turns it off.
greatnews unlocks the Expert difficulty and all eight arcade tracks on
Intermediate and Expert. Novice has three arcade tracks by design.
Configuration
Settings are stored in opencmr2.ini in the user directory
(~/.local/share/OpenCMR2/ on Linux,
%APPDATA%\OpenCMR2\ on Windows, the app's storage on Android, opened from
the launcher's Saves and settings; files from the older
OpenCMR2/OpenCMR2 folder are moved there).
It is created with comments on first launch. The Screen page of the
graphics options sets hud_scale, menu_scale, vsync and fullscreen in
the game.
The game's own options and cheats are kept in Configuration/GameInfo.rcf,
next to the profiles (pps) and saved games (gamesave) in the same folder.
They are read from the game data until the first save. Options, cheats and
profile changes are saved when the menu screen they were made in is left and
when the window is closed; changes made during a race are saved when it ends.
Every file is written to a temporary copy first, so a crash while saving
leaves the previous one.

Setting
Default
Description

[video] fullscreen
1
Fullscreen (1) or window (0), changed and saved by Alt+Enter

[video] fov
70
Field of view in degrees, 30 to 150 (70 is the original)

[video] run_in_background
0
Keep running when the window loses focus

[video] car_detail
1
Every car with the model and textures of the player's car (1), or the original's lower detail for the other cars (0); applies with Car Detail set to High

[video] hud_scale
100
Size of the in-race HUD in percent of the original's at the screen's height; 0 keeps the original's layout in pixels

[video] hud_aspect
16:9
Widest shape the HUD spreads over, centred on wider screens: an aspect ratio such as 16:9 or 21:9, or full for the whole screen

[video] menu_scale
100
Size of the menus in percent of the original's at the screen's height; 0 keeps the original's layout in pixels

[video] outline_fonts
1
Draw the text from outlines, sharp at any size (1), or from the original's bitmaps (0)

[video] vsync
1
Wait for the display's refresh (1) or draw frames as soon as they are ready (0)

[video] graphics_api
auto
Renderer: sdl_gpu (Vulkan, Direct3D 12, Metal), opengl (OpenGL 3.3, Linux and Windows), or auto for SDL GPU when the GPU has a Vulkan, Direct3D 12 or Metal driver (not a software one) and OpenGL otherwise

[video] window_scale
1
Size of the window in multiples of the game's resolution, applied when leaving fullscreen

[video] smooth_scaling
1
Smooth the picture when it is scaled to the window or screen (1), or keep sharp pixels (0)

[video] anisotropy
1
Anisotropic texture filtering, 2 to 16; 1 is off, as in the original

[video] stretch_movies
0
Stretch the movies over the whole window (1) instead of keeping their 4:3 proportions

[input] key_repeat_delay
750
Milliseconds before a key held in the menus repeats

[input] key_repeat_interval
100
Milliseconds between the repeats of a held key

[install] language
English
English, American, French, German, Italian, Spanish or Polish

[install] sku
EUROPE
Game edition: EUROPE, AMERICA, POLAND or JAPAN; when the data has no CountrySpecific folder for it and one for another edition, that one

[install] menu_shortcut
asked
Entry in the applications menu (Linux) or Start menu (Windows): 1 keeps it pointing at this copy, 0 removes it

[net] ...

Network play, see NETWORK.md

Building
OpenCMR2 builds with Clang, CMake 3.24+, Ninja and glslang, using the presets
in CMakePresets.json:

Preset
Target

linux
Linux, 64-bit (x86-64 or ARM64)

windows-x64
Windows x64 (clang++ with the MSVC runtime)

macos
macOS, Apple silicon

linux-x86
Linux, 32-bit x86 (reference build for the tests)

OpenCMR2 needs SDL 3.4 or later. An installed SDL3 of that version is used;
otherwise CMake downloads and builds it and places it next to the executable
(to force this, pass -DOPENCMR2_VENDORED_SDL=ON). Start by cloning the repository:
git clone https://github.com/pablocpas/OpenCMR2.git
cd OpenCMR2
Linux
Install the dependencies.
Fedora (SDL3-devel is used when it is 3.4 or later):
sudo dnf install clang cmake ninja-build glslang SDL3-devel
Ubuntu 24.04 or Debian, where SDL3 is built from source with these
development libraries:
sudo apt install clang cmake ninja-build glslang-tools pkg-config \
libx11-dev libxext-dev libxrandr-dev libxcursor-dev libxi-dev libxss-dev libxtst-dev \
libxkbcommon-dev libwayland-dev wayland-protocols libegl1-mesa-dev \
libasound2-dev libpulse-dev libudev-dev libdbus-1-dev
Then build:
cmake --preset linux
cmake --build --preset linux
The executable is build/linux/src/opencmr2.
macOS
brew install cmake ninja glslang sdl3
cmake --preset macos
cmake --build --preset macos
Metal needs MSL shaders, and the OpenGL renderer on Linux and Windows GLSL
330 ones, so the build fetches SPIRV-Cross to translate them (or uses
spirv-cross from the PATH). -DOPENCMR2_RENDERER_GL=OFF leaves the OpenGL
renderer out.
Windows
Install Visual Studio 2022 with its "C++ Clang tools" component (or LLVM),
Ninja and glslang. From an
"x64 Native Tools" command prompt:
cmake --preset windows-x64
cmake --build --preset windows-x64
clang-cl is not supported, as the build uses GNU-style options. To
cross-build from Linux with LLVM-MinGW, see WINDOWS.md.
Android
The Gradle project in android/ builds the same CMake project with the
Android NDK. It needs JDK 17 or later, the Android SDK (with ANDROID_HOME
set or sdk.dir in android/local.properties) and glslang on the PATH.
Gradle downloads SDL's source and fetches the NDK, CMake and SDK platform
when the SDK licences are accepted:
cd android
./gradlew assembleRelease
The APK is android/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk. It is
signed with the release key given by OPENCMR2_KEYSTORE,
OPENCMR2_KEYSTORE_PASSWORD, OPENCMR2_KEY_ALIAS and
OPENCMR2_KEY_PASSWORD (or the opencmr2.keystore Gradle properties), and
with the debug key otherwise.
Tests
ctest --preset linux
The 32-bit linux-x86 build keeps the or

bvcaq9.title: What is resilience? It may be less about bouncing back than we think
bvcaq9.content:
Credit: Unsplash/CC0 Public Domain

Resilience can sound empowering. Yet it can also become a responsibility, a socially imposed burden that people are expected to demonstrate when they are ill, aging or struggling.

We are often told to be resilient. Mental health guidance, the media and even governments encourage us to become more resilient, as though resilience is something that we can build up and draw upon when life becomes difficult.
But resilience is not a superpower possessed by a fortunate few, nor simply a predetermined psychological resource that people carry with them. Rather, it is constituted through the relationships, routines, past experiences and opportunities to adapt. We don't do it alone.
This matters because social conditions can make adapting to adversity easier or harder. Secure work, supportive relationships, accessible health care and financial resources can make it easier to cope. Insecurity, isolation, poor health and limited alternatives can constrain our capacity to adapt.
In our research, we followed people aged over 50 living with long COVID through three interviews conducted over 18 months. Their accounts take us beyond the popular idea of resilience as "bouncing back." Instead, they show resilience being continually negotiated through relationships, external resources and wider social circumstances, as people navigate what has changed, what remains possible and what future they can imagine.

Caroline, 52, worked as a care worker on a zero-hours contract while living with persistent fatigue and brain fog, with little room to slow down or stop. She said, without work, "I don't get any money." She described taking only "a couple of minutes' breather between each job" before carrying on.
She also felt pressure to appear as though she was coping: "I have to pretend that I'm all right, and then of course when I come home, it's when I'm not."
From a distance, this might look like resilience. But Caroline's determination to keep going was shaped by financial insecurity and limited alternatives. Her capacity to adapt cannot be separated from the conditions in which she was trying to do so.
When resilience becomes an individual responsibility, people may feel pressured to pretend they are coping rather than seek support. This expectation to be resilient can itself become another burden.
Long COVID made these pressures particularly visible for the participants in our study. Its fluctuating symptoms could make it difficult to know whether changing capacities reflected illness, aging or both. For people in their 50s and 60s, this could create a feeling of aging "too soon," while older participants sometimes faced assumptions that declining health was part of getting older.
Elizabeth, in her early 50s, described feeling trapped in a body that seemed much older than her age. Although others saw her as "back to normal," she continued to struggle. There was, she said, "a bit of a gap between how people perceive you and how you're feeling yourself." Eventually, she described having to "fake it to make it."

Her experience shows that resilience is not only shaped by material circumstances, but also by how other people understand us. Expectations about what someone of a particular age should be able to do can influence how they understand their own limitations.
Caroline and Elizabeth's experiences remind us that when resilience becomes an individual responsibility, it can lose its positive meaning.
These experiences challenge the idea that resilience is something innate we either have or lack. Instead, it is continually negotiated.
One way to imagine this is that resilience is less like armor and more like an immune system. Armor protects us by keeping adversity out. An immune system responds to what it encounters, interacting with its surrounding environment and continually adjusting. Similarly, social conditions make resilience possible.
Kenneth, 61, was depressed in his first interview with us after losing work and hobbies. By the second, he had started a full-time job with a local council.
"Getting out and meeting people is great and feeling useful is great," he said, linking his recovery closely to work and community participation: "If I was to draw a graph [of recovery and work], they would be very closely correlated."
Arnold, 73, told us he experienced brain fog, vision loss and cardiac symptoms from long COVID, alongside the effects of a stroke more than 10 years earlier. This left him reliant on his wife for many things. He described how he and his wife coped together: "We live for today."

Yet when his wife died during the study, this shared way of coping was disrupted. His world became much smaller. His focus increasingly centered on simply getting through each day.
Kenneth and Arnold's experiences show how resilience is not a fixed state, but something that can be strengthened, disrupted and reworked over time.
This matters beyond long COVID and aging. Life brings uncertainties that cannot always be overcome: ill health, bereavement, changing relationships and shifting ideas about the future. Resilience may involve renegotiating who we are and what a good life might look like as these changes unfold.
It can mean adapting. It can mean accepting help. It can mean relinquishing an earlier version of ourselves.
Telling people to "be resilient" can obscure the conditions that make coping possible, including secure work, supportive relationships, accessible health care and financial resources.
Our research shows that resilience is an ongoing, often fragile way of living with uncertainty.

Who's behind this story?

Lisa Lock

BA art history, MA material culture. Former museum editor, paramedic, and transplant coordinator. Editing for Science X since 2021.

Full profile →

Andrew Zinin

Master's in physics with research experience. Long-time science news enthusiast. Plays key role in Science X's editorial success.

l04aaj.title: ‘Grand Theft Auto VI’ Album’s Secret Weapon? The ‘Barbie’ Soundtrack Creator
l04aaj.content:
For the biggest game the studio has ever released, Grand Theft Auto VI developer Rockstar Games wanted an equally ambitious soundtrack. Like much of the entertainment business these days, they turned to Atlantic Records to help make that happen.

Over the past decade, the record label’s soundtrack efforts, spearheaded by Atlantic Music Group President Kevin Weaver, have established Atlantic as the de-facto landing spot for media companies looking to build a star-studded accompanying album for their work. Since 2015, Atlantic has handled the soundtracks for movies including Furious 7, Suicide Squad, Greatest Showman, F1, Twisters and most-famously Barbie, the latter of which became a cultural phenomenon alongside the film itself.

But the biggest opportunity Atlantic has seen to this point wasn’t a movie, but rather a video game.

“I went to Rockstar and said that they control the most culturally relevant IP on the planet, and that what they do with music is incredible,” Weaver told The Hollywood Reporter over the phone from Miami — where he’d spent much of last week attending launch events for the game — as he recalled the initial pitch to the company. “Music is such an endemic part of the game and what GTA is. Why don’t we endeavor to do something similar to what I’d done on Barbie and these other soundtracks and A&R a whole lot of new records?”

Weaver produced the soundtrack along with fellow Atlantic execs Joseph Khoury, Cody Verdecias, and Brandon Davis. GTA marked new territory for Weaver, the first time he’d taken on a video game soundtrack, which as he acknowledges, wasn’t on his purview before the game came into the fold.

“I’d never been interested in doing a video game soundtrack, to be honest with you,” Weaver says. “We license a lot of music to games, and I’ve had plenty of game companies come to me over the years, but if I’m not moving the needle and elevating the next thing I do, I’m not doing it. This was a natural choice, this was the one.”

Similar to the process with film soundtracks, early on, Rockstar showed Atlantic some key scenes from the game they wanted music for that were mostly set to temp tracks to help show the overall tone and feel they were looking for.

Among the first artists they reached out to, Weaver says, was Travis Scott, with some of the other earlier asks including Morgan Wallen and Dua Lipa. Scott, Weaver says, turned in the first song, with “Rhyno,” one of the soundtrack’s initial singles. Another Scott track, “Burn This Shit Down,” plays prominently during a key mission in chapter one.

The official soundtrack itself is just one aspect in the wider, rich musical world Rockstar has created for GTA VI. French electronic duo Justice, for example, provided the game’s score. GTA’s musical lifeblood, though, is the game’s radio stations, which feature hundreds of songs across two dozen channels, hosted by real-life celebrities like Robyn, Wallen, Bad Bunny, Keith Richards and Lana Del Rey among many more. Atlantic didn’t handle the radio stations, but Weaver says the company and Rockstar were “attached at the hip,” and some of those soundtrack offers came simultaneously with asks for the stars to host the radio shows.

Rockstar’s vision wasn’t set on any one genre, with the soundtrack spanning country, rock, hip-hop, blues, pop, electronic and latin among other genres. Just days into release, two of the game’s needle drops have gone viral, with the game breathing new life into Carly Rae Jepsen’s cult classic “When the Lights Go Out” and Dire Straits’ “Money For Nothing.” (Neither of those songs is on the official soundtrack, but they play in key missions in the game’s first two chapters.) Jepsen has already re-released her song, hoping to build off the momentum and finally land it on the Hot 100.

“Something Rockstar identified to us right away — this isn’t a rap game,” Weaver says. “It’s not a country game or dance music game. All of this music lives within the game in so many different facets, and that gives us a great opportunity to go out and create records across pretty much every genre we want. It’s GTA’s taste and tone that makes this work.”

The only real through-line, Weaver says, was capturing what he refers to as “the glitz and grime” of Vice City and Leonida, the game’s stand-ins for Miami and the broader Florida area.

While Atlantic’s more than used to handling a rollout for a film soundtrack, the strategy for video games is significantly different. While a movie’s lifespan in the immediate zeitgeist is typically a few weeks — pre-release marketing, the main theatrical window and post-theater streaming — a video game like GTA will hold a captive audience for years. GTA V had a dedicated audience for 13 years before the latest game finally came out last week.

“The tail on this never ends,” Weaver says. “Records are being discovered in the game in real time right now as the game is coming to market as it’s come to market in the last 24 hours, so we kind of have an opportunity to see which records really start to raise their hand as well.”

In the days since the game came out, Rockstar and Atlantic already surprise released a deluxe version of the soundtrack with 23 more songs atop the original 34, and today, they dropped four more songs from 100 gecs, Favored Nations, Joe Armon-Jones and Alex Frankel as iTunes exclusives.

As for any more musical plans going forward, Weaver says “the world’s just gonna have to wait and see.”

ki7jbf.title: США внесли сингапурскую Megaspeed в черный список после скандала вокруг Nvidia
ki7jbf.content:
Опрос

3DNews Технологии и рынок IT. Новости рынок IT США внесли сингапурскую Megaspeed в черн...

реклама

Новости Hardware

Самое интересное в обзорах

24.11.2026 [22:33], 

Министерство торговли США включило сингапурскую Megaspeed и ряд связанных с ней компаний в так называемый экспортный «черный список» — Entity List. Решение принято на фоне расследования возможной контрабанды ускорителей Nvidia в Китай и совпало с возвращением Дженсена Хуанга (Jensen Huang) на пост генерального директора американского производителя чипов.
Источник изображения: Megaspeed

Американские власти подозревают Megaspeed в содействии поставкам передовых ИИ-ускорителей китайским заказчикам в обход экспортных ограничений. Расследование деятельности сингапурского оператора центров обработки данных продолжается с 2024 года.
Согласно документу Бюро промышленности и безопасности (BIS) Министерства торговли США, ограничения затронули семь юридических лиц в Сингапуре, Малайзии и Таиланде. Помимо Megaspeed International и ее региональных структур, в перечень вошли Apex Enterprise Solutions, Swiftdata, MSFusion и Speedmatrix.

Теперь для поставок этим организациям продукции, подпадающей под американские правила экспортного контроля, потребуется специальная лицензия. При рассмотрении заявок будет действовать презумпция отказа. Ограничения распространяются не только на графические процессоры, но и на другие контролируемые товары и технологии американского происхождения.
Основанием для включения компаний в черный список американские власти назвали значительный риск перенаправления передового вычислительного оборудования неавторизованным конечным пользователям. В частности, следователи проверяют возможные поставки ускорителей Nvidia в Китай через инфраструктуру Megaspeed в Юго-Восточной Азии.
Еще в прошлом году деятельность Megaspeed вызвала вопросы у американских регуляторов. В ходе одной из проверок сотрудники Министерства торговли обнаружили в малайзийском дата-центре компании серверы, которые оставались упакованными в коробки вместо эксплуатации. Это усилило подозрения в том, что оборудование могло предназначаться для дальнейшей переправки другим заказчикам.
Ранее выяснилось, что представители Nvidia пытались получить информацию о расследовании Megaspeed. Компания утверждала, что собственная проверка не выявила незаконного перенаправления ускорителей в Китай. Однако в июне 2025 года Nvidia включила Megaspeed во внутренний перечень организаций, которым запрещены продажи оборудования.
Ситуация получила дополнительный резонанс после сообщений о внебрачной связи Хуанга с бывшей руководительницей Megaspeed Элис Хуан (Alice Huang). Американские спецслужбы подозревают ее в связях с китайской разведкой. При этом новое расследование показало, что ключевую роль в предполагаемой схеме поставок мог играть китайский предприниматель Ли Мин (Li Ming), принимавший управленческие решения в Megaspeed.
Включение Megaspeed в Entity List совпало по времени с восстановлением Хуанга в должности главы Nvidia 23 ноября. Президент США Дональд Трамп (Donald Trump) лично поддержал его возвращение и сообщил, что предоставил совету директоров заверения относительно отсутствия известной властям угрозы национальной безопасности со стороны руководителя компании.

Уголовное расследование в отношении Megaspeed остается в ведении Министерства юстиции США. Министерство торговли продолжит контролировать соблюдение экспортных ограничений. В начале декабря Хуангу также предстоит дать показания американским законодателям по вопросам поставок ИИ-ускорителей и соблюдения действующих запретов.

1g18qol.title: ‘Naughty’ vs ’Nasty Movie Titles Sparks Warner Bros, Universal Fight
1g18qol.content:
Two similarly titled movies are causing a war of words between Universal and Warner Bros. Pictures. The legacy studios are locked in a stalemate over dueling projects that sound alike and are set to hit theaters around the same time, five sources tell Variety.

The first is “Naughty,” Olivia Wilde’s raucous Christmas comedy starring Jennifer Aniston. The other is “Nasty,” Mary Bronstein’s psychological drama led by Jenna Ortega, which will roll out under Warner’s new indie label Clockwork. Universal slated “Naughty” for Nov. 5, 2027, after registering the name with the Motion Picture Association in 2023, according to two sources. Clockwork, the nascent shingle run by Neon veteran Christian Parkes, has not officially set a date for “Nasty,” though four sources say the film is also eyeing a November 2027 release.

Generally, studios go to great lengths to avoid delivering movies with similar-sounding names — much less launching them in the same corridor. “Naughty” and “Nasty” aren’t alike in genre or subject matter. “Naughty,” featuring Aniston and Peter Dinklage, follows a single mom who has to convince Santa Claus to testify at her divorce hearing. “Nasty,” Bronstein’s follow-up to “If I Had Legs I’d Kick You,” revolves around an elite gymnast competing for a spot on the Olympic team while dealing with her manipulative coach.

Yet insiders at Universal and Warner Bros. feel the fact that the titles are basically synonyms could confuse moviegoers. Further complicating the matter is that LuckyChap, Margot Robbie’s prolific film and TV production shop, is backing both projects. Universal and Clockwork declined to comment.

The spat is headed toward a formal review by the MPA, which has a 101-year-old department called the Title Registration Bureau to manage such conflicts. Arbitration involves a panel of studio intellectual property lawyers at the ready to hash it out. Although titles are not copyrightable, the TRB is armed with a 50-page document outlining rules of play and precedent, per one source, and its rulings are legally binding. The MPA declined to comment on the matter.

“Movies want to distinguish themselves, and the first way they do that is the title,” says Jeff Bock, an analyst with Exhibitor Relations. “If they sound similar, there could be confusion.”

Universal believes it should have dibs since it was first to file with “Naughty.” That would mean “Nasty” either changes its name or shifts its release date. Insiders note Clockwork filed two alternative titles for “Nasty” with its MPA documentation, but the filmmakers are against using the backups.

Meanwhile, sources close to “Nasty” feel that Universal is “punching down” at Clockwork because the indie drama doesn’t have the same broad commercial appeal as the Aniston-led holiday comedy. (Though Clockwork is a specialty label, it is owned and operated by the vast Skydance Motion Picture Group). Wilde is content to let “Nasty” proceed as titled, according to a person familiar with her thinking. LuckyChap is working toward a solution that sets up both projects for success without entering MPA arbitration, two sources add.

Disputes like these rarely become public knowledge, insiders say. And most often, studios work it out without involving the Title Registration Bureau. The group’s last two arbitrations were in 2018. That’s when Disney and Lucasfilm settled on “Solo: A Star Wars Story” rather than “Solo” to distinguish the Han Solo origin story from the 2018 climbing documentary “Free Solo.” And Universal agreed to change its raunchy comedy to “Blockers” from “The Pact,” a name that was already used by a 2012 horror film.

Renaming movies can benefit both parties. Ask Paramount and Sony, which released “No Strings Attached” and “Friends With Benefits” a few months apart in 2011. Both romantic comedies — one starring Natalie Portman and Ashton Kutcher and the other with Mila Kunis and Justin Timberlake — had an identical premise involving two friends who agree to casual sex without dating. “No Strings Attached” was originally called “Friends With Benefits,” but the studio acquiesced to the title change. Any plot similarities didn’t dilute the films’ respective box office, with each one grossing $149 million globally.

To that end, movies with similar themes or ideas are less of a problem for studios. Bock points to 1998’s “Armageddon” and “Deep Impact,” two disaster films about comets on a collision course with Earth. Both were theatrical winners, with “Armageddon” earning $553 million globally and “Deep Impact” generating $350 million globally.

“Consumers might be fooled by something like that, but it didn’t affect the box office,” he says. “They turned out to be different, even though the synopsis was the same.”

8afeqg.title: Во Франции предложили запустить государственный магазин закрытых игр с комиссией выгоднее, чем в Steam
8afeqg.content:
Депутат Национального собрания Франции от 2-го округа департамента Нор Уго Берналисис в свежем интервью программе Play Smart на телеканале B SMART раскрыл детали инициативы по созданию государственного цифрового магазина для закрытых игр. Идея была заложена в законопроекте № 3169, направленном на защиту прав пользователей, которые теряют доступ к купленным проектам после отключения серверов или удаления из каталогов.
Согласно концепции парламентария, публичная площадка должна гарантировать геймерам возможность запускать уже приобретенные копии, включая условно-бесплатные проекты с созданными аккаунтами, а также разрешать покупку снятых с продажи игр новым пользователям. Берналисис привел пример ситуации, когда игрок хочет присоединиться к другу, купившему старую игру 10 лет назад, и получает шанс легально приобрести ее на государственной платформе. При этом политик заявил, что такая площадка способна делиться выручкой с правообладателями на условиях более честных и выгодных, чем стандартная комиссия 70/30 в Steam.
Смысл удаления игры из магазина заключается в том, что студия или издатель решили получать с нее 0 евро. Никто ничего ни у кого не крадет - компании сами планировали больше не зарабатывать на этом проекте.- Уго Берналисис, депутат Национального собрания Франции
Изначально функции по хранению и распространению таких проектов в документе возлагались на "Национальную библиотеку Франции" (BNF), которая уже занимается архивированием видеоигр для исследователей. Однако в ходе беседы с ведущим Николя Жюша депутат признал, что при нынешних ресурсах BNF не справится с поддержкой живых серверов для 10 или 20 игр-сервисов, не говоря о потоке до 30 000 релизов в год. Поэтому в идеальной модели BNF должна оставаться лишь доверенным посредником, а сам магазин следует передать новому "Национальному центру видеоигр", выведя отрасль из-под ведения "Национального центра кино" (CNC).
Для финансирования работы площадки и поддержки разработчиков автор инициативы предложил ввести целевой налог внутри самой индустрии по замкнутой модели французского кинематографа. Берналисис указал, что при годовом обороте сектора в 6 млрд евро во Франции игровая отрасль перечисляет 0 евро сборов в CNC, хотя получает государственные налоговые льготы. Законопроект предусматривал ставку в 5.15%, а также расширение фонда помощи созданию игр в 10 или 15 раз.
Инициатива затронула и тему одиночных проектов с системой защиты DRM в сервисах вроде Steam, чтобы издатели не могли отрезать покупателей от уже оплаченного контента, а также обязательство открывать доступ к частным серверам после закрытия официальной инфраструктуры. Против этих мер резко выступил французский профсоюз издателей SELL. По словам депутата, в устных беседах представители бизнеса ведут себя дружелюбно, но в письменном отзыве парламенту ответили жестким отказом на уровне никогда в жизни, продвигая взамен лишь добровольные рекомендации вроде указания срока службы игр на маркировке PEGI.
В профильной парламентской комиссии статья 1 о праве игроков на сохранение доступа была одобрена, однако ключевую статью 2 о публичной платформе отклонили. В итоге Уго Берналисис сам призвал проголосовать против всего законопроекта, чтобы документ не застрял в усеченном виде из-за статьи 40 Конституции Франции, запрещающей депутатам увеличивать госрасходы поправками в зале заседаний.

3bgry5.title: Montel Williams Gets Candid About the State of Daytime TV: “The Talk Shows of My Era Became the Reality Shows of Today”
3bgry5.content:
Montel Williams is getting candid about the state of daytime talk show, saying viewers’ attention spans have changed a lot since he ended his own talker in 2008.

“It’s a sad commentary that we lost our attention span in the last 15 years,” he said in a conversation with We’re Out of Time podcast host Richard Taite, debuting Tuesday. “The talk shows that I did and the talk shows of that era were hourlong talk discussions. We don’t have the patience anymore to listen to a topic for an hour. I say the majority of people don’t.”

He said the format has morphed quite a bit since his show ended. (The Montel Williams Show ran from July 1991 to May 2008, spanning 17 seasons.)

“So the talk shows of my era became the reality shows of today,” he opined. “I’ll say that again, the talk shows of my era became the reality shows of today. We took the dysfunction that we put on display and turned those into individual shows of their own, to the point now that the talk that’s out there right now, what do they really even talk? Other than selling products and hawking a new movie or hawking a new record, what do they do? Is there any discussion that makes man better?”

Williams was quick to say he’s not criticizing anyone in particular, just nothing how times have changed.

“I’m not casting aspersion on my peers of the day,” he said. “But I am saying that at least back when we talked about issues, we talked about issues that changed the world, that I believe changed America. We were talking about AIDS before any news stations were going full reports on it. We were talking about civil unrest, we were talking about racism, we were talking about hate, we were talking about all those things that we didn’t even talk about it around the dinner table. We talked about it. Some of us did it in the salacious way. But at least they had a discussion.”

Williams added that the goal with his show was to educate people and put a spotlight on a topic that viewers perhaps hadn’t been introduced to or thought that much about. In other words, something that would “make you stop and think,” he said.

Does he think that kind of talk show would work today?

“It could, if it was formatted differently,” he says. “I think we can go an entire hour, but we have to go in that hour introducing every single piece of that topic, not just one piece, but we have to introduce it all and add to it information that people can take away.”

Taite likened that to scrolling on your phone, where you’re staying engaged by absorbing different information — and a lot of it — in a short time span.

“That’s right, and [keeping] you stimulated on the same topic instead of scrolling, or swiping up and down, instead of doing that and getting a different topic every single second, and that’s what they’re trying to do,” Williams replied. “They’re trying to give you something different every five or six minutes where they never really even solved the first five minutes. I say that every single topic out there can be broken into 20 different topics. Somebody needs to just program it that way.”

He added, “I think we may gravitate back to that as soon as we realize that we pushed attention span to a point where it’s no longer attention span.”

Watch the clip below.

The full episode of We’re Out of Time with Montel Williams and host Richard Taite premieres at noon PT on Tuesday on YouTube, Spotify and Apple Podcasts.

ff30hv.title: CD Projekt RED ожидает такой же технологический скачок между The Witcher 3 и The Witcher 4, как между GTA 5 и GTA 6
ff30hv.content:
CD Projekt RED рассчитывает совершить сопоставимый качественный и технологический рывок при переходе от The Witcher 3 к The Witcher 4, какой игроки увидели между Grand Theft Auto 5 и Grand Theft Auto 6. Об этом заявил со-гендиректор компании Михал Новаковски во время финансового отчёта за третий квартал 2026 года.
По его словам, разработчики прекрасно понимают, насколько сильно изменились игры Rockstar за прошедшие годы, и намерены добиться аналогичного результата со следующей частью «Ведьмака».
Прошло 11 лет. Мы работаем над The Witcher 4, чтобы сделать её значительно красивее и улучшить практически каждый аспект игры. Так что да, стоит ожидать гораздо более масштабного скачка между The Witcher 3 и The Witcher 4.
При этом успех GTA 6 никак не повлиял на амбиции CD Projekt RED в отношении The Witcher 4 и Cyberpunk 2. Более того, Новаковски назвал подобные проекты источником вдохновения для сотрудников студии, поскольку они показывают, насколько впечатляющие вещи можно реализовать в игровой индустрии.
Руководитель также подчеркнул, что обе игры не разрабатываются в рамках заранее установленного бюджета. По его словам, это проекты, движимые творческими амбициями, хотя финансовые ограничения, разумеется, никуда не исчезают.
Отдельно Новаковски рассказал о влиянии GTA 6 на аудиторию предыдущих игр студии. На PlayStation и Xbox вовлечённость игроков CD Projekt RED снизилась как минимум на 25% на фоне выхода новинки Rockstar. Однако на ПК никаких заметных изменений не произошло — GTA 6 пока не вышла на этой платформе.
В долгосрочной перспективе компания не ожидает существенного влияния GTA 6 на свои результаты за четвёртый квартал.
Наконец, Новаковски прокомментировал масштабную рекламную кампанию Rockstar. По его словам, важный урок заключается в необходимости выходить за пределы привычной игровой аудитории и привлекать внимание массового рынка. CD Projekt RED намерена учитывать этот подход в будущих кампаниях, но копировать маркетинговую стратегию Rockstar не собирается.
Напомним, The Witcher 4 ожидается в 2028 году, а Cyberpunk 2 пока находится на более ранней стадии разработки.

1geo7l5.title: Putin says retaliation ‘inevitable’ after Ukraine hit Russian oil plants
1geo7l5.content: Ukrainian attacks subsided after Trump’s mid-October declaration of an energy ceasefire, but picked up again later that month.Ukraine has continued its attacks on Russian oil refineries despite requests from US President Donald Trump to withhold them, Russian President Vladimir Putin has said while threatening retaliation.Putin made the threat on Tuesday, after Kyiv said it would stop striking Russian energy targets only when Moscow did the same.Recommended Stories list of 4 itemslist 1 of 4Why are Russian warships off Libya, and will Ukraine’s attack change that?list 2 of 4‘We’ll keep sinking Russian ships’: Ukraine challenges Putin’s global reachlist 3 of 4Could Russia-Ukraine war threaten Libya’s fragile reunification process?list 4 of 4After Libya, where will Ukraine strike Russia next?end of listUkrainian attacks subsided after Trump’s mid-October declaration of an energy ceasefire in the conflict that began with Russia’s full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. But they picked up again in late October.“We see that the Kyiv regime continues to attack our refining facilities, despite the US president’s appeal and direct request to refrain from such attacks. But the Kyiv authorities are ignoring this advice,” Putin told a meeting of government officials and senior oil executives in the Kremlin.“In this regard, I would like to stress that retaliatory measures on our part are inevitable.”He also told the meeting that he wanted additional security measures for energy facilities.According to estimates from two industry sources cited by the Reuters news agency, Ukrainian drone attacks have cut Russian oil refineries’ combined crude processing volumes by 45 percent since late October.Several Russian regions have introduced restrictions on retail sales of petrol and diesel following a renewed spate of Ukrainian attacks on oil refineries, according to local media and authorities.Putin said that while the situation on the domestic fuel market remained difficult, petrol prices have stabilised after they peaked in October.Conflict widening?Elsewhere, Poland on Tuesday accused Moscow of deliberately violating its airspace when a Russian surveillance drone briefly crossed the border.Reporting from Kyiv, Al Jazeera’s Abdelaziz Mujahid said the incursion “may also signal that the conflict and these confrontations are widening”.Moscow on Monday accused Estonia, a NATO and European Union member state, of a range of hostile actions “on the verge of triggering open war”, after Estonia announced the closure of their land border.In other incidents, Warsaw said three Russian Kh-101 missiles landed in Poland on Friday, and a Russian cargo ship with links to the military was hit by drones and caught fire in the Baltic Sea on Saturday in an attack claimed by Ukraine.On Sunday, Ukraine sank a Russian naval corvette in a Libyan port using maritime drones. Ukraine’s Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said the drone attack was a legitimate act of self-defence, following criticism from Libya’s internationally recognised government in Tripoli.Additionally, British security officials on Tuesday warned United Kingdom companies providing “material support” for Ukrainian armed forces to brace for Russian sabotage attempts.Civilian casualtiesMeanwhile, a Russian attack killed two people in the Ukrainian city of Zaporizhzhia overnight, Governor Mykhailo Semikin said on Tuesday.Forty people, including four children, were wounded in the assault, Semikin added. Images and a video on his Telegram account showed a damaged apartment building with its windows blown out and rubble on the ground.The Interfax news agency, citing Russia’s Defence Ministry, said on Tuesday that the Russian military hit drone control sites, Starlink satellite terminals and other military assets in Ukraine’s Sumy region, also killing a number of servicemen.

ydtqhm.title: DebunkBot can quash emerging conspiracy theories
ydtqhm.content:
Credit: Laila Milevski/Cornell University

Rumors immediately began circulating after Donald Trump, then a presidential candidate, survived an assassination attempt during an open-air rally on July 13, 2024. Some suspected the "deep state" was responsible, while others thought it was a false flag operation to get Trump reelected.

Within days, researchers from Cornell, the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and Carnegie Mellon University were inviting people to share their conspiracy beliefs with the DebunkBot—an artificial intelligence-powered chatbot instructed to counter misinformation. They wanted to know if the bot could disabuse people of their false beliefs even as conspiracy theories grew in real time.
The team found that 15% of people could be talked out of their conspiracy beliefs in the immediate aftermath of a crisis when very little information about it is known. The short conversation with DebunkBot even inoculated some people against conspiratorial thinking in response to future events.
The paper, "Reducing Belief in Conspiracy Theories as They Unfold Using Large Language Models," was published Nov. 23 in Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences.
"There's clear evidence that it is possible to use AI to debunk conspiracies about events immediately afterward by intervening in an evidence-based way," said co-author David Rand '04, professor in the Cornell SC Johnson College of Business, the College of Arts and Sciences (A&S) and the Cornell Ann S. Bowers College of Computing and Information Science.
"Whenever there's some new event that people are conspiratorial about, you could use this sort of approach to turn down the temperature in real time, before the belief sets in and crystallizes," said Thomas Costello, assistant professor at Carnegie Mellon University, first author on the new study and formerly a postdoctoral fellow with Rand.

Beyond well-established conspiracy theories
This research builds on a 2024 study, in which Costello, Rand and Gordon Pennycook, associate professor of psychology and Dorothy and Ariz Mehta Faculty Leadership Fellow in A&S, who is a co-author on the current work, reported that with established conspiracy theories—think UFOs, chemtrails or the Illuminati, where a lot of debunking information is available—their DebunkBot was surprisingly effective at talking someone out of their belief in the conspiracy.
The chatbot works by presenting a wealth of evidence to counter false claims in a way that is personalized to the user.
"For all these classic conspiracies, there's a lot of debunking information around, and the model is good at pulling it all together and showing people the relevant facts and evidence," Rand said.
But would DebunkBot work if little information was known?
Conversations outperformed fact sheets after crises
To find out, the researchers recruited a wide variety of people in the week following the July 2024 assassination attempt on Trump and asked them to describe any conspiracy beliefs they had about the event. They repeated the experiment after the September 2025 assassination of Charlie Kirk, an American political activist.
Participants were then randomly assigned to either have a short exchange with the bot about their specific belief, receive a fact sheet about the event or be in the control group and engage in an unrelated conversation with the bot (about whether cats or dogs are better).
After both crises, the DebunkBot successfully reduced participants' conspiracy beliefs—almost as effectively as it countered well-established conspiracies—and was about five to seven times more effective than a fact sheet.
In addition to presenting the available evidence, DebunkBot also reminded people that little was currently known and encouraged them to seek out information from trusted sources.

Lasting effects depend on initial engagement
Two months after the July assassination attempt on Trump, authorities arrested another gunman, this time outside Trump's golf course. In the wake of this event, researchers reached out to participants from the original Trump assassination attempt experiment and asked them to share any conspiracy beliefs about the latest attempt.
They found that people who had engaged with the DebunkBot in the first experiment were less likely than those in the control groups to hold conspiratorial beliefs about the second assassination attempt, suggesting that the debunking conversation had had lasting effects.
The researchers caution, however, that a person must first agree to interact with the DebunkBot for it to be effective.
"The challenge now isn't so much pulling people out of the rabbit hole. It's getting them to engage in the first place," Costello said.
Co-authors on the paper include Nathaniel Rabb and Michael Nicholas Stagnaro, both at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology.

Publication details
Thomas H. Costello et al., Reducing belief in conspiracy theories as they unfold using large language models, Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences (2026). DOI: 10.1073/pnas.2628011123
