xzbb8z.title: SXSW Heads To Egypt In Partnership With Youth-Focused UTH Festival
xzbb8z.content:
SXSW is headed to Egypt through a new partnership with the country’s burgeoning youth-focused UTH Festival, created by Egyptian entrepreneurs Omar El Aawar and Ahmed Ragy in 2024.

Under the agreement formalised at the third UTH Festival, this past weekend in Cairo, the event will serve as SXSW’s partner in Egypt, to connect Egyptian filmmakers, musicians, creators, founders and business leaders to engage with the Austin-based festival’s international network.

In a key element of the accord, an Egyptian delegation, curated and led by UTH, will attend SXSW in Austin, Texas in March 2027.

The delegation is expected to bring together representatives from Egypt’s film and music industries, the creator economy, entrepreneurship, investment and institutional sectors. The organisations also envisage a UTH-led programming session and a community gathering in Austin.

“SXSW was founded to help creative people connect, launch new ideas, and shape the future. We are excited to partner with the UTH Festival team, who share our vision to empower the next generation of compelling, visionary and diverse creative voices,” said Peter Lewis, Chief Commercial Officer at SXSW.

“We look forward to working closely with UTH in Egypt, and welcoming leaders from Egypt’s business, entertainment and creative industries to Austin next March.”

The announcement follows a programme at UTH Festival bringing SXSW and Egyptian industry figures together in Cairo. Peter Lewis, SXSW’s Chief Commercial Officer, is attending the festival, with plans for a conversation on the role of international creative festivals and a meeting with selected leaders from Egypt’s entertainment, music and business communities.

“Egypt has no shortage of creative talent. What we need are more opportunities for that talent to connect with the global industry. Our partnership with SXSW is about building that bridge, creating real opportunities for Egyptian filmmakers, musicians, creators and entrepreneurs to take their work beyond our borders,” said El Aawar.

The collaboration also outlines possible Egyptian participation in SXSW EDU and SXSW London in 2027, with programme formats to be developed by the parties. Looking further ahead, UTH’s ambition is to establish an Egypt House at SXSW, providing a gathering place for Egyptian talent, companies and institutional partners in Austin.

The UTH Festival was launched by El Aawar and Ahmed Ragy in 2024 under the banner of Youth Summit, and has continued to double its attendance every year. The third edition unfolded November 20 and 21 at the Grand Egyptian Museum, with the organisers aiming for some 10,000 attendees.

Trevor Noah headlined the event running under the theme of ‘Work in Progress’ and featuring talks across topics of Fashion & Design, Money, Creator Economy, Film & Music, Food, and Sports.

This year’s edition also hosted a short film competition in partnership with Solari, an independent creative production and cultural management company founded and led by CEO Sarah Bissada, attracting approximately 140 submissions from nine countries.

A jury featuring Egyptian writer and director Omar Hilal (Voy! Voy! Voy!); Emirati Maitha Alawadi (X, Charlie) and Egyptian actress Salma Abou Deif (Sheikh Jackson) awarded Egyptian director Abdelrahman Taha the top prize for 7,000 Years Of Color.

1o3lx3m.title: Brad Pitt, Angelina Jolie Settle Lawsuit That Aired Abuse Allegations
1o3lx3m.content:
Brad Pitt has settled his legal battle with ex-wife Angelina Jolie over the sale of her stake in the couple’s winery in France.

Pitt sued Jolie in 2022, accusing her of selling her 50% share in Château Miraval to a subsidiary of Stoli, the Russian spirits company, without Pitt’s approval. The litigation drew attention to Jolie’s allegation that Pitt abused her and the couple’s children on a private plane in 2016, precipitating the couple’s divorce.

“We have settled out of court in the best interests of our family and will not be commenting further,” representatives for Jolie and Pitt said in a statement on Wednesday. “Any comments in media stories attributed to ‘sources’ are in fact not coming from either of us, or anyone close to us.”

Terms of the agreement were not disclosed. Pitt has also sued Yuri Shefler, the Russian-born billionaire who owns the Stoli Group. That portion of the litigation is ongoing.

Pitt and Jolie bought the Miraval estate in 2008, and were married there in 2014. They invested tens of millions of dollars in the 1,300-acre property in order to turn Château Miraval into a profitable rosé brand.

Jolie filed for divorce in 2016, and the fate of the winery has been in dispute ever since. Pitt has argued that the company was his “passion,” that he poured his energies into making it a success, and that Jolie has forced him into an unworkable arrangement with Stoli, a competitor. In a cross-complaint filed in 2022, Jolie accused Pitt attempting to seize control from her and of “looting” it for other ventures.

“Pitt is an actor, not a winemaker. He deals in illusions, not dirt and grapes,” Jolie’s lawyers wrote. “While he no doubt visited the vineyards to admire the work of the French laborers who actually made the business successful, Pitt is no vigneron.”

According to her cross-complaint, Jolie initially planned to sell her half of the winery to Pitt. But in 2021, the deal fell apart. According to her, Pitt conditioned the buyout on her willingness to sign a non-disclosure agreement about the domestic abuse incident that led to their divorce.

The cross-complaint alleged that during a flight from France to the U.S., Pitt drunkenly grabbed her by the head and pushed her into a wall of the plane. The suit also claimed that Pitt lunged at one of the couple’s children, poured beer on Jolie and the children as they tried to sleep, and then refused to let the family leave the plane for 20 minutes after it landed.

Her complaint alleged that Pitt “sought to use Château Miraval as leverage to coerce Jolie into keeping quiet about Pitt’s behavior. This new demand essentially imposed a poison pill, all but ensuring that no deal could ever be reached.”

Rather than accept that condition, Jolie sold her stake to Stoli. She alleged that the couple had no agreement not to sell to a third party.

A judge denied Jolie’s demurrer in November 2024, finding that Pitt’s claims were adequately pled.

The parties have since been engaged in disputes over access to financial records and over jurisdictional issues. Pitt has accused Stoli and Shefler of attempting a “hostile takeover” of the wine business. In June, an appellate court revived Pitt’s case against them, finding that Shefler, a Swiss resident, can be sued in California.

17xcdtb.title: Constance Wang Denounces ‘The Altruists’ Portrayal As “Very Stereotypical” & “Racist”: “What Did We Expect?”
17xcdtb.content:
As Netflix‘s The Altruists recounts the downfall of FTX, one of the company’s executives had some thoughts about her portrayal and the show’s overall accuracy.

Constance Wang, the former FTX COO who is portrayed by Madison Hu, called the depiction “very stereotypical” and “racist” as she unpacked some of the apparent inaccuracies of the limited series from creator Graham Moore.

“People have asked whether Netflix consulted me. They didn’t,” Wang wrote on X. “One conversation would at least have saved Madison Hu, who plays me, the trouble of putting on a Chinese accent I don’t have. It feels very stereotypical, then again, it’s Netflix. What did we expect?”

Wang previously shared her critique of the show after watching the eight-episode series with some of her former colleagues at FTX and Alameda Research.

“We recognised so little beyond the names. My expectations were low, but I’m still surprised it’s this bad,” she started in another post. “In short, the story has nothing to do with what actually happened at FTX or Alameda.”

I finished watching The Altruists today with a few people who used to work at Alameda and FTX. We recognised so little beyond the names. My expectations were low, but I’m still surprised it’s this bad.In short, the story has nothing to do with what actually happened at FTX or… https://t.co/D8Nu4ZsXoq— Constance W 🌊 (@ConstanceWaing) November 23, 2026

Wang added that the “biggest stretch” of the companies’ origin story was turning it “into a story about Sam and Caroline’s relationship,” noting some discrepancies with the timeline.

The financier, who has since co-founded AI-crypto trading platform Pacifica, also found the depiction of Changpeng “CZ” Zhao, former CEO of Binance who played a role in FTX’s 2022 collapse, “particularly hard to watch.”

“FTX started in Hong Kong, and a lot of the people who built it were Asian,” she explained. “I found the stereotypes about Asians and Chinese culture racist.”?

“Even Sam and Caroline felt unfamiliar. Sam was one of the least emotionally expressive people I’ve ever met. His character seems drawn from Michael Lewis’s book and the way he came across in public after the bankruptcy. Caroline reads like someone tried to piece her together from her private blog. She wasn’t nearly that reckless, and she was never the one pushing to go all in. The idea that she was the mastermind behind everything made us laugh,” added Wang.

Wang noted, “Maybe you’ll enjoy The Altruists as a romantic comedy. For those of us who watched it together, it felt like someone else’s story with our names attached.”

The Altruists recounts Sam Bankman-Fried’s (Anthony Boyle) formation of FTX and Alameda Research, as well as his and co-CEO girlfriend Caroline Ellison’s (Julia Garner) role in FTX’s 2022 collapse, when it was found that Alameda used FTX company funds against the latter’s terms of service.

gh-1466693282.title: GitHub - rams95blue/rawdanger-recomp: Raw Danger! (PS2) as a native Windows game, built from your own discs: widescreen, high resolution, Enhanced Edition with Japanese voices, orbit camera, offline achievements.
gh-1466693282.content:
Raw Danger! (PS2, 2006) and Zettai Zetsumei Toshi 2, running natively on Windows.
Built from your own discs: the game's code is translated to C++ and compiled for your PC. No emulator, no game data included.

Quick start ·
Highlights ·
Full guide ·
Roadmap ·
How it works

Highlights

Enhanced Edition
Built from your four discs: the US game with the Japanese voices, faces, signs, logo and opening film, each switchable while you play. Its title reads ENHANCED EDITION with the build number.

Any resolution, any screen
Internal resolution 1x to 8x, widescreen, full screen, FSR 1, SMAA, sharpening, field of view 80 to 150 %.

The PS2 look, kept or cleaned
The game's own glow, tint and haze in one cheap GPU pass; ambient occlusion; a hero who looks wet when soaked; rain on the lens that follows the weather; cutscene bars from 100 % to none.

A modern camera
Mouse look in the follow and first-person views, an orbit camera that circles the hero, free tilt, a hero who turns the head where you look and breathes, shivers and leans, and an option to keep your camera where the game has a fixed one.

Achievements, offline
RetroAchievements' set of 83, checked on your PC: no account, no connection, badges and progress in the game.

Saves as folders
Every save is a plain folder next to the launcher: copy it, back it up, share it.

PC controls
Rebindable keys with key caps, the PC keys shown in the game's own texts, F-key shortcuts, fast forward.

Every patch is a switch
Widescreen, intro logos, filters, regional textures: in the launcher and live in the game (F3).

Quick start

Download the latest release and unzip it anywhere.
Run RawDangerPC.exe, point it at your disc images and press Build: LEGACY converts one disc as it is; MODERN builds the Enhanced Edition once it has found all four (US, Japanese and the two Japanese demos). The first build fetches the nine free build tools from their official pages (about 330 MB) and takes a few minutes.
Play. F1 opens the PC menu in the game, F3 the game's switches, F10 shows your keys.

You need: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit), a GPU with Vulkan or DirectX 12, and your own copies of the discs (Raw Danger! USA SLUS-21501; for the Enhanced Edition also Zettai Zetsumei Toshi 2, SLPS-25606, and its two demos).
Screenshots

Screenshots from your own build go here.

Full guide
A native Windows port of Raw Danger! (USA, SLUS-21501) and Zettai Zetsumei Toshi 2 (Japan, SLPS-25606), plus
both Japanese demos, made from your own discs with our fork of
ps2-native-recomp (engine\ps2-native-recomp, see
engine\FORK.md). No game data is included. You need your own discs.
Play (Windows)
Run RawDangerPC.exe. It has two tabs. MODERN (first, recommended) builds the Enhanced Edition: everything this
project adds, from your four discs. LEGACY converts one disc as it is, with a few options. Choose the build speed
(Light keeps the PC quick for other work, Balanced, Full is the fastest), build, then press Play or make a desktop shortcut.
The first build downloads the nine build tools from their official pages once (about 330 MB); already have them? Build
tools... lists them with their links and where they are found (docs/BUILD_TOOLS.md).

Games: US, JP, JP demo Type-A, JP demo Type-B, and the Enhanced Edition (built from the US disc, with the
Japanese voices from the JP disc; offered once all four discs are found). It starts as the US release (English voices, US
pictures, logo and film); its title screen reads ENHANCED EDITION with the build number by the logo, in the US logo's yellow
or the Japanese logo's white. To redraw those words: python tools/rd_title_art_source.py psd <TITLE.DAT> us|jp out.psd
makes a layered PSD at 8 times the size; after editing it, python tools/rd_title_art_source.py png edited.psd tools/title_art_us.png (or title_art_jp.png) cuts the words out of Photoshop's own picture (layer effects included),
and the next build uses them. The PSDs of the current words are in launcher\art\rawdanger-title-art.
Recomp options: every patch as an option, in the launcher and in the game (F1 -> Recomp options, or F3). They
switch while you play: widescreen, intro logos, the PS2 post-processing filter, and in the Enhanced Edition Japanese / English
voices, Japanese faces and hair and Japanese signs (the 151 textures the US release redrew, from the JP disc).
The Enhanced Edition has no build options: everything is in it and switched in the game.
Achievements (US, Japanese and Enhanced): offline, unlock pop-up with the badge in the game, list on F1 ->
Achievements (F4) and in the launcher, with your progress (unlocked, points, %). RetroAchievements' set (83) is kept in
achievements\ra\5616.json and checked on this PC: no account, no connection. It is made for the European and Japanese
programs; the US build and the Enhanced Edition use 5616.us.json, the same set moved to the US program's addresses
(rd.py ra-port). rd.py ra-logic writes what each one checks, in words. A newer set can be taken from PCSX2's RAIntegration
copy (launcher -> Achievements). Badges from the export in launcher\art\Raw Danger! - Achievement Icons: in colour once
unlocked, grey until then. Each achievement can be switched off (launcher list, or Enter on the in-game page).
In the game: F1 opens the menu (Resume, Quick save/load, Settings, Achievements, Language, Quit to desktop).
Settings has tabs (Tab / Q / E, L1 / R1 or the mouse): Display (internal resolution 1x-6x, 8x or auto, at once;
window size, full screen, widescreen, whole-number scaling, pause in the background, menu look), Picture (upscale
filter: raw pixels, soft, sharp or FSR 1; anti-aliasing: smooth edges or SMAA low to ultra; sharpen the picture (off,
low, medium, high; off by default: the picture is crisp by itself); text and menus; field of view (80 % to 150 % of the game's); the PS2 post-processing filter (the
game's own glow, tint and haze; on by default: now one GPU-friendly pass, as cheap as off, and without the blurry picture
it used to bring); cutscene black bars by opacity, 100 % (as the game draws them) down to 0 (removed: the picture fills the
screen); rain on the lens (on by default, as hard as it rains, in gusts, heavier when the camera looks up),
which follows the map's weather and stays under the HUD, the texts and the bars), Sound (master volume, reverb),
Controls (change keys with key caps, mouse look with speed and invert (since v0.7.9 the mouse turns the camera
itself: as far as it moved, no top speed; build the game again once to get it), the PC keys shown in the game's own texts
and in its menus' button pictures (v0.9.3) in place of the PlayStation symbols, Camera up/down (v0.9.0: ORBIT circles the hero at the same distance, PS2 tilts and
zooms as on the console) and Fixed cameras (OFF keeps your camera in the places that have a fixed one; ON by default) and Head follows camera (v0.9.4: the hero looks where the camera looks; on by default)), Game (the game's other switches, and the developers' map select). Every one of
these settings is also a row of the game's own Options screen (from the title and from the in-game menu's Options
tab), with the game's live options of recomp.ini: they sit in the game's list like its own lines (the same cursor,
Left / Right, help line; "< value >" for settings with more steps), and the list scrolls. The game goes on behind the
F1 menu (Settings -> Display -> Game runs behind this menu; off: it waits). See docs/GRAPHICS.md.
Keys: F1 menu, F2 picture look, F3 game options, F4 achievements, F5 / F8 quick save / load, F6 held: fast
forward (skips through cutscenes, talks and walks at the game's top speed), F7: the developers' map select left on
the disc (up / down a line, left / right its value, Cross loads the map; docs/DEBUG.md), F9 report, F10 your keys on screen, F11 full screen. (The developers' other menu, DEBSEL, only led to the map select, so v0.8.9 dropped its Shift+F7; docs/DEBUG.md lists what else the disc still names.) The camera tilts much further up and down
than on the PS2 (free tilt since v0.8.6, a switch in F3). The mouse wheel sets
walk or run for the walk keys (up runs, down walks) when no button is put on the wheel. The memory-card
check at start is not shown at all (the card is still read).
Language (F1 -> Language): restarts in the other language with your saves carried over (US / Enhanced <-> the JP
build; build both).
Saves without the memory card: your saves are plain folders in saves beside RawDangerPC.exe (one per save; copy,
back up or share them as folders). The game's card image is made from them at each start and written back when the game
ends; your old card's saves are brought in the first time (docs/SAVES.md). The engine is ps2-native-recomp of 2026-11-18 with our patches. Each run adds a performance line to logs\<game>_performance.log.
Engine: the fork in engine\ps2-native-recomp is kept for Raw Danger on its own (engine\FORK.md): the launcher no
longer looks for upstream changes at start (EngineCheck2=1 in launcher.ini turns the check back on; rd.py engine-check
writes the same report by hand).
Builds: the launcher shows an estimated time before and during a build (your last build of the same game, or a
typical time), and cleans up afterwards: the translated code and compiler objects go, and the copy of an .iso disc too
(the game reads your .iso where it is, so a game folder holds no disc image unless it came from a .cue/.bin).
Music: put a music file of your own (.flac/.mp3/.wav/.wma, any name) in the art folder (launcher\art, with the
cast pictures) and the launcher plays it at MusicVolume= (launcher.ini, default 0.25); a file named music.* wins; the
Music button turns it off.
Undub discs (Japanese voices modded into the US disc) are not compatible: the launcher marks them and says why.

Docs: docs\ROADMAP.md (what is done and what is next), docs\DEMOS.md (the demos compared with retail),
docs\VOICE_SWAP.md, docs\NATIVE_RECOMP.md.
Tools (rd.py)
rd.py demos compares the demo discs with retail (work\reports\demos.md). The rest of rd.py is the older
ps2recomp pipeline, kept for its research; the sections below describe it.

match the real layout, with a real build of ps2recomp at the pinned commit.
None of it has touched your real discs yet, because I couldn't read 1.6 GB+ ISOs
from this session — that's step 1 below.
License: ps2recomp is GPL-3.0 and this project patches and links it, so GPL-3.0
is the natural choice if you publish it.
Quick start (Windows)
Requirements: Git, CMake ≥ 3.21, Visual Studio 2022 (Desktop C++), Python ≥ 3.11.
Recommended: Ghidra 12.2 (JDK 25) + ghidra-emotionengine-reloaded built for the same version.
cd "RAW DANGER DECOMP\rawdanger-recomp"
rd extract :: both ISOs -> work\us, work\jp (~4 GB of disk)
rd compare :: -> work\reports\report.md <- answers "which version is better"
rd analyze :: -> work\reports\elf_us.md, elf_jp.md + patch-site verification
rd setup :: clone ps2recomp @ pinned commit, apply our patches, build tools
rd ghidra :: headless Ghidra (found next to this folder) -> work\ghidra\*.toml/.csv
rd config :: -> recomp\out\config.toml
rd recomp :: generate C++ into ps2recomp\ps2xRuntime\src\runner
rd build :: -> ps2EntryRunner.exe
rd run
rd all runs setup → build in one go.
rd build turns OFF whole-program optimization (/GL + /LTCG): over ~1M
recompiled instructions it exhausts MSVC's heap (C1002 / LNK1257) even with
64 GB. --ltcg turns it back on, --unity-batch 8 lowers per-file memory, and
--jobs N limits parallel compiles. rd voicepack builds the JP voice pack
(see docs/VOICE_SWAP.md).
Send me back work/reports/report.md, elf_us.md, elf_jp.md and the
rd analyze console output. Those decide the next steps: which version's assets
to use, whether the game needs the ISO mounted, and where the voices live.
Settings — rawdanger.ini (next to the ELF)
[disc] image = <path to Raw Danger (USA).iso>

gh-1404706030.content:
Def Jam: Fight for NY — Recompiled

Bring Def Jam: Fight for NY to Windows, macOS and Linux, including the Steam Deck.
This unofficial native port recompiles the original Xbox game for your computer,
with higher rendering resolution, modern controller support, extensive mod support, and other PC-specific enhancements.
This is the definitive port of the game. All game functionality is working and we are continuously optimizing, enhancing, and bugfixing based on player feedback. The project's roadmap now focuses on expanding game moddability, gameplay, and presentation.
You need your own supported USA Xbox dump. The app checks your copy and builds
the game on your computer. PS2 and GameCube copies cannot be used.
Download Def Jam Recompiled for your platform ·

Join the Discord

Drag the before-and-after sliders on the website
One app for everything

Def Jam Recompiled sets up the game, then handles Play, settings, controls, mods,
updates, repair and uninstall. It holds no game files: it checks your own copy and builds
the game on your computer. See the app and overlay guide.
Features

Native on three platforms. Windows x64 uses Direct3D 11; Apple Silicon
Macs and x86-64 Linux use Vulkan. Steam Deck runs the Linux version natively.
60 fps, up to 4× resolution. The port targets 60 frames per second, with 1×–4×
internal resolution in a resizable window or borderless full screen. We're optimizing for
low-powered hardware: Steam Deck hits a steady 60 fps in all game modes at 2× render resolution
with all HD texture mods enabled. Performance depends on your hardware, settings and the scene.
Widescreen, up to 32:9. Windows, macOS and Linux/Steam Deck support 16:9 and 16:10
ratios, as well as ultrawide up to 32:9. Download the HD Widescreen Menus mod in the app to
transform every menu and background to match. Original 4:3 is one setting away.
Play in your language. Translation mod support is here. Spanish and French are the
first additional languages: ZARF's Spanish mod in the catalogue, and the disc's own French
as a setting.
Mod support. Texture and language mods are here, with a curated catalogue in the app.
Custom fighters, stages and game modes are coming up on the roadmap.
Your own music. Add MP3, FLAC, Ogg or WAV songs and play them in the Beatbox, menus and
fights. The cut song "Holler If Ya Hear Me" is restored too. Manage your music on the
Songs page; see Custom songs.
Controllers and keyboard. Xbox, DualSense, Switch Pro and other supported gamepads,
with remapping, hot-plug and rumble. Keyboard and mouse buttons can supply gameplay bindings;
the app and settings support a pointer.
One app for everything. Setup, Play, settings, controls, mods, updates, repair and
uninstall all live in Def Jam Recompiled. Press F1 during play, or a configured controller
shortcut, to change settings in the game.
Cheat menu. Infinite health, max Blazin', giant and tiny fighters, fighter swaps, Story
cash and development points.
Add to Steam. On Windows, Linux and Steam Deck, one button beside Play puts the game in
your Steam library, artwork included.
Upscaled Original Textures. The app can generate 4× versions of the game's textures from
your copy, on your computer, with no GPU, AI model or downloaded artwork. Further restored
textures can be downloaded in Mods.
Up to four local players. Play with gamepads and a keyboard player.
Network multiplayer is not supported.
EA's developer menu, restored. The game's own debug menu, cut off in the retail
build, opens from the overlay (Diagnostics tab): set up any match with any fighters, venue and
match type, play any Story scene, or look at a venue in the stage viewer. See
The developer menu.

Get started

Have your own USA Xbox disc image or extracted dump matching the
supported dump manifest.
Download Def Jam Recompiled for your platform from the
latest release.
Open it, choose your copy and the Modern or Original experience, and optionally add Upscaled
Original Textures. The app then verifies your copy, recompiles and builds the game.

Customize your game

App and overlay
Controllers, keyboard and mouse

Language packs

Texture and language mods
Available now: texture replacement packs, including the Upscaled Original Textures the app
generates, language mods, and reviewed catalogue downloads such as HD Widescreen Menus. Enable
mods and set their priority on the app's Mods page.
Want to make a pack? Start with Texture Modding — Getting Started:

The format reference and mod-manager reference

Import Xbox and PS2 saves.

Coming up: custom fighters, stages and game modes. See the roadmap below.
Where the project is heading
The project aims to preserve the original game's experience while making it
easier to play and customize on modern computers.

Direction
Goal

Engine optimizations
Improve performance on low-spec machines, stay up to date with xboxrecomp, and contribute improvements upstream.

Port accuracy
Keep the visuals, tone and gameplay feel faithful to the original Xbox game.

Fully unlocked frame rates
Support frame rates above 60 fps while preserving game speed, timing and gameplay feel. Future work; not supported by the current release.

Widescreen refinement
Improve edge cases and broader aspect and venue coverage.

Extensible Custom Fighter Mod support
Add your own fighters to the game.

Additional HD Upscaling mods
Story Fighter customization, plus Stages and Level textures.

Def Jam: The Takeover expansion
Bring the mechanics and story mode from Def Jam: The Takeover into this game.

Broader mod support
Custom stages and game modes, difficulty changes and restored cut content.

Build and release automation
Improve automation and the gameplay test harness so shipping builds have reliable, repeatable validation.

Deeper gameplay decompilation
Long-term stretch goal.

These are directions, not promised release dates. GitHub Issues,
milestones and
open PRs track concrete work.
Compatibility and known limits
The released build targets Windows x64, Apple Silicon macOS and x86-64 Linux.
Steam Deck has automated regression coverage and maintainer playtesting;
Proton is untested. Performance varies with hardware, settings and scenes.
Release-specific test qualifications are recorded with the release; open reports
and follow-up work are tracked in GitHub Issues.
Check both GitHub Issues and the
latest release notes.
Some release-specific fixes and validation limits appear in the notes first.
Community
This project is in very active development, and the
Def Jam: Fight for NY Recomp Discord is where
we collaborate and talk it through. Join to:

follow and discuss development as it happens;
share player feedback and ask for help getting set up;
suggest enhancements and ideas for the port;
talk about mods and texture packs.

Discord is for conversation. Please still file bugs as
GitHub issues
so they are tracked, and never share game files or dumps there either.
Help improve the port
Report a problem
with your version, operating system, CPU/GPU, controller, reproduction steps and
relevant log lines. Remove personal paths, and please don't attach F9 bug bundles, game
files, saves or memory dumps. See Contributing for reporting guidance,
development setup and the tests a change needs.
Bug fixes, platform testing and documentation improvements are welcome.
The gameplay test harness explains automated game
checks and their limits. GitHub CI also runs checks that need no game data;
a passing CI badge does not establish full campaign compatibility.
How it works
The xboxrecomp toolchain translates the
Xbox executable into C, which is compiled ahead of time. The game's code runs
through an Xbox compatibility runtime, with graphics, audio and input supplied
by your computer. This is a static recompilation port; deeper gameplay
decompilation remains future work.
The repository distributes maintained port code, build tools and documentation.
It does not distribute a disc image, playable game data, translated game source
or a compiled game executable. The repository does include selected approved
screenshots and branding artwork; those retain their original ownership.
Credits and licensing
Maintained by vyanhursky, with development assistance from Claude Code and
Codex. Built on sp00nz's xboxrecomp and work from the Xbox emulation
community, including xemu hardware references and attributed toolkit components.
Burnout 3 and
Mercenaries Recompiled
are related projects that helped shape the documentation.
The project's code is MIT licensed. Toolkit components retain their
own licenses; see the toolkit NOTICE
and license texts.
The license grants no rights to the game or its artwork.
This is an unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Electronic Arts, AKI or
Def Jam. Def Jam: Fight for NY and its assets belong to their respective owners.

c5l1dz.title: King Crimson Drummer Michael Giles Dies at 84
c5l1dz.content:
Michael Giles, whose drumming on King Crimson’s legendary debut album brought fire and abandon to an already wild and innovative sound, has died, according to a post on the band’s website. No cause of death was announced; he was 84.

“His extraordinary rhythmic imagination, musical sensitivity and highly inventive approach to drumming were fundamental to the band’s pioneering sound,” the announcement reads in part. “Michael’s originality, musical curiosity and uncompromising commitment to creative freedom challenged conventions and inspired generations of musicians around the world. He leaves behind an extraordinary musical legacy, and his unique contribution to the evolution of progressive music will never be forgotten.”

Born in 1942, Giles hailed from Bournemouth on England’s south coast, along with Crimson cofounders Robert Fripp and Greg Lake. In 1967, he formed a group with his brother Peter and Fripp called, naturally enough, Giles, Giles and Fripp. The trio released an album titled “The Cheerful Insanity of Giles, Giles and Fripp” the following year, to extremely modest commercial results. However, the album laid the groundwork for King Crimson, which Giles formed late in 1968 with Fripp, vocalist/ bassist Lake, multi-instrumentalist Ian McDonald and lyricist Peter Sinfield.

Crimson’s early concerts electrified the British rock scene, to the extend that the band was invited to open for the Rolling Stones at its massive concert in London’s Hyde Park in July of 1969. The group’s innovative sound, as captured on its debut album, “In the Court of the Crimson King,” combined rock, jazz, classical and avant-garde music into a concoction that many consider to be the first true progressive-rock album; certainly nothing like it had been heard during the rock era.

Its influence was profound, and can be heard everywhere from the music of fellow prog-rock travelers Yes and Genesis as well as David Bowie, Roxy Music and countless later acolytes like Tool and the Mars Volta; its song “20 th Century Schizoid Man” was famously sampled by Kanye West on his 2010 single “Power.”

Giles’ wild drumming was key to the band’s first lineup, embellishing its classical-tinged sound with innovative, thunderous drum rolls and lightning-fast rhythms.

However, in a trend that would follow throughout Crimson’s long existence, this lineup was short-lived: By early 1970, McDonald, Lake and Giles had all left the band, although the latter two did contribute to the band’s second album, “In the Wake of Poseidon.”

Giles subsequently recorded an album with McDonald under the name McDonald and Giles (naturally enough), and over the years performed on recordings with an unusually diverse array of artists, including erstwhile bandmates Lake and Sinfield as well as Steve Winwood, Bryan Ferry, Leo Sayer, original Genesis guitarist Anthony Phillips, Kevin Ayers, Neil Sedaka, Yvonne Elliman, Andy Summers and the Penguin Cafe Orchestra.

He also released a solo album titled “Progress, Ghost Dance” with later Crimson member Jamie Muir and David Cunningham, and the Michael Giles MAD Band, which featured yet another Crimson alumnus, Keith Tippett.

He and several other alums united in 2002 to form the 21st Century Schizoid Band, which toured performing the band’s early repertoire.

He is survived by his five children, Tina, Amanda, William, Rosie and Oliver, several grandchildren, his sister Marion and brother Peter.

daffzk.title: All The Songs In Disney’s ‘Hexed’: Queen, Dua Lipa & More
daffzk.content:
November 25, 2026 3:00pm

L-R: Billie Doe (voiced by Hailee Steinfeld) and Beef Roger Crummchuk (voiced by Walton Goggins) in Walt Disney Animation Studios' 'Hexed'

Disney’s Hexed tells the story of a family trio of witches, disconnected from themselves, each other and their powers.

Billie Doe (voiced by Hailee Steinfeld), a rebellious teen in Toledo, Ohio who does anything to get out from under her controlling mother’s (Rashida Jones) thumb, discovers a hidden world full of witches when her long dormant magical powers awaken and transfigure a portal that takes her to Hexe, where her estranged grandmother (Jodie Foster) is queen and her mother was a princess. Adventures ensue with the help of Beef Rogers (Walton Goggins) as Billie uncovers her true family history.

Original music composed by Kris Bowers (Bridgerton), is accompanied by several themed needle drops throughout the film. Each song fits emotional moments as well, from the parenting themes in the opening needle drop to the rebellion of the one that follows. Dua Lipa’s “Levitating” is a natural selection, as is Demi Lovato’s “Confident,” a string cover of which was used in Bridgerton Season 3 Part 2. Magic is another theme in song selections in the animated film.

Star Hailee Steinfeld also lends her vocals to a cover of a very appropriate song by The Cars, which plays during the film’s credits.

Find all the songs in Hexed below:

“My Girl” by The Mamas & The Papas

“I Want to Break Free” by Queen

“Levitating” by Dua Lipa

“Black Magic” by Little Mix

“Confident” by Demi Lovato

“Magic” Sung by Hailee Steinfeld and Written by The Cars in 1975

What's New in v1.6.1

Cheat Menu PopStyleColor() Crash Fix & Full ImGui Stack / Gamepad / Modal Hardening:

Fixed a Dear ImGui g.ColorStack.Size underflow crash when clicking Disable All Cheats inside the F2 / F1 -> Cheats overlay (where PopStyleColor(3) ran unconditionally after DisableAllCheatToggles() mutated any_toggle mid-scope), and deployed RAII ScopedStyleColors / ScopedStyleVars / ScopedDisabled guards across ui_common.cpp, settings_ui.cpp, launcher_ui.cpp, and file_browser_ui.cpp so early returns and state transitions can never leak or underflow ImGui stacks.
Hardened gamepad LB/RB tab switching while modals or key-rebind capture are active, preserved file-list focus when navigating up directories in the in-app XISO file browser, and sanitized popup/modal dismissal paths across both the Pre-Game Launcher and in-game overlay.

10 Docks Wooden / Railed / Long-Flight Staircase Fix (sub_00179D60 & sub_001709C0):

Fixed Torque clipping through, wedging against side handrails on, or getting blocked on wooden, switchback, and multi-flight staircases in 10 Docks (as well as 4a/4b Quarry): corrected the inverted 400.0f slope-length FPU check in IsWalkableOrStepTriangle (sub_00179D60 @ 0x00179E00, which previously rejected 40°–57° staircase ramps with slope_len <= 400.0f from step_candidate_tris), fixed ShouldSkipStepTriangle (sub_001709C0) rejecting the lower half of long 400..1301-unit Docks staircase flights (tri_centroid_y >= foot_center_y with uninitialized STriEntry.normal) as solid walls, preserved CGroundSupport step transitions off flat landings, expanded CTriPool snapshot handling on dense Docks meshes, and widened multi-offset top-edge clearance probing on narrow railed stairs.

OneHitKills 8b Bluff Hermes Boss Softlock Guard & hooks.cpp FPU / Memory Bounds Hardening:

Hardened One-Hit Kills (Hostiles Only) (CNPC::ApplyHealthLoss, sub_000F1E80) to explicitly exclude environmental-puzzle apparition bosses (CHermes in 8b Bluff — whose 999,999 HP burner encounter has m_bInvulnerable == 0 and softlocks burner relay #7949 if killed directly — plus CHorace and CKilljoy) and sentinel-HP setpiece actors (>= 5,000 HP), alongside Dallas (#2152) and plot-protected allies.
Added full SavedX87State FPU register/control-word preservation around nested CallGuest / CallThiscall invocations and strict overflow-safe ValidGuest(va, size) committed-memory bounds checks across hooks.cpp and cheats.cpp.

Windows Release -O3 -DNDEBUG Optimization, Zero-Path-Leak Deterministic Builds & Binary Hygiene Gate:

Enforced explicit -O3 -DNDEBUG Release flags across Windows & Linux Clang presets (fixing unoptimized Windows Clang Release builds and stripping debug assertions from Release binaries while keeping them in Debug), deterministic /Brepro + /PDBALTPATH:%_PDB% PE linking and --build-id=sha1 --strip-debug ELF linking, comprehensive -ffile-prefix-map / -fdebug-compilation-dir=. host/workspace/FetchContent path remapping before FetchContent_MakeAvailable(), and automated PE/ELF/COFF binary path-leak scanning (gate2b_binary_hygiene in tools/audit_release.py).

Previous Highlights (v1.6.0)

In-Game Cheat Menu (F2 Quick-Toggle or F1 / BACK + L3 -> Cheats) & Native Main Menu "Quit Game":

Added a native "Quit Game" button directly below "Bonus Material" on the in-game Main Menu (matching Original Xbox typography, horror CGUIEffects ghosting, and UI audio) with full Controller (D-Pad/Stick + A), Keyboard (Up/Down/W/S + Enter), and PC Mouse hover/click support for clean host shutdown without Alt+F4 (automatically bypassed during deterministic --replay-input).
Added a thread-safe In-Game Cheat Menu (F2 quick-open/close, or F1 / BACK + L3 -> Cheats tab with LB/RB controller tab switching) featuring a live Torque status header (HP, Xombium, Insanity, Morality gauge, and 1-click Disable All Cheats), 9 persistent combat & XBE post-FX toggles (with friendly-NPC/Dallas #2152 protection on One-Hit Kills), 13 queued guest-main-thread loadout, morality, and appearance actions (including the secret Gonzo Gun), and an optional CHEATS ACTIVE (N) HUD badge.

Persistent Controller Thumbstick Inversion & In-Game Options ([game_options] in settings.toml):

Fixed controller thumbstick pitch inversion (0x002DB248) and all 17 in-game CUserSettings preferences (0x002DB218: Controller Preset, Invert Pitch Axis, Vibration, Turn/Pitch Sensitivity, Auto-Targeting, Auto Pitch Correction, Checkpoints, Help Text, Screen Adjust X/Y, Effects/Dialog/Music Volumes, Speaker Setup, and Subtitles) resetting to Xbox factory defaults on cold restart when no Xbox "Settings" save container existed.
Added bidirectional live sync between the Pre-Game Launcher, In-Game F1 -> Controls / Audio tabs (Invert Controller Right-Stick Y-Axis, Right-Stick Turn & Pitch Sensitivity, Controller Rumble/Vibration, and In-Game Subtitles), and the native Xbox Options screens, persisting every change atomically to settings.toml ([game_options]) across restarts while preserving unlocked Archive/Prelude flags (+0x44/+0x48/+0x50).

East Block, Yard & Asylum Sky/Cloud Rendering Fixes (D3D12 & Vulkan):

Fixed horizontal RGB static/dark scanline bands and stepped cutouts on wall decals, outdoor concrete pillars, and scrolling multi-layer D3DFMT_P8 sky/cloud domes across level transitions (2 Cellblocks, 3a YardCellBlock, 5a Asylum) caused by asynchronous RenderTarget readbacks writing into freed/reallocated Xbox 64 MB contiguous memory pages, sparse texture-cache MemSig sampling above 64 KB, missing MmFreeContiguousMemory GPU cache invalidation, and un-fenced D3D12 64 MiB texture-slab suballocation reuse (plus d3d::g_lock / render-thread serialization on d3d::FlushCaches() during shutdown).
Fixed NV2A programmable vertex shaders (xvsTextureMatrix / xvsTextureMatrix_Reflection) having D3DTADDRESS_WRAP overridden to CLAMP when static [0..1] mesh UVs were scrolled or scaled via vertex shader constants c[4..5] (eliminating border-texel streak smearing on scrolling clouds, water, and reflections), added mid-frame DirtyEpoch texture re-upload and child-mip D3DSurface lock/busy propagation, and doubled D3D12 per-frame SRV descriptor ring capacity (65,536 SRVs/frame).

Staircase Top-Edge Step-Up & Quarry Staircase Clipping / Anti-Wedge Fix:

Fixed Torque getting snagged horizontally at the top lip/crest of staircases until jumping, clipping his legs through 40.5°–45° Quarry industrial staircases (4a/4b Quarry), and getting locked in State 9 (Fall, Jump disabled) across unwelded .mdu staircase seams and V-creases — enabling CCollider step-up slope support (0x8008), fixing high-FPS (60+ Hz) SweepStep post-collision micro-slide penetration and spatial substep scaling, adding framerate-independent 3D-clearance-verified top-edge step-up assist and unwelded seam ground-bridging, and adding automatic V-crease anti-wedge recovery (bypassed during deterministic --replay-input).

1rwakfo.title: NBC Plans to Run Thanksgiving Parade Ads Twice After Macy's Postpones
1rwakfo.content:
NBC has a Thanksgiving Week present for advertisers scheduled to appear in the now-postponed Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade.

The network plans to run commercials from sponsors of the event twice this week — once when the 2026 parade airs on Saturday and once on Thursday, when the network will run a repeat of last year’s Macy’s extravaganza. In short, Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade advertisers get two runs on the network for ther price of one. The details were confirmed by an NBC spokesperson.

Macy’s and NBC decided to postpone the parade to Saturday, November 28, citing extreme wind conditions and inclement weather expected on Thursday. Many of the signature balloons used in the parade cannot be controlled properly during high wind speeds. The network said it is “committed to ensuring this remains a high-priority opportunity for our clients with both the reach and scale of tomorrow’s re-airing and the original live telecast on Saturday.”

NBC has many reasons to keep advertisers in the parade happy. The cost of a 30-second commercial in the parade is up 15% to 20% over last year, according to Guideline, a tracker of ad spending, when NBC was able to charge between $900,000 and $1 million per unit. Those figures would indicate that a 30-second spot in the 2026 parade could cost between$1.03 million and $1.2 million. Ad spend on the event is pacing about 25% to 30% ahead of last year, according to Guideline. The parade snared more than $88.7 million in ads last year, the company says.

The parade is also part of a time-honored lineup that includes the National Dog Show and a primetime NFL game. The Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade telecast was the opening event in a extended schedule of holiday programs that the network uses to lure marketers eager to court holiday shoppers.

Geico had plans to run a two-minute commercial that uses stop-motion animation featuring many of its trademark characters, such as the Geico Gecko. Starbucks had signed on to promote a new holiday album, “The Holiday Blend,” and is the sponsor of a takeover of an NBC livestream of the parade on TikTok.

NBC isn’t the first TV network to confront delays tied to a massive live event. CBS in 2013 gave some of the advertisers in that year’s Super Bowl an extra run of their commercials after a 35-minute power outage brought a game between the Baltimore Ravens and the San Francisco 49’ers. Bud Light and Subway were among the marketers that enjoyed an extra airing of ads that had multi-million-dollar price tags.

t5tk2w.title: S&P considers Nvidia credit downgrade over governance and ‘key man’ risks
t5tk2w.content:
S&P Global Ratings, one of the three major credit rating agencies, is considering downgrading Nvidia’s rating, citing concerns about the company’s management and governance practices.

Despite Nvidia’s strong financial performance, the ouster and reinstatement of CEO Jensen Huang has raised concerns about “weak executive oversight and lack of succession planning” and “key man risk,” meaning heavy reliance on Huang for its future success, S&P said in a statement. 

The agency expects to finish its review within 90 days and could cut Nvidia’s rating from AA to AA-, the fourth-highest on its scale.

Although Nvidia is certain to keep its investment-grade rating, a downgrade could raise its borrowing costs. Because Nvidia backstops neoclouds and other infrastructure companies that lack strong credit on their own, a lower rating could make their debt costlier or force them to post more collateral.

In August, Nvidia announced plans to arrange $500 billion in financing for AI infrastructure with six financial institutions, including Goldman Sachs, Apollo, and Blackstone. Under the original terms, Nvidia would guarantee 25% of the loans. But even before Huang’s ouster and return, lenders had been demanding that Nvidia guarantee more, Bloomberg reported.

A downgrade would likely prompt lenders to demand even larger guarantees.
