s49hd.title: Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair is getting a Switch 2 Definitive Edition
s49hd.content: Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair: Definitive Edition has been announced for Nintendo Switch 2.Available from next month, on December 15, Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair: Definitive Edition will offer improved performance and visuals and come packaged with the Trowzer’s Top Tonic Pack DLC.This follows the launch of Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair on the original Switch, PS4, Xbox One, and PC in 2019.If you had the original game on Switch, this Definitive Edition upgrade is available for free. You will just need a physical copy of the game, or use the same Nintendo account you used to purchase a digital copy on Switch.We’re still waiting on the specifics, but we’re told that the Definitive Edition will support up to 120FPS, and “enhanced lighting and ambient occlusion effects.”, and “higher-fidelity textures and shadows”.Yooka-Laylee and the Impossible Lair was met with positive reviews back at launch. Unlike the first game in the series, The Impossible Lair opts for 2D platforming, more akin to Donkey Kong Country than its initial Banjo-Kazooie inspirations. The efforts paid off, with the game being much better received by both critics and fans, and keeping the series going for further releases.Following on from Impossible Lair, developer Playtonic released a remake of the first game, Yooka-Replaylee, in 2025. Alongside the re-release of Impossible Lair, Playtonic is also working on the first Yooka-Laylee racer, Super Yooka-Laylee Kart, which doesn’t currently have a release date.

3vfzrz.title: Италия выразила недовольство ударами ВСУ по российским кораблям в Ливии, назвав атаки "ошибкой"
3vfzrz.content:
Италия заявила Украине, что нападение на российские корабли в ливийских водах было ошибкой, и предупредила Киев от распространения войны на новые территории, сообщил газете Corriere della Sera министр иностранных дел Антонио Таяни в среду, 25 ноября. "Нарушение суверенитета Ливии было ошибкой", - заявил он, добавив, что Рим не получал предварительного предупреждения об украинских операциях.

"Италия абсолютно не знала о намерениях Киева нанести удары в территориальных водах Ливии, даже внутри порта", - заверил он. Его и власти в Риме беспокоят военные действия "всего в нескольких сотнях километров от Италии".

В состоявшемся накануне телефонном разговоре с украинским коллегой Андреем Сибигой Таяни выразил обеспокоенность по поводу недавних военных операций на востоке Ливии, ответственность за которые взяло на себя украинское правительство, говорится в пресс-релизе на сайте МИД страны. "Таяни заверил собеседника, что дипломатические усилия Италии будут продолжаться в поддержку обороны Украины на пути к справедливому и прочному миру", - указано также в сообщении.

Politico: Ситуация в Ливии может быть использована Россией для дестабилизации Италии

Действующие власти Италии во главе с премьер-министром Джорджей Мелони является стойким сторонником Киева с момента полномасштабного вторжения России в 2022 году, напоминает агентство Reuters. Однако входящий в правительство Маттео Сальвини неоднократно критиковал продолжение оказания военной помощи Украине. После инцидента в Средиземном море он заявил, что "было бы бессмысленно", если бы военная поддержка, оказываемая Украине, "в конечном итоге привела к войнам и потоплению кораблей по всему миру".

Скептически настроено и итальянское общество: согласно опросу YouGov в 2026 году, лишь 32% итальянцев беспокоит победа Украины над Россией, что является наинизшим показателем среди всех стран Западной Европы.

В преддверии весенних выборов в Италии проблема с военными действиями в Ливии "грозит стать для Мелони настоящей головной болью", пишет 25 ноября издание Politico. "Рим особенно обеспокоен дестабилизацией Ливии, бывшей итальянской колонии, опасаясь, что если эта политически нестабильная страна снова погрузится в хаос, это может спровоцировать волну миграции через Средиземное море. Россия и ее союзники в Ливии могут использовать миграцию как оружие против страны", - говорится в материале.В Ливии сообщили о гибели двух военных после атаки Украины

В результате украинских атак на российский военный корабль "Меркурий" и грузовое судно у побережья Ливии погибли два ливийских военных, заявили власти восточной части этой североафриканской страны. Моряки "скончались от ранений, полученных при исполнении национального долга" в ходе нападения на военно-морскую базу в Бенгази, написал в ночь 25 ноября в Facebook Саддам Хафтар, сын генерала Халифы Хафтара, контролирующего восточную часть Ливии.

Аналогичное заявление сделал глава контролирующего восточную часть Ливии правительства Усама Хамад. Ранее непризнанные международным сообществом власти на востоке Ливии потребовали прояснить ситуацию. Они попросили ООН провести расследование в связи с предполагаемым присутствием Вооруженных сил Украины на западе страны. В Бенгази заявили о нарушении суверенитета Ливии.

Между тем в Париже поддержали действия украинских военных в Средиземном море. Министр иностранных дел Франции Жан-Ноэль Барро в эфире телеканала TF1 напомнил о праве Украины на самооборону. "Что бы делали мы, если бы нас день и ночь бомбил противник, захватчик? Мы бы защищались и реализовали наше неотъемлемое право на самооборону. Именно это и делают украинцы", - заявил он. Кроме того, именно Россия несет ответственность за расширение масштабов войны против Украины, добавил он.

Операция Украины у побережья Ливии

Президент Украины Владимир Зеленский 23 ноября заявил о проведении у побережья Ливии успешной операции с применением морских дронов. В результате действий украинских подразделений был потоплен российский корвет "Меркурий", а также поражено грузовое судно, использующееся для перевозки оружия в ходе войны РФ против Украины. В МИД Украины заявили, что российский корвет был законной целью, при этом Украина уважает суверенитет Ливии и заинтересована в дальнейшем развитии двустороннего сотрудничества.

После свержения ливийского диктатора Муаммара Каддафи в 2011 году североафриканское государство фактически разделено на две части. Признанному на международном уровне правительству в Триполи противостоит конкурирующее правительство в Бенгази, поддерживающее тесные связи с Россией. Вооруженные силы восточной Ливии, которыми командует Хафтар, контролируют всю восточную часть страны и значительную часть ее южных территорий.

3r8f5x.title: Russian Official Warns of Ukrainian Drone Attacks on Utility Infrastructure This Winter
3r8f5x.content: Smoke over the Afipsky refinery in the Krasnodar region after a Ukrainian attack on Nov. 6, 2026.@supernova_plus / TelegramPreparations for potential Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian utility infrastructure this winter, particularly in regions near the border, are a top priority for the government, Deputy Prime Minister Marat Khusnullin said on Wednesday.Russia has been striking Ukrainian civilian energy infrastructure since the start of the war, causing major disruptions, especially in large cities. This year, Ukraine has been able to strike Russian refineries, ports and warehouses, some of them deep inside Russia.Ukrainian attacks are widely expected this winter on utility infrastructure across Russia, and many people are stocking up on generators and high-capacity batteries. In and around Moscow, some power and heating plants have been covered in anti-drone nets.Read moreHeating Main Break Leaves 40K Without Heat in Khabarovsk“This is now the most important question: how we’ll get through the winter, especially given drone attacks, particularly in the border regions. This is the number one issue we need to be dealing with right now,” Khusnullin, who is overseeing the housing sector, told lawmakers.The comments mirrored warnings from Ukrainian leaders about the risk of winter attacks on energy infrastructure disrupting power and heating supplies.Temperatures are falling below freezing in Moscow this week and are already below zero in many regions. Last year, drone attacks in the city of Belgorod, near the Ukrainian border, left tens of thousands of residents without heating and electricity for days.Khusnullin said the challenge was made more difficult by budget pressures and the fact that residents in many border regions are exempt by law from paying utility bills.Russia resumed large-scale attacks on Ukraine’s civilian energy and heating infrastructure in mid-autumn this year, causing widespread power, heating and water outages ahead of winter.Moscow denies deliberately targeting civilians but says critical energy infrastructure is a legitimate military target.Our weekly newsletter contains a hand-picked selection of news, features, analysis and more from The Moscow Times. 7l1u6i.title: Why did Rockstar Games make empathy a key mechanic in GTA 6? "Because it's fun" says head of development Rob Nelson
7l1u6i.content:
That, and parts of RDR2 became "too hard to ignore or walk away from".

Image credit: Rockstar Games

There's been plenty of chatter about Grand Theft Auto 6's 'honour system', so to speak, implemented here via what the game calls your Criminal Profile.
Our own Dom just wrote that they prefer to turn its notifications off, for instance, in favour of fully soaking into the immersion. Personally I quite like the pop-ups - I find the act of figuring out systems and how they're manipulated almost as fun as the games they're a part of. And pop-ups or no, the fact that GTA 6 can arguably be portrayed as 'rewarding' empathy and 'discouraging' the series' famous rampages of mass violence has sparked a fair bit of debate.
Some of that is genuinely interesting - I'm dubious as to whether that's really what this system is doing, for a start. Is it incentivising and disincentivising certain in-game behaviour, or just putting a label on it? And then, actually: does the act of labelling "psycho" behaviour alone actually become a disincentivising factor in itself?
Either way, until now Rockstar hasn't said a great deal about why, exactly, this system - seen by some as one that builds empathy into GTA's chaotic world - was implemented in the first place. But during an interview I had with Rob Nelson, Rockstar Games' head of development, just before GTA 6's launch earlier this month, a little more on that came to light.A little context is necessary here: Nelson's response was actually following a question I had about the overall approach to design that Rockstar took, and how its wider themes and intentions came about. As a part of that, he turned to this system - and how, in a way, it exists here because of the work the studio simply didn't want to leave behind after Red Dead Redemption 2.
Nelson explained that this all began when the team was in the early phase of exploring what type of game GTA 6 would be, in 2015 and 2016, while much of the studio was still working full-tilt on RDR2 - a game which itself didn't release until late 2018. The team was looking to "build up the sophistication of the NPC population, and also allow for more player choice than we had [before], and more options in terms of the way you interact with the world beyond just violence," Nelson told me.
The idea would be that "it's still a world of violence - but you could threaten somebody by aiming a gun at them and just robbing them, and they have a chance to comply. So you don't have to beat them to death to get their money." Ideas that were "simple things" in principle, he said, "but they create a lot more work in terms of development of the sophistication of the systems."
Then, as systems were gradually implemented, it became a question of "trying to marry up what you're doing in the open world with who we're saying you are in the narrative - more than we had, I would say, previously, in Red Dead 2." It's here where the system now referred to as the Criminal Profile started to form.The thinking turned to "the nature of 'honour', which wasn't always a part of it" with Red Dead Redemption 2, Nelson continued, "but became part of it as we were working on this story and finding that the 'redemption arc' didn't feel so good when it was foisted upon you - and feelings that we had playing Red Dead sort of early on." (Those feelings, primarily, were around getting you to invest in a gang led by Dutch Van der Linde, who was fundamentally unlikable from the off - or plain "crazy", as Nelson put it. The implementation of more player choices and agency was part of Rockstar's way to build investment in Arthur, even as he followed Dutch.)
That meant moving the choices away from key story moments, where many games tend to put them. Instead, Rockstar built a system that ran alongside the story via smaller, moment-to-moment choices you might make. "We tried to take all of those off the main flow and make them optional. So again, they're a choice."
"Usually they involve some form of slight sacrifice or more effort on the part of the player," he added. The hope, then, was that you as a player would both "feel something", and ultimately also feel "you got the outcome that you deserved."
That was the initial thinking behind this kind of system as a whole. Coming to GTA 6, it then combined with a wider desire to "evolve" Grand Theft Auto as both the team's storytelling and the available technology matured. "You're thinking about story and character set, but we're also thinking about what we want to do with GTA as a series, and how you want to evolve it," Nelson said."I think as the resolution goes up, it sort of asks different new questions," he continued. "As the resolution goes up, you want the sophistication of the experience to go up, and obviously the sophistication of the mechanics. So it just naturally flowed that we give players choices to interact with the world beyond just violence, beyond just 'down the barrel of a gun', because it's fun."
"It's fun for some people like myself to just sort of role-play in the world, and be in the world, and restraint becomes something you hadn't thought about," he continued. That tied back into the more sophisticated NPCs and reactions the team were making.
"If you think about the NPCs, even back to [GTA] 5, you would draw a weapon - first of all, they didn't react if you drew an invisible shotgun out of nowhere, or a rocket launcher," he said. "They don't react unless you aim it, and then they flee in terror, and you're just sort of this demigod stomping through the world, you know? And that's fun, but for how long?
"The team then started thinking of ways to build a bit more sustained enjoyment from it. "What if you can't do that?" Nelson continued. What if, instead of whipping an RPG out of nowhere, "you have to call your car. You have to pop a car trunk and get it, and now I'm walking, and now people are noticing, but they're sort of sidling away, and it's more believable. And then they're still fleeing in terror, but then there's people who also have guns, and they're shooting at you, or you try to hold somebody up and they pull a gun, or they grab it, and then you have to deal with them."And then, he continued, "you choose. You're trying to jack somebody off a motorcycle, and they pull a gun on you, and you have to blow their head off and it's like, 'You shouldn't have made me do that!' And so then it has more meaning, and it's more funny in a way when it's a little bit more pointed. And you can still go on those rampages and basically smash your Criminal Profile until it breaks and then you enter this irredeemable state, which basically says 'I reject your criminal profile system! I don't want it.'"
That Irredeemable profile level, for what it's worth, was another element born of Red Dead Redemption 2. "We had that with Red Dead, where people would sort of have low honour, and then 'greet' their way back up to high honour. And so this was an attempt of sorts of [making something] for people that just want to go crazy and almost opt out of the system. They can opt out of it - and you can also turn off the notifications in the system."
It's notable, in fact, just how interlinked the thinking was with GTA 6 and Red Dead Redemption 2. As Nelson put it at one point: "There was maybe more emotional resonance in the story of RDR2 than we had had, certainly in a GTA before. So we liked that idea." What Rockstar did with GTA 6 was then in a way a natural next step. "We didn't necessarily come to GTA 6 going: 'We must have emotional resonance,' but all of those things combine. It's more that those systems and that element of player choice and agency, and the way that affected the narrative, was a hard thing to ignore and walk away from."
We'll have much more like this from our interview with Nelson very soon, so do look out for that on Eurogamer over the coming days. In the meantime, we've a handy guide explaining exactly how GTA 6's Criminal Profile system works and how to change, raise, or lower that profile if you're in need of a deep dive into how it all really works.

1y0bdo0.title: DeepMind's Gemini Robotics 2.5 Aims to Make Robots Safer, More Dexterous, and Faster Learners
1y0bdo0.content:
Google DeepMind introduced Gemini Robotics 2.5, a vision-language-action (VLA) model designed to improve robots' dexterity, reliability, and learning speed, while enabling safer operation in unstructured real-world environments.

According to DeepMind's vice president and head of robotics Carolina Parada, the model "marks a leap forward in three key areas": dexterity, reliability, and safety. She says its performance has been evaluated across more than 200 tasks, with reported improvements of 30% to 100% in success rates and 20% to 30% in task completion compared with prior versions. Demonstrated capabilities include serving food with tongs, tying a bow on a gift box, and pipetting liquids.

These tasks represent a step toward human-level dexterity by combining a number of skills, including advanced tool use, complex manipulation of deformables, and handling delicate objects with finesse.

The model is designed to work natively with different types of robots, including humanoid platforms such as Apptronik's Apollo 2 and tabletop pick & place systems such as Franka Duo platform.

Parada highlights the industrial trials conducted with Mercedes Benz, in which Apollo 2 humanoid robots were deployed on an existing industrial line, achieving a 96% success rate in tasks involving automotive kitting and sorting mixed metal brackets. In the trial, the Gemini Robotics ER embodied reasoning model enabled the robot to keep track of the workflow over multiple steps and adapt to changeing conditions, while Gemini Robotics 2.5 controlled the robot's hands and arms.

Another key aspect highlighted by Parada is Gemini Robotics 2.5's safety features, which include using reasoning guidance to identify and manage physical hazards:

Much like safety classifiers add a protective layer around Gemini’s responses, this guidance allows the robot to navigate complex environments securely. In our evaluations, this capability boosted safe task completion around obstacles by 33% and around nearby people by 43%.

DeepMind also open-sourced the new safety benchmark ASIMOV-jailbreak, containing hundreds of unsafe prompts across dozens of scenes.

Commenting on the announcement on LinkedIn, GEICO director of software Sean P. observed that "the combination of simulation, learning from mistakes, and real-world testing is what will make robots more capable and reliable in everyday tasks".

LightSpeed founder and CEO Biju Kulathakal emphasized that 96% accuracy may not be enough in real contexts involving humans:

Pausing when a person gets close is what gets robots out from behind the fence. And on a real line, customers live in the 4%. Learning from its own mistakes is how that closes.

Level principal engineer Ariel Franco Ferreira expressed his view that

Releasing an open benchmark for jailbreaks on a VLA model is the part I find most interesting, because a prompt injection that ends in a physical action is a very different failure from a bad chat answer.

He also raised the question of how to handle situations "when the robot refuses the unsafe step but leaves the task half done in a risky state".

As a final note, Gemini Robotics 2.5's development was accelerated using Gemini 4 Argon as a simulation engine, leveraging its robotics research capabilities to generate simulated environments.

14e7bd6.title: Paradox grand strategy Afterworld has a wasteland band mechanic that sounds worryingly like a continent-sized game of The Sims
14e7bd6.content:
Unify your tribe with carrot, stick or many gradations thereof

Image credit: Paradox / Rock Paper Shotgun

Much like a huge dust cloud gradually resolving into an army of skull-painted bikers, Paradox's post-apocalyptic grand strategy game Afterworld continues to take shape in the course of developer blog posts. The latest Parablog digs into what I think is one of the game's most interesting aspects – you don't control one single unified civ. Instead, you amass a motley tribe by befriending, conquering, or otherwise assimilating a range of individual wasteland bands.
Each band has needs, satiation of which makes them feel more motivated and thus, more willing to follow your orders and work for the good of the tribe as a whole. Some of the needs are more generic – for example, shelter, nutrition, hydration, medicine, social standing, and security against threats. Others are bespoke, shaped by Custom - another in-game social metric - and by that band's origins.
It appears to make for some alarming diversity. For example, you could have a band that are full vegetarian, and excel at foraging - they won't even eat dried insects, the hippies! You could also have a band of cannibals who have a literal Human Flesh consumption gauge. I see nothing in the latest dev diary to forbid you from assimilating both the cannibals and the vegetarians. Let's, er, not seat them next to each other at the next council meeting, unless we're really running low on finger food.
"All needs can scale by band size, level or other game state elements that make sense," the developers write. "Another thing to keep in mind is that different bands will value different needs depending on who they are or recent events. For example a band that’s experienced extreme hunger will get more motivation from nutrition, while a band on the council will expect to get more standing because of where they are in society, not just because of who they are."When all of these things come together, you are invited to pick which bands are important for your tribe’s goals," the blog continues. "Those bands are the ones you will pay the most attention to motivate. When you look more closely at what those bands actually want you will find narratively and systemically immersive choices to make. At one point a band may care about food because you are facing a famine, but then rumors of some dustland horror beyond the tribe borders scares everyone into caring more about security and downplaying their previous preoccupation with food."
The most "work-in-progress" part of Afterworld's band motivation system is managing the potential gulf between an individual band's needs and overall tribe policy. You can, for example, put troops in settlements to make bands feel "dominated", which "increases their motivation, bypassing the needs, and allows you to run parts of your tribe with the stick, while others get the carrot."
The developers are "still iterating on this side of the system, but the intent is for such tactics to [offer] various degrees of sustainability for your tribe, depending on your set up and who your bands are". If you try to coerce a band, you run the risk of them blowing up in rebellion as and when the stick is removed. "This can result in cool moments like you taking down a bigger threatening tribe who’s keeping their lower classes under control through forced medical sedation, but it all comes apart when you find a way to sabotage or raid the source of the sedatives," the blog explains.

Seems very fiendish! There are many points of comparison here with other Paradox games, of course. Before writing this piece, I asked Mark for his take on Afterworld based on many hours desecrating the Catholic Church and/or wine trade in Crusader Kings 3. He observed that the game sounds a bit like playing the unlanded leader of some adventurers in CK3.Myself, I wish I could make some precise references to the Europa Universalis series, but our resident expert Brendy (RPS in peace) left many moons ago to found some appalling indepedendent website or other. So I'm going to swing for the fences and say this feels like a continent-scale game of The Sims, except with groups of irradiated and tattooed, neo-Bronze age pillagers instead of smooth-faced burbanites. For the most informed appraisal of all, here's Julian's chat with Paradox about the game's procedural history generation - it writes you a new apocalypse for every playthrough.

12klm1i.title: Оркестр The 8-Bit Big Band, который занимается джазовыми аранжировками музыки из игр, удалил со своего YouTube-канала десятки треков — по требованию Nintendo — Музыка на DTF
12klm1i.content: Под удар попали в том числе те композиции, за которые коллектив удостоился статуэток «Грэмми».О сложившейся ситуации сообщил Чарли Розен — глава оркестра The 8-Bit Big Band, специализирующегося на джазовых аранжировках видеоигровой музыки.По требованию Nintendo коллектив удалил со своего YouTube-канала несколько десятков треков, поскольку «на них не было нужных лицензий». Это были каверы на композиции из Mario, The Legend of Zelda, Animal Crossing и других тайтлов японской компании.Друзья, близкие, а также любимые слушатели и поклонники The 8-Bit Big Band! Возможно, вы заметили, что некоторые материалы исчезли с нашего сайта и наших площадок. Недавно выяснилось, что на этот контент не было получено нужных лицензий. Из уважения к Nintendo и её музыке мы удалили эти треки.Уважение к правам разработчиков — это то, что для нас очень важно, и этот случай стал важным напоминанием о том, почему лицензирование имеет значение. Спасибо Nintendo за сотрудничество и спасибо нашим фанатам за постоянную поддержку!Чарли Розен, глава The 8-Bit Big BandНекоторую музыку убрали и с других площадок The 8-Bit Big Band. Под удар также попали композиции «Meta Knight's Revenge» и «Super Mario Praise Break», за которые оркестр получил премии «Грэмми» в 2022 и 2026 году соответственно.В теме на Reddit можно узнать о том, какие треки удалил коллектив. Там же отметили, что вся музыка всё ещё доступна на Bandcamp.Nintendo добилась взыскания 4,5 миллиона долларов с модератора Reddit, распространявшего «пиратские» игры для Switch По утверждениям компании, нарушитель руководил целой сетью.

1x5ssuy.title: КНДР пока не спешит опять отправлять своих солдат в Россию, но военную помощь Москве оказывает
1x5ssuy.content:
Президент Украины Владимир Зеленский в августе 2026 года утверждал, что вскоре ожидается переброска в Россию 30-50 тыс. северокорейских солдат в рамках продолжающейся поддержки Пхеньяном Москвы. До сих пор ничего подобного не произошло. Для аналитиков остается неясным, будет ли КНДР вновь отправлять в Россию своих военных.

Андрей Коваленко, который в сентябре ушел с поста главы украинского Центра противодействия дезинформации (ЦПД) СНБО, написал 9 ноября в Telegram, что, согласно разведывательной оценке, подготовленной в августе, Кремль запросил у Пхеньяна более 30 тыс. северокорейских военнослужащих для осеннего наступления в Украине.

По его словам, саммит лидера КНДР Ким Чен Ына и президента России Владимира Путина ожидался в сентябре, но так и не состоялся. Власти в Киеве подчеркивают, что Северная Корея отправила тысячи своих военнослужащих в Россию в 2024 году, когда РФ вела боевые действия в Курской области, вытесняя оттуда ВСУ.

Лидер КНДР Ким Чен Ын и президент России Владимир Путин в Пхеньяне, июнь 2026 годаФото: Komsomolskaya Pravda/Picvario/picture allianceКоваленко считает, что Пхеньян отклонил новый запрос Москвы, поскольку участие в наступательных операциях на оккупированных Россией территориях Донецкой области Украины, возможно, по-прежнему остается для Северной Кореи красной линией. В то же время он добавил, что Россия по-прежнему зависит от материальной поддержки КНДР, прежде всего от поставок боеприпасов. Вероятность новой крупной переброски северокорейских боевых подразделений в РФ этой зимой Коваленко оценивает как низкую.

Есть ли у России необходимость в подкреплении от КНДР?

Хан Ги Бом, бывший замдиректора Национальной разведывательной службы Южной Кореи, пояснил DW, что снижение интенсивности боевых действий и наступление зимы дают Пхеньяну мало непосредственных оснований для новой отправки своих военных в Россию. Состоявшийся на прошлой неделе визит в Москву Чо Ён Вона, члена Президиума Политбюро ЦК Трудовой партии Кореи и близкого соратника Ким Чен Ына, может пролить свет на возможные дальнейшие планы, говорит Хан.По его словам, пока неясно, было ли целью этой поездки углубление политических связей между правящими партиями обеих стран в дополнение к уже существующему военному сотрудничеству или же непосредственная подготовка визита в Москву самого северокорейского лидера.

Ан Чхан Иль, бывший северокорейский солдат, перебежавший на Юг в 1979 году, ныне глава сеульского Всемирного института изучения Северной Кореи (WINKS), полагает, что у россиян также есть причины ограничивать развертывание северокорейских войск. Россия, указал Ан в интервью DW, будет сопоставлять свои потребности на поле боя с издержками от привлечения дополнительных военных из КНДР. По словам собеседника, Москва вряд ли станет запрашивать отправку нового контингента, если только конфликт не приобретет более широкий масштаб.

Поставки северокорейского вооружения России продолжаются

Экс-глава ЦПД Андрей Коваленко утверждает, что в Воронежской области России по-прежнему находится подразделение северокорейских ракетчиков, а также в тыловых районах около 8500 военнослужащих КНДР из вспомогательных частей, включая операторов беспилотников, инженеров и саперов. Пхеньян, добавил Коваленко, наращивает производство боеприпасов и демонстрирует новые дроны и ракетные системы.

Президент Украины Владимир ЗеленскийФото: Virginia Mayo/AP Photo/picture allianceМежду тем президент Украины Владимир Зеленский 17 ноября написал в Х, что Россия ежемесячно получает десятки баллистических ракет из Северной Кореи. Их применение в Украине, по выражению Зеленского, помогает Пхеньяну совершенствовать свое оружие и создает риски для безопасности стран, расположенных в районе Корейского полуострова. Испытание вооружений в реальных боевых условиях - одно из главных преимуществ, которые Пхеньян получает от военного сотрудничества с Россией, уверены наблюдатели.

Эксперт: КНДР балансирует между Россией и Китаем

Пхеньян, отмечает Андрей Коваленко, судя по всему, придерживается курса, который он назвал "стратегией сдерживания" - ограничивает свое участие в войне на стороне России и одновременно поддерживает отношения как с Москвой, так и с Пекином. По его оценке, такой подход позволяет Северной Корее сохранять преимущества союзнических отношений с Россией, одновременно снижая свою зависимость от исхода войны.

По мнению руководителя WINKS Ан Чхан Иля, военное сотрудничество Пхеньяна с Москвой продолжится, поскольку помощь со стороны России имеет решающее значение для усилий Северной Кореи по развитию технологий БПЛА и укреплению военно-морского флота. Тем не менее, прогнозирует Ан, масштабы этого сотрудничества в будущем могут быть более ограниченными, а Пхеньян также может рассчитывать на Китай как на дополнительную опору.

Если Россия ограничит использование северокорейских войск, то, продолжает глава WINKS, поступления иностранной валюты, которую КНДР получает благодаря этому, будут расти не столь быстро. И это еще один повод для Пхеньяна добиваться более значительной поддержки со стороны Пекина.

Чон Чжун Хи, бывший пресс-секретарь министерства по делам объединения Южной Кореи, предположил в беседе с DW, что недавние шаги по улучшению отношений с Пекином могут также отражать недовольство Пхеньяна тем, что Москва предложила в ответ на помощь, поступившую от Северной Кореи. По словам Чона, укрепляя отношения с Китаем и одновременно сохраняя стабильные связи с Россией, Ким Чен Ын может попытаться убедить Россию быть более щедрой.

Северной Корее, наряду с поддержкой, получаемой от России, необходимы экономическая, политическая и дипломатическая поддержка Китая, подчеркнул в интервью DW Ким Хён Сок, в прошлом замминистра по делам объединения Южной Кореи. По его мнению, Пхеньян будет и далее стремиться заручиться поддержкой Китая независимо от того, какую роль КНДР будет играть в войне.

PS4PS5

96dfz.title: В России запущен процесс сертификации двух добротных кроссоверов: подробности
96dfz.content:
На российский рынок возвращается марка Seres – правда, уже под крылом другого дистрибьютора. Сейчас идет сертификация двух кроссоверов бренда.Прежним дистрибьютором Seres в России была «МБ Рус». Официально о прекращении сотрудничества никто не объявлял. Зато еще в январе 2026 года сообщалось: у дилеров практически закончились машины, причем речь шла о выпущенных в 2023 и 2024 годах экземплярах. Сведений о новых поставках не появлялось, а раздел «Автомобили в наличии» с официального сайта марки к настоящему моменту пропал.Косвенное подтверждение смены дистрибьютора все же есть. Реализацией Seres в России, судя по документам, займется Sinomach – компания, которая ввозит в страну автомобили Li Auto.Сертификация Seres 7 и Seres 9 в РоссииПолучателем документов стала «ИАЭК Хуаюнь», связанная с Sinomach. Между прочим, раньше это юридическое лицо занималось сертификацией гибридных кроссоверов Li Auto для Евразийского экономического союза. В декларациях на Seres указано: автомобили китайского производства задекларированы в России для серийного выпуска, а действуют документы до 2030 года.В тексте бумаг фигурирует договор от 26 августа 2026 года. Его заключили Seres и «ИАЭК Хуаюнь» – о предоставлении полномочий на проведение оценки соответствия и ответственности за обеспечение безопасности продукции. Так что соглашения между компаниями действительно существуют.В Китае эти модели известны как Aito M7 и Aito M9. 1b0bu72.title: Симулятор жизни студента-чародея Witchbrook ушёл на золото
1b0bu72.content:
Больше никаких переносов — студия Chucklefish объявила, что симулятор жизни  Witchbrook отправился на золото. Игра стартует 28 января на ПК (Steam, Microsoft Store), PlayStation 5, Xbox One / Series X|S и Nintendo Switch 1|2, а также в подписке Game Pass.
We're delighted to announce that Witchbrook has GONE GOLD ALL PLATFORMS! 💛We're can't for you all to join us on the journey on Jan 28th! ✨ pic.twitter.com/zpGORuqEoW— ✨Witchbrook ✧ Wishlist now! (@Witchbrook) November 24, 2026

Антураж Witchbrook — приморский город Мохопорт, где расположен Чароводный колледж для одарённых волшебников. Вы — молодой колдун или ведьма. Студенту предстоит грызть гранит магической науки, осваивая алхимию, зельеварение, астрологию, ритуалы, охоту на демонов, таро и другие дисциплины. По ходу обучения вы будете сдавать экзамены и разблокировать новые заклинания.В свободное от учёбы время можно открыть своё дело — производить товары и развозить их на мопеде или метле. Чем лучше отношения с клиентами, тем больше бонусов и наград будете получать.На этом список занятий не заканчивается. В колледже вы найдёте друзей и, возможно, свою любовь — по словам разработчиков, каждый персонаж Witchbrook наделён уникальной историей. Кроме того, симулятор позволяет обустраивать своё жилище — разбить огород, привлечь волшебных зверушек и так далее. Наконец, можно гулять на природе, участвовать в конкурсах и наряжать своего героя.Помимо одиночного режима, творение Chucklefish поддерживает онлайн-кооп на четверых.Для Witchbrook подтверждён русский перевод.

lppi00.title: The Best Audible Books 2026: Famesick, The Deal and More
lppi00.content:
If you’re looking to get through a few more books before the end of the year, now is a particularly good time to sign up for Audible. As part of its Black Friday sale, the Amazon-owned audiobook platform is offering eligible subscribers three months of its Standard membership for just 99 cents a month, plus a $20 bonus to spend on audiobooks. The limited-time deal runs through Dec. 28.

Whether you’re looking for something to listen to on a long-haul flight home for the holidays or hoping to get a head start on your 2027 reading goals, Audible’s sprawling library runs the gamut from buzzy celebrity memoirs and bestselling romantasy novels to immersive, full-cast productions of literary classics. In recent years, the audiobook format has become an entertainment medium in its own right, with ambitious original productions featuring A-list voice casts, cinematic sound design and original music.

From the latest installments in some of BookTok’s most beloved fantasy franchises to a reimagining of Jane Austen’s “Pride and Prejudice,” we’ve rounded up the best audiobooks to listen to on Audible right now.

Below, we rounded up the best audiobooks you should listen to this month. But if you prefer your books with a spine, worry not: check out these best-selling celebrity memoirs and celebrity-written graphic novels instead.

BESTSELLER

A Court of Splintered Harmony

BookTok’s favorite romantasy author returns with the sixth installment in her bestselling “A Court of Thorns and Roses” series. Narrated by Elizabeth Evans, the long-awaited release kicks off a new story arc dubbed “The Valkyrie Cycle,” with the next installment slated to arrive in January 2027.

BESTSELLER

Exoplanet by Andy Weir

From the author of “Project Hail Mary” and “The Martian” comes a cinematic Audible Original, co-written with Benjamin Percy and featuring a starry voice cast led by Anthony Mackie, Ariana DeBose and John Leguizamo. The sci-fi thriller follows the survivors of a spacecraft disaster who find themselves stranded on the same hostile planet across different points in time.

BESTSELLER

Sunrise on the Reaping (The Hunger Games): A Hunger Games Novel

Fresh off its big-screen adaptation, the fifth novel in Collins’ “Hunger Games” franchise transports readers back to Panem 24 years before Katniss Everdeen enters the arena, chronicling a teenage Haymitch Abernathy’s fight for survival in the Second Quarter Quell. “Yellowstone” star Jefferson White narrates the audiobook.

READ BY ROSAMUND PINKE

Sense and Sensibility

Famesick by Lena Dunham

The “Girls” creator didn’t hold back in her long-awaited second memoir. In “Famesick,” Dunham recounts her tumultuous relationships with Adam Driver and her former best friend Jenni Konner, her fallout between her and Jack Antonoff and her struggles with addiction following her hysterectomy. Check out the biggest revelations from the book here.

Roll the Calls by Ari Emanuel

Hollywood superagent Ari Emanuel opens up about his rise through the entertainment business in “Roll the Calls,” a candid account of building Endeavor and navigating decades of high-stakes deals, rivalries and relationships. The memoir also gets personal, covering Emanuel’s childhood struggles with ADHD and dyslexia, his marriage and family life and plenty of behind-the-scenes encounters with some of Hollywood’s biggest names.

BESTSELLER

Daddy Issues by Sofia Franklyn

The former “Call Her Daddy” co-host tells her side of the story in a candid memoir that goes well beyond her highly publicized split from the podcast. Narrated by Franklyn herself, the book delves into the complicated intersections of fame, friendship, ambition and self-worth.

Klara and the Sun: A Novel

Few novels feel more timely than Nobel Prize-winning author Kazuo Ishiguro’s 2021 bestseller, which explores the nature of human connection through the eyes of an AI companion purchased to care for an ailing teenage girl, played by Jenna Ortega in Taika Waikiki’s new adaptation. The audiobook is narrated by Sura Siu.

Pride & Prejudice

Harris Dickinson as Mr. Darcy? Say no more. Audible’s full-cast adaptation of Austen’s literary classic stars the “Babygirl” actor opposite “Industry” breakout Marisa Abela as Elizabeth Bennet, with supporting performances from Glenn Close, Jessie Buckley, Bill Nighy and Will Poulter, alongside an original score by Morgan Kibby.

This Is Me: A Reckoning by Hayden Panettiere

In “This Is Me: A Reckoning,” the now 36 year-old actor recounts the traumatizing Hollywood experiences and tabloid scrutiny she experienced through the early-aughts, in addition to candid stories about postpartum depression, addiction and domestic abuse.

The Deal by Elle Kennedy

Elle Kennedy’s “The Deal” is the first book in the Off-Campus series, adapted into Prime Videos’ breakout new show about a hockey college romance.

Never Say Die by Ke Huy Quan

Quan tells the unlikely story of his Hollywood comeback in “Never Say Die,” beginning with his childhood as a Vietnamese refugee and early success in “Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom” and “The Goonies.” Quan also writes about the decades of rejection that led him to step away from acting, his work behind the camera and the eventual return that culminated in his Oscar-winning performance in “Everything Everywhere All at Once.”

View from the East Wing: A Memoir

Jill Biden shares her account as First Lady of the United States for the first time in a new memoir — from her journey as a teacher to Air Force One, to a behind-the-scenes look at her husband’s bid for reelection.

Kids Make Me Angry by Kevin Hart

Kevin Hart opens up about his experience as a dad of four in a new memoir.

Transcendent: A Memoir by Laverne Cox

In “Transcendent,” Laverne Cox shares her journey as a transgender woman in Hollywood, delving into an abusive childhood and her breakout role in “Orange Is the New Black.”

The Uncool: A Memoir by Cameron Crowe

Cameron Crowe wrote and directed the film “Almost Famous,” based on his experiences as a 15-year-old music journalist who embedded with rock legends like Led Zeppelin and David Bowie. With “The Memoir,” Crowe strips down the Hollywood version and tells the true stories of his youth that led him to become Rolling Stone’s youngest-ever contributor, a movie director and an Oscar-winning screenwriter. Fans of classic rock will marvel at Crowe’s access and descriptions of a bygone era in music. Check out more celebrity memoirs here.

Cher: The Memoir

Cher’s gargantuan two-part memoir includes dozens of headline-worthy moments, including the time she considered jumping off a balcony while married to Bono. If you don’t have the energy to read through 432 pages (only the first installment), an audiobook is the way to go.

I’m Glad My Mom Died by Jennette McCurdy

In her first book, Jennette McCurdy best known for her starring role in the show “ICarly,” the 30 year-old actor gets candid about the struggles she faced as a child actor on the Nickelodeon show, such as eating disorders, OCD and her infamously strained relationship with her mother Debra McCurdy who died in 2013. Jennifer Aniston is now set to star as McCurdy in a new Apple TV series based on the book.

Peculiar Stars by Rebecca Yarros

Described as a “slow-burn romance novel about love, family, and what it means to become the truest version of yourself,” bestselling author Rebecca Yarros’s newest book follows the main character Callista as she develops a relationship with her fiancé’s cousin in the aftermath of a tragedy.

Remarkably Bright Creatures by Shelby Van Pelt

Now a Netflix film, “Remarkably Bright Creatures” follows grieving widow named Tova who forms an unlikely friendship with a remarkably intelligent giant Pacific octopus named Marcellus. The audio version is narrated by  Marin Ireland with Michael Urie as the voice of Marcellus.

Project Hail Mary

Stranded aboard a spaceship with no memory, Ryland Grace, who Ryan Gosling portrayed in the blockbuster adaptation earlier this year, must piece together who he is, why he’s there, and how to save Earth from an extinction-level threat. Andy Weir’s signature mix of suspense, science, humor, and high stakes shines through in this interstellar odyssey. Narrated by Ray Porter, a standout voice in speculative fiction audiobooks.

Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone, Book 1

A chorus of more than 200 voices, ranging from young newcomers to Hollywood stars, bring new life to all seven of J.K. Rowling’s “Harry Potter” book series in a new production for Audible. The first audiobook in the bunch, “Harry Potter and the Sorcerer’s Stone,” dropped in November.

Lorne: The Man Who Invented Saturday Night Live

Susan Morrison’s biography on Lorne Michaels offers a definitive look at the elusive producer who transformed late-night TV, tracing his journey from his Canadian roots to building and sustaining one of the most enduring comedy institutions on television. Featuring insights from cast and collaborators including Tina Fey, Will Ferrell, Chris Rock and John Mulaney, the nearly 23-hour audiobook is narrated by Kristen DiMercurio with contributions from Morrison himself.

READ BY SHAILENE WOODLEY

Game of Nines by James Patterson

This high-stakes crime thriller drops FBI agent Sarah Cole into a chilling game: somebody has issued her an invitation to the “Game of Nines,” a secret murder puzzle that’s been baffling law enforcement for decades. Given one week to catch the killer — who promises to vanish and strike again in nine years if not caught — Cole must outthink a cat-and-mouse built for the most twisted of minds. Narrated in full audio-drama style by Shailene Woodley, Morena Baccarin, Sasha Roiz, and Ben Shenkman.

Poems & Prayers

In this intimate, lyrical audiobook, Matthew McConaughey trades in his on-screen swagger for a quieter, contemplative voice as he delivers a personal collection of poems and prayers that explore faith, love, loss, and the surprising grace found in everyday moments. At just over two hours, “Poems & Prayers” is narrated by McConaughey himself, giving a raw, confessional energy.

The Book of Sheen: A Memoir

In this nearly nine-hour audiobook, actor Charlie Sheen delivers a raw, unvarnished account of his life — from early success in “Two and a Half Men,” “Wall Street,” and “Major League,” through personal turmoil, public controversy, and the highs-and-lows of fame. Narrated by Sheen himself, “The Book of Sheen” offers a firsthand look at both the man behind the headlines and the forces — ambition, addiction, redemption, love — that have shaped his journey.

Dancing with Myself

In “Dancing with Myself,” punk-rock icon Billy Idol delivers an electrifying and painfully honest memoir tracing his journey from the brash energy of the London punk scene to international superstardom. It’s with behind-the-scenes anecdotes of Sex Pistols’ relations, his move to America, brushes with danger, and encounters with fame’s darker edges. Narrated by Idol himself, this Audible edition rings with the same snarling attitude and raw charisma that defined his music

Truly

Narrated by the music legend himself, Lionel Richie’s memoir-in-audio revisits the highs and lows of his career — from humble beginnings to global superstardom — alongside personal stories of heartbreak, triumph, and reinvention.

Semi-Well-Adjusted Despite Literally Everything: A Memoir

In this 11-hour self-narrated memoir, actress, dancer, and YouTube personality Alyson Stoner takes listeners through the twists and turns of growing up in the spotlight — the expectations, the struggles with identity and mental health, the pressure to perform, and the moments of self-discovery.

Robert Redford: The Biography

For those looking to revisit Robert Redford following the iconic filmmaker’s death this week, this biography traces his rise from youthful ambition to iconic Hollywood status while also unfolding his off-screen passions — from preserving the wild to championing new voices in film. Long before Sundance and screen legends, Redford’s story starts in small-town Colorado and arcs through acting breakthroughs, directorial risks and environmental activism.

The Ride of a Lifetime: Lessons Learned from 15 Years as CEO of the Walt Disney Company

Robert Iger reflects on his 15 years at the helm of Disney, steering the company through acquisitions (Pixar, Marvel, Lucasfilm), digital transformation, crises, and ever-shifting entertainment landscapes — all while preserving the magic Disney is known for. Narrated by Iger himself (with Jim Frangione credited), this audiobook offers a rare insider’s look at leadership at scale.

Tonight in Jungleland: The Making of Born to Run

Dive deep into the soul of rock as biographer Peter Ames Carlin pulls back the curtain on Bruce Springsteen’s iconic “Born to Run,” tracing the album from its fraught creation through its thunderous legacy. Released for its 50th anniversary, this audiobook unfolds with vivid inside access to Springsteen, his bandmates, and the recording sessions themselves.

Eternally Electric: The Message in My Music

Narrated by Debbie Gibson herself, this autobiographical audio memoir lays bare the creative journey and personal evolution of the pop icon best known for hits like “Only in My Dreams” and “Electric Youth.”

Heart Life Music

Country star Kenny Chesney opens up in this 8-hour memoir filled with songs, stories, and the soul behind the stage lights. He reflects on his upbringing, the draw of the road, and the moments that shaped both his music and his life.

For Your Eyes Only: Ian Fleming and James Bond

Ben Macintyre dives into the life of Ian Fleming and the origins of the world-famous spy in “For Your Eyes Only,” tracing how Fleming’s experiences, obsessions, and wartime intelligence work shaped the creation of James Bond.

Greenlights by Matthew McConaughey

At 50 years old, the Academy Award-winning actor took to the desert to write this memoir based on the lessons, advice and wisdom he’s recounted through years of journaling. The main thesis of the unconventional book (and his general approach to living) is something he calls “catching greenlights”: enjoying life’s successes while having the faith that the yellows and reds will turn green at some point, too. McConaughey narrates the intimate audiobook, leading listeners through his own successes, failures, realizations, lessons and vivid memories from his life.

Daisy Jones & The Six: A Novel

Prime Video’s rollicking, drama-filled show about the epic rise and fall of an iconic 1970s rock band, loosely based on Fleetwood Mac, is based on Taylor Jenkins Reid’s bestselling “Daisy Jones & The Six.”

Heartburn by Nora Ephron

Meryl Streep narrates the audiobook version of Nora Ephron’s beloved novel “Heartburn,” which tells the story of Rachel Samstat who, seven months into her pregnancy, discovers that her husband Mark is in love with another woman. The “Sleepless in Seattle” and “Harry Met Sally” creator reminds us all why she’s the queen of romance (and anguish) with this sidesplitting novel.

READ BY TARON EGERTON

Me: Elton John Official Autobiography

If you find yourself fascinated by Elton John after watching his upcoming documentary, you’ll want to read his debut autobiography in which the music icon himself narrates his remarkable life — from a young shy boy (born Reginald Kenneth Dwight) in a small London suburb, to the legendary artist who ended up changing the music world forever with his songs. Aside from his rise to success and extravagant lifestyle, all things shown in the bio-pic “Rocketman,” John also recounts his experience with the AIDs crisis and writes candidly about getting clean from addiction.

Yearbook by Seth Rogen

Everyone’s favorite comedian and producer puts together a hilarious collection of personal essays in his first book, in which he writes about his foray into comedy as a teenager, his Jewish upbringing and some wild Hollywood stories through the lens of a far-from-typical A-lister.  You won’t want to miss the audiobook version, which features a star-studded cast with cameos by Rogen’s mom and dad, Nick Kroll, Jay Pharoah, Jason Segel, Dan Aykroyd, Ike Barinholtz, Simon Helberg, Tommy Chong, Billy Idol and many more.

kate mckinnon and emily lynne

Heads Will Roll

Less of a book and more of an audio comedy, Audible Original’s “Heads Will Roll” is a 10-episode series created by “Saturday Night Live” star Kate McKinnon and co-creator/star (and sister!) Emily Lynne. The story follows Queen Mortuana of the Night Realm (McKinnon) and her ditsy sister JoJo (Lynne) who work together to hilariously put down an impending peasant rebellion that threatens their throne. The star-studded satire features performances by Meryl Streep, Tim Gunn, Peter Dinklage and “Queer Eye”‘s Fab Five.

Catch and Kill: Lies, Spies, and a Conspiracy to Protect Predators

Pulitzer Prize winner Ronan Farrow exposes a Russian doll of explosive stories in this real-life account of how he broke the Harvey Weinstein story for “The New Yorker” in 2017. In this tell-all book, which he narrates himself for the audio version, he recounts the shadowy operatives and war-hardened spies that surveilled him for months as he bravely uncovered the truth about one of Hollywood’s most powerful producers. He also writes about the process of getting Weinstein’s victims to tell their stories, which ended up sparking an explosive reckoning within Hollywood, and an entire movement around the world. If you’re really interested in the subject, you can couple it with Jodi Kantor and Megan Twohey’s audiobook “She Said,” in which they explain how they investigated the same story for “The New York Times.” 

Angels in America: A Gay Fantasia on National Themes

The audio version of the Pulitzer Prize-winning play, which stars the cast of the 2018 Broadway revival, explores the themes of identity, justice, community and redemption as New Yorkers grapple with the devastating AIDS crisis throughout the 1980s. Andrew Garfield and Nathan Lane, in addition to the rest of cast, recreate their acclaimed performances for the immersive theatrical experience.

Is This Anything?

In his first book in 25 years, the legendary comedian tracks his success from his performances as a shy 21 year-old college student to selling out the Madison Square Garden today — all through the best bits he’s saved over his iconic career. Half stand-up comedy, half memoir, “Is This Anything” gives valuable insight into one of the best comedians of our generation, narrated with Seinfeld’s distinct, shrill (and hilarious) intonation. If you’re a comedy lover, you can also check out Tina Fey’s “Bossy Pants” and Amy Poehler’s “Yes Please.”

Me Talk Pretty One Day

Sedaris’s distinct and lovable high-pitched voice carries readers through hilarious and whacky stories from his eccentric upbringing. From course-correcting his lisp through speech therapy lessons in elementary school, to moving to Paris with no grasp on the French language, to a short-lived stint as a writing teacher that he was woefully under qualified for, Sedaris has no shortage of real-life stories that double as comedy bits. In fact, more of his entertaining short essays can be found in his other popular books “Calypso,” “Naked” and “Dress Your Family in Corduroy and Denim.”

The Things They Carried

“The Things They Carried,”  a finalist for both the 1990 Pulitzer Prize and National Book Critics Circle Award, is still a No. 1 bestseller on Amazon 24 years since its original release. The Audible exclusive is narrated by award-winning actor Bryan Cranston, who tells the story of a group of soldiers in the Vietnam War through the weaponry (and other miscellaneous items) they brought with them on their journey. This audiobook also includes an exclusive recording “The Vietnam in Me,” a recount of the author’s trip back to Vietnam in 1994, revisiting his experience there as a soldier

1i8igwf.title: BBC Under Investigation for Antisemitism Amid “Growing Feeling of Discomfort Among Jewish Staff”
1i8igwf.content:
The BBC is under investigation over allegations of “a hostile work environment” for Jewish employees.

Lord John Mann, the government’s antisemitism adviser, told the broadcaster’s Today program on Thursday that he’s opening an investigation “because there seems to be a growing feeling of discomfort among Jewish staff,” adding: “Some of the things that I’m being told have been quite disturbing sometimes, how little the senior managers of the BBC seem to get it, and so I’m opening this up.”

Mann encouraged any Jewish people currently working or who used to work for the corporation to come forward and talk to him. He expects to wrap up by Easter, at which point he’ll report back to the BBC.

In a statement, a BBC representative said the public broadcaster takes “any and all allegations of discrimination extremely seriously — there is no place for it at the BBC. We have introduced compulsory training on antisemitism for all our staff, and we actively encourage colleagues to report any incidences or concerns they have.”

Concluded the statement: “We are determined to ensure the BBC is a place where everyone can be themselves and feel accepted.”

Mann won’t be probing any department or program in particular, but said an “underlying atmosphere” hostile to Jewish members of staff. “The personal validations that I hear from former and current BBC Jewish employees and contractors is that, fundamentally, there is an institutional culture that demands that Jewish people must be expected to justify their existence, their identity, how they define their Jewishness,” he said.

The adviser maintained he has “no agenda against the BBC” and said to Today: “Look, there is a problem. The question is — is the problem just a few people? Is it a problem that’s easily solved? But if it’s an institutional problem, that’s much deeper and more difficult to solve. It may be. I’ll report the facts.”

The news of the investigation comes just a few weeks after an Oscar-winning producer, Lucie Kon, said she received a £400,000 ($525,000) payout from the BBC after alleging antisemitic remarks from her colleagues while she worked there.

Kon, a commissioning editor on several documentaries at the broadcaster, including the Academy Award-winning Mr Nobody Against Putin, said at the time: “I really did feel like I had Jew stamped on my forehead. I became a problem.” The BBC did not uphold the claims of antisemitism, but accepted there were “shortcomings” in how Kon was treated, and didn’t go into further detail.

Deputy director general Rhodri Talfan Davies said there are “very, very robust processes” that are reviewed regularly at a Broadcasting Press Guild lunch earlier this month. “Of course, in any large organisation there can be instances of discrimination, which you deal with when they arise, but there is no evidence of any systemic issue within the BBC that would merit anything like that,” said Davies. “I don’t believe there is institutional discrimination of any sort in the BBC, but I think as an organisation you always have to look harder and review how you go about identifying issues, and that work is never done.”

gh-1473364134.title: GitHub - onederson/the-3rd-birthday-recomp-android: Android port of The 3rd Birthday static recompilation (based on BasedYuki/the-3rd-birthday-recomp). No game data included.
gh-1473364134.content:
A native Windows build of The 3rd Birthday (PSP, US release ULUS10567), made by
statically recompiling the game's MIPS code to C and running it on a native runtime
with a Vulkan renderer. It is not an emulator: the game logic runs as compiled PC code.

Work in progress. All 111 scenes of the game load and run at full speed, with movies,
voice, music and saving, but few people have played it through yet. Expect bugs, and please
report them.
On top of the original it adds things the PSP version never had, like free aim (aim with
the mouse or the right stick, up and down too, with the crosshair in the middle of the screen),
a modern over-the-shoulder camera, 60 fps, widescreen, higher resolution, remappable controls
and a cheats menu. See What works.
You need your own copy of the game (a PSP disc image you dumped yourself). No game data
is included in this repository or in the releases.
Playing it

Download The3rdBirthday-<version>.zip from the
Releases page and extract it.
Start The 3rd Birthday.exe (the launcher) and choose your own disc image of the game
(USA, ULUS10567, .iso).
Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" the first time, because the program isn't
signed: click More info, then Run anyway.
Press Prepare game. The game is built once, on your PC, from your disc (3-10 minutes;
nothing is downloaded). Then press Play.

The download contains no game code or data: only the PC runtime, the launcher and a kit
(compiler, Python, translation tools) with which your PC turns your disc into the game.
Before you start: what is and isn't tested yet
Tested: on a clean copy of the download, with nothing else installed, Prepare game
finishes in about 3 minutes and Play starts the game. All 111 scenes of the game load and
run at full speed. Not tested yet, so these may give you trouble:

Other PCs. So far it has only run on one PC: Windows 11 with an NVIDIA RTX 3050 laptop
GPU. Other graphics cards (AMD, Intel), Windows 10 and older drivers haven't been tried. You
need a graphics card with Vulkan support and up-to-date drivers.
Overlays (RivaTuner / MSI Afterburner). RivaTuner's on-screen display makes the game close
a second after it starts. Turn RivaTuner's overlay off for ULUS10567.exe (in RivaTuner, add
the exe with the + button and set "Show On-Screen Display" to Off). The game's own FPS counter
is in the Esc menu.
Antivirus. Prepare game runs a compiler and creates a new game.dll, which some
antivirus programs block, quarantine or slow down a lot. If preparing fails or game.dll
disappears, allow the game's folder in your antivirus.
Where you extract it. Use a folder you can write to, such as C:\Games\The3rdBirthday
or your Documents. Not Program Files: the launcher writes settings, saves and the
prepared game next to itself.
Only the US disc image (ULUS10567) as a plain .iso works. The European and Japanese
versions and compressed images (.cso, .chd) aren't supported. Convert a .cso back to
.iso first.
Full playthroughs. Every scene was checked by jumping to it, but the whole game hasn't
been played from start to finish yet. Missions may still have bugs.

If something goes wrong, please open an
issue with your PC (Windows
version, graphics card), what happened, and the run.err file from the game's folder.
The launcher
The 3rd Birthday.exe is where you start the game and change its settings without opening
any files:

Disc image: finds your .iso next to it or lets you choose one, and checks it is the
right game
Prepare game / Play: builds the game from your disc the first time (with a progress
bar), then starts it. After an update it tells you when the game needs preparing again.
Graphics: internal resolution, 60 fps, widescreen, glow, FPS counter, skip the intro,
check for updates at start
Controls: mouse camera, mouse sensitivity and invert, smooth WASD turning, mouse buttons
on/off, and Change buttons...: every action with two keys (keyboard keys or mouse buttons)
and a controller button, chosen by pressing them or from a list
Saves: your saves with their episode and play time; open the folder, back up all,
restore a backup. Unlock all extras unlocks every costume, the extra DNA boards and
the Cheat Codes; your progress is kept.
Mods: texture packs on/off, texture dump, memory patches on/off
Updates: says whether you have the newest version, with a link to the Releases page

The background is the game's own PSP cover art (Aya on red, as on the PSP's home screen),
read from your disc image when the launcher starts; it is not included in the download.
The blood drips and splatters are drawn by the launcher, and the window icon is the disc's
icon. Until a disc image is chosen, the background is dark red with the blood only.
Screenshots

What works

Boot, menus, movies (H.264 via Windows Media Foundation) with their audio
Gameplay with ATRAC3/ATRAC3+ music and voices and the PSP sound chip (SAS)
Optional: skip the boot logos and the opening movie (setting "Skip intro at start", off by default)
Saving and loading (a virtual memory stick; a "Game saved" notice after each save)
Vulkan renderer at higher internal resolution (4x the PSP's on a 1080p screen)
60 fps: the game runs at 30 fps; an in-between frame is generated on the GPU for every
game frame (camera, objects and limb animation are blended). It can be switched back to 30
in the settings menu.
Widescreen / ultrawide (settings menu, "Aspect ratio"): the game renders a wider view to
fill the window; the HUD keeps its shape in the middle
Remappable controls, in the game (Esc > Controls) or in the launcher (Change buttons...):
every action gets two keys, which can also be mouse buttons (left, right, middle, side buttons
4 and 5), and a controller button. Only the two sticks are fixed (left = move, right = camera).
Three camera styles (Esc menu > Camera style; the launcher has Modern): Classic orbits
around Aya and returns behind her like the original; Modern is an over-the-shoulder camera
that stays where you point it, and Aya walks where you look; Centred is the same with Aya in
the middle of the screen
Free aim (Esc menu > Free aim, on by default): hold L / right mouse and the aim starts
where the camera looks; the mouse or the right stick then moves it left, right, up and down,
with the crosshair staying in the middle and the shots going where it points. If the game
locked onto an enemy, the lock stays until you move the aim. The sniper scope and the
launchers keep the game's own stick aiming (the mouse moves it)
Full analog left stick (Esc menu > Left stick, on by default): Aya runs exactly where the
stick points; the original keeps her straight within about 35 degrees of her heading
Mouse camera: click the game window and the mouse turns the camera (left button fires, right
aims; Esc releases the mouse); smooth WASD turning
Launcher (The 3rd Birthday.exe): disc image, settings, save list with backup / restore,
unlock all extras, mods, update status, Play (see The launcher)
Update notice: the game and the launcher tell you when a newer release is out
Safe saves: every save is written safely and the previous one is kept in memstick/BACKUP/
FPS counter, a glow (bloom) on/off switch, texture filtering (sharp or smooth, separately
for the 3D and the HUD) and texture upscaling (2x-4x xBRZ, like PPSSPP) in the settings menu
Xbox button prompts (Esc menu > Button prompts): the PSP buttons in the game's menus and
text become A / B / X / Y, LT / RT, VIEW and MENU
Mods: HD texture packs (PPSSPP packs work too), memory patches and compiled code mods, see mods/README.md
Cheats (Esc menu > Cheats): no damage, infinite ammo, infinite grenades, infinite
Liberation, max BP (999,999). Each can be switched on and off and stays as you leave it
(cheats.cfg). From the community CWCheat database
Data Install (Extra menu) works, and Use Install Data reads from it like on a PSP
Saves from a real PSP or PPSSPP can be imported (tools/save_import.py); the port's saves load in PPSSPP
Xbox, PlayStation and other controllers through SDL3, plus keyboard
Twin-stick camera: the right stick orbits the camera around Aya. Aiming starts where
the camera looks, and the game's own cameras take over for aiming, Overdive and Liberation.

—
click the window, then mouse / left button / right button

Cross / Circle / Square / Triangle
A / B / X / Y
X or Space / Z / C / V

L / R
LB or LT / RB or RT

D-pad (the game's own camera turn)

Every action in this table can be changed: in the game (Esc > Controls) or in the launcher
(Change buttons...). Keys can be keyboard keys or mouse buttons; mouse buttons work once you
have clicked into the game window.
Settings
Most options are in the launcher and in the in-game settings menu (Esc). They are stored in
plain text files next to the executable (created on first run):

graphics.cfg — render_scale (0 = match the display, or 1 to 8), frame_interpolation (1 = 60 fps), skip_intro (1 = skip logos and opening movie; default 0), widescreen (1 = fill the window), texture_dump (1 = write the game's textures to textures/dump/ for texture packs)
controls.cfg — key, mouse and controller bindings (edited by the Controls page and the
launcher), e.g. r = E, Mouse Left | righttrigger
twinstick.cfg — sensitivity, invert_x, invert_y, recenter,
recenter_delay, recenter_delay_still

Building
The toolchain is MSYS2 UCRT64 (GCC, SDL3, Vulkan headers, glslc). See
runtime/README.md for the recompiler and runtime, and
PLAN.md for the design decisions and a dated log of the work.
scripts/setup.ps1 sets up a fresh clone (MSYS2 packages, the program decrypted from your
disc image) and builds; scripts/build.ps1 rebuilds. The build makes ULUS10567.exe (the
runtime, no game code) and game.dll (the game's code, recompiled). scripts/package.ps1
makes the release package (runtime, launcher, kit; checked to hold no game code) and
scripts/release.ps1 publishes it.
Versions
VERSION holds the current version; docs/CHANGELOG.md lists what
changed. A release carries the notes and the package; the game code is always built from your
own disc on your PC, so a release never contains it.
Support
This port is made in my free time. If you enjoy it and want to support the work, you can on
Ko-fi. It's completely optional: the port is and stays
free.
Credits and license
GPL-2.0-or-later. This project builds on other people's work — see
runtime/CREDITS.md:

PPSSPP — the reference for PSP behaviour; several
HLE modules (sceMpeg, SAS, ATRAC) are ported from it
AljandrOrtega's PSP recompilation toolkit — the recompiler and runtime this port started from
FFmpeg's ATRAC decoder (via PPSSPP's at3_standalone), SDL3

Much of the code was written with the help of an AI model (Anthropic's Claude); the
details are in runtime/CREDITS.md.
The 3rd Birthday is a trademark of Square Enix. This project is not affiliated with or
endorsed by Square Enix.

bb35ro.title: Finland Extends Russian Border Closure for Another 2 Years
bb35ro.content: A closed gate of the newly erected fence at the border with Russia at the Vartius border crossing in Kuhmo, Finland.Alessandro Rampazzo / AFPFinland announced Thursday that it will keep its border with Russia closed for another two years, with Finnish President Alexander Stubb expected to formally approve the extension later this week.The Nordic country shut its 1,340-kilometer (830-mile) eastern border in December 2023 amid an uptick in asylum seekers from the Middle East and Africa. Finnish authorities accuse the Kremlin of encouraging the asylum seekers to cross their shared frontier in a destabilization ploy — a “hybrid attack” Helsinki sees as Moscow’s retribution for having joined NATO.The Finnish interior ministry said the widely anticipated extension, which takes effect Dec. 1 and runs through Dec. 31, 2028, was necessary to “combat attempts to put pressure on Finland, strengthen border security and help Finland prepare for the most serious incidents of instrumentalized migration.”The measure extends the existing Border Security Act without altering its provisions, the ministry said, adding that the risk of renewed migrant surges “remains high.”Read moreTension and Unease for Russians in Finland Amid Border ShutdownIn 2024, Finland adopted a controversial “deportation law” that allows border guards to refuse entry to asylum seekers crossing from Russia. The law, to be enforced at the government’s discretion, has drawn criticism from human rights advocates who say it may violate Finland’s international legal obligations.Finland became a NATO member in April 2023, abandoning decades of military non-alignment and drawing condemnation from Moscow, which warned of “countermeasures.”In July, Russia closed its railway border checkpoints with Finland. Russian officials at the time did not disclose the reasons for the closures or when the checkpoints might reopen.Our weekly newsletter contains a hand-picked selection of news, features, analysis and more from The Moscow Times. hzouz0.title: GTA 6 reportedly sets massive livestreaming record, watched more in its first week than Elden Ring, Diablo 4, Valorant, and Lost Ark combined
hzouz0.content:
Belville of the ball.

Grand Theft Auto 6 has broken another livestreaming record. After attracting more viewers across livestreaming platforms than any game ever on its launch day, Rockstar's open-world crime sim has reportedly continued to dominate on platforms like Twitch, YouTube, and Kick.
Over its first seven days on sale, GTA 6 has amassed over 420m hours watched, according to Streams Charts. That's nearly three times more than the previous record, held by Valorant's closed beta in April 2020. In fact, that 420m hours tally is more than the first-week watch time achieved by Valorant, Elden Ring, Diablo 4, and Lost Ark combined.
As for the livestreaming platforms that saw the largest audiences for GTA 6, YouTube reportedly had the lead in average audience numbers during the first six hours of launch, but Twitch took over in content volume in the days that followed. In fact, Twitch's GTA 6 watch time was higher at launch than any other game in its history.
Streams Charts also noted 1,056 channels reached new all-time peak viewership numbers while streaming GTA 6, in some cases multiplying their previous record tenfold. Major content creators like IShowSpeed, IlloJuan, and TheBurntPeanut stole the spotlight, but GTA 6 also helped many other channels set new viewership records.Livestreaming, of course, isn't the only area where GTA 6 has set new records. Publisher Take-Two called it the biggest entertainment launch in history, generating $3.79bn (£2.89bn) in revenue from 32.5m copies sold on day one. Other parts of the industry have benefited, too. Anticipation for GTA 6 boosted US hardware sales for both PlayStation and Xbox, just as GTA 6 became each console brand's most pre-ordered title ever. At launch, more than 39 million people played GTA 6 on PS5, according to Sony. The game also had the highest number of concurrent players ever on any PlayStation console, beating even the most popular free-to-play titles.
You can check out Eurogamer's GTA 6 walkthrough if you're in need of assistance, which we just updated today with a guide on how to whistle in GTA 6 - something I didn't know you could do. The walkthrough also covers other lesser-known mechanics such as how to steal ATMs in GTA 6, and much more besides.
